grammarPages.explanationEnglish: After the motion verb and direction, add the destination before 來 or 去: Motion verb + Direction + Place + 來/去. This tells both the path and where the movement ends.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: A directional compound describes the direction of the action. The structures include: (1) directional verb + 來/去, (2) motion verb + directional verb + 來/去, (3) motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去, (4) combined with 把 construction to indicate the Subject moves the Object to another location: S + 把 + O + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來/去.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with directional verbs
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 把 to move something to a place: bring the desk over, take the clothes upstairs.
grammarPages.explanation: 用「把」把要移動的東西放在前面，後面接動作動詞、方向動詞和「來／去」，也可以加上地方：把書桌搬過來、把衣服拿上樓去。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來 / 去

columns.meaning: take out of the washing machine

text.traditional: 請你把那張書桌搬過來。
text.simplified: 请你把那张书桌搬过来。
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ nà zhāng shūzhuō bān guòlái.
text.english: Please move that desk over here.

text.traditional: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上樓去了。
text.simplified: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上楼去了。
text.pinyin: Jiějie bǎ tā de yīfu ná shànglóu qù le.
text.english: My older sister took her clothes upstairs.

text.traditional: 我還沒把褲子從洗衣機裡拿出來。
text.simplified: 我还没把裤子从洗衣机里拿出来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi bǎ kùzi cóng xǐyījī lǐ ná chūlái.
text.english: I haven't taken the pants out of the washing machine yet.

items.question: What happens if you leave out the directional ending after 搬?
items.answer: 「把」字句的動詞後面要有結果或方向：搬過來。
items.wrongTraditional: 請你把那張書桌搬。
items.wrongSimplified: 请你把那张书桌搬。

right.traditional: 請你把那張書桌搬過來。
right.simplified: 请你把那张书桌搬过来。
right.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ nà zhāng shūzhuō bān guòlái.
right.english: Please move that desk over here.

items.question: Where does 了 go in 拿上樓去?
items.answer: 「了」放在最後，表示動作完成：拿上樓去了。
items.wrongTraditional: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上樓了去。
items.wrongSimplified: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上楼了去。

right.traditional: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上樓去了。
right.simplified: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上楼去了。
right.pinyin: Jiějie bǎ tā de yīfu ná shànglóu qù le.
right.english: My older sister took her clothes upstairs.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 把 before the object when a subject moves it along a direction and to a place: Subject + 把 + Object + Motion verb + Direction + (Place) + 來/去. The direction and destination describe where the object is moved.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: A directional compound describes the direction of the action. The structures include: (1) directional verb + 來/去, (2) motion verb + directional verb + 來/去, (3) motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去, (4) combined with 把 construction to indicate the Subject moves the Object to another location: S + 把 + O + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來/去.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use a doubled two-syllable verb to say you will do something briefly and casually.
grammarPages.explanation: 兩個音節的動詞可以重疊成 XYXY，語氣比較輕鬆，表示動作時間不長。這個說法不能和「一下」、「一點」一起用。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + XYXY (+ Object)

text.traditional: 他們都是我的同學，我給你介紹介紹。
text.simplified: 他们都是我的同学，我给你介绍介绍。
text.pinyin: Tāmen dōu shì wǒ de tóngxué, wǒ gěi nǐ jièshào jièshào.
text.english: They are all my classmates. Let me introduce them to you.

text.traditional: 我還沒決定要不要去留學，我要和父母討論討論。
text.simplified: 我还没决定要不要去留学，我要和父母讨论讨论。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi juédìng yào bu yào qù liúxué, wǒ yào hé fùmǔ tǎolùn tǎolùn.
text.english: I haven't decided whether to study abroad yet. I want to discuss it with my parents.

text.traditional: 弟弟的房間有一點兒髒，這個週末他要打掃打掃。
text.simplified: 弟弟的房间有一点儿脏，这个周末他要打扫打扫。
text.pinyin: Dìdi de fángjiān yǒu yìdiǎnr zāng, zhège zhōumò tā yào dǎsǎo dǎsǎo.
text.english: My younger brother's room is a little dirty. He will do some cleaning this weekend.

items.question: Can you add 一下 to 討論討論?
items.answer: 不行。XYXY 已經表示動作不久，不能再加「一下」或「一點」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我要和父母討論討論一下。
items.wrongSimplified: 我要和父母讨论讨论一下。

right.traditional: 我要和父母討論討論。
right.simplified: 我要和父母讨论讨论。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yào hé fùmǔ tǎolùn tǎolùn.
right.english: I want to discuss it with my parents.

items.question: Is 打掃一打掃 correct for a two-syllable verb?
items.answer: 不行。兩個音節的動詞重疊成 XYXY：打掃打掃。
items.wrongTraditional: 這個週末他要打掃一打掃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个周末他要打扫一打扫。

right.traditional: 這個週末他要打掃打掃。
right.simplified: 这个周末他要打扫打扫。
right.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò tā yào dǎsǎo dǎsǎo.
right.english: This weekend he will do some cleaning.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Repeat a two-syllable verb as XYXY to describe doing the action briefly or casually. This pattern sounds light and suggests the action will not take long. Do not add 一下 or 一點 after the reduplicated verb.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The reduplication of disyllabic verb, with the structure XYXY, creates a casual tone and implies the Subject is going to do something and the action is not going to take long. Note that this pattern cannot be used along with “一下 (in a while)” and “一點 (a little bit)”. e.g., “討論討論一下” is considered to be a wrong usage.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Judgemental 起來: how something seems
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use V起來 to say how something looks, sounds or feels.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V起來」用來說對人或事物的感覺或看法。前面的動詞常是「看、聽、吃、喝、穿」等單音節動詞，後面接評論。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + V起來 (+ Adv) + Adjective

text.traditional: A：王小姐看起來很害羞。B：是啊！她不敢跟不熟的男生說話。
text.simplified: A：王小姐看起来很害羞。B：是啊！她不敢跟不熟的男生说话。
text.pinyin: A: Wáng xiǎojiě kànqǐlái hěn hàixiū. B: Shì a! Tā bù gǎn gēn bù shóu de nánshēng shuōhuà.
text.english: A: Miss Wang looks shy. B: Yes! She doesn't dare talk to boys she doesn't know well.

text.traditional: A：明天放假，我們去動物園吧。B：聽起來不錯，我們幾點去呢？
text.simplified: A：明天放假，我们去动物园吧。B：听起来不错，我们几点去呢？
text.pinyin: A: Míngtiān fàngjià, wǒmen qù dòngwùyuán ba. B: Tīngqǐlái búcuò, wǒmen jǐ diǎn qù ne?
text.english: A: We're off tomorrow. Let's go to the zoo. B: That sounds good. What time shall we go?

text.traditional: A：這件裙子是今年最流行的。B：看起來不錯，你穿起來應該很好看。
text.simplified: A：这件裙子是今年最流行的。B：看起来不错，你穿起来应该很好看。
text.pinyin: A: Zhè jiàn qúnzi shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de. B: Kànqǐlái búcuò, nǐ chuān qǐlái yīnggāi hěn hǎokàn.
text.english: A: This skirt is the most popular style this year. B: It looks nice. It should look good on you.

items.question: Do you say 看起來不錯 or 不錯看起來?
items.answer: 「起來」放在動詞後面，評論放在最後：看起來不錯。
items.wrongTraditional: 這件裙子不錯看起來。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件裙子不错看起来。

right.traditional: 這件裙子看起來不錯。
right.simplified: 这件裙子看起来不错。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn qúnzi kànqǐlái búcuò.
right.english: This skirt looks nice.

items.question: Is it 穿起來 or 穿出來 for how clothes look on you?
items.answer: 說衣服穿在身上的樣子，用「穿起來」：穿起來很好看。
items.wrongTraditional: 你穿出來應該很好看。
items.wrongSimplified: 你穿出来应该很好看。

right.traditional: 你穿起來應該很好看。
right.simplified: 你穿起来应该很好看。
right.pinyin: Nǐ chuān qǐlái yīnggāi hěn hǎokàn.
right.english: It should look good on you.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use a verb + 起來 before a comment to describe the impression you get when seeing, hearing, tasting, or otherwise experiencing something. The comment follows 起來; common verbs include 看, 聽, 吃, 喝, 穿, and 用.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern is used to make comments on someone or something. The verb placed before “起來” is often a monosyllabic sensory verb or action verb, such as “看 (look)”, “聽 (sound)”, 吃 (taste), “喝 (drink)”, “穿 (wear)”, etc. “起來” is followed by comments; thus, the structure is “V 起來 (+Adv) +Vs”.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 替: for or on behalf of someone
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that you do something for someone else with 替.
grammarPages.explanation: 「替」表示因為某人有原因不能自己做某事，所以找另一個人代做。句型是「替＋人＋動詞」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 替 + Person + Verb Phrase

text.traditional: 你可以替我裝網路嗎？費用我自己付。
text.simplified: 你可以替我装网路吗？费用我自己付。
text.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ tì wǒ zhuāng wǎnglù ma? Fèiyòng wǒ zìjǐ fù.
text.english: Can you set up the internet for me? I'll pay the fee myself.

text.traditional: 昨天王老師不舒服，所以林老師替他上課。
text.simplified: 昨天王老师不舒服，所以林老师替他上课。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān Wáng lǎoshī bù shūfu, suǒyǐ Lín lǎoshī tì tā shàngkè.
text.english: Teacher Wang didn't feel well yesterday, so Teacher Lin taught the class for him.

text.traditional: 孩子應該自己打掃房間，父母不要常常替他們做。
text.simplified: 孩子应该自己打扫房间，父母不要常常替他们做。
text.pinyin: Háizi yīnggāi zìjǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān, fùmǔ búyào chángcháng tì tāmen zuò.
text.english: Children should clean their rooms themselves. Parents should not often do it for them.

items.question: Does 替 come before the person or after the verb?
items.answer: 「替」放在人前面，動詞在最後：替我裝網路。
items.wrongTraditional: 我裝網路替你。
items.wrongSimplified: 我装网路替你。

right.traditional: 我替你裝網路。
right.simplified: 我替你装网路。
right.pinyin: Wǒ tì nǐ zhuāng wǎnglù.
right.english: I'll set up the internet for you.

items.question: Can 替他 stand alone without a verb?
items.answer: 不行。「替」後面要說出做的事：替他上課。
items.wrongTraditional: 昨天王老師不舒服，所以林老師替他。
items.wrongSimplified: 昨天王老师不舒服，所以林老师替他。

right.traditional: 昨天王老師不舒服，所以林老師替他上課。
right.simplified: 昨天王老师不舒服，所以林老师替他上课。
right.pinyin: Zuótiān Wáng lǎoshī bù shūfu, suǒyǐ Lín lǎoshī tì tā shàngkè.
right.english: Teacher Wang didn't feel well yesterday, so Teacher Lin taught the class for him.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 替 before the person who benefits from an action, then say what is done for them: 替 + Person + Verb phrase. It describes acting on someone’s behalf, especially when that person cannot do it themselves.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “替” is used in the situation when a person cannot do something for some reason and finds someone else to do it for him.

items.title: Grammar 8–9 · Renting a House Is Not Easy

dialogue.title: 短文 · 租房子不容易

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 山本良介來台灣以後，一直住在學校的宿舍，可是他下個學期不想住了，因為室友很晚才睡覺，總是在半夜開著燈打電腦，聲音很吵。除了生活習慣很不一樣，良介的室友還常常把房間弄得很髒，所以他決定到學校外面去租房子。
lines.simplified: 山本良介来台湾以后，一直住在学校的宿舍，可是他下个学期不想住了，因为室友很晚才睡觉，总是在半夜开着灯打电脑，声音很吵。除了生活习惯很不一样，良介的室友还常常把房间弄得很脏，所以他决定到学校外面去租房子。
lines.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, yìzhí zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè, kěshì tā xià ge xuéqī bù xiǎng zhù le, yīnwèi shìyǒu hěn wǎn cái shuìjiào, zǒngshì zài bànyè kāizhe dēng dǎ diànnǎo, shēngyīn hěn chǎo. Chúle shēnghuó xíguàn hěn bù yíyàng, Liángjiè de shìyǒu hái chángcháng bǎ fángjiān nòng de hěn zāng, suǒyǐ tā juédìng dào xuéxiào wàimiàn qù zū fángzi.
lines.english: After Yamamoto Ryosuke came to Taiwan, he has always been living in the school dormitory, but he doesn't want to live there next semester. That was because his roommate slept late, always used the computer with the light on at midnight, and made a lot of noise. In addition to different living habits, Ryosuke's roommate often made their room dirty, so he decided to rent a house off-campus.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介本來覺得找房子不難，沒想到不太順利。他上租屋網站找了很多資料，可是看了好幾個地方都不滿意。有的房東一看他是外國人，就不太願意租給他。陳可欣知道他的問題以後，就決定陪他去找房子、看房子。
lines.simplified: 良介本来觉得找房子不难，没想到不太顺利。他上租屋网站找了很多资料，可是看了好几个地方都不满意。有的房东一看他是外国人，就不太愿意租给他。陈可欣知道他的问题以后，就决定陪他去找房子、看房子。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè běnlái juéde zhǎo fángzi bù nán, méi xiǎngdào bú tài shùnlì. Tā shàng zūwū wǎngzhàn zhǎo le hěn duō zīliào, kěshì kàn le hǎo jǐ ge dìfāng dōu bù mǎnyì. Yǒude fángdōng yí kàn tā shì wàiguórén, jiù bú tài yuànyì zū gěi tā. Chén Kěxīn zhīdào tā de wèntí yǐhòu, jiù juédìng péi tā qù zhǎo fángzi, kàn fángzi.
lines.english: Ryosuke supposed that finding a house was not difficult. He never thought that it would not go smoothly. He searched for a lot of information on house rental websites. However, after he viewed several places, he still was not satisfied. Some landlords were unwilling to rent out their houses to him just because he was a foreigner. After knowing his problem, Chen Kexin decided to accompany him to find and view houses.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介聽說王太太的公寓要出租，就找可欣一起去看看。那個公寓附近的環境不錯，離學校也不太遠。雖然良介很想租，但是付了房租以後，獎學金就只剩下一萬塊錢了。他問王太太，房租可不可以便宜一點兒。因為王太太的兒子在法國留學，她知道一個人在國外生活不容易。她想了想，決定只收良介一萬兩千元的房租，良介很高興可以搬家了。
lines.simplified: 良介听说王太太的公寓要出租，就找可欣一起去看看。那个公寓附近的环境不错，离学校也不太远。虽然良介很想租，但是付了房租以后，奖学金就只剩下一万块钱了。他问王太太，房租可不可以便宜一点儿。因为王太太的儿子在法国留学，她知道一个人在国外生活不容易。她想了想，决定只收良介一万两千元的房租，良介很高兴可以搬家了。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè tīngshuō Wáng tàitai de gōngyù yào chūzū, jiù zhǎo Kěxīn yìqǐ qù kànkan. Nàge gōngyù fùjìn de huánjìng búcuò, lí xuéxiào yě bú tài yuǎn. Suīrán Liángjiè hěn xiǎng zū, dànshì fù le fángzū yǐhòu, jiǎngxuéjīn jiù zhǐ shèngxià yí wàn kuài qián le. Tā wèn Wáng tàitai, fángzū kě bu kěyǐ piányi yìdiǎnr. Yīnwèi Wáng tàitai de érzi zài Fǎguó liúxué, tā zhīdào yí ge rén zài guówài shēnghuó bù róngyì. Tā xiǎng le xiǎng, juédìng zhǐ shōu Liángjiè yí wàn liǎngqiān yuán de fángzū, Liángjiè hěn gāoxìng kěyǐ bānjiā le.
lines.english: As soon as Ryosuke heard Mrs. Wang's apartment was for rent, he went with Kexin to have a look. The surroundings of the apartment were not bad and it was not too far away from the school. Although Ryosuke would like to rent it, he would have only $10,000 of his scholarship left after paying the rent. He asked Mrs. Wang whether the rent could be cheaper. Because Mrs. Wang's son has been studying in France, she knew that it was not easy to live abroad alone. After thinking it over, she decided to charge Ryosuke a rent of only $12,000. Ryosuke was happy that he could move.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 除了……還…… to add a second, more important point.
grammarPages.explanation: 「除了……還……」先說一個情況，再加上另一個更重要的情況。「除了」後面可以接名詞、動詞或短句；前後主語不同時，第二個主語放在「還」前面。
grammarPages.pattern: 除了 + Clause 1，Subject + 還 + Clause 2

columns.pinyin: hái sòng gěi tā yí liàng chē

text.traditional: 我除了喜歡吃蘋果，還喜歡吃香蕉。
text.simplified: 我除了喜欢吃苹果，还喜欢吃香蕉。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chúle xǐhuān chī píngguǒ, hái xǐhuān chī xiāngjiāo.
text.english: Besides liking to eat apples, I also like to eat bananas.

text.traditional: 很多人喜歡來這裡旅行，除了風景很好，交通還很方便。
text.simplified: 很多人喜欢来这里旅行，除了风景很好，交通还很方便。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō rén xǐhuān lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng, chúle fēngjǐng hěn hǎo, jiāotōng hái hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Many people like to travel here. Besides the nice scenery, the transportation is also convenient.

text.traditional: A：白小姐生日的時候，男朋友送給她一個很貴的皮包。B：除了皮包，還送給她一輛車呢！
text.simplified: A：白小姐生日的时候，男朋友送给她一个很贵的皮包。B：除了皮包，还送给她一辆车呢！
text.pinyin: A: Bái xiǎojiě shēngrì de shíhou, nánpéngyou sòng gěi tā yí ge hěn guì de píbāo. B: Chúle píbāo, hái sòng gěi tā yí liàng chē ne!
text.english: A: On Miss Bai's birthday, her boyfriend gave her a very expensive purse. B: Besides the purse, he also gave her a car!

items.question: Where does 還 go?
items.answer: 「還」放在第二個動詞或形容詞前面：還喜歡吃香蕉。
items.wrongTraditional: 我除了喜歡吃蘋果，喜歡吃香蕉還。
items.wrongSimplified: 我除了喜欢吃苹果，喜欢吃香蕉还。

right.traditional: 我除了喜歡吃蘋果，還喜歡吃香蕉。
right.simplified: 我除了喜欢吃苹果，还喜欢吃香蕉。
right.pinyin: Wǒ chúle xǐhuān chī píngguǒ, hái xǐhuān chī xiāngjiāo.
right.english: Besides liking apples, I also like bananas.

items.question: When the two subjects are different, where does the second subject go?
items.answer: 第二個主語放在「還」前面：交通還很方便。
items.wrongTraditional: 除了風景很好，還交通很方便。
items.wrongSimplified: 除了风景很好，还交通很方便。

right.traditional: 除了風景很好，交通還很方便。
right.simplified: 除了风景很好，交通还很方便。
right.pinyin: Chúle fēngjǐng hěn hǎo, jiāotōng hái hěn fāngbiàn.
right.english: Besides the scenery being nice, the transportation is also convenient.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 除了 before one situation and 還 before an additional, often more important, situation. The first part can be a noun, verb, state word, or phrase. If the second part has a different subject, put that subject before 還.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern indicates there are different situations coming after “除了” and “還”, with the latter one being even more important than the former. “除了” can be followed by nouns, verbs, intransitive state verbs (Vs) or phrases. If the Subjects of the two clauses are different, the second Subject should be placed before “還”, as in example 2.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with V得 + comment
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 把 with V得 to say how an action leaves something.
grammarPages.explanation: 「把」後面的動作動詞加「得」，再接程度或結果：把足球踢得很遠、把問題弄得更麻煩。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + 得 + Adv + Adjective

text.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
text.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
text.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
text.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

text.traditional: 他把那隻兔子畫得很可愛。
text.simplified: 他把那只兔子画得很可爱。
text.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà zhī tùzi huà de hěn kě'ài.
text.english: He drew that rabbit very cute.

text.traditional: 請你不要把這個問題弄得更麻煩。
text.simplified: 请你不要把这个问题弄得更麻烦。
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ búyào bǎ zhège wèntí nòng de gèng máfan.
text.english: Please don't make this problem even more troublesome.

items.question: Where does 得 go?
items.answer: 「得」放在動詞後面，再接程度或結果：踢得很遠。
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟把足球得踢很遠。
items.wrongSimplified: 弟弟把足球得踢很远。

right.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
right.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
right.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
right.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

items.question: Does the object go after 把 or after the verb?
items.answer: 要處理的東西放在「把」後面：把足球踢得很遠。
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟踢得足球很遠。
items.wrongSimplified: 弟弟踢得足球很远。

right.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
right.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
right.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
right.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 把 + object + verb + 得 + degree word + adjective to describe the result or state caused by the action. The object follows 把; 得 follows the verb and introduces the comment on the result.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “把” is followed by the Object that receives the action of a verb, while “V得” is followed by the outcome after the action.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （可欣約美心一起去逛夜市）
lines.simplified: （可欣约美心一起去逛夜市）
lines.pinyin: （Kěxīn yuē Měixīn yìqǐ qù guàng yèshì）
lines.english: (Kexin invites Meixin to go to the night market together.)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 妳平常不愛逛夜市，今天怎麼忽然想去啊？
lines.simplified: 你平常不爱逛夜市，今天怎么忽然想去啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng bú ài guàng yèshì, jīntiān zěnme hūrán xiǎng qù a?
lines.english: You don't usually like to go to night markets. Why do you suddenly want to go today?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 因為良介說他跟朋友都想到夜市看看，請我給他們介紹介紹台灣的小吃。
lines.simplified: 因为良介说他跟朋友都想到夜市看看，请我给他们介绍介绍台湾的小吃。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi Liángjiè shuō tā gēn péngyou dōu xiǎng dào yèshì kànkan, qǐng wǒ gěi tāmen jièshào jièshào Táiwān de xiǎochī.
lines.english: Because Ryosuke said that he and his friend both wanted to look around the night market, and asked me to introduce some Taiwanese snacks to them.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 你們在哪裡見面呢？
lines.simplified: 你们在哪里见面呢？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zài nǎlǐ jiànmiàn ne?
lines.english: Where will you meet?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 在捷運站二號出口。他們應該快到了。
lines.simplified: 在捷运站二号出口。他们应该快到了。
lines.pinyin: Zài jiéyùnzhàn èr hào chūkǒu. Tāmen yīnggāi kuài dào le.
lines.english: At Exit 2 of the MRT station. They should be arriving soon.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （可欣跟美心到了捷運站二號出口）
lines.simplified: （可欣跟美心到了捷运站二号出口）
lines.pinyin: （Kěxīn gēn Měixīn dào le jiéyùnzhàn èr hào chūkǒu）
lines.english: (Kexin and Meixin arrive at Exit 2 of the MRT station.)

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 不好意思，妳們等了很久了嗎？
lines.simplified: 不好意思，你们等了很久了吗？
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, nǐmen děng le hěn jiǔ le ma?
lines.english: Sorry! Have you been waiting for a long time?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 我們也剛到。良介，給我們介紹一下你的朋友吧！
lines.simplified: 我们也刚到。良介，给我们介绍一下你的朋友吧！
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yě gāng dào. Liángjiè, gěi wǒmen jièshào yíxià nǐ de péngyou ba!
lines.english: We just arrived, too. Ryosuke, introduce your friend to us!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 他是我的好朋友龍介，這幾天到台灣來旅行。
lines.simplified: 他是我的好朋友龙介，这几天到台湾来旅行。
lines.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou Lóngjiè, zhè jǐ tiān dào Táiwān lái lǚxíng.
lines.english: He is my good friend Ryusuke. He is traveling in Taiwan these days.

lines.speaker: 龍介
lines.traditional: 妳們好，我叫九十九龍介。
lines.simplified: 你们好，我叫九十九龙介。
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo, wǒ jiào Jiǔshíjiǔ Lóngjiè.
lines.english: Hello! I'm Ryusuke Tsukumo.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 你好，我是陳可欣，良介的大學同學。她是我室友王美心。
lines.simplified: 你好，我是陈可欣，良介的大学同学。她是我室友王美心。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Chén Kěxīn, Liángjiè de dàxué tóngxué. Tā shì wǒ shìyǒu Wáng Měixīn.
lines.english: Hello! I'm Kexin Chen, Ryosuke's university classmate. She is my roommate Meixin Wang.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 很高興認識你。你的姓真特別！
lines.simplified: 很高兴认识你。你的姓真特别！
lines.pinyin: Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ. Nǐ de xìng zhēn tèbié!
lines.english: Nice to meet you! Your surname is so special!

lines.speaker: 龍介
lines.traditional: 是啊！姓九十九的日本人很少。我一直想來夜市逛逛，今天請妳們帶我去吃好吃的台灣小吃。
lines.simplified: 是啊！姓九十九的日本人很少。我一直想来夜市逛逛，今天请你们带我去吃好吃的台湾小吃。
lines.pinyin: Shì a! Xìng Jiǔshíjiǔ de Rìběnrén hěn shǎo. Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng lái yèshì guàngguang, jīntiān qǐng nǐmen dài wǒ qù chī hǎochī de Táiwān xiǎochī.
lines.english: Yes! Few Japanese people have this surname. I have always wanted to walk around a night market. Please take me to eat delicious Taiwanese snacks today.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 沒問題，夜市就在前面。
lines.simplified: 没问题，夜市就在前面。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, yèshì jiù zài qiánmiàn.
lines.english: No problem. The night market is right ahead.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我聽說台灣的夜市很有意思，有各種小吃跟點心，買東西還可以殺價呢！
lines.simplified: 我听说台湾的夜市很有意思，有各种小吃跟点心，买东西还可以杀价呢！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu yìsi, yǒu gè zhǒng xiǎochī gēn diǎnxīn, mǎi dōngxi hái kěyǐ shājià ne!
lines.english: I heard that Taiwanese night markets are very interesting. They have all kinds of snacks and treats, and you can even bargain when you buy things!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 沒錯，有時候我在夜市買衣服也會殺價。對了！等一下你會看到一些招牌上有英文、日文，就是希望外國遊客也看得懂。
lines.simplified: 没错，有时候我在夜市买衣服也会杀价。对了！等一下你会看到一些招牌上有英文、日文，就是希望外国游客也看得懂。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò, yǒu shíhou wǒ zài yèshì mǎi yīfu yě huì shājià. Duì le! Děng yíxià nǐ huì kàndào yìxiē zhāopái shàng yǒu Yīngwén, Rìwén, jiùshì xīwàng wàiguó yóukè yě kàn de dǒng.
lines.english: That's right. Sometimes I bargain when I buy clothes at the night market too. By the way! Later you'll see English and Japanese on some signboards; that's to help foreign tourists understand them.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 這裡有臭豆腐、炸雞排、蚵仔煎……，這些小吃都很好吃。當然，還有有名的珍珠奶茶。
lines.simplified: 这里有臭豆腐、炸鸡排、蚵仔煎……，这些小吃都很好吃。当然，还有有名的珍珠奶茶。
lines.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu chòu dòufǔ, zhá jīpái, ézǐjiān……, zhèxiē xiǎochī dōu hěn hǎochī. Dāngrán, hái yǒu yǒumíng de zhēnzhū nǎichá.
lines.english: There is stinky tofu, fried chicken cutlet, oyster omelet... These snacks are all delicious. Of course, there is also the famous pearl milk tea.

lines.speaker: 龍介
lines.traditional: 聽說這裡的珍珠奶茶喝起來又香又甜，可是我不習慣喝太甜的飲料。
lines.simplified: 听说这里的珍珠奶茶喝起来又香又甜，可是我不习惯喝太甜的饮料。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhèlǐ de zhēnzhū nǎichá hē qǐlái yòu xiāng yòu tián, kěshì wǒ bù xíguàn hē tài tián de yǐnliào.
lines.english: I heard that the pearl milk tea here tastes fragrant and sweet, but I am not used to drinks that are too sweet.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 在台灣，你可以請他們少放一點兒糖，或是選無糖的、半糖的，也可以決定加多少冰塊。
lines.simplified: 在台湾，你可以请他们少放一点儿糖，或是选无糖的、半糖的，也可以决定加多少冰块。
lines.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, nǐ kěyǐ qǐng tāmen shǎo fàng yìdiǎnr táng, huòshì xuǎn wútáng de, bàntáng de, yě kěyǐ juédìng jiā duōshǎo bīngkuài.
lines.english: In Taiwan, you can ask them to put in less sugar, or choose sugar-free or half-sugar, and you can also decide how much ice to add.

lines.speaker: 龍介
lines.traditional: 太好了！妳們還推薦我們吃什麼？
lines.simplified: 太好了！你们还推荐我们吃什么？
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Nǐmen hái tuījiàn wǒmen chī shénme?
lines.english: That's great! What else do you recommend we eat?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 要是你們想吃特別的，我就推薦你們吃臭豆腐，辣的更好吃。（美心買了一份臭豆腐）你們聞，這就是臭豆腐的味道，臭不臭？
lines.simplified: 要是你们想吃特别的，我就推荐你们吃臭豆腐，辣的更好吃。（美心买了一份臭豆腐）你们闻，这就是臭豆腐的味道，臭不臭？
lines.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐmen xiǎng chī tèbié de, wǒ jiù tuījiàn nǐmen chī chòu dòufǔ, là de gèng hǎochī. （Měixīn mǎi le yí fèn chòu dòufǔ）Nǐmen wén, zhè jiùshì chòu dòufǔ de wèidào, chòu bu chòu?
lines.english: If you want to eat something special, I recommend stinky tofu. The spicy one is even more delicious. (Meixin buys a serving of stinky tofu.) Smell it! This is the smell of stinky tofu. Is it stinky?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （良介、龍介聞了一下）
lines.simplified: （良介、龙介闻了一下）
lines.pinyin: （Liángjiè, Lóngjiè wén le yíxià）
lines.english: (Ryosuke and Ryusuke take a sniff.)

lines.speaker: 龍介
lines.traditional: 這種味道我不討厭。其實我什麼小吃都想試試，特別是炸雞排，聽說又大又好吃。
lines.simplified: 这种味道我不讨厌。其实我什么小吃都想试试，特别是炸鸡排，听说又大又好吃。
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèidào wǒ bù tǎoyàn. Qíshí wǒ shénme xiǎochī dōu xiǎng shìshi, tèbié shì zhá jīpái, tīngshuō yòu dà yòu hǎochī.
lines.english: I don't dislike this smell. Actually, I want to try every snack, especially the fried chicken cutlet. I heard it's big and delicious.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我不敢吃臭豆腐，可是很想吃雞排。
lines.simplified: 我不敢吃臭豆腐，可是很想吃鸡排。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù gǎn chī chòu dòufǔ, kěshì hěn xiǎng chī jīpái.
lines.english: I don't dare eat stinky tofu, but I really want to eat the chicken cutlet.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 好，那麼我們先去買雞排，我再帶你們去喝非常好喝的香蕉牛奶。
lines.simplified: 好，那么我们先去买鸡排，我再带你们去喝非常好喝的香蕉牛奶。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nàme wǒmen xiān qù mǎi jīpái, wǒ zài dài nǐmen qù hē fēicháng hǎohē de xiāngjiāo niúnǎi.
lines.english: OK, then let's go buy the chicken cutlet first, and then I'll take you to drink some delicious banana milk.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Point at exactly where something or someone is.
grammarPages.explanation: 在對話中，提到的人、事或物就在眼前或很容易找到時，可以用「就」加強肯定語氣，表示「正是這個」或「就在這裡」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject / Thing + 就 + 在 / 是 + Place / Person

text.traditional: A：我忘了把筆放在哪裡了。B：我看看，你的筆就在桌上啊！
text.simplified: A：我忘了把笔放在哪里了。B：我看看，你的笔就在桌上啊！
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ wàng le bǎ bǐ fàng zài nǎlǐ le. B: Wǒ kànkan, nǐ de bǐ jiù zài zhuō shàng a!
text.english: A: I forgot where I put the pen. B: Let me see—your pen is right there on the desk!

text.traditional: A：喂，請問，陳可欣小姐在家嗎？B：我就是。
text.simplified: A：喂，请问，陈可欣小姐在家吗？B：我就是。
text.pinyin: A: Wèi, qǐngwèn, Chén Kěxīn xiǎojiě zài jiā ma? B: Wǒ jiùshì.
text.english: A: Hello, may I ask, is Ms. Chen Kexin at home? B: This is she.

text.traditional: A：我聽說他家在學校附近。B：是啊！他家就在學校旁邊，走路五分鐘就到了。
text.simplified: A：我听说他家在学校附近。B：是啊！他家就在学校旁边，走路五分钟就到了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ tīngshuō tā jiā zài xuéxiào fùjìn. B: Shì a! Tā jiā jiù zài xuéxiào pángbiān, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
text.english: A: I heard his home is near the school. B: Yes! His home is right next to the school; it is a five-minute walk.

items.question: 東西就在眼前時，用「就」還是「才」？
items.answer: 用「就」表示就在那裡；「才」表示晚、慢或只有這樣。
items.wrongTraditional: 你的筆才在桌上。
items.wrongSimplified: 你的笔才在桌上。

right.traditional: 你的筆就在桌上。
right.simplified: 你的笔就在桌上。
right.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ jiù zài zhuō shàng.
right.english: Your pen is right there on the desk.

items.question: 回答「是哪一位」時，可以說「我就在」嗎？
items.answer: 不行。回答「是哪一位」或「在家嗎」時，用「我就是」表示「正是我」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我就在。
items.wrongSimplified: 我就在。

right.traditional: 我就是。
right.simplified: 我就是。
right.pinyin: Wǒ jiùshì.
right.english: This is she.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When the thing or place being discussed is close at hand or exactly where expected, put 就 before 在 or 是 to emphasize and affirm it: Thing + 就 + 在/是 + Place or Person.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In conversation, if something mentioned is within reach, “就” can be used to show emphasis and affirmation.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.titleEnglish: V到: success and ability with 到
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether an action reached its result, and whether you can do it at all.
grammarPages.explanation: 「到」是結果補語，表示動作成功達到結果。「V到了／沒V到」說動作最後有沒有達到；「V得到／V不到」說有沒有能力或機會達到。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 到 (result) / Verb + 得 / 不 + 到 (potential)

text.traditional: 李先生租到了不錯的公寓。
text.simplified: 李先生租到了不错的公寓。
text.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng zū dào le búcuò de gōngyù.
text.english: Mr. Li successfully rented a nice apartment.

text.traditional: 我沒想到那個外國人會說中文。
text.simplified: 我没想到那个外国人会说中文。
text.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào nàge wàiguórén huì shuō Zhōngwén.
text.english: I didn't expect that foreigner to speak Chinese.

text.traditional: 妹妹昨天在百貨公司逛了很久，買到了很多她喜歡的衣服。
text.simplified: 妹妹昨天在百货公司逛了很久，买到了很多她喜欢的衣服。
text.pinyin: Mèimei zuótiān zài bǎihuò gōngsī guàng le hěn jiǔ, mǎi dào le hěn duō tā xǐhuan de yīfu.
text.english: Yesterday my younger sister shopped at the department store for a long time and bought many clothes she likes.

text.traditional: 我找不到我的錢包，怎麼辦？
text.simplified: 我找不到我的钱包，怎么办？
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo bu dào wǒ de qiánbāo, zěnme bàn?
text.english: I can't find my wallet. What should I do?

text.traditional: 在台灣，到處都吃得到小吃。
text.simplified: 在台湾，到处都吃得到小吃。
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, dàochù dōu chī de dào xiǎochī.
text.english: In Taiwan, you can get snacks to eat everywhere.

text.traditional: 台北101離這裡有一點兒遠，你十五分鐘走得到走不到？
text.simplified: 台北101离这里有一点儿远，你十五分钟走得到走不到？
text.pinyin: Táiběi 101 lí zhèlǐ yǒu yìdiǎnr yuǎn, nǐ shíwǔ fēnzhōng zǒu de dào zǒu bu dào?
text.english: Taipei 101 is a little far from here. Can you walk there in fifteen minutes?

items.question: 「V到了」和「V得到」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「V到了」說動作最後成功了；「V得到」說有沒有能力或機會成功。
items.wrongTraditional: 我昨天找得到錢包了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我昨天找得到钱包了。

right.traditional: 我昨天找到了錢包。
right.simplified: 我昨天找到了钱包。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zhǎo dào le qiánbāo.
right.english: I found my wallet yesterday.

items.question: 「找不到」的「不」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在「找」和「到」中間：找不到。不能說「不到找」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我不到找我的錢包。
items.wrongSimplified: 我不到找我的钱包。

right.traditional: 我找不到我的錢包。
right.simplified: 我找不到我的钱包。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo bu dào wǒ de qiánbāo.
right.english: I can't find my wallet.

subsections.title: V到了 / 沒V到: the result was or was not reached
subsections.explanation: 「V到了」表示動作最後成功了；「沒V到」表示最後沒有成功。

subsections.title: V得到 / V不到: can or cannot reach the result
subsections.explanation: 「V得到」表示有能力或機會達到；「V不到」表示沒有能力或機會達到。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 到 after a verb marks a successfully reached result. V到了 and 沒V到 say whether the action did or did not achieve that result. V得到 and V不到 describe whether the result is possible or within someone’s ability.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: Resultative Complements are used to express the result of an action or a behavior. The structure is “Verb + RC.” The resultative complement “到” indicates that the outcome of a verb is successfully achieved. Besides, the pattern “V得到/V不到” indicates the potential or capability of achieving something or not, while the patterns “V到了” and “沒V到” indicate whether the outcome of a verb was achieved or not at last. The verbs often used in this pattern include “看 (see)”, “聽 (hear)”, “拿 (take)”, “走 (walk)”, “買 (buy)”, “找 (find)”, “租 (rent)”, “做 (do)” and “想 (think)”.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether someone understood, and whether they can understand.
grammarPages.explanation: 「懂」是結果補語，表示主語明白了某事，常接在「聽、看」後面。「V懂了／沒V懂」說最後懂不懂；「V得懂／V不懂」說有沒有能力聽懂、看懂。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 懂 (result) / Verb + 得 / 不 + 懂 (potential)

text.traditional: 我看不懂他寫的英文信。
text.simplified: 我看不懂他写的英文信。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn bu dǒng tā xiě de Yīngwén xìn.
text.english: I can't understand the English letter he wrote.

text.traditional: 你剛剛說的話，我沒聽懂。
text.simplified: 你刚刚说的话，我没听懂。
text.pinyin: Nǐ gānggāng shuō de huà, wǒ méi tīng dǒng.
text.english: I didn't understand what you just said.

text.traditional: A：他聽得懂聽不懂中國話？B：他只聽得懂一點兒。
text.simplified: A：他听得懂听不懂中国话？B：他只听得懂一点儿。
text.pinyin: A: Tā tīng de dǒng tīng bu dǒng Zhōngguóhuà? B: Tā zhǐ tīng de dǒng yìdiǎnr.
text.english: A: Can he understand Chinese? B: He only understands a little.

items.question: 太難而沒有能力懂，用「看不懂」還是「沒看懂」？
items.answer: 用「看不懂」說沒有能力懂；「沒看懂」說看了，但最後沒懂。
items.wrongTraditional: 這封英文信太難了，我看得不懂。
items.wrongSimplified: 这封英文信太难了，我看得不懂。

right.traditional: 這封英文信太難了，我看不懂。
right.simplified: 这封英文信太难了，我看不懂。
right.pinyin: Zhè fēng Yīngwén xìn tài nán le, wǒ kàn bu dǒng.
right.english: This English letter is too hard; I can't understand it.

items.question: 「懂」要放在動詞前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在動詞後面：聽懂、看懂。不能說「懂聽」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我懂聽他的話。
items.wrongSimplified: 我懂听他的话。

right.traditional: 我聽得懂他的話。
right.simplified: 我听得懂他的话。
right.pinyin: Wǒ tīng de dǒng tā de huà.
right.english: I can understand what he says.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 懂 after a verb means that the subject understands the result of listening, looking, or watching. V懂了 and 沒V懂 report whether understanding was achieved. V得懂 and V不懂 describe whether the material can be understood.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When serving as a resultative complement, “懂” indicates that the subject understands something. Thus, “懂” often comes after verbs such as “聽 (listen)” and “看 (look, watch, see)”. Besides, the “V得懂/V不懂” pattern indicates whether the subject has the ability to understand something, while the “V懂了” and “沒V懂” patterns indicate whether the subject understood something or not after a certain action.

items.title: Grammar 4–8 · The Night Market Culture in Taiwan

dialogue.title: 短文 · 台灣的夜市文化

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 除了百貨公司，夜市也是台灣人常去的地方。那裡有各種好吃的小吃、好喝的飲料和好玩的遊戲。一般的夜市大概從晚上六點開始，到半夜才結束。很多台灣人喜歡去夜市吃喝玩樂，所以夜市總是很熱鬧，到了週末晚上更是擠得不得了。
lines.simplified: 除了百货公司，夜市也是台湾人常去的地方。那里有各种好吃的小吃、好喝的饮料和好玩的游戏。一般的夜市大概从晚上六点开始，到半夜才结束。很多台湾人喜欢去夜市吃喝玩乐，所以夜市总是很热闹，到了周末晚上更是挤得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Chúle bǎihuò gōngsī, yèshì yě shì Táiwān rén cháng qù de dìfāng. Nàlǐ yǒu gè zhǒng hǎochī de xiǎochī, hǎohē de yǐnliào hé hǎowán de yóuxì. Yìbān de yèshì dàgài cóng wǎnshang liù diǎn kāishǐ, dào bànyè cái jiéshù. Hěn duō Táiwān rén xǐhuan qù yèshì chīhēwánlè, suǒyǐ yèshì zǒngshì hěn rènao, dào le zhōumò wǎnshang gèng shì jǐ de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: Besides department stores, night markets are also places Taiwanese people often go. There are all kinds of delicious snacks, tasty drinks and fun games. An ordinary night market opens at about six in the evening and closes at midnight. Many Taiwanese people like to eat, drink and have fun at night markets, so they are always lively—and even more packed on weekend nights.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 這幾年，來台灣旅遊的外國人越來越多了。他們去夜市可以一邊逛街，一邊吃小吃，還能了解台灣的夜市文化。很多小吃的做法簡單，價錢也便宜，誰都吃得起。台灣最常見的小吃除了臭豆腐、蚵仔煎，還有鹹酥雞、滷肉飯、烤魷魚。天氣熱的時候，排隊買豆花、芒果冰、西瓜汁的人很多，生意好極了！逛夜市的時候，不但吃得飽，也買得到流行的衣服，你一定不會覺得無聊。最有意思的是，買東西的時候，你可以跟老闆講價，也許能便宜一點兒。
lines.simplified: 这几年，来台湾旅游的外国人越来越多了。他们去夜市可以一边逛街，一边吃小吃，还能了解台湾的夜市文化。很多小吃的做法简单，价钱也便宜，谁都吃得起。台湾最常见的小吃除了臭豆腐、蚵仔煎，还有咸酥鸡、卤肉饭、烤鱿鱼。天气热的时候，排队买豆花、芒果冰、西瓜汁的人很多，生意好极了！逛夜市的时候，不但吃得饱，也买得到流行的衣服，你一定不会觉得无聊。最有意思的是，买东西的时候，你可以跟老板讲价，也许能便宜一点儿。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián, lái Táiwān lǚyóu de wàiguórén yuèláiyuè duō le. Tāmen qù yèshì kěyǐ yìbiān guàngjiē, yìbiān chī xiǎochī, hái néng liǎojiě Táiwān de yèshì wénhuà. Hěn duō xiǎochī de zuòfǎ jiǎndān, jiàqián yě piányi, shéi dōu chī de qǐ. Táiwān zuì chángjiàn de xiǎochī chúle chòu dòufǔ, ézǐjiān, hái yǒu xiánsūjī, lǔròu fàn, kǎo yóuyú. Tiānqì rè de shíhou, páiduì mǎi dòuhuā, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de rén hěn duō, shēngyì hǎo jí le! Guàng yèshì de shíhou, búdàn chī de bǎo, yě mǎi de dào liúxíng de yīfu, nǐ yídìng bú huì juéde wúliáo. Zuì yǒu yìsi de shì, mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, nǐ kěyǐ gēn lǎobǎn jiǎngjià, yěxǔ néng piányi yìdiǎnr.
lines.english: In recent years, more and more foreigners have come to Taiwan to travel. At night markets they can shop, eat snacks, and learn about Taiwan's night market culture. Many snacks are simple to make and cheap; anyone can afford them. Besides stinky tofu and oyster omelet, the most common Taiwanese snacks also include popcorn chicken, braised pork on rice and grilled squid. When the weather is hot, many people line up to buy tofu pudding, mango ice and watermelon juice—business is great! When you walk around a night market, you can not only eat your fill but also buy trendy clothes, so you will definitely not feel bored. Most interestingly, when you buy things you can bargain with the vendor; perhaps you can get a lower price.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在台灣，很多寺廟附近都有夜市，比如說：台北的龍山寺旁邊有華西街夜市。對龍山寺有興趣的外國遊客，常常先去廟裡參觀，再去夜市逛逛。這樣的旅行除了能了解寺廟文化，還吃得到有名的小吃，真的太值得了！
lines.simplified: 在台湾，很多寺庙附近都有夜市，比如说：台北的龙山寺旁边有华西街夜市。对龙山寺有兴趣的外国游客，常常先去庙里参观，再去夜市逛逛。这样的旅行除了能了解寺庙文化，还吃得到有名的小吃，真的太值得了！
lines.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, hěn duō sìmiào fùjìn dōu yǒu yèshì, bǐrú shuō: Táiběi de Lóngshān sì pángbiān yǒu Huáxī Jiē yèshì. Duì Lóngshān sì yǒu xìngqù de wàiguó yóukè, chángcháng xiān qù miào lǐ cānguān, zài qù yèshì guàngguang. Zhèyàng de lǚxíng chúle néng liǎojiě sìmiào wénhuà, hái chī de dào yǒumíng de xiǎochī, zhēn de tài zhídé le!
lines.english: In Taiwan, many temples have night markets nearby. For example, Huaxi Street Night Market is next to Longshan Temple in Taipei. Foreign tourists who are interested in Longshan Temple often visit the temple first and then walk around the night market. On a trip like this, besides learning about temple culture, you can also eat famous snacks—it is really worth it!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Vs得不得了 / Vs極了: extreme degree
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something is extremely tall, delicious, lively or tiring.
grammarPages.explanation: 「Vs得不得了」和「Vs極了」都表示程度非常高，放在狀態動詞後面；前面不再加「很、非常」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Vs + 得不得了 / Vs + 極了

text.traditional: 台北101大樓高得不得了！
text.simplified: 台北101大楼高得不得了！
text.pinyin: Táiběi 101 dàlóu gāo de bùdéliǎo!
text.english: The Taipei 101 building is extremely tall!

text.traditional: 我媽媽烤的蛋糕好吃得不得了！
text.simplified: 我妈妈烤的蛋糕好吃得不得了！
text.pinyin: Wǒ māma kǎo de dàngāo hǎochī de bùdéliǎo!
text.english: The cake my mom baked is incredibly delicious!

text.traditional: 他累得不得了，一回家就睡了。
text.simplified: 他累得不得了，一回家就睡了。
text.pinyin: Tā lèi de bùdéliǎo, yì huí jiā jiù shuì le.
text.english: He was extremely tired and went to sleep as soon as he got home.

text.traditional: 週末的時候，夜市熱鬧極了！
text.simplified: 周末的时候，夜市热闹极了！
text.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, yèshì rènao jí le!
text.english: On weekends, the night market is extremely lively!

text.traditional: 他十歲就能念大學，真是聰明極了！
text.simplified: 他十岁就能念大学，真是聪明极了！
text.pinyin: Tā shí suì jiù néng niàn dàxué, zhēn shì cōngmíng jí le!
text.english: He could attend university at ten—truly extremely smart!

text.traditional: 她快結婚了，所以最近心情好極了！
text.simplified: 她快结婚了，所以最近心情好极了！
text.pinyin: Tā kuài jiéhūn le, suǒyǐ zuìjìn xīnqíng hǎo jí le!
text.english: She is getting married soon, so she has been in a great mood lately!

items.question: 「他很累得不得了」對嗎？
items.answer: 不對。「得不得了」已經表示程度很高，前面不能再加「很」。
items.wrongTraditional: 他很累得不得了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很累得不得了。

right.traditional: 他累得不得了。
right.simplified: 他累得不得了。
right.pinyin: Tā lèi de bùdéliǎo.
right.english: He is extremely tired.

items.question: 「非常乾淨極了」對嗎？
items.answer: 不對。「極了」已經表示程度很高，前面不能再加「非常」。
items.wrongTraditional: 他的房間非常乾淨極了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他的房间非常干净极了。

right.traditional: 他的房間乾淨極了。
right.simplified: 他的房间干净极了。
right.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān gānjìng jí le.
right.english: His room is extremely clean.

words.meaning: room (M: 個 gè, 間 jiān)

subsections.title: Vs得不得了: extremely
subsections.explanation: 「得＋不得了」放在狀態動詞後面，表示程度非常高；前面不再加「很、非常」。

subsections.title: Vs極了: exceedingly
subsections.explanation: 「極了」放在狀態動詞後面，表示程度非常高；前面不再加「很、非常」。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 得不得了 or 極了 after a state word to say that the degree is extremely high. Do not put 很 or 非常 before the state word in the same pattern; the ending already expresses the strong degree.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish:
The “Vs得不得了” pattern implies a very great degree. The complement “得＋不得了” should come after Vs to add intensity. When this pattern is used, degree adverbs such as “很” and “非常” should not be placed before Vs at the same time.

The “Vs極了” pattern also implies a very great degree. The complement “極了” should come after Vs to add intensity. When this pattern is used, adverbs of degree such as “很” and “非常” should not be placed before Vs at the same time.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something changes more and more over time.
grammarPages.explanation: 「越來越……」表示程度或數量隨時間增加或減少，後面接狀態動詞或動詞短語：越來越熟、越來越少、越來越了解。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 越來越 + Verb / Adjective

text.traditional: 我跟室友越來越熟了。
text.simplified: 我跟室友越来越熟了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu yuèláiyuè shú le.
text.english: My roommate and I are getting more and more familiar.

text.traditional: 那個人很不客氣，所以他的朋友越來越少了。
text.simplified: 那个人很不客气，所以他的朋友越来越少了。
text.pinyin: Nàge rén hěn bú kèqi, suǒyǐ tā de péngyou yuèláiyuè shǎo le.
text.english: That person is very rude, so he has fewer and fewer friends.

text.traditional: 阮先生在台灣住了半年了，越來越了解台灣的文化了。
text.simplified: 阮先生在台湾住了半年了，越来越了解台湾的文化了。
text.pinyin: Ruǎn xiānsheng zài Táiwān zhù le bànnián le, yuèláiyuè liǎojiě Táiwān de wénhuà le.
text.english: Mr. Ruan has lived in Taiwan for half a year and understands Taiwanese culture more and more.

items.question: 「越來越」後面可以加「很」嗎？
items.answer: 不可以。「越來越」已經表示程度變化，後面直接接形容詞或動詞。
items.wrongTraditional: 天氣越來越很熱。
items.wrongSimplified: 天气越来越很热。

right.traditional: 天氣越來越熱了。
right.simplified: 天气越来越热了。
right.pinyin: Tiānqì yuèláiyuè rè le.
right.english: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

items.question: 「朋友越來越少了」的「越來越」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在主語後面、動詞或形容詞前面。
items.wrongTraditional: 越來越朋友少了。
items.wrongSimplified: 越来越朋友少了。

right.traditional: 朋友越來越少了。
right.simplified: 朋友越来越少了。
right.pinyin: Péngyou yuèláiyuè shǎo le.
right.english: There are fewer and fewer friends.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 越來越 before a changing state or action to show that its degree or amount keeps increasing or decreasing over time. It can describe a state directly, or modify a verb phrase or an action with an object.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “越來越……” pattern is used to express the level of changes or the amount increasing or decreasing with time. It also includes “S+越來越+Vs / Vst+O / Vaux+V+O.”

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether you can afford to eat, drink, buy or rent something.
grammarPages.explanation: 「起」作結果補語時表示有能力負擔，常用於「吃、喝、念、買、住、付、租、穿、用」等少數動詞。常見形式是「V得起／V不起」；不能說「V起了」或「沒V起」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + V + 得起 / 不起

text.traditional: 那件衣服太貴了，我怎麼買得起？
text.simplified: 那件衣服太贵了，我怎么买得起？
text.pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu tài guì le, wǒ zěnme mǎi de qǐ?
text.english: That piece of clothing is too expensive. How could I afford it?

text.traditional: 台灣小吃的價錢很便宜，誰都吃得起。
text.simplified: 台湾小吃的价钱很便宜，谁都吃得起。
text.pinyin: Táiwān xiǎochī de jiàqián hěn piányi, shéi dōu chī de qǐ.
text.english: Taiwanese snacks are cheap; anyone can afford to eat them.

text.traditional: 他非常有錢，當然喝得起一杯一千塊的酒。
text.simplified: 他非常有钱，当然喝得起一杯一千块的酒。
text.pinyin: Tā fēicháng yǒu qián, dāngrán hē de qǐ yì bēi yìqiān kuài de jiǔ.
text.english: He is very rich; of course he can afford a glass of wine that costs a thousand dollars.

text.traditional: 在這裡看醫生貴得不得了，沒錢的人看不起。
text.simplified: 在这里看医生贵得不得了，没钱的人看不起。
text.pinyin: Zài zhèlǐ kàn yīshēng guì de bùdéliǎo, méi qián de rén kàn bu qǐ.
text.english: Seeing a doctor here is extremely expensive; people without money can't afford it.

items.question: 「買起了」可以說嗎？
items.answer: 不行。「起」只用在「V得起／V不起」，沒有「V起了」。
items.wrongTraditional: 那件衣服太貴了，我買起了。
items.wrongSimplified: 那件衣服太贵了，我买起了。

right.traditional: 那件衣服太貴了，我買不起。
right.simplified: 那件衣服太贵了，我买不起。
right.pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu tài guì le, wǒ mǎi bu qǐ.
right.english: That clothing is too expensive; I can't afford it.

items.question: 「沒買起」可以說嗎？
items.answer: 不行。否定用「買不起」，不用「沒買起」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我沒買起那件衣服。
items.wrongSimplified: 我没买起那件衣服。

right.traditional: 我買不起那件衣服。
right.simplified: 我买不起那件衣服。
right.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi bu qǐ nà jiàn yīfu.
right.english: I can't afford that piece of clothing.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 得起 or 不起 after certain verbs to say that someone can or cannot afford to do something. The book lists verbs such as 吃, 喝, 買, 住, 付, 租, 穿, and 用. Do not use this meaning with V起了 or 沒V起.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The verb complement “起” implies one’s ability to afford something. Thus, only a few verbs, such as “吃 (eat)”, “喝 (drink)”, “念 (study)”, “買 (buy)”, “住 (live)”, “付 (pay)”, “租 (rent)”, “穿 (wear)” and “用 (use)”, can be used along with “起”. The common patterns include “V得起” and “V不起”, but patterns like “V起了” or “沒V起” are not acceptable in Chinese.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.titleEnglish: V飽: full after eating or sleeping
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether you got enough to eat or enough sleep.
grammarPages.explanation: 「飽」是結果補語，表示吃飽或睡飽。「V得飽／V不飽」說夠不夠；「V飽了／沒V飽」說最後有沒有吃飽、睡飽。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 飽 (result) / Verb + 得 / 不 + 飽 (potential)

text.traditional: 你只吃了半碗飯，怎麼吃得飽呢？
text.simplified: 你只吃了半碗饭，怎么吃得饱呢？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ chī le bàn wǎn fàn, zěnme chī de bǎo ne?
text.english: You only ate half a bowl of rice—how can you be full?

text.traditional: 我昨天只睡了三個鐘頭的覺，當然沒睡飽！
text.simplified: 我昨天只睡了三个钟头的觉，当然没睡饱！
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zhǐ shuì le sān ge zhōngtóu de jiào, dāngrán méi shuì bǎo!
text.english: I only slept three hours yesterday, so of course I didn't get enough sleep!

text.traditional: 今天的舞會我們準備了很多好吃的食物，大家一定吃得飽。
text.simplified: 今天的舞会我们准备了很多好吃的食物，大家一定吃得饱。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān de wǔhuì wǒmen zhǔnbèi le hěn duō hǎochī de shíwù, dàjiā yídìng chī de bǎo.
text.english: We prepared a lot of delicious food for today's dance party; everyone will surely eat their fill.

items.question: 「睡飽了」的「飽」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在動詞「睡」後面：睡飽了。不能放在「了」後面。
items.wrongTraditional: 我昨天睡了飽。
items.wrongSimplified: 我昨天睡了饱。

right.traditional: 我昨天睡飽了。
right.simplified: 我昨天睡饱了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān shuì bǎo le.
right.english: I got enough sleep yesterday.

items.question: 「沒吃得飽」對嗎？
items.answer: 不對。說沒有能力吃飽用「吃不飽」；說最後沒吃飽用「沒吃飽」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我沒吃得飽。
items.wrongSimplified: 我没吃得饱。

right.traditional: 我沒吃飽。
right.simplified: 我没吃饱。
right.pinyin: Wǒ méi chī bǎo.
right.english: I didn't eat my fill.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 飽 after a verb says that someone is full or has had enough; it commonly follows 吃 or 睡. V飽了 and 沒V飽 report the actual result, while V得飽 and V不飽 ask or say whether enough is possible.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The resultative complement “飽” implies that the subject feels fully satisfied or has enough. Thus, “飽” often comes after “吃 (eat)” and “睡 (sleep)”. The “V得飽/V不飽” pattern indicates whether something is potentially enough to satisfy the subject, while the “V飽了” and “沒V飽” patterns indicate whether the subject feels fully satisfied at last or not.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 對……有（沒）興趣: to be interested in
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what someone is or is not interested in.
grammarPages.explanation: 「對……有興趣」表示對某人、某事或做某事有興趣；否定是「對……沒（有）興趣」，也可以加程度詞：很有興趣、有一點兒興趣。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 對 + Noun / Verb Phrase + 有 / 沒（有）興趣

text.traditional: 台灣人不都對吃臭豆腐有興趣。
text.simplified: 台湾人不都对吃臭豆腐有兴趣。
text.pinyin: Táiwānrén bù dōu duì chī chòu dòufǔ yǒu xìngqù.
text.english: Not all Taiwanese people are interested in eating stinky tofu.

text.traditional: 弟弟只對數學有興趣，其他的都沒興趣。
text.simplified: 弟弟只对数学有兴趣，其他的都没兴趣。
text.pinyin: Dìdi zhǐ duì shùxué yǒu xìngqù, qítā de dōu méi xìngqù.
text.english: My younger brother is only interested in math; he's not interested in anything else.

text.traditional: 陳小姐對逛百貨公司很有興趣，每個週末都去。
text.simplified: 陈小姐对逛百货公司很有兴趣，每个周末都去。
text.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě duì guàng bǎihuò gōngsī hěn yǒu xìngqù, měi ge zhōumò dōu qù.
text.english: Miss Chen is very interested in shopping at department stores and goes every weekend.

items.question: 「我對數學有興趣」的「對」可以換成「在」嗎？
items.answer: 不可以。說對某事物有興趣，固定用「對」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我在數學很有興趣。
items.wrongSimplified: 我在数学很有兴趣。

right.traditional: 我對數學很有興趣。
right.simplified: 我对数学很有兴趣。
right.pinyin: Wǒ duì shùxué hěn yǒu xìngqù.
right.english: I am very interested in math.

items.question: 「興趣」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在「有／沒有」後面：對……有興趣。
items.wrongTraditional: 我興趣對學中文。
items.wrongSimplified: 我兴趣对学中文。

right.traditional: 我對學中文有興趣。
right.simplified: 我对学中文有兴趣。
right.pinyin: Wǒ duì xué Zhōngwén yǒu xìngqù.
right.english: I am interested in learning Chinese.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use Subject + 對 + Noun or Verb phrase + 有/沒有興趣 to say whether someone is interested in a topic or activity. The thing they are interested in follows 對; 有 or 沒有興趣 completes the statement. A degree word can appear before 有/沒有 to say how much interest someone has.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “興趣” is used when the subject is passionate about doing something or does something very often.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Welcome to My House

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （明生在他住的社區等可欣和美心）
lines.simplified: （明生在他住的社区等可欣和美心）
lines.pinyin: （Míngshēng zài tā zhù de shèqū děng Kěxīn hé Měixīn）
lines.english: (Mingsheng is waiting for Kexin and Meixin in the apartment complex he lives in.)

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 歡迎你們來，我就住在這個社區的A棟七樓。
lines.simplified: 欢迎你们来，我就住在这个社区的A栋七楼。
lines.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen lái, wǒ jiù zhù zài zhège shèqū de A dòng qī lóu.
lines.english: Welcome! I just live on the seventh floor of Building A in this apartment complex.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 這個社區好大啊！比我住的大多了。
lines.simplified: 这个社区好大啊！比我住的大多了。
lines.pinyin: Zhège shèqū hǎo dà a! Bǐ wǒ zhù de dà duō le.
lines.english: This complex is huge! It’s much bigger than the one I live in.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 這個社區又大又舒服，可是上個月有一輛汽車被小偷偷了，因為警察來幫忙，所以很快就找到汽車了。現在白天、晚上都有人負責社區的安全。
lines.simplified: 这个社区又大又舒服，可是上个月有一辆汽车被小偷偷了，因为警察来帮忙，所以很快就找到汽车了。现在白天、晚上都有人负责社区的安全。
lines.pinyin: Zhège shèqū yòu dà yòu shūfu, kěshì shàng ge yuè yǒu yí liàng qìchē bèi xiǎotōu tōu le, yīnwèi jǐngchá lái bāngmáng, suǒyǐ hěn kuài jiù zhǎodào qìchē le. Xiànzài báitiān, wǎnshàng dōu yǒu rén fùzé shèqū de ānquán.
lines.english: This complex building is both big and comfortable. But last month a car was stolen by a thief, and the police came to help, so they found the car quickly. Now day and night there’s someone responsible for the safety of the community.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 社區安全真的很重要。對了，我在大門那邊看到一大片草地，你們會在那裡辦活動嗎？
lines.simplified: 社区安全真的很重要。对了，我在大门那边看到一大片草地，你们会在那里办活动吗？
lines.pinyin: Shèqū ānquán zhēn de hěn zhòngyào. Duì le, wǒ zài dàmén nàbiān kàndào yí dà piàn cǎodì, nǐmen huì zài nàlǐ bàn huódòng ma?
lines.english: The safety of the community is really important. By the way, I saw a large lawn near the main gate. Do you hold activities there?

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 會啊！晴天的時候，我們會在那裡曬太陽、踢足球；有時候也會在那裡野餐、露營，好玩得不得了。
lines.simplified: 会啊！晴天的时候，我们会在那里晒太阳、踢足球；有时候也会在那里野餐、露营，好玩得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Huì a! Qíngtiān de shíhou, wǒmen huì zài nàlǐ shài tàiyáng, tī zúqiú; yǒu shíhou yě huì zài nàlǐ yěcān, lùyíng, hǎowán de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: Yes! On sunny days, we sunbathe and play soccer, and sometimes we have a picnic and camp there. It’s great fun.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？我很喜歡露營，以後我也可以來這裡露營嗎？
lines.simplified: 真的吗？我很喜欢露营，以后我也可以来这里露营吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ hěn xǐhuan lùyíng, yǐhòu wǒ yě kěyǐ lái zhèlǐ lùyíng ma?
lines.english: Really? I like camping very much. May I come here to camp in the future, too?

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 可以啊！上個週末我跟可欣就在那裡露營。晚上沒有雲的時候，躺在草地上聊天、看星星，感覺好輕鬆，我們聊著聊著就睡著了。
lines.simplified: 可以啊！上个周末我跟可欣就在那里露营。晚上没有云的时候，躺在草地上聊天、看星星，感觉好轻松，我们聊着聊着就睡着了。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ a! Shàng ge zhōumò wǒ gēn Kěxīn jiù zài nàlǐ lùyíng. Wǎnshàng méiyǒu yún de shíhou, tǎng zài cǎodì shàng liáotiān, kàn xīngxīng, gǎnjué hǎo qīngsōng, wǒmen liáozhe liáozhe jiù shuìzháo le.
lines.english: Sure! I was camping there with Kexin last weekend. In the evening, when there were no clouds, we were lying on the lawn chatting, watching stars, and feeling relaxed; we fell asleep while chatting.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 我想住在這裡的人，早上看到陽光、聞到花香，再聽到幾隻鳥在唱歌，應該就不想去上班了。
lines.simplified: 我想住在这里的人，早上看到阳光、闻到花香，再听到几只鸟在唱歌，应该就不想去上班了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhù zài zhèlǐ de rén, zǎoshàng kàndào yángguāng, wéndào huāxiāng, zài tīngdào jǐ zhī niǎo zài chànggē, yīnggāi jiù bù xiǎng qù shàngbān le.
lines.english: I think people who live here, having seen the sunlight and smelled the aroma of flowers in the morning, and then heard a few birds singing, shouldn’t want to go to work.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 聽妳這麼說，我也好想搬來這裡住。
lines.simplified: 听妳这么说，我也好想搬来这里住。
lines.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, wǒ yě hǎo xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.
lines.english: As I hear you say so, I really want to move here too!

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 歡迎，歡迎。這裡環境很好，還有兩座球場和游泳池。有一個校友也住在這個社區，我常跟他一起打網球呢！
lines.simplified: 欢迎，欢迎。这里环境很好，还有两座球场和游泳池。有一个校友也住在这个社区，我常跟他一起打网球呢！
lines.pinyin: Huānyíng, huānyíng. Zhèlǐ huánjìng hěn hǎo, hái yǒu liǎng zuò qiúchǎng hé yóuyǒngchí. Yǒu yí ge xiàoyǒu yě zhù zài zhège shèqū, wǒ cháng gēn tā yìqǐ dǎ wǎngqiú ne!
lines.english: Welcome, welcome. The environment here is good, and there are also two playgrounds and a swimming pool. There’s an alumnus that lives in this community, too. I often play tennis with him!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我也會打網球，可是打得不好。
lines.simplified: 我也会打网球，可是打得不好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě huì dǎ wǎngqiú, kěshì dǎ de bù hǎo.
lines.english: I also can play tennis, but I don’t play well.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 打得不好沒關係，只要有機會運動就好了。
lines.simplified: 打得不好没关系，只要有机会运动就好了。
lines.pinyin: Dǎ de bù hǎo méiguānxi, zhǐyào yǒu jīhuì yùndòng jiù hǎo le.
lines.english: It doesn’t matter if you don’t play well. As long as you can have opportunity to exercise, it’s fine.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 對啊！我平常下班回來，有時候去游泳，有時候去打球，所以身體越來越健康了。
lines.simplified: 对啊！我平常下班回来，有时候去游泳，有时候去打球，所以身体越来越健康了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a! Wǒ píngcháng xiàbān huílái, yǒu shíhou qù yóuyǒng, yǒu shíhou qù dǎqiú, suǒyǐ shēntǐ yuèláiyuè jiànkāng le.
lines.english: Right! When I come back from work, sometimes I go swimming, and sometimes I play sports, so my body is getting healthier and healthier.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 聊了這麼久，我有一點兒餓了。
lines.simplified: 聊了这么久，我有一点儿饿了。
lines.pinyin: Liáo le zhème jiǔ, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr è le.
lines.english: We’ve been chatting for so long. I am a bit hungry.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 那今天我請客，請你們去附近的餐廳吃牛排。從這裡往前走，看到紅綠燈，往右轉就到了。
lines.simplified: 那今天我请客，请你们去附近的餐厅吃牛排。从这里往前走，看到红绿灯，往右转就到了。
lines.pinyin: Nà jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, qǐng nǐmen qù fùjìn de cāntīng chī niúpái. Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng qián zǒu, kàndào hónglǜdēng, wǎng yòu zhuǎn jiù dào le.
lines.english: It’s my treat today. I treat you to the nearby restaurant to eat steak. Go forward from here, see the traffic light, turn right and you will be there.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 被 passive: N₁ (+Neg) + 被 (+N₂) + V + C
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what happened to someone or something without making them the doer.
grammarPages.explanation: 「被」構成被動句：先說承受動作的人或事物（N₁），再說被、可省略的動作者（N₂）和動作。補語 C 說明動作的結果或完成方式。否定詞「沒」放在「被」前面。
grammarPages.pattern: N₁ (+ Neg) + 被 (+ N₂) + V + C

subsections.title: N₁ + 被 (+N₂) + V + C
subsections.explanation: 主語是承受動作的人或事物；動作的人（N₂）可以不出現。

columns.pinyin: tóngshì sòng gěi wǒ de tiándiǎn
columns.meaning: the dessert my colleague gave me

subsections.title: N₁ + Neg + 被 (+N₂) + V + C
subsections.explanation: 否定時，「沒」放在「被」前面，不能放在動詞前面。

columns.meaning: moved up to the second floor

columns.pinyin: nǐ nà jiàn piàoliang de yīfu

text.traditional: 他家的門被小偷打開了。
text.simplified: 他家的门被小偷打开了。
text.pinyin: Tā jiā de mén bèi xiǎotōu dǎkāi le.
text.english: His family’s door was opened by a thief.

text.traditional: 他亂丟垃圾的時候，被鄰居發現了。
text.simplified: 他乱丢垃圾的时候，被邻居发现了。
text.pinyin: Tā luàn diū lèsè de shíhou, bèi línjū fāxiàn le.
text.english: When he carelessly threw away garbage, he was spotted by a neighbor.

text.traditional: 同事昨天送給我的甜點怎麼被吃了？我記得放在冰箱裡啊！
text.simplified: 同事昨天送给我的甜点怎么被吃了？我记得放在冰箱里啊！
text.pinyin: Tóngshì zuótiān sòng gěi wǒ de tiándiǎn zěnme bèi chī le? Wǒ jìde fàng zài bīngxiāng lǐ a!
text.english: How come the dessert my colleague gave me yesterday was eaten? I remember putting it in the fridge!

text.traditional: 那張桌子在一樓，沒被搬上二樓去。
text.simplified: 那张桌子在一楼，没被搬上二楼去。
text.pinyin: Nà zhāng zhuōzi zài yì lóu, méi bèi bān shàng èr lóu qù.
text.english: That table is on the first floor; it was not moved up to the second floor.

text.traditional: 你的東西不要亂放，才不會被媽媽丟了。
text.simplified: 你的东西不要乱放，才不会被妈妈丢了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ de dōngxi búyào luàn fàng, cái bú huì bèi māma diū le.
text.english: Don’t leave your things lying around, so Mom won’t throw them away.

text.traditional: 你那件漂亮的衣服沒被姊姊穿去參加舞會，還掛在衣櫃裡呢！
text.simplified: 你那件漂亮的衣服没被姊姊穿去参加舞会，还挂在衣柜里呢！
text.pinyin: Nǐ nà jiàn piàoliang de yīfu méi bèi jiějie chuān qù cānjiā wǔhuì, hái guà zài yīguì lǐ ne!
text.english: That pretty outfit of yours wasn’t worn by your sister to the dance; it’s still hanging in the wardrobe!

items.question: 「被」和「把」可以互換嗎？
items.answer: 不行。「把」的主語是動作的執行者；「被」的主語是承受動作的人或物。
items.wrongTraditional: 小偷把汽車被偷了。
items.wrongSimplified: 小偷把汽车被偷了。

right.traditional: 汽車被小偷偷了。
right.simplified: 汽车被小偷偷了。
right.pinyin: Qìchē bèi xiǎotōu tōu le.
right.english: The car was stolen by a thief.

items.question: 否定時，「沒」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 「沒」要放在「被」的前面，不能放在動詞前面。
items.wrongTraditional: 那張桌子在一樓，被沒搬上二樓去。
items.wrongSimplified: 那张桌子在一楼，被没搬上二楼去。

right.traditional: 那張桌子在一樓，沒被搬上二樓去。
right.simplified: 那张桌子在一楼，没被搬上二楼去。
right.pinyin: Nà zhāng zhuōzi zài yì lóu, méi bèi bān shàng èr lóu qù.
right.english: That table is on the first floor; it was not moved up to the second floor.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 被 to make a passive sentence. N₁ is the person or thing affected by the action; 被 introduces the doer N₂, which may be left out. In N₁ 被 (N₂) V C, C tells the result or how the action is carried out. Put 沒 before 被 to negate the action.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is one type of passive sentences. “N₁” is the Patient of the verb, while “N₂”, which sometimes would be omitted, is the Agent. Another common pattern is “N₁ 被 (N₂) V C”, where C is the complement denoting the result of the verb or how an action is accomplished. The negation word “沒” must be placed before “被”.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: V著V著: while doing A, B happens
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that one thing happened while someone was doing another.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V著V著」表示動作持續進行時，另一件事接著發生；後面常用「就……了」。兩個子句主語不同時，第二個主語放在「就」前。
grammarPages.pattern: S₁ + V著V著, (S₂) + 就 …… 了

columns.pinyin: jiù wàng le huí jiā de shíjiān
columns.meaning: then forgot the time to go home

text.traditional: 他跟我聊天的時候，聊著聊著就笑了。
text.simplified: 他跟我聊天的时候，聊着聊着就笑了。
text.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ liáotiān de shíhou, liáozhe liáozhe jiù xiào le.
text.english: While he was chatting with me, he started laughing.

text.traditional: 孩子在公園裡玩著玩著，就忘了回家的時間了。
text.simplified: 孩子在公园里玩着玩着，就忘了回家的时间了。
text.pinyin: Háizi zài gōngyuán lǐ wánzhe wánzhe, jiù wàng le huí jiā de shíjiān le.
text.english: The child was playing in the park and then forgot the time to go home.

text.traditional: 我用這枝筆寫字，寫著寫著，不知道為什麼，筆就壞了。
text.simplified: 我用这枝笔写字，写着写着，不知道为什么，笔就坏了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yòng zhè zhī bǐ xiězì, xiězhe xiězhe, bù zhīdào wèishénme, bǐ jiù huài le.
text.english: I was writing with this pen; while writing, for some reason, the pen broke.

items.question: 有兩個主語時，第二個主語放在哪裡？
items.answer: 第二個主語要放在「就」前面，不能放在「就」後面。
items.wrongTraditional: 媽媽說故事給孩子聽，說著說著就孩子睡著了。
items.wrongSimplified: 妈妈说故事给孩子听，说着说着就孩子睡着了。

right.traditional: 媽媽說故事給孩子聽，說著說著孩子就睡著了。
right.simplified: 妈妈说故事给孩子听，说着说着孩子就睡着了。
right.pinyin: Māma shuō gùshì gěi háizi tīng, shuōzhe shuōzhe háizi jiù shuìzháo le.
right.english: Mom told the child a story; while she was telling it, the child fell asleep.

items.question: 「聊著聊著」和「聊一聊」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「V著V著」表示一邊做一邊發生另一件事；「V一V」表示做一下。
items.wrongTraditional: 他跟我聊天的時候，聊一聊就笑了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他跟我聊天的时候，聊一聊就笑了。

right.traditional: 他跟我聊天的時候，聊著聊著就笑了。
right.simplified: 他跟我聊天的时候，聊着聊着就笑了。
right.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ liáotiān de shíhou, liáozhe liáozhe jiù xiào le.
right.english: While he was chatting with me, he started laughing.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: V著V著 describes one action continuing until another event happens. Pattern: S₁ + V著V著，（S₂）+ 就 + event + 了. If the second clause has a different subject, put S₂ before 就.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: If there are two subjects (S₁, S₂), S₂ should be placed in front of “就”, “S₁+ V著V著，(S₂)+就……了”.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give the one easy condition that solves a problem.
grammarPages.explanation: 「只要」引出足以帶來結果的條件，「就」引出結果。課本把這個句型用來說明解決問題的簡單方法。
grammarPages.pattern: 只要 + Condition, (Subject) + 就 + Result

columns.traditional: 跟門口的人說你的名字
columns.simplified: 跟门口的人说你的名字
columns.pinyin: gēn ménkǒu de rén shuō nǐ de míngzi
columns.meaning: tell the person at the gate your name
finish paying the deposit and rent

columns.pinyin: wǒ jiù huì bǎ yàoshi gěi nǐ

text.traditional: A：請問，我要怎麼參加學校的網球比賽？B：很簡單，只要跟老師說就可以了。
text.simplified: A：请问，我要怎么参加学校的网球比赛？B：很简单，只要跟老师说就可以了。
text.pinyin: A: Qǐngwèn, wǒ yào zěnme cānjiā xuéxiào de wǎngqiú bǐsài? B: Hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyào gēn lǎoshī shuō jiù kěyǐ le.
text.english: A: May I ask, how do I join the school tennis competition? B: Very simple—just tell the teacher and that’s fine.

text.traditional: A：喂，我到你家大樓門口了，要怎麼進去呢？B：你只要跟門口的人說你的名字，就可以進來了。
text.simplified: A：喂，我到你家大楼门口了，要怎么进去呢？B：你只要跟门口的人说你的名字，就可以进来了。
text.pinyin: A: Wèi, wǒ dào nǐ jiā dàlóu ménkǒu le, yào zěnme jìnqù ne? B: Nǐ zhǐyào gēn ménkǒu de rén shuō nǐ de míngzi, jiù kěyǐ jìnlái le.
text.english: A: Hello, I’m at the entrance of your building. How do I get in? B: Just tell the person at the gate your name, and you can come in.

text.traditional: 錢先生：我什麼時候能搬進去？王太太：只要付完押金和房租，我就會把鑰匙給你。
text.simplified: 钱先生：我什么时候能搬进去？王太太：只要付完押金和房租，我就会把钥匙给你。
text.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng: Wǒ shénme shíhou néng bān jìnqù? Wáng tàitai: Zhǐyào fù wán yājīn hé fángzū, wǒ jiù huì bǎ yàoshi gěi nǐ.
text.english: Mr. Qian: When can I move in? Mrs. Wang: As long as you finish paying the deposit and rent, I’ll give you the key.

items.question: 「只要……就……」的結果前面用「就」還是「才」？
items.answer: 用「就」；「才」表示條件很難或結果來得晚，不能跟「只要」搭配。
items.wrongTraditional: 只要跟老師說才可以了。
items.wrongSimplified: 只要跟老师说才可以了。

right.traditional: 只要跟老師說就可以了。
right.simplified: 只要跟老师说就可以了。
right.pinyin: Zhǐyào gēn lǎoshī shuō jiù kěyǐ le.
right.english: Just tell the teacher and that’s fine.

items.question: 「只要」和「要是」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「只要」表示條件一滿足就夠了；「要是」只表示假設。
items.wrongTraditional: 要是跟老師說就可以了。
items.wrongSimplified: 要是跟老师说就可以了。

right.traditional: 只要跟老師說就可以了。
right.simplified: 只要跟老师说就可以了。
right.pinyin: Zhǐyào gēn lǎoshī shuō jiù kěyǐ le.
right.english: Just tell the teacher and that’s fine.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 只要 introduces a condition that is enough to bring about a result; 就 introduces that result. The examples use this pattern to explain a simple way to do something: once the condition is met, the action or outcome can follow.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates an easy solution to a problem. If the condition coming after “只要” is fulfilled, the problem can be solved.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 有時候……，有時候……: sometimes … sometimes …
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that you do two different things some of the time.
grammarPages.explanation: 「有時候」放在兩個動作或情況前，說明它們發生的頻率；也可以是同一個動作搭配不同對象。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 有時候 + Action 1, 有時候 + Action 2

text.traditional: A：你去夜市的時候，常常吃雞排嗎？B：不一定，有時候吃雞排，有時候吃烤魷魚。
text.simplified: A：你去夜市的时候，常常吃鸡排吗？B：不一定，有时候吃鸡排，有时候吃烤鱿鱼。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ qù yèshì de shíhou, chángcháng chī jīpái ma? B: Bù yídìng, yǒu shíhou chī jīpái, yǒu shíhou chī kǎo yóuyú.
text.english: A: When you go to the night market, do you often eat chicken cutlets? B: Not necessarily; sometimes I eat chicken cutlets, and sometimes I eat grilled squid.

text.traditional: A：放假的時候我喜歡去露營，你呢？B：我有時候去旅行，有時候在家休息。
text.simplified: A：放假的时候我喜欢去露营，你呢？B：我有时候去旅行，有时候在家休息。
text.pinyin: A: Fàngjià de shíhou wǒ xǐhuan qù lùyíng, nǐ ne? B: Wǒ yǒu shíhou qù lǚxíng, yǒu shíhou zài jiā xiūxí.
text.english: A: On holidays I like to go camping. What about you? B: Sometimes I travel, and sometimes I rest at home.

text.traditional: A：每天下課以後，你都去哪裡？B：有時候去圖書館看書，有時候回家寫功課。
text.simplified: A：每天下课以后，你都去哪里？B：有时候去图书馆看书，有时候回家写功课。
text.pinyin: A: Měi tiān xiàkè yǐhòu, nǐ dōu qù nǎlǐ? B: Yǒu shíhou qù túshūguǎn kàn shū, yǒu shíhou huí jiā xiě gōngkè.
text.english: A: Where do you go every day after class? B: Sometimes I go to the library to read, and sometimes I go home to do homework.

items.question: 「有時候」要放在動詞前面還是後面？
items.answer: 要放在動詞前面：有時候吃雞排、有時候去旅行。
items.wrongTraditional: 我吃有時候雞排，去有時候旅行。
items.wrongSimplified: 我吃有时候鸡排，去有时候旅行。

right.traditional: 我有時候吃雞排，有時候去旅行。
right.simplified: 我有时候吃鸡排，有时候去旅行。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou chī jīpái, yǒu shíhou qù lǚxíng.
right.english: Sometimes I eat chicken cutlets, and sometimes I go traveling.

items.question: 「有時候……，有時候……」可以只說一個「有時候」嗎？
items.answer: 這個句型要成對出現，說出兩種交替發生的情況。
items.wrongTraditional: 我有時候去旅行。
items.wrongSimplified: 我有时候去旅行。

right.traditional: 我有時候去旅行，有時候在家休息。
right.simplified: 我有时候去旅行，有时候在家休息。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou qù lǚxíng, yǒu shíhou zài jiā xiūxí.
right.english: Sometimes I travel, and sometimes I rest at home.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 有時候…有時候… tells how often two actions or situations happen. The actions can be different, or the same action with different objects.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The frequency adverb “sometimes” in this pattern indicates the frequency of two actions. (It can be same action with different objects.)

items.title: Grammar 5–8 · Happy Community

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我住的地方叫「幸福社區」，這個社區在台北市的郊區，我跟妹妹都是在這裡長大的。雖然社區很大，環境很好，可是因為在山上，走起路來很辛苦，所以每次出門，都得搭社區的小巴士。還好巴士每十五分鐘就有一班，要不然就會很麻煩。
lines.simplified: 我住的地方叫「幸福社区」，这个社区在台北市的郊区，我跟妹妹都是在这里长大的。虽然社区很大，环境很好，可是因为在山上，走起路来很辛苦，所以每次出门，都得搭社区的小巴士。还好巴士每十五分钟就有一班，要不然就会很麻烦。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jiào 「Xìngfú Shèqū」, zhège shèqū zài Táiběi Shì de jiāoqū, wǒ gēn mèimei dōu shì zài zhèlǐ zhǎngdà de. Suīrán shèqū hěn dà, huánjìng hěn hǎo, kěshì yīnwèi zài shān shàng, zǒu qǐ lù lái hěn xīnkǔ, suǒyǐ měi cì chūmén, dōu děi dā shèqū de xiǎo bāshì. Háihǎo bāshì měi shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù yǒu yì bān, yàobùrán jiù huì hěn máfán.
lines.english: The place where I live is called “Happy Community”. This community is in the suburbs of Taipei City. My younger sister and I grew up here. Although the community is very big and the environment is very good, it is located in the mountains, and we have a hard time walking along the road. Therefore, every time we go out, we have to take the community’s minibus. Fortunately, the bus comes every fifteen minutes; otherwise it would be very troublesome.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 幸福社區很安全，如果有客人來，都得經過大門口，門口的安全人員覺得沒有問題了，才可以進來。這個社區也有很大的草地、漂亮的花園和新鮮的空氣。客人到了這裡，就像到了公園一樣輕鬆。花園旁邊有一家書店跟二十四小時的超級市場，超市的停車場可以停很多車，停多久都不需要付停車費。
lines.simplified: 幸福社区很安全，如果有客人来，都得经过大门口，门口的安全人员觉得没有问题了，才可以进来。这个社区也有很大的草地、漂亮的花园和新鲜的空气。客人到了这里，就像到了公园一样轻松。花园旁边有一家书店跟二十四小时的超级市场，超市的停车场可以停很多车，停多久都不需要付停车费。
lines.pinyin: Xìngfú shèqū hěn ānquán, rúguǒ yǒu kèrén lái, dōu děi jīngguò dàménkǒu, ménkǒu de ānquán rényuán juéde méiyǒu wèntí le, cái kěyǐ jìnlái. Zhège shèqū yě yǒu hěn dà de cǎodì, piàoliang de huāyuán hé xīnxiān de kōngqì. Kèrén dào le zhèlǐ, jiù xiàng dào le gōngyuán yíyàng qīngsōng. Huāyuán pángbiān yǒu yì jiā shūdiàn gēn èrshísì xiǎoshí de chāojí shìchǎng, chāoshì de tíngchēchǎng kěyǐ tíng hěn duō chē, tíng duō jiǔ dōu bù xūyào fù tíngchēfèi.
lines.english: Happy Community is very safe. If there are guests coming in, they must pass through the main gate. Only if the security guard at the gate thinks there is no problem can they get in. This community also has a big lawn, a beautiful garden, and fresh air. When guests come here, it is just like they come to a park, they feel relaxed. Next to the garden there is a bookstore and a 24-hour supermarket. The parking lot of the supermarket can accommodate a lot of cars. No matter how long you park, you don’t need to pay the parking fee.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 每年的中秋節，社區的人都會坐在草地上，一邊看著又大又圓的月亮，一邊吃著又香又甜的月餅，開心極了！我覺得住在這裡真是太幸福了，你想不想搬來當我的鄰居呢？
lines.simplified: 每年的中秋节，社区的人都会坐在草地上，一边看着又大又圆的月亮，一边吃着又香又甜的月饼，开心极了！我觉得住在这里真是太幸福了，你想不想搬来当我的邻居呢？
lines.pinyin: Měi nián de Zhōngqiū jié, shèqū de rén dōu huì zuò zài cǎodì shàng, yìbiān kànzhe yòu dà yòu yuán de yuèliàng, yìbiān chīzhe yòu xiāng yòu tián de yuèbǐng, kāixīn jí le! Wǒ juéde zhù zài zhèlǐ zhēnshi tài xìngfú le, nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng bān lái dāng wǒ de línjū ne?
lines.english: On Mid-Autumn Festival every year, people living in the community would sit on the lawn watching the big and round moon and eating fragrant and sweet moon cakes with great joy! I am really happy to live here. Do you want to move here and become my neighbor?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Vs起來 / V起（O）來: start and keep going
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that an action or state starts and keeps going.
grammarPages.explanation: 「起來」表示動作或狀態開始並持續。放在句尾時也可表示結果；「V起（O）來」若放在前句，後句可修飾前句。有賓語時，賓語放在「起」和「來」之間，例如「下起雨來」「說起話來」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Vs起來 / V起 (O) 來

columns.pinyin: jiù tiào qǐ wǔ lái le
zěnme wán qǐ shǒujī lái le
columns.meaning: why started playing with the phone

text.traditional: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就熱鬧起來了。
text.simplified: 到了下午四、五点，夜市就热闹起来了。
text.pinyin: Dào le xiàwǔ sì, wǔ diǎn, yèshì jiù rènao qǐlái le.
text.english: At four or five in the afternoon, the night market became lively.

text.traditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就跳起舞來了。
text.simplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就跳起舞来了。
text.pinyin: Nàge háizi yì tīngdào yīnyuè, jiù tiào qǐ wǔ lái le.
text.english: As soon as that child heard the music, he started dancing.

text.traditional: 現在在上課，你怎麼玩起手機來了？
text.simplified: 现在在上课，你怎么玩起手机来了？
text.pinyin: Xiànzài zài shàngkè, nǐ zěnme wán qǐ shǒujī lái le?
text.english: We’re in class now—why have you started playing with your phone?

items.question: 要說夜市開始熱鬧，用「起來」還是「極了」？
items.answer: 「起來」表示開始並持續；「極了」表示程度最高。
items.wrongTraditional: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就開始熱鬧極了。
items.wrongSimplified: 到了下午四、五点，夜市就开始热闹极了。

right.traditional: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就熱鬧起來了。
right.simplified: 到了下午四、五点，夜市就热闹起来了。
right.pinyin: Dào le xiàwǔ sì, wǔ diǎn, yèshì jiù rènao qǐlái le.
right.english: At four or five in the afternoon, the night market became lively.

items.question: 有賓語時，「起來」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 賓語要放在「起」和「來」中間：跳起舞來、下起雨來。
items.wrongTraditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就跳起來舞了。
items.wrongSimplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就跳起来舞了。

right.traditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就跳起舞來了。
right.simplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就跳起舞来了。
right.pinyin: Nàge háizi yì tīngdào yīnyuè, jiù tiào qǐ wǔ lái le.
right.english: As soon as that child heard the music, he started dancing.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: V起來 or V起（O）來 can show that an action or state begins and continues. At the end of a sentence, 起來 can also describe a resulting state. When V起（O）來 comes before another clause, that clause can describe the action or state. If there is an object, put it between 起 and 來, as in 下起雨來 and 說起話來.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “Vs 起來/V 起 (O) 來” indicates an action or a status begins and lasts. Sometimes, it would be placed at the end of a sentence to show results. If “V 起 (O) 來” is placed in the former part of a sentence, the latter part is used to modify the former one. If an object exists, it should be placed between “起” and “來”, e.g., “下起雨來”, “說起話來”, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what you are lucky happened, and what would have happened otherwise.
grammarPages.explanation: 「還好」引出值得慶幸的情況；「要不然」引出若沒有前述情況就可能發生的負面結果。
grammarPages.pattern: 還好 + Good situation, 要不然 + Bad result

columns.pinyin: jiù bù néng qù lùyíng le
shénme dōngxi dōu bù néng mǎi le
jiù děi zài kǎo yí cì le
columns.meaning: then I’d have to take it again

text.traditional: 還好今天沒下雨，要不然就不能去露營了。
text.simplified: 还好今天没下雨，要不然就不能去露营了。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo jīntiān méi xiàyǔ, yàobùrán jiù bù néng qù lùyíng le.
text.english: Fortunately it didn’t rain today; otherwise we couldn’t go camping.

text.traditional: 還好我帶了錢，要不然什麼東西都不能買了。
text.simplified: 还好我带了钱，要不然什么东西都不能买了。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ dài le qián, yàobùrán shénme dōngxi dōu bù néng mǎi le.
text.english: Fortunately I brought money; otherwise I couldn’t buy anything.

text.traditional: 還好我的期中考成績不錯，要不然就得再考一次了。
text.simplified: 还好我的期中考成绩不错，要不然就得再考一次了。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ de qízhōngkǎo chéngjī búcuò, yàobùrán jiù děi zài kǎo yí cì le.
text.english: Fortunately my midterm grade was good; otherwise I’d have to take it again.

items.question: 「還好」後面接好情況還是壞結果？
items.answer: 「還好」後面接值得慶幸的好情況；「要不然」後面才是可能發生的壞結果。
items.wrongTraditional: 還好不能去露營了，要不然今天沒下雨。
items.wrongSimplified: 还好不能去露营了，要不然今天没下雨。

right.traditional: 還好今天沒下雨，要不然就不能去露營了。
right.simplified: 还好今天没下雨，要不然就不能去露营了。
right.pinyin: Háihǎo jīntiān méi xiàyǔ, yàobùrán jiù bù néng qù lùyíng le.
right.english: Fortunately it didn’t rain today; otherwise we couldn’t go camping.

items.question: 「還好」和「但是」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「還好」表示慶幸；「但是」只表示轉折。
items.wrongTraditional: 但是我帶了錢，要不然什麼東西都不能買了。
items.wrongSimplified: 但是我带了钱，要不然什么东西都不能买了。

right.traditional: 還好我帶了錢，要不然什麼東西都不能買了。
right.simplified: 还好我带了钱，要不然什么东西都不能买了。
right.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ dài le qián, yàobùrán shénme dōngxi dōu bù néng mǎi le.
right.english: Fortunately I brought money; otherwise I couldn’t buy anything.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 還好 introduces a fortunate situation. 要不然 introduces the bad result that could have happened if things had gone differently.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates the situation described after “還好” is appreciated, without it, a negative result after “要不然” could happen.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 每 + time + verb + frequency: how often
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how often something happens with 每.
grammarPages.explanation: 「每＋時間單位＋（就）＋動作＋次數」表示動作發生的頻率。加「就」可強調動作發生得更頻繁。
grammarPages.pattern: 每 + Nu + M₁ (+ 就) + V + Nu + M₂ (+ N)

text.traditional: 我們的中文課每四課考一次（試）。
text.simplified: 我们的中文课每四课考一次（试）。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè měi sì kè kǎo yí cì (shì).
text.english: Our Chinese class has a test every four lessons.

text.traditional: 山本良介每半年就回一次日本。
text.simplified: 山本良介每半年就回一次日本。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè měi bàn nián jiù huí yí cì Rìběn.
text.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto returns to Japan once every half year.

text.traditional: 我朋友很喜歡牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
text.simplified: 我朋友很喜欢牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
text.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou hěn xǐhuan niúròu, měi sān tiān jiù chī yí cì niúpái.
text.english: My friend really likes beef and eats steak once every three days.

items.question: 「每四課考一次」的「一次」可以放在動詞前面嗎？
items.answer: 不行。次數要放在動詞後面：考一次、回一次。
items.wrongTraditional: 我們的中文課每四課一次考。
items.wrongSimplified: 我们的中文课每四课一次考。

right.traditional: 我們的中文課每四課考一次。
right.simplified: 我们的中文课每四课考一次。
right.pinyin: Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè měi sì kè kǎo yí cì.
right.english: Our Chinese class has a test every four lessons.

items.question: 「每」可以接具體的數量嗎？
items.answer: 可以，但「每」要放在數量前面，表示每三天一次、每四課一次。
items.wrongTraditional: 我朋友很喜歡牛肉，三天每就吃一次牛排。
items.wrongSimplified: 我朋友很喜欢牛肉，三天每就吃一次牛排。

right.traditional: 我朋友很喜歡牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
right.simplified: 我朋友很喜欢牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
right.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou hěn xǐhuan niúròu, měi sān tiān jiù chī yí cì niúpái.
right.english: My friend really likes beef and eats steak once every three days.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 每 + time unit + (就) + action + number of times tells how often an action happens. Adding 就 emphasizes that it happens frequently.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates the frequency of an action. “就” can be added to emphasize that the action occurs more frequently.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Welcome to My House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: A像B一樣 (+Vs): A is just like B
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that two people or things are alike.
grammarPages.explanation: 「A像B一樣」表示A和B有相似之處；需要說明相似之處時，放在「一樣」後。A、B可以是名詞短語、動詞短語或子句，不限於形容詞。
grammarPages.pattern: A + 像 + B + 一樣 (+ Vs)

columns.traditional: 像金先生住的社區一樣
columns.simplified: 像金先生住的社区一样
columns.pinyin: xiàng Jīn xiānsheng zhù de shèqū yíyàng
columns.meaning: like the community Mr. Jin lives in

text.traditional: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社區一樣安全。
text.simplified: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社区一样安全。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de gōngyù xiàng Jīn xiānsheng zhù de shèqū yíyàng ānquán.
text.english: The apartment I live in is as safe as the community Mr. Jin lives in.

text.traditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅，真可愛！
text.simplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红，真可爱！
text.pinyin: Nàge háizi de liǎn xiàng píngguǒ yíyàng hóng, zhēn kě’ài!
text.english: That child’s face is red like an apple—so cute!

text.traditional: 哥哥愛吃牛肉麵，就像爸爸愛吃牛排一樣。
text.simplified: 哥哥爱吃牛肉面，就像爸爸爱吃牛排一样。
text.pinyin: Gēge ài chī niúròu miàn, jiù xiàng bàba ài chī niúpái yíyàng.
text.english: My older brother loves beef noodles, just like Dad loves steak.

text.traditional: 弟弟覺得逛百貨公司像參觀博物館一樣無聊，所以他不要去。
text.simplified: 弟弟觉得逛百货公司像参观博物馆一样无聊，所以他不要去。
text.pinyin: Dìdi juéde guàng bǎihuò gōngsī xiàng cānguān bówùguǎn yíyàng wúliáo, suǒyǐ tā bú yào qù.
text.english: My younger brother thinks going to a department store is as boring as visiting a museum, so he doesn’t want to go.

items.question: 「比」和「像……一樣」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「比」比較高低；「像……一樣」表示相似。
items.wrongTraditional: 我住的公寓比金先生住的社區一樣安全。
items.wrongSimplified: 我住的公寓比金先生住的社区一样安全。

right.traditional: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社區一樣安全。
right.simplified: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社区一样安全。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de gōngyù xiàng Jīn xiānsheng zhù de shèqū yíyàng ānquán.
right.english: The apartment I live in is as safe as the community Mr. Jin lives in.

items.question: 「一樣」可以放在形容詞後面嗎？
items.answer: 不行。「一樣」要放在形容詞前面：像蘋果一樣紅。
items.wrongTraditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果紅一樣。
items.wrongSimplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果红一样。

right.traditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅。
right.simplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红。
right.pinyin: Nàge háizi de liǎn xiàng píngguǒ yíyàng hóng.
right.english: That child’s face is red like an apple.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: A像B一樣 says that A is similar to B. Add the point of similarity after 一樣, such as an adjective. A and B can be noun phrases, verb phrases, or clauses.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates two things or situations having something similar. If further explanation of the similarity is needed, it should come after “一樣”. A and B in this pattern can be NPs, VPs or clauses.

items.title: Grammar 1–6 · Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 下星期六是可欣的生日，我們要怎麼慶祝呢？
lines.simplified: 下星期六是可欣的生日，我们要怎么庆祝呢？
lines.pinyin: Xià xīngqīliù shì Kěxīn de shēngrì, wǒmen yào zěnme qìngzhù ne?
lines.english: Next Saturday is Kexin's birthday. How are we going to celebrate it?

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 她愛唱歌，去KTV幫她過生日，好不好？
lines.simplified: 她爱唱歌，去KTV帮她过生日，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Tā ài chànggē, qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, hǎo bu hǎo?
lines.english: She loves singing. Let's go to a KTV bar and celebrate her birthday there, OK?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 太好了！我很想看看台灣的KTV，聽說跟日本的有點兒不同。
lines.simplified: 太好了！我很想看看台湾的KTV，听说跟日本的有点儿不同。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ hěn xiǎng kànkan Táiwān de KTV, tīngshuō gēn Rìběn de yǒudiǎnr bùtóng.
lines.english: Great! I want to see the KTV in Taiwan. I heard it's a little bit different than in Japan.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我覺得都差不多，可是很多台灣的KTV可以吃到飽。
lines.simplified: 我觉得都差不多，可是很多台湾的KTV可以吃到饱。
