lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dōu chàbùduō, kěshì hěn duō Táiwān de KTV kěyǐ chīdàobǎo.
lines.english: I think there's no big difference. But in many Taiwanese KTV bars, you can eat as much as you want.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？我沒聽過日本有吃到飽的KTV，不過，我去KTV的目的不是吃東西，是唱歌。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？我没听过日本有吃到饱的KTV，不过，我去KTV的目的不是吃东西，是唱歌。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ méi tīngguò Rìběn yǒu chīdàobǎo de KTV, búguò, wǒ qù KTV de mùdì bú shì chī dōngxi, shì chànggē.
lines.english: Really? I haven't heard about any all-you-can-eat KTV bar in Japan. But the purpose I go to the KTV is to sing, not to eat.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我聽說，日本人跟朋友去KTV的時候，每個人一次只能點一首歌，點好了就換下一個人，是真的嗎？
lines.simplified: 我听说，日本人跟朋友去KTV的时候，每个人一次只能点一首歌，点好了就换下一个人，是真的吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō, Rìběnrén gēn péngyou qù KTV de shíhou, měi ge rén yí cì zhǐ néng diǎn yì shǒu gē, diǎn hǎo le jiù huàn xià yí ge rén, shì zhēn de ma?
lines.english: I heard that when the Japanese go to KTV bars with friends, one person can order only one song each time. After ordering the song, it is another one's turn. Is that right?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 沒錯，跟台灣不一樣嗎？
lines.simplified: 没错，跟台湾不一样吗？
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò, gēn Táiwān bù yíyàng ma?
lines.english: That's right! Is it different from Taiwan?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我們喜歡大家合唱，這樣比較熱鬧，唱錯了也沒關係。
lines.simplified: 我们喜欢大家合唱，这样比较热闹，唱错了也没关系。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xǐhuan dàjiā héchàng, zhèyàng bǐjiào rènao, chàng cuò le yě méi guānxi.
lines.english: We like singing altogether. It's more lively that way and it doesn't matter if you sing it wrong.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 有一次我們在KTV唱歌，隔壁的人唱得好開心，又唱又跳，感覺地板都動起來了。
lines.simplified: 有一次我们在KTV唱歌，隔壁的人唱得好开心，又唱又跳，感觉地板都动起来了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì wǒmen zài KTV chànggē, gébì de rén chàng de hěn kāixīn, yòu chàng yòu tiào, gǎnjué dìbǎn dōu dòng qǐlái le.
lines.english: Once while we were singing in a KTV bar, the people next door were singing so happily. They were both singing and dancing. It felt like the floor was starting to move.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 聽美心說你很會唱歌，可以教我唱中文歌嗎？
lines.simplified: 听美心说你很会唱歌，可以教我唱中文歌吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīng Měixīn shuō nǐ hěn huì chànggē, kěyǐ jiāo wǒ chàng Zhōngwén gē ma?
lines.english: I heard from Meixin that you sing very well. Can you teach me how to sing Chinese songs?

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 沒問題，我先教你唱簡單的，你一定很快就學會了。
lines.simplified: 没问题，我先教你唱简单的，你一定很快就学会了。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ xiān jiāo nǐ chàng jiǎndān de, nǐ yídìng hěn kuài jiù xuéhuì le.
lines.english: No problem. I'll teach you to sing the simple ones first. You'll learn it very fast for sure.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 台灣的KTV也有很多日文歌曲，你可以選幾首拿手的，在可欣生日那天，唱給大家聽。
lines.simplified: 台湾的KTV也有很多日文歌曲，你可以选几首拿手的，在可欣生日那天，唱给大家听。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV yě yǒu hěn duō Rìwén gēqǔ, nǐ kěyǐ xuǎn jǐ shǒu náshǒu de, zài Kěxīn shēngrì nà tiān, chàng gěi dàjiā tīng.
lines.english: Taiwanese KTV bars have many Japanese songs, too. You can choose a few songs that you mastered and sing them for everyone on Kexin's birthday.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 可是我很容易緊張，要是唱不好怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 可是我很容易紧张，要是唱不好怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ hěn róngyì jǐnzhāng, yàoshi chàng bu hǎo zěnme bàn?
lines.english: But I get nervous very easily. What shall I do if I don't sing well?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 沒關係。我每次去KTV，總是把自己當歌星，想像那是我的演唱會，想唱什麼就唱什麼，自己開心最重要。
lines.simplified: 没关系。我每次去KTV，总是把自己当歌星，想象那是我的演唱会，想唱什么就唱什么，自己开心最重要。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi. Wǒ měi cì qù KTV, zǒngshì bǎ zìjǐ dāng gēxīng, xiǎngxiàng nà shì wǒ de yǎnchànghuì, xiǎng chàng shénme jiù chàng shénme, zìjǐ kāixīn zuì zhòngyào.
lines.english: It doesn't matter. Every time I go to a KTV bar, I always act like a singer and imagine that was my concert. I sing what I want to sing. My own happiness is the most important.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我看過一個日本的電視節目，在KTV唱歌的時候，用機器給唱歌的人打分數，這樣就可以知道自己唱得怎麼樣。
lines.simplified: 我看过一个日本的电视节目，在KTV唱歌的时候，用机器给唱歌的人打分数，这样就可以知道自己唱得怎么样。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kànguò yí ge Rìběn de diànshì jiémù, zài KTV chànggē de shíhou, yòng jīqì gěi chànggē de rén dǎ fēnshù, zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ chàng de zěnmeyàng.
lines.english: I've seen a Japanese TV show. While people were singing in a KTV bar, they used a machine to score the singing. In that way they could find out how well they sang.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 聽起來好像是考試，好可怕！
lines.simplified: 听起来好像是考试，好可怕！
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái hǎoxiàng shì kǎoshì, hǎo kěpà!
lines.english: It sounds like an exam. So scary!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 那種機器常常弄錯，有時候我覺得唱得不差，可是分數很低。
lines.simplified: 那种机器常常弄错，有时候我觉得唱得不差，可是分数很低。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhǒng jīqì chángcháng nòngcuò, yǒu shíhou wǒ juéde chàng de bù chà, kěshì fēnshù hěn dī.
lines.english: That kind of machine often goes wrong. Sometimes I think my singing is not bad, but the score is very low.

lines.speaker: 美心、明生
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈！
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈！
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā!
lines.english: Hahaha! (laughing)

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我們去KTV那天，我教你一些唱歌的方法吧！
lines.simplified: 我们去KTV那天，我教你一些唱歌的方法吧！
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen qù KTV nà tiān, wǒ jiāo nǐ yìxiē chànggē de fāngfǎ ba!
lines.english: Let me teach you some singing methods on the day we go to a KTV bar.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: （興奮地說）太棒了！我一定會好好練習的，這樣就不怕機器給我打分數了。
lines.simplified: （兴奋地说）太棒了！我一定会好好练习的，这样就不怕机器给我打分数了。
lines.pinyin: (Xīngfèn de shuō) Tài bàng le! Wǒ yídìng huì hǎohǎo liànxí de, zhèyàng jiù bú pà jīqì gěi wǒ dǎ fēnshù le.
lines.english: (says excitedly) Awesome! I will definitely practice well, so I am not afraid of the machine giving me a score.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 對了，我們要買什麼禮物送給可欣呢？
lines.simplified: 对了，我们要买什么礼物送给可欣呢？
lines.pinyin: Duì le, wǒmen yào mǎi shénme lǐwù sòng gěi Kěxīn ne?
lines.english: By the way, what gifts are we going to give Kexin?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （大家想一想）
lines.simplified: （大家想一想）
lines.pinyin: (Dàjiā xiǎng yi xiǎng)
lines.english: (Everyone was thinking...)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我想到了！可欣很喜歡香水，我們送她一瓶香水吧。
lines.simplified: 我想到了！可欣很喜欢香水，我们送她一瓶香水吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngdào le! Kěxīn hěn xǐhuan xiāngshuǐ, wǒmen sòng tā yì píng xiāngshuǐ ba.
lines.english: I have an idea! Kexin likes perfume. Let's give her a bottle of perfume.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我還要送她巧克力跟一大束紅玫瑰，九十九朵喔！
lines.simplified: 我还要送她巧克力跟一大束红玫瑰，九十九朵喔！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái yào sòng tā qiǎokèlì gēn yí dà shù hóng méigui, jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ o!
lines.english: I also want to send her chocolate and a big bunch of red roses, with ninety-nine flowers!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 別忘了買蛋糕跟幾罐啤酒喔！
lines.simplified: 别忘了买蛋糕跟几罐啤酒喔！
lines.pinyin: Bié wàng le mǎi dàngāo gēn jǐ guàn píjiǔ o!
lines.english: Don't forget to buy a cake and a few cans of beer!

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 那麼等可欣下課以後，我就告訴她這個好消息。
lines.simplified: 那么等可欣下课以后，我就告诉她这个好消息。
lines.pinyin: Nàme děng Kěxīn xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ jiù gàosu tā zhège hǎo xiāoxí.
lines.english: Well, when Kexin finishes her classes, I'll tell her this piece of good news.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something is finished and ready, or done well or badly.
grammarPages.explanation: 「好」放在動詞後面當結果補語，表示動作完成，而且結果理想。「V好了」說完成了、準備好了；「沒V好」說還沒完成；「V得好／V不好」說做得好或做得不好。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (還沒) + V + 好 (+ Object)

columns.pinyin: hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo
columns.meaning: have not finished your homework yet

columns.pinyin: zuò de hǎo zuò bu hǎo
columns.meaning: can do it well or not

text.traditional: 媽媽把明天要去野餐的東西都準備好了。
text.simplified: 妈妈把明天要去野餐的东西都准备好了。
text.pinyin: Māma bǎ míngtiān yào qù yěcān de dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
text.english: Mom has got everything for tomorrow's picnic ready.

words.pinyin: míngtiān yào qù yěcān de dōngxi

text.traditional: 你還沒把功課寫好，不能出去踢足球。
text.simplified: 你还没把功课写好，不能出去踢足球。
text.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo, bù néng chūqù tī zúqiú.
text.english: You haven't finished your homework yet; you can't go out to play soccer.

text.traditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然學不好。
text.simplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然学不好。
text.pinyin: Xué xīn de yǔyán, yàoshi nǐ bù cháng liànxí, dāngrán xué bu hǎo.
text.english: If you don't practice often, of course you won't learn a new language well.

text.traditional: 這份工作不簡單，你覺得他做得好做不好？
text.simplified: 这份工作不简单，你觉得他做得好做不好？
text.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò bù jiǎndān, nǐ juéde tā zuò de hǎo zuò bu hǎo?
text.english: This job is not easy. Do you think he can do it well or not?

words.pinyin: zuò de hǎo zuò bu hǎo
words.meaning: can do it well or not

items.question: 「V好了」和「V得好」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「V好了」說動作完成、準備好了；「V得好」說做得好不好。
items.wrongTraditional: 你還沒把功課寫得好，不能出去踢足球。
items.wrongSimplified: 你还没把功课写得好，不能出去踢足球。

right.traditional: 你還沒把功課寫好，不能出去踢足球。
right.simplified: 你还没把功课写好，不能出去踢足球。
right.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo, bù néng chūqù tī zúqiú.
right.english: You haven't finished your homework yet; you can't go out to play soccer.

words.traditional: 你還沒把功課寫好，不能出去踢足球。
words.simplified: 你还没把功课写好，不能出去踢足球。
words.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo, bù néng chūqù tī zúqiú.
words.meaning: You haven't finished your homework yet; you can't go out to play soccer.

items.question: 「學不好」的「不」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在「好」前面，說結果不好；「不學好」是「不學」加「好」，意思不同。
items.wrongTraditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然不學好。
items.wrongSimplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然不学好。

right.traditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然學不好。
right.simplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然学不好。
right.pinyin: Xué xīn de yǔyán, yàoshi nǐ bù cháng liànxí, dāngrán xué bu hǎo.
right.english: If you don't practice often, of course you won't learn a new language well.

words.traditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然學不好。
words.simplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然学不好。
words.pinyin: Xué xīn de yǔyán, yàoshi nǐ bù cháng liànxí, dāngrán xué bu hǎo.
words.meaning: If you don't practice often, of course you won't learn a new language well.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 好 after a verb is a result complement. V好 means the action is finished with the intended result, often meaning something is ready. 沒V好 means it is not finished yet; V得好 and V不好 describe how well the action is done.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: 「好」is placed after the verb and acts as a verb complement. When used together with a verb, 「好」serves as a verb complement denoting the action is finished with an ideal result.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone did something wrong, or did not do it wrong.
grammarPages.explanation: 「錯」放在動詞後面當結果補語，表示動作的結果是錯的。「V錯了」說做了，可是做錯了；「沒V錯」說沒有做錯。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (沒) + V + 錯 (+ Object)

subsections.title: V錯了: did something wrong
subsections.explanation: 「錯」放在動詞後面，表示動作的結果是錯的；後面可以接受詞。

subsections.title: 沒V錯: did not do something wrong
subsections.explanation: 「沒」放在動詞前面，表示沒有做錯；不要再用「了」。

text.traditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你聽錯了。
text.simplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你听错了。
text.pinyin: Tā shì Huáng xiānsheng bú shì Wáng xiānsheng, nǐ tīng cuò le.
text.english: He is Mr. Huang, not Mr. Wang; you heard wrong.

text.traditional: 今天早上我坐錯了車，所以上班遲到了。
text.simplified: 今天早上我坐错了车，所以上班迟到了。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ zuò cuò le chē, suǒyǐ shàngbān chídào le.
text.english: This morning I took the wrong bus, so I was late for work.

text.traditional: A：我們要去看的演唱會是下個星期六不是這個星期六。B：真的嗎？我記錯了時間嗎？
text.simplified: A：我们要去看的演唱会是下个星期六不是这个星期六。B：真的吗？我记错了时间吗？
text.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào qù kàn de yǎnchànghuì shì xià ge xīngqīliù bú shì zhège xīngqīliù. B: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ jì cuò le shíjiān ma?
text.english: A: The concert we're going to is next Saturday, not this Saturday. B: Really? Did I remember the time wrong?

words.pinyin: wǒmen yào qù kàn de yǎnchànghuì

text.traditional: 孩子沒做錯事，你為什麼要打他？
text.simplified: 孩子没做错事，你为什么要打他？
text.pinyin: Háizi méi zuò cuò shì, nǐ wèishénme yào dǎ tā?
text.english: The child didn't do anything wrong; why do you want to hit him?

text.traditional: A：你吃了什麼？為什麼肚子疼呢？B：醫生說我沒吃錯東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。

items.question: 「V錯了」的「錯」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在動詞後面，說動作的結果錯了；不能放在動詞前面。
items.wrongTraditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你錯聽了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你错听了。

right.traditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你聽錯了。
right.simplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你听错了。
right.pinyin: Tā shì Huáng xiānsheng bú shì Wáng xiānsheng, nǐ tīng cuò le.
right.english: He is Mr. Huang, not Mr. Wang; you heard wrong.

words.traditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你聽錯了。

words.pinyin: Tā shì Huáng xiānsheng bú shì Wáng xiānsheng, nǐ tīng cuò le.

items.question: 「沒V錯」後面可以加「了」嗎？
items.answer: 不可以。「沒」已經表示否定，後面不再用「了」。

items.wrongSimplified: 医生说我没吃错了东西，可能是饮料不新鲜。

right.traditional: 醫生說我沒吃錯東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。
right.simplified: 医生说我没吃错东西，可能是饮料不新鲜。
right.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ méi chī cuò dōngxi, kěnéng shì yǐnliào bù xīnxiān.
right.english: The doctor said I didn't eat the wrong thing; maybe the drink wasn't fresh.

words.traditional: 醫生說我沒吃錯東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 錯 after a verb is a result complement: V錯 means the action was done, but the result was wrong. 沒V錯 means the action was not done incorrectly.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: 「錯」is placed after the verb, serving as the verb complement. V錯 indicates that the subject did something wrong. The result of the action is a mistake.

right.english: I learned to swim; after a month of learning, I had learned it.

words.traditional: 我學游泳，學了一個月就學會了。

words.traditional: 那個孩子那麼小，爸爸教不會他怎麼騎腳踏車。

words.meaning: That child is so small; his father cannot teach him how to ride a bike.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 會 after a verb is a result complement meaning that someone has gained a skill. The examples most often use 學 or 教: 學會 means to learn how to do something, and 教會 means to teach someone how.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When used together with a verb, 「會」serves as a resultative complement. The verbs used in this pattern include 「學（learn）」 and 「教（teach）」, which indicate someone acquires certain techniques through learning or teaching.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that any person, thing, place, or way will do.
grammarPages.explanation: 兩個相同的疑問詞前後呼應，表示選擇沒有特別限制；前面的條件成立，後面就採取相應的選擇。疑問詞可包括誰、什麼時候、哪裡、什麼、幾＋量詞、哪＋量詞、怎麼等。「誰」的第二次出現也可放在「就」前，例如「誰想吃誰就吃」。

items.question: 前後兩個疑問詞要不一樣嗎？
items.answer: 要用同一個疑問詞，表示同樣的人、事、地方或方式。
items.wrongTraditional: 他很有錢，想買什麼就買哪個。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很有钱，想买什么就买哪个。

right.traditional: 他很有錢，想買什麼就買什麼。
right.simplified: 他很有钱，想买什么就买什么。
right.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu qián, xiǎng mǎi shénme jiù mǎi shénme.

words.traditional: 他很有錢，想買什麼就買什麼。

words.meaning: He is rich; he buys whatever he wants to buy.

items.question: 「誰想吃誰就吃」的「誰」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 第二個「誰」可以放在「就」前面。
items.wrongTraditional: 這個巧克力，誰想吃就誰吃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个巧克力，谁想吃就谁吃。

right.traditional: 這個巧克力，誰想吃誰就吃。
right.simplified: 这个巧克力，谁想吃谁就吃。
right.pinyin: Zhège qiǎokèlì, shéi xiǎng chī shéi jiù chī.
right.english: Whoever wants to eat this chocolate can eat it.

words.traditional: 這個巧克力，誰想吃誰就吃。
words.simplified: 这个巧克力，谁想吃谁就吃。
words.pinyin: Zhège qiǎokèlì, shéi xiǎng chī shéi jiù chī.
words.meaning: Whoever wants to eat this chocolate can eat it.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Repeat the same question word to mean “whichever” or “whoever.” The first phrase sets the choice or condition; the second gives the matching action, with 就 before it. The choice has no special restriction once the condition is met. For 誰, the second 誰 can also come before 就: 誰想吃，誰就吃.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The two question words, which show a tone of randomness, represent the same thing and indicate there is no special requirement or limitation as long as the requirement going before 「就」 is fulfilled. If the question word is 「誰（who）」, the second 「誰」 can be placed before 「就」, e.g., 「這個巧克力，誰想吃誰就吃。」 The question words include: 誰（who）, 什麼時候（when）, 哪裡／哪兒（where）, 什麼（what）, 幾＋M（＋N）（how many）, 哪＋M（＋N）（which）, 怎麼（how）, etc.

items.answer: 「的」放在句尾，表示說話者很肯定，語氣也比較緩和。

words.traditional: 他一定會找到好工作的。

words.traditional: 只要好好地跟他們說，他們不會不同意的。

words.pinyin: Zhǐyào hǎohǎo de gēn tāmen shuō, tāmen bú huì bù tóngyì de.
words.meaning: As long as you talk to them nicely, they will not disagree.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 會 + statement + 的 expresses the speaker’s confidence that the situation will happen. Ending with 的 makes the assurance sound gentler.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates the speaker believes the situation after 「會」 is quite likely to happen. 「的」 in this pattern is added to show affirmation with a more softened tone.

items.title: Grammar 7–8 · Taiwanese KTV Bars

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在台灣，KTV是一個吃喝玩樂的好地方。很多人會到KTV過生日、辦活動；不少學生一考完試就去KTV唱歌、吃東西，讓自己輕鬆一下。有人家裡有卡拉OK的機器，不但想唱的時候隨時都能唱，也可以請朋友、鄰居一起來唱。
lines.simplified: 在台湾，KTV是一个吃喝玩乐的好地方。很多人会到KTV过生日、办活动；不少学生一考完试就去KTV唱歌、吃东西，让自己轻松一下。有人家里有卡拉OK的机器，不但想唱的时候随时都能唱，也可以请朋友、邻居一起来唱。
lines.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, KTV shì yí ge chī hē wán lè de hǎo dìfāng. Hěn duō rén huì dào KTV guò shēngrì, bàn huódòng; bùshǎo xuésheng yì kǎo wán shì jiù qù KTV chànggē, chī dōngxi, ràng zìjǐ qīngsōng yíxià. Yǒu rén jiā lǐ yǒu kǎlā OK de jīqì, búdàn xiǎng chàng de shíhou suíshí dōu néng chàng, yě kěyǐ qǐng péngyou, línjū yìqǐ lái chàng.
lines.english: In Taiwan, KTV is a good place to eat, drink, and have fun. Many people will go to KTV bars to sing when they celebrate birthdays or organize activities. Many students go to KTV bars to sing, eat, and relax themselves right after exams. Some people also have karaoke sets at home. They can not only sing whenever they want but also invite their friends and neighbors to sing together.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 台灣的KTV是二十四小時的，你想什麼時候去唱歌都可以。不同的時間，價錢也不同，早上六點到中午十二點前最便宜，一個人才兩百多塊錢。週末、假日比平日貴得多，還常常客滿，所以很多大學生利用沒課時去KTV，不但省錢，也不需要排隊。
lines.simplified: 台湾的KTV是二十四小时的，你想什么时候去唱歌都可以。不同的时间，价钱也不同，早上六点到中午十二点前最便宜，一个人才两百多块钱。周末、假日比平日贵得多，还常常客满，所以很多大学生利用没课时去KTV，不但省钱，也不需要排队。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV shì èrshísì xiǎoshí de, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou qù chànggē dōu kěyǐ. Bùtóng de shíjiān, jiàqián yě bùtóng, zǎoshang liù diǎn dào zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián zuì piányi, yí ge rén cái liǎngbǎi duō kuài qián. Zhōumò, jiàrì bǐ píngrì guì de duō, hái chángcháng kèmǎn, suǒyǐ hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng méi kè shí qù KTV, búdàn shěng qián, yě bù xūyào páiduì.
lines.english: The KTV bars in Taiwan are open 24 hours a day. You can go there and sing whenever you want. The price is different for different times. From 6 am to 12:00 noon is the cheapest, only a bit over $200 for a person. Though weekends and holidays are much more expensive than weekdays, the bars are often full. Therefore, many university students use the time when they have no classes to go to KTV bars. Not only can they save money, but they also don't need to line up.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 台灣的KTV還有一個特色，就是有各式各樣的食物和飲料。只要你多付一點兒錢，就可以吃到飽，不必擔心唱著唱著就餓了。有的KTV還有好玩的樂器，讓客人唱得更開心。其實，也有人生氣或是傷心的時候，會自己一個人去KTV，一邊唱、一邊哭，等唱完以後，心情就好多了。
lines.simplified: 台湾的KTV还有一个特色，就是有各式各样的食物和饮料。只要你多付一点儿钱，就可以吃到饱，不必担心唱着唱着就饿了。有的KTV还有好玩的乐器，让客人唱得更开心。其实，也有人生气或是伤心的时候，会自己一个人去KTV，一边唱、一边哭，等唱完以后，心情就好多了。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV hái yǒu yí ge tèsè, jiùshì yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shíwù hé yǐnliào. Zhǐyào nǐ duō fù yìdiǎnr qián, jiù kěyǐ chīdàobǎo, búbì dānxīn chàngzhe chàngzhe jiù è le. Yǒu de KTV hái yǒu hǎowán de yuèqì, ràng kèrén chàng de gèng kāixīn. Qíshí, yě yǒu rén shēngqì huòshì shāngxīn de shíhou, huì zìjǐ yí ge rén qù KTV, yìbiān chàng, yìbiān kū, děng chàng wán yǐhòu, xīnqíng jiù hǎo duō le.
lines.english: Taiwanese KTV bars have another special feature—that is, a wide range of food and beverages. As long as you pay a little more, you can eat as much as you want. You do not have to worry that you'll get hungry while singing. Some KTV bars also have funny musical instruments, so that the guests can enjoy their singing more. Actually, there are also some people who go alone to a KTV bar when they are angry or sad. They cry while singing. When they finish singing, their moods become much better.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 要是你想慶祝生日，去KTV跟大家合唱，一定會很開心的；如果心情不好，去KTV自己一個人唱歌，也能把不愉快的事情忘了，所以去KTV真是一個不錯的選擇。
lines.simplified: 要是你想庆祝生日，去KTV跟大家合唱，一定会很开心的；如果心情不好，去KTV自己一个人唱歌，也能把不愉快的事情忘了，所以去KTV真是一个不错的选择。
lines.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng qìngzhù shēngrì, qù KTV gēn dàjiā héchàng, yídìng huì hěn kāixīn de; rúguǒ xīnqíng bù hǎo, qù KTV zìjǐ yí ge rén chànggē, yě néng bǎ bù yúkuài de shìqing wàng le, suǒyǐ qù KTV zhēn shì yí ge búcuò de xuǎnzé.
lines.english: If you want to celebrate your birthday, go to KTV bars to sing with people, you must be very happy; if you are in a bad mood, go to KTV bars to sing on your own, you can also forget the unpleasant things. So going to KTV bars is really a good choice.

grammarPages.explanation: 這一課的「才」表示數量比說話者預期的少；「才」和「只」都可表示少，但「才」強調說話者的主觀判斷。「才」可直接放在數量詞前；課本說「只」放在動詞前，不能直接接數量詞。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Here, 才 before a number says the amount is less than the speaker expected. 只 can also suggest a small amount, but it goes before a verb; it cannot directly come before a number. 才 can: 這件衣服才一百塊錢.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates the number is fewer than the speaker's expectation, different from the usage of 「才」 in Lesson Two. Both 「才」 and 「只」 imply a small number. However, 「才」 emphasizes the small number is the speaker's subjective opinion. Also, 「才」 can be followed directly with number words; 「只」 is placed before the verb and cannot be followed with number words, e.g., 「＊這件衣服只一百塊錢。」

lines.english: Don't worry. I'll tell him you're a student and ask him to make it a little cheaper.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （良介拿出一塊錢來）
lines.simplified: （良介拿出一块钱来）
lines.pinyin: （Liángjiè ná chū yí kuài qián lái）
lines.english: (Ryosuke takes out one dollar.)

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: （笑著說）你看！我只剩下一塊錢，沒錢吃飯了。
lines.simplified: （笑着说）你看！我只剩下一块钱，没钱吃饭了。
lines.pinyin: （Xiàozhe shuō）Nǐ kàn! Wǒ zhǐ shèngxià yí kuài qián, méi qián chīfàn le.
lines.english: (Laughing.) Look! I only have one dollar left. I have no money for food.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 你比我好，我今天出門時忘了帶錢包，現在一毛錢都沒有，我們中午讓美心請客吧。
lines.simplified: 你比我好，我今天出门时忘了带钱包，现在一毛钱都没有，我们中午让美心请客吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bǐ wǒ hǎo, wǒ jīntiān chūmén shí wàng le dài qiánbāo, xiànzài yì máo qián dōu méiyǒu, wǒmen zhōngwǔ ràng Měixīn qǐngkè ba.
lines.english: You're better off than me. I forgot my wallet when I left home today, and now I don't have a single cent. Let's have Meixin treat us to lunch.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （兩人哈哈大笑。這時候，美心剛好從外面走進來）
lines.simplified: （两人哈哈大笑。这时候，美心刚好从外面走进来）
lines.pinyin: （Liǎng rén hāhā dàxiào. Zhè shíhou, Měixīn gānghǎo cóng wàimiàn zǒu jìnlái）
lines.english: (Both of them laugh out loud. Just then, Meixin walks in from outside.)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 你們在聊什麼？聊得這麼開心？
lines.simplified: 你们在聊什么？聊得这么开心？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de zhème kāixīn?
lines.english: What are you talking about? What's so funny?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我們正在聊去花蓮旅行的事，可欣要幫我訂民宿。
lines.simplified: 我们正在聊去花莲旅行的事，可欣要帮我订民宿。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài liáo qù Huālián lǚxíng de shì, Kěxīn yào bāng wǒ dìng mínsù.
lines.english: We're talking about traveling to Hualien. Kexin is going to help me book a B&B.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 住民宿不錯，你要怎麼去呢？
lines.simplified: 住民宿不错，你要怎么去呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhù mínsù búcuò, nǐ yào zěnme qù ne?
lines.english: Staying at a B&B is nice. How are you going to get there?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我還沒決定。聽說蘇花公路有一點兒危險，下大雨的時候，山上的大石頭可能會掉下來。
lines.simplified: 我还没决定。听说苏花公路有一点儿危险，下大雨的时候，山上的大石头可能会掉下来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi juédìng. Tīngshuō Sūhuā Gōnglù yǒu yìdiǎnr wēixiǎn, xià dàyǔ de shíhou, shān shàng de dà shítou kěnéng huì diào xiàlái.
lines.english: I haven't decided yet. I heard the Suhua Highway is a little dangerous. When it rains heavily, rocks from the mountain may fall.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 蘇花公路是比較危險，搭火車去比較安全，可是假日的票很難買，一下子就賣光了，你最好趕快上網訂票。
lines.simplified: 苏花公路是比较危险，搭火车去比较安全，可是假日的票很难买，一下子就卖光了，你最好赶快上网订票。
lines.pinyin: Sūhuā Gōnglù shì bǐjiào wēixiǎn, dā huǒchē qù bǐjiào ānquán, kěshì jiàrì de piào hěn nán mǎi, yíxiàzi jiù mài guāng le, nǐ zuìhǎo gǎnkuài shàngwǎng dìngpiào.
lines.english: The Suhua Highway is more dangerous. Taking the train is safer, but holiday tickets are hard to buy—they sell out in no time. You'd better book online soon.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我上過台灣鐵路局的網站，可是看不懂網頁，覺得訂票很難。
lines.simplified: 我上过台湾铁路局的网站，可是看不懂网页，觉得订票很难。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàng guò Táiwān Tiělùjú de wǎngzhàn, kěshì kàn bu dǒng wǎngyè, juéde dìngpiào hěn nán.
lines.english: I've been on the Taiwan Railways website, but I can't understand the web pages. I find booking tickets difficult.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 在台灣，上網訂票、訂位一點兒都不難，我現在就幫你訂。（用手機上台鐵的網站）你要訂什麼時候的？
lines.simplified: 在台湾，上网订票、订位一点儿都不难，我现在就帮你订。（用手机上台铁的网站）你要订什么时候的？
lines.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shàngwǎng dìngpiào, dìngwèi yìdiǎnr dōu bù nán, wǒ xiànzài jiù bāng nǐ dìng. （Yòng shǒujī shàng Táitiě de wǎngzhàn）Nǐ yào dìng shénme shíhou de?
lines.english: In Taiwan, booking tickets and seats online is not difficult at all. I'll help you book right now. (She goes to the Taiwan Railways website on her phone.) When do you want to book it for?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 大概六月底。火車票貴不貴？
lines.simplified: 大概六月底。火车票贵不贵？
lines.pinyin: Dàgài liùyuè dǐ. Huǒchē piào guì bu guì?
lines.english: Around the end of June. Are train tickets expensive?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 太魯閣號比較貴，可是只停幾個站，兩個多鐘頭就到花蓮了。
lines.simplified: 太鲁阁号比较贵，可是只停几个站，两个多钟头就到花莲了。
lines.pinyin: Tàilǔgé Hào bǐjiào guì, kěshì zhǐ tíng jǐ ge zhàn, liǎng ge duō zhōngtóu jiù dào Huālián le.
lines.english: The Taroko Express is more expensive, but it only stops at a few stations. It takes a little over two hours to get to Hualien.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 貴一點兒沒關係，要是訂得到第一班太魯閣號，早上從台北出發，中午就可以去太魯閣國家公園爬山了。
lines.simplified: 贵一点儿没关系，要是订得到第一班太鲁阁号，早上从台北出发，中午就可以去太鲁阁国家公园爬山了。
lines.pinyin: Guì yìdiǎnr méi guānxi, yàoshi dìng de dào dì yī bān Tàilǔgé Hào, zǎoshang cóng Táiběi chūfā, zhōngwǔ jiù kěyǐ qù Tàilǔgé guójiā gōngyuán páshān le.
lines.english: A little more expensive is fine. If I can book the first Taroko Express and leave Taipei in the morning, I can go hiking in Taroko National Park at noon.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 我前年就是搭太魯閣號去的，真的又快又方便！
lines.simplified: 我前年就是搭太鲁阁号去的，真的又快又方便！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qiánnián jiùshì dā Tàilǔgé Hào qù de, zhēn de yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn!
lines.english: I took the Taroko Express two years ago. It's really fast and convenient!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 不好意思，我想坐在窗戶旁邊，可以自己選座位嗎？
lines.simplified: 不好意思，我想坐在窗户旁边，可以自己选座位吗？
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ xiǎng zuò zài chuānghu pángbiān, kěyǐ zìjǐ xuǎn zuòwèi ma?
lines.english: Excuse me. I'd like to sit by the window. Can I choose the seat myself?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 沒辦法，位子都是電腦選的。（看著網頁）訂好了！你把訂票號碼記下來，這個日期以前去便利商店付錢，就可以拿到票了。
lines.simplified: 没办法，位子都是电脑选的。（看着网页）订好了！你把订票号码记下来，这个日期以前去便利商店付钱，就可以拿到票了。
lines.pinyin: Méi bànfǎ, wèizi dōu shì diànnǎo xuǎn de. （Kànzhe wǎngyè）Dìng hǎo le! Nǐ bǎ dìngpiào hàomǎ jì xiàlái, zhège rìqī yǐqián qù biànlì shāngdiàn fù qián, jiù kěyǐ ná dào piào le.
lines.english: No way. The seats are all chosen by the computer. (She looks at the web page.) Booked! Write down the booking number. Pay at a convenience store before this date, and you can get the ticket.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Traveling to Hualien by Train
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 不但…，還…: not only… but also…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a second, more important point with 不但…，還….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不但」引出第一項，「還」引出受到更強調的另一項。兩個分句的主語一致；第二分句可省略重複的主語。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不但 + Clause 1，還 + Clause 2

text.traditional: 我去夜市，不但要吃雞排，還要吃蚵仔煎。
text.simplified: 我去夜市，不但要吃鸡排，还要吃蚵仔煎。
text.pinyin: Wǒ qù yèshì, búdàn yào chī jīpái, hái yào chī ézǐjiān.
text.english: I'm going to the night market. I not only want to eat chicken fillet but also oyster omelet.

words.meaning: also want to eat oyster omelet

text.traditional: 那個印尼學生不但會說中文，還會寫很多中國字。
text.simplified: 那个印尼学生不但会说中文，还会写很多中国字。
text.pinyin: Nà ge Yìnní xuésheng búdàn huì shuō Zhōngwén, hái huì xiě hěn duō Zhōngguó zì.
text.english: That Indonesian student can not only speak Chinese but also write many Chinese characters.

text.traditional: 這家民宿不但有免費的無線網路，還有游泳池呢！
text.simplified: 这家民宿不但有免费的无线网路，还有游泳池呢！
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù búdàn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, hái yǒu yóuyǒngchí ne!
text.english: This B&B not only has free Wi-Fi but also a swimming pool!

items.question: 「不但」後面可以接「但是」嗎？
items.answer: 不行。這個句型後面用「還」或「也」來說第二件事，不用轉折的「但是」。
items.wrongTraditional: 這家民宿不但有免費的無線網路，但是有游泳池。
items.wrongSimplified: 这家民宿不但有免费的无线网路，但是有游泳池。

right.traditional: 這家民宿不但有免費的無線網路，還有游泳池呢！
right.simplified: 这家民宿不但有免费的无线网路，还有游泳池呢！
right.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù búdàn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, hái yǒu yóuyǒngchí ne!
right.english: This B&B not only has free Wi-Fi but also a swimming pool.

words.traditional: 這家民宿不但有免費的無線網路，還有游泳池呢！
words.simplified: 这家民宿不但有免费的无线网路，还有游泳池呢！
words.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù búdàn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, hái yǒu yóuyǒngchí ne!
words.meaning: This B&B not only has free Wi-Fi but also a swimming pool.

items.question: 兩個句子的主語不一樣，還可以用「不但……，還……」嗎？
items.answer: 不可以。主語不一樣時，第二句用「也」，不要用「還」再接一個新主語。
items.wrongTraditional: 不但我喜歡吃雞排，可欣還喜歡吃蚵仔煎。
items.wrongSimplified: 不但我喜欢吃鸡排，可欣还喜欢吃蚵仔煎。

right.traditional: 我喜歡吃雞排，可欣也喜歡吃蚵仔煎。
right.simplified: 我喜欢吃鸡排，可欣也喜欢吃蚵仔煎。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī jīpái, Kěxīn yě xǐhuan chī ézǐjiān.
right.english: I like chicken fillet, and Kexin also likes oyster omelet.

words.traditional: 我喜歡吃雞排，可欣也喜歡吃蚵仔煎。
words.simplified: 我喜欢吃鸡排，可欣也喜欢吃蚵仔煎。
words.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī jīpái, Kěxīn yě xǐhuan chī ézǐjiān.
words.meaning: I like chicken fillet, and Kexin also likes oyster omelet.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不但 introduces one fact, and 還 adds another fact for extra emphasis. The two clauses normally have the same subject; the second subject can be omitted when it is the same as the first.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In addition to the situation after “不但”, the speaker lays more stress on the situation after “還”. In this pattern, the first subject should be consistent with the second one.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Traveling to Hualien by Train
grammarPages.titleTraditional: 一 + M（+N）+ 都／也 + Neg（+Vaux）+ V
grammarPages.titleSimplified: 一 + M（+N）+ 都／也 + Neg（+Vaux）+ V
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 一 + Measure word + 都/也 + not: not even one
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize that there is not even one of something.
grammarPages.explanation: 「一」加量詞，後面用「都」或「也」加否定，表示「一個也沒有」或「一點也不」，常常有誇張、意外的感覺。否定詞後面可以接「願意」這類助動詞。
grammarPages.pattern: 一 + Measure word (+ Noun) + 都／也 + 不／沒 + Verb

text.traditional: 我等了一個小時，一班公車都沒來。
text.simplified: 我等了一个小时，一班公车都没来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ děng le yí ge xiǎoshí, yì bān gōngchē dōu méi lái.
text.english: I waited for an hour, but not a single bus came.

text.traditional: 我忘了帶錢包，現在一毛（錢）都沒有。
text.simplified: 我忘了带钱包，现在一毛（钱）都没有。
text.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le dài qiánbāo, xiànzài yì máo (qián) dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: I forgot my wallet. Now I don't have even a dime.

text.traditional: 這裡一家醫院也沒有，要是生病了就很麻煩。
text.simplified: 这里一家医院也没有，要是生病了就很麻烦。
text.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yì jiā yīyuàn yě méiyǒu, yàoshi shēngbìng le jiù hěn máfan.
text.english: There isn't even one hospital here. If you get sick, it will be a lot of trouble.

words.meaning: it will be a lot of trouble

text.traditional: 那個學生不愛上課，一個字都不願意寫，所以老師很生氣。
text.simplified: 那个学生不爱上课，一个字都不愿意写，所以老师很生气。
text.pinyin: Nà ge xuésheng bú ài shàngkè, yí ge zì dōu bú yuànyì xiě, suǒyǐ lǎoshī hěn shēngqì.
text.english: That student doesn't like going to class and isn't willing to write even one character, so the teacher is very angry.

items.question: 「一」後面的量詞可以省掉嗎？
items.answer: 不行。「一」後面要有量詞，例如「一班公車」「一個字」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我等了一個小時，一公車都沒來。
items.wrongSimplified: 我等了一个小时，一公车都没来。

right.traditional: 我等了一個小時，一班公車都沒來。
right.simplified: 我等了一个小时，一班公车都没来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ děng le yí ge xiǎoshí, yì bān gōngchē dōu méi lái.
right.english: I waited for an hour, but not a single bus came.

words.traditional: 我等了一個小時，一班公車都沒來。
words.simplified: 我等了一个小时，一班公车都没来。
words.pinyin: Wǒ děng le yí ge xiǎoshí, yì bān gōngchē dōu méi lái.
words.meaning: I waited for an hour, but not a single bus came.

items.question: 「願意」前面用「不」還是「沒」？
items.answer: 用「不」。這裡說意願，不用「沒」。
items.wrongTraditional: 那個學生不愛上課，一個字都沒願意寫。
items.wrongSimplified: 那个学生不爱上课，一个字都没愿意写。

right.traditional: 那個學生不愛上課，一個字都不願意寫。
right.simplified: 那个学生不爱上课，一个字都不愿意写。
right.pinyin: Nà ge xuésheng bú ài shàngkè, yí ge zì dōu bú yuànyì xiě.
right.english: That student doesn't like going to class and isn't willing to write even one character.

words.traditional: 那個學生不愛上課，一個字都不願意寫。
words.simplified: 那个学生不爱上课，一个字都不愿意写。
words.pinyin: Nà ge xuésheng bú ài shàngkè, yí ge zì dōu bú yuànyì xiě.
words.meaning: That student doesn't like going to class and isn't willing to write even one character.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一 + measure word (+ noun) + 都／也 + 不／沒 + verb means “not even one” or “none at all.” It often emphasizes a surprising or extreme situation. The negative verb phrase can also include a helping verb such as 願意.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “一 M 都/也不（沒）” indicates “there is not any...” or “don't want any...”, and shows a strange and unexpected situation with a bit of exaggeration.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Traveling to Hualien by Train
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 讓: to make, to let; to allow, to permit (politely)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Politely say that someone lets or allows another person to do something.
grammarPages.explanation: 「讓」有不同用法：可以表示「使、讓」的結果（L6），也可以客氣地表示「讓某人做某事」或「允許某人做某事」。這裡的「讓」比「叫」「要」客氣，不是命令。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 讓 + Person + Verb (+ Object)

text.traditional: 他上班常遲到，工作也做不好，所以老闆讓/叫/要他明天別來上班了。
text.simplified: 他上班常迟到，工作也做不好，所以老板让/叫/要他明天别来上班了。
text.pinyin: Tā shàngbān cháng chídào, gōngzuò yě zuò bu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn ràng/jiào/yào tā míngtiān bié lái shàngbān le.
text.english: He is often late for work and doesn't do his work well, so the boss told him not to come to work tomorrow.

words.meaning: he is often late for work
and doesn't do his work well

words.pinyin: tā míngtiān bié lái shàngbān le
words.meaning: that he not come to work tomorrow

text.traditional: 陳小姐讓/叫/要男朋友在樓下等一下，因為她還沒選好要穿哪件衣服。
text.simplified: 陈小姐让/叫/要男朋友在楼下等一下，因为她还没选好要穿哪件衣服。
text.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě ràng/jiào/yào nánpéngyou zài lóuxià děng yíxià, yīnwèi tā hái méi xuǎn hǎo yào chuān nǎ jiàn yīfu.
text.english: Miss Chen asked her boyfriend to wait downstairs because she still hasn't chosen what to wear.

text.traditional: A：今天我忘了帶錢，讓你請吃午餐，可以嗎？B：沒問題，你想吃什麼？我讓餐廳老闆送過來。
text.simplified: A：今天我忘了带钱，让你请吃午餐，可以吗？B：没问题，你想吃什么？我让餐厅老板送过来。
text.pinyin: A: Jīntiān wǒ wàng le dài qián, ràng nǐ qǐng chī wǔcān, kěyǐ ma? B: Méi wèntí, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Wǒ ràng cāntīng lǎobǎn sòng guòlái.
text.english: A: I forgot to bring money today. Can I let you treat me to lunch? B: No problem. What do you want to eat? I'll have the restaurant owner deliver it.

words.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ wàng le dài qián
words.meaning: I forgot to bring money today
let you treat me to lunch
what do you want to eat

text.traditional: 客人：這些菜吃不完，可不可以讓我帶回家？老闆：不可以喔！帶回去就不新鮮了。
text.simplified: 客人：这些菜吃不完，可不可以让我带回家？老板：不可以喔！带回去就不新鲜了。
text.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhèxiē cài chī bu wán, kě bu kěyǐ ràng wǒ dài huí jiā? Lǎobǎn: Bù kěyǐ o! Dài huíqù jiù bù xīnxiān le.
text.english: Guest: We can't finish these dishes. Can you let me take them home? Owner: No. They won't be fresh if you take them home.

items.question: 「讓」後面接人，還是接事情？
items.answer: 接人，再說請他做的事：「讓 + 人 + 動作」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我對餐廳老闆送過來。
items.wrongSimplified: 我对餐厅老板送过来。

right.traditional: 我讓餐廳老闆送過來。
right.simplified: 我让餐厅老板送过来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ ràng cāntīng lǎobǎn sòng guòlái.
right.english: I'll have the restaurant owner deliver it.

words.pinyin: Wǒ ràng cāntīng lǎobǎn sòng guòlái.
words.meaning: I'll have the restaurant owner deliver it.

items.question: 「讓」後面可以直接加「了」嗎？
items.answer: 不行。「了」放在句尾或動詞後面，不放在「讓」後面。
items.wrongTraditional: 老闆讓了我回家休息。
items.wrongSimplified: 老板让了我回家休息。

right.traditional: 老闆讓我回家休息。
right.simplified: 老板让我回家休息。
right.pinyin: Lǎobǎn ràng wǒ huí jiā xiūxi.
right.english: The boss let me go home and rest.

words.pinyin: Lǎobǎn ràng wǒ huí jiā xiūxi.
words.meaning: The boss let me go home and rest.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 讓 + person + verb can mean “let” or “allow” someone to do something. It can also be a polite way to ask or tell someone to do it; compared with 叫 or 要, 讓 sounds less like a direct order. Elsewhere in the book, 讓 can mean “make” someone feel or become a certain way.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish:
（1）This “讓” functions as a verb. There are different usages of 讓, such as “to make” and “to let”, ie: “有的 KTV 還有好玩的樂器，讓客人唱得更開心。（to make）（L6）” and the dialogue in this lesson, “讓美心請客吧。”（to let）. The “讓 (to let)” is more polite than “叫” or “要”, ie: “老師叫你去辦公室找他” is an order while “老師讓你去辦公室找他” is a polite expression.

（2）“讓” also indicates to permit and to allow somebody to do something, ie: “父母讓我一個人在學校附近租房子。” and “我不舒服，老闆讓我回家休息。”

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Traveling to Hualien by Train
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 是 + Adjective: indeed, it is true
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize that something really is a certain way.
grammarPages.explanation: 「美、漂亮、年輕」等狀態動詞（Vs）本身不需要「是」。說話者要確認或強調程度時，可以在Vs前加「是」；中間可加程度副詞。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 是 + (Adverb) + Adjective

text.traditional: A：我覺得王小姐比以前漂亮了。B：她是比以前漂亮多了。
text.simplified: A：我觉得王小姐比以前漂亮了。B：她是比以前漂亮多了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde Wáng xiǎojiě bǐ yǐqián piàoliang le. B: Tā shì bǐ yǐqián piàoliang duō le.
text.english: A: I think Miss Wang is prettier than before. B: She is indeed much prettier than before.

words.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě bǐ yǐqián piàoliang le
words.meaning: Miss Wang is prettier than before

words.pinyin: tā shì bǐ yǐqián piàoliang duō le
words.meaning: she is indeed much prettier than before

text.traditional: A：外國人都覺得中國字很難寫，你覺得呢？B：是有點兒難寫，可是多練習幾次就好了。
text.simplified: A：外国人都觉得中国字很难写，你觉得呢？B：是有点儿难写，可是多练习几次就好了。
text.pinyin: A: Wàiguórén dōu juéde Zhōngguó zì hěn nán xiě, nǐ juéde ne? B: Shì yǒudiǎnr nán xiě, kěshì duō liànxí jǐ cì jiù hǎo le.
text.english: A: Foreigners all think Chinese characters are hard to write. What do you think? B: They are indeed a little hard to write, but they'll be fine after a few more times of practice.

words.meaning: Chinese characters are hard to write
they are indeed a little hard to write
but after practicing a few more times

text.traditional: 良介：聽說蘇花公路的風景很美，是真的嗎？美心：是真的，可是下大雨的時候，那條路比較危險。
text.simplified: 良介：听说苏花公路的风景很美，是真的吗？美心：是真的，可是下大雨的时候，那条路比较危险。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè: Tīngshuō Sūhuā Gōnglù de fēngjǐng hěn měi, shì zhēn de ma? Měixīn: Shì zhēn de, kěshì xià dàyǔ de shíhou, nà tiáo lù bǐjiào wēixiǎn.
text.english: Ryosuke: I heard the scenery on the Suhua Highway is beautiful. Is that true? Meixin: It is true, but that road is rather dangerous when it rains heavily.

words.pinyin: Sūhuā Gōnglù de fēngjǐng hěn měi
words.meaning: the scenery on the Suhua Highway is beautiful

items.question: 每個形容詞前面都要加「是」嗎？
items.answer: 不用。平常說「她很漂亮」；想強調時才說「她是比以前漂亮多了」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我覺得她是漂亮。
items.wrongSimplified: 我觉得她是漂亮。

right.traditional: 我覺得她很漂亮。
right.simplified: 我觉得她很漂亮。
right.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tā hěn piàoliang.
right.english: I think she is pretty.

items.question: 「是」要放在主語前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在主語後面：「王小姐是比以前漂亮多了」。
items.wrongTraditional: 是王小姐比以前漂亮多了。
items.wrongSimplified: 是王小姐比以前漂亮多了。

right.traditional: 王小姐是比以前漂亮多了。
right.simplified: 王小姐是比以前漂亮多了。
right.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě shì bǐ yǐqián piàoliang duō le.
right.english: Miss Wang is indeed much prettier than before.

words.traditional: 王小姐是比以前漂亮多了。
words.simplified: 王小姐是比以前漂亮多了。
words.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě shì bǐ yǐqián piàoliang duō le.
words.meaning: Miss Wang is indeed much prettier than before.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Adjectives such as 美 and 漂亮 can describe someone or something without 是. Add 是 before the adjective when confirming or emphasizing the degree; a degree word can come between 是 and the adjective.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In Chinese, intransitive state verbs, such as “美”, “漂亮”, “年輕”, etc., do not have to come after “是”. However, “是” can be added when the speaker wants to confirm or emphasize the degree of Vs.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Traveling to Hualien by Train
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something has been completely used up or eaten.
grammarPages.explanation: 「光」放在動詞後面，表示東西用完、吃光或走光，一點也不剩。常和「把」一起用；不高興、可惜的感覺也可能在裡面。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (把 + Object) + Verb + 光 + 了

text.traditional: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了，讓我很生氣。
text.simplified: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了，让我很生气。
text.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ wǒ de qiǎokèlì dōu chī guāng le, ràng wǒ hěn shēngqì.
text.english: My younger brother ate all my chocolate, which made me very angry.

text.traditional: 時間很晚了，咖啡館的客人差不多都走光了。
text.simplified: 时间很晚了，咖啡馆的客人差不多都走光了。
text.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn wǎn le, kāfēiguǎn de kèrén chàbuduō dōu zǒu guāng le.
text.english: It was very late, and almost all the customers in the café had left.

text.traditional: 要是你一下子就把獎學金用光，下個月就沒錢付房租了。
text.simplified: 要是你一下子就把奖学金用光，下个月就没钱付房租了。
text.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yíxiàzi jiù bǎ jiǎngxuéjīn yòng guāng, xià ge yuè jiù méi qián fù fángzū le.
text.english: If you use up your scholarship all at once, you won't have money to pay rent next month.

words.pinyin: jiù méi qián fù fángzū le
words.meaning: you won't have money to pay rent

items.question: 「光」要放在動詞前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在動詞後面，說結果一點也不剩。
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟把我的巧克力都光吃了。
items.wrongSimplified: 弟弟把我的巧克力都光吃了。

right.traditional: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了。
right.simplified: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了。
right.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ wǒ de qiǎokèlì dōu chī guāng le.
right.english: My younger brother ate all my chocolate.

words.traditional: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了。
words.simplified: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了。
words.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ wǒ de qiǎokèlì dōu chī guāng le.
words.meaning: My younger brother ate all my chocolate.

items.question: 功課可以用「V光」嗎？
items.answer: 不行。「寫光」不自然；功課是「寫完」，不是用完。
items.wrongTraditional: 我把功課寫光了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我把功课写光了。

right.traditional: 我把功課寫完了。
right.simplified: 我把功课写完了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gōngkè xiě wán le.
right.english: I finished my homework.

words.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gōngkè xiě wán le.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 光 after a verb means that something has been used, eaten, or otherwise depleted until none is left. It often appears with 把 and 了. Depending on the situation, it can also suggest regret or disappointment.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “光” here serves as a verb complement denoting “running out” or “nothing left”, and sometimes it suggests a sense of regret and disappointment. It often collocates with “把”, ie: “把錢用光了” and “弟弟把糖吃光了”; however, “我把功課寫光了” is unacceptable.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: 一點兒 + 都／也 + Neg + Vs
grammarPages.titleSimplified: 一点儿 + 都／也 + Neg + Vs
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 一點兒都/也不: not at all
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say strongly that something is not at all a certain way.
grammarPages.explanation: 「一點兒＋都／也＋不」加在動詞或狀態動詞前，強烈否定某種情況，表示「完全不……」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一點兒 + 都／也 + 不／沒 + Adjective／Verb

text.traditional: 這杯珍珠奶茶是無糖的，一點兒都不甜。
text.simplified: 这杯珍珠奶茶是无糖的，一点儿都不甜。
text.pinyin: Zhè bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá shì wútáng de, yìdiǎnr dōu bù tián.
text.english: This cup of bubble tea is sugar-free; it's not sweet at all.

text.traditional: 網路訂票一點兒也不難，你可以自己上網試試看。
text.simplified: 网路订票一点儿也不难，你可以自己上网试试看。
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù dìngpiào yìdiǎnr yě bù nán, nǐ kěyǐ zìjǐ shàngwǎng shìshi kàn.
text.english: Booking tickets online is not difficult at all. You can go online and try it yourself.

text.traditional: 我跟他一點兒都不熟，為什麼要一起去KTV唱歌呢？
text.simplified: 我跟他一点儿都不熟，为什么要一起去KTV唱歌呢？
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā yìdiǎnr dōu bù shú, wèishénme yào yìqǐ qù KTV chànggē ne?
text.english: He and I are not close at all. Why would we go to KTV and sing together?

words.meaning: go to KTV and sing together

items.question: 「一點兒」可以放在否定詞後面嗎？
items.answer: 不行。要說「一點兒都不甜」，不是「都不甜一點兒」。
items.wrongTraditional: 這杯珍珠奶茶是無糖的，都不甜一點兒。
items.wrongSimplified: 这杯珍珠奶茶是无糖的，都不甜一点儿。

right.traditional: 這杯珍珠奶茶是無糖的，一點兒都不甜。
right.simplified: 这杯珍珠奶茶是无糖的，一点儿都不甜。
right.pinyin: Zhè bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá shì wútáng de, yìdiǎnr dōu bù tián.
right.english: This cup of bubble tea is sugar-free; it's not sweet at all.

words.traditional: 這杯珍珠奶茶是無糖的，一點兒都不甜。
words.simplified: 这杯珍珠奶茶是无糖的，一点儿都不甜。
words.pinyin: Zhè bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá shì wútáng de, yìdiǎnr dōu bù tián.
words.meaning: This cup of bubble tea is sugar-free; it's not sweet at all.

items.question: 「有一點兒」和「一點兒都」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「有一點兒」是「稍微」；「一點兒都」加否定是「完全不」。
items.wrongTraditional: 網路訂票有一點兒不難。
items.wrongSimplified: 网路订票有一点儿不难。

right.traditional: 網路訂票一點兒也不難。
right.simplified: 网路订票一点儿也不难。
right.pinyin: Wǎnglù dìngpiào yìdiǎnr yě bù nán.
right.english: Booking tickets online is not difficult at all.

words.traditional: 網路訂票一點兒也不難。
words.simplified: 网路订票一点儿也不难。
words.pinyin: Wǎnglù dìngpiào yìdiǎnr yě bù nán.
words.meaning: Booking tickets online is not difficult at all.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一點兒 + 都／也 + 不／沒 + verb or adjective makes a strong negative: the subject is not in that state or does not do that action at all.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The expression “一點兒都/也不” shows strong negation, often followed by verbs or state verbs to emphasize the subject is not in a certain status at all.

items.title: Grammar 7–8 · Online Ticket Booking

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我跟室友計畫春假去阿里山森林遊樂區走走。那時候草綠了、花開了，天氣也暖和了。不必帶太多行李，也不需要穿大衣，只要穿一雙好走的鞋子，再帶一件外套、雨衣、幾雙襪子跟幾件內衣褲就夠了。
lines.simplified: 我跟室友计划春假去阿里山森林游乐区走走。那时候草绿了、花开了，天气也暖和了。不必带太多行李，也不需要穿大衣，只要穿一双好走的鞋子，再带一件外套、雨衣、几双袜子跟几件内衣裤就够了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu jìhuà chūnjià qù Ālǐ Shān sēnlín yóulè qū zǒuzǒu. Nà shíhou cǎo lǜ le, huā kāi le, tiānqì yě nuǎnhuo le. Búbì dài tài duō xínglǐ, yě bù xūyào chuān dàyī, zhǐyào chuān yì shuāng hǎo zǒu de xiézi, zài dài yí jiàn wàitào, yǔyī, jǐ shuāng wàzi gēn jǐ jiàn nèiyīkù jiù gòu le.
lines.english: My roommate and I are planning to walk around the Alishan Forest Recreation Area during spring break. At that time, the grass is green, the flowers are blooming, and the weather is warm. We don't need to bring much luggage or wear a coat. We just need a pair of comfortable walking shoes, a jacket, a raincoat, a few pairs of socks, and some underwear.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 本來我想參加阿里山的團體旅遊，這樣就不必自己上網訂票、訂旅館，可是室友覺得自己去比較自由，也不趕時間，所以我們決定第一天搭台鐵到嘉義，再從嘉義搭小火車上阿里山，當天晚上就可以在山上散步、看星星了。沒想到剛上台鐵的網站，就發現春假第一天的票都賣光了。原來除了去國外旅行，想留在國內玩的人也不少。
lines.simplified: 本来我想参加阿里山的团体旅游，这样就不必自己上网订票、订旅馆，可是室友觉得自己去比较自由，也不赶时间，所以我们决定第一天搭台铁到嘉义，再从嘉义搭小火车上阿里山，当天晚上就可以在山上散步、看星星了。没想到刚上台铁的网站，就发现春假第一天的票都卖光了。原来除了去国外旅行，想留在国内玩的人也不少。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái wǒ xiǎng cānjiā Ālǐ Shān de tuántǐ lǚyóu, zhèyàng jiù búbì zìjǐ shàngwǎng dìngpiào, dìng lǚguǎn, kěshì shìyǒu juéde zìjǐ qù bǐjiào zìyóu, yě bù gǎn shíjiān, suǒyǐ wǒmen juédìng dì yī tiān dā Táitiě dào Jiāyì, zài cóng Jiāyì dā xiǎo huǒchē shàng Ālǐ Shān, dāngtiān wǎnshang jiù kěyǐ zài shān shàng sànbù, kàn xīngxing le. Méi xiǎngdào gāng shàng Táitiě de wǎngzhàn, jiù fāxiàn chūnjià dì yī tiān de piào dōu mài guāng le. Yuánlái chúle qù guówài lǚxíng, xiǎng liú zài guónèi wán de rén yě bùshǎo.
lines.english: At first I wanted to join a group tour to Alishan so I wouldn't have to book tickets and a hotel online myself. But my roommate thought going on our own would be more free and we wouldn't be rushed, so we decided to take the Taiwan Railways to Chiayi on the first day, then take the small train from Chiayi up to Alishan. That evening we could take a walk in the mountains and look at the stars. Unexpectedly, as soon as I went to the Taiwan Railways website, I found that all the tickets for the first day of spring break were sold out. It turns out that besides traveling abroad, many people also want to stay in Taiwan for fun.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 後來我上高鐵的網站，很幸運訂到了兩張台北到嘉義的車票，馬上用信用卡付了錢，這樣就放心了。雖然高鐵票比較貴，可是又快又舒服，而且第一天晚上住在嘉義市也不錯，因為當地的雞肉飯很有名，剛好趁這個機會去吃吃看。我正在想像一邊吃雞肉飯，一邊喝啤酒的樣子，室友忽然大叫，「成功了！阿里山小火車的票訂到了！」
lines.simplified: 后来我上高铁的网站，很幸运订到了两张台北到嘉义的车票，马上用信用卡付了钱，这样就放心了。虽然高铁票比较贵，可是又快又舒服，而且第一天晚上住在嘉义市也不错，因为当地的鸡肉饭很有名，刚好趁这个机会去吃吃看。我正在想象一边吃鸡肉饭，一边喝啤酒的样子，室友忽然大叫，「成功了！阿里山小火车的票订到了！」
lines.pinyin: Hòulái wǒ shàng gāotiě de wǎngzhàn, hěn xìngyùn dìng dào le liǎng zhāng Táiběi dào Jiāyì de chēpiào, mǎshàng yòng xìnyòngkǎ fù le qián, zhèyàng jiù fàngxīn le. Suīrán gāotiě piào bǐjiào guì, kěshì yòu kuài yòu shūfu, érqiě dì yī tiān wǎnshang zhù zài Jiāyì Shì yě búcuò, yīnwèi dāngdì de jīròufàn hěn yǒumíng, gānghǎo chèn zhège jīhuì qù chīchi kàn. Wǒ zhèngzài xiǎngxiàng yìbiān chī jīròufàn, yìbiān hē píjiǔ de yàngzi, shìyǒu hūrán dàjiào, 「Chénggōng le! Ālǐ Shān xiǎo huǒchē de piào dìng dào le!」
lines.english: Later I went to the high-speed rail website and was lucky enough to book two tickets from Taipei to Chiayi. I immediately paid with a credit card, and then I felt relieved. Although the high-speed rail tickets are more expensive, it's fast and comfortable, and staying in Chiayi City the first night is also nice because the local chicken rice is famous. It's a good chance to try it. I was imagining eating chicken rice and drinking beer at the same time when my roommate suddenly shouted, "Success! I booked the Alishan Forest Railway tickets!"

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我們能利用網路做好多事情，除了訂車票、機票、餐廳，還能買到各式各樣、又便宜又流行的衣服。有網路真好！
lines.simplified: 我们能利用网路做好多事情，除了订车票、机票、餐厅，还能买到各式各样、又便宜又流行的衣服。有网路真好！
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen néng lìyòng wǎnglù zuò hǎo duō shìqing, chúle dìng chēpiào, jīpiào, cāntīng, hái néng mǎi dào gèshìgèyàng, yòu piányi yòu liúxíng de yīfu. Yǒu wǎnglù zhēn hǎo!
lines.english: We can use the Internet to do many things. Besides booking train tickets, plane tickets, and restaurants, we can also buy all kinds of cheap and fashionable clothes. It's really great to have the Internet!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Traveling to Hualien by Train
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that one thing happened right after another.
grammarPages.explanation: 「剛」後面說第一件事，「就」後面說馬上發生的第二件事，強調兩件事很近。兩個句子的主語不同時，第二句的主語要放在「就」前面。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 剛 + Verb₁，(+ Subject₂) + 就 + Verb₂

text.traditional: 那個蛋糕剛烤好就被孩子吃光了。
text.simplified: 那个蛋糕刚烤好就被孩子吃光了。
text.pinyin: Nà ge dàngāo gāng kǎo hǎo jiù bèi háizi chī guāng le.
text.english: That cake was eaten up by the children as soon as it was baked.

words.pinyin: jiù bèi háizi chī guāng le
words.meaning: and was eaten up by the children

text.traditional: 他剛搬進宿舍，無線網路就壞了。
text.simplified: 他刚搬进宿舍，无线网路就坏了。
text.pinyin: Tā gāng bān jìn sùshè, wúxiàn wǎnglù jiù huài le.
text.english: The Wi-Fi broke right after he moved into the dorm.

text.traditional: 他剛畢業就找到了一份好工作，真是太幸運了！
text.simplified: 他刚毕业就找到了一份好工作，真是太幸运了！
text.pinyin: Tā gāng bìyè jiù zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
text.english: He found a good job right after graduating. He is really so lucky!

words.pinyin: jiù zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò
words.meaning: found a good job right away

items.question: 兩個句子的主語不同時，「就」要放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在第二個主語後面。
items.wrongTraditional: 他剛搬進宿舍，就無線網路壞了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他刚搬进宿舍，就无线网路坏了。

right.traditional: 他剛搬進宿舍，無線網路就壞了。
right.simplified: 他刚搬进宿舍，无线网路就坏了。
right.pinyin: Tā gāng bān jìn sùshè, wúxiàn wǎnglù jiù huài le.
right.english: The Wi-Fi broke right after he moved into the dorm.

words.traditional: 他剛搬進宿舍，無線網路就壞了。
words.simplified: 他刚搬进宿舍，无线网路就坏了。
words.pinyin: Tā gāng bān jìn sùshè, wúxiàn wǎnglù jiù huài le.
words.meaning: The Wi-Fi broke right after he moved into the dorm.

items.question: 「剛」後面可以加「了」嗎？
items.answer: 不行。這個句型說「剛 + 動作」，後面直接接「就」。
items.wrongTraditional: 他剛畢業了，就找到了一份好工作。
items.wrongSimplified: 他刚毕业了，就找到了一份好工作。

right.traditional: 他剛畢業就找到了一份好工作。
right.simplified: 他刚毕业就找到了一份好工作。
right.pinyin: Tā gāng bìyè jiù zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò.
right.english: He found a good job right after graduating.

words.traditional: 他剛畢業就找到了一份好工作。
words.simplified: 他刚毕业就找到了一份好工作。
words.pinyin: Tā gāng bìyè jiù zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò.
words.meaning: He found a good job right after graduating.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 剛 + first action, + 就 + second action says the second event happened as soon as the first happened. If the clauses have different subjects, put the second subject before 就.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates when the situation after “剛” happens, another situation or action occurs right away. It emphasizes the close connection between two situations or actions. If the two clauses has different subjects, the subject of the latter clause should be placed before “就”.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Traveling to Hualien by Train
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone uses a good chance or time to do something.
grammarPages.explanation: 「趁」後面接機會、時間或好天氣，說利用這個機會做對自己有利的事；後面可以接名詞、動詞短語或狀態動詞。「著」可以加，也可以不加。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 趁（著）+ Chance／Time + Verb Phrase

text.traditional: 媽媽趁（著）好天氣，把髒衣服都洗了。
text.simplified: 妈妈趁（着）好天气，把脏衣服都洗了。
text.pinyin: Māma chèn (zhe) hǎo tiānqì, bǎ zāng yīfu dōu xǐ le.
text.english: Mom took advantage of the good weather and washed all the dirty clothes.

words.meaning: taking advantage of the good weather

text.traditional: 張先生趁著到花蓮旅行時，買了一些當地的名產。
text.simplified: 张先生趁着到花莲旅行时，买了一些当地的名产。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng chènzhe dào Huālián lǚxíng shí, mǎi le yìxiē dāngdì de míngchǎn.
text.english: Mr. Zhang bought some local specialties while traveling to Hualien.

text.traditional: 他趁著去法國留學的時候，參觀了有名的博物館。
text.simplified: 他趁着去法国留学的时候，参观了有名的博物馆。
text.pinyin: Tā chènzhe qù Fǎguó liúxué de shíhou, cānguān le yǒumíng de bówùguǎn.
text.english: He visited a famous museum while studying in France.

words.traditional: 趁著去法國留學的時候
words.simplified: 趁着去法国留学的时候
words.pinyin: chènzhe qù Fǎguó liúxué de shíhou

items.question: 「趁」和「因為」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「趁」是利用機會；「因為」是說原因。
items.wrongTraditional: 張先生因為到花蓮旅行時，買了一些當地的名產。
items.wrongSimplified: 张先生因为到花莲旅行时，买了一些当地的名产。

right.traditional: 張先生趁著到花蓮旅行時，買了一些當地的名產。
right.simplified: 张先生趁着到花莲旅行时，买了一些当地的名产。
right.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng chènzhe dào Huālián lǚxíng shí, mǎi le yìxiē dāngdì de míngchǎn.
right.english: Mr. Zhang bought some local specialties while traveling to Hualien.

words.traditional: 張先生趁著到花蓮旅行時，買了一些當地的名產。
words.simplified: 张先生趁着到花莲旅行时，买了一些当地的名产。
words.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng chènzhe dào Huālián lǚxíng shí, mǎi le yìxiē dāngdì de míngchǎn.
words.meaning: Mr. Zhang bought some local specialties while traveling to Hualien.

items.question: 「趁」後面可以加「了」嗎？
items.answer: 不行。要說「趁著」或「趁」，不是「趁了」。
items.wrongTraditional: 他趁了去法國留學的時候，參觀了有名的博物館。
items.wrongSimplified: 他趁了去法国留学的时候，参观了有名的博物馆。

right.traditional: 他趁著去法國留學的時候，參觀了有名的博物館。
right.simplified: 他趁着去法国留学的时候，参观了有名的博物馆。
right.pinyin: Tā chènzhe qù Fǎguó liúxué de shíhou, cānguān le yǒumíng de bówùguǎn.
right.english: He visited a famous museum while studying in France.

words.traditional: 他趁著去法國留學的時候，參觀了有名的博物館。
words.simplified: 他趁着去法国留学的时候，参观了有名的博物馆。
words.pinyin: Tā chènzhe qù Fǎguó liúxué de shíhou, cānguān le yǒumíng de bówùguǎn.
words.meaning: He visited a famous museum while studying in France.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 趁（著）introduces an opportunity, time, or favorable condition that someone uses to do something useful. It can be followed by a noun, a verb phrase, or a state verb. 著 is optional.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The expression “趁著” means taking advantage of a certain chance or time to do something beneficial to oneself. “趁” can be followed by nouns, verb phrases, and intransitive state verbs, etc.

items.title: Grammar 1–5 · Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Set a quantity threshold that unlocks an offer or condition.
grammarPages.explanation: 「滿」放在數量前，表示達到該數量或門檻；後句說達到門檻後成立的結果或條件。
grammarPages.pattern: 滿 + Number + Measure word (+ Noun)，+ Result

text.traditional: 在那家店訂飲料，滿十杯就可以替客人送過去。
text.english: At that shop, they can deliver an order to the customer once it reaches ten cups.
text.pinyin: Zài nà jiā diàn dìng yǐnliào, mǎn shí bēi jiù kěyǐ tì kèrén sòng guòqù.

words.meaning: measure word for stores and families; home
to reach; to meet a threshold

text.simplified: 在那家店订饮料，满十杯就可以替客人送过去。

text.traditional: 在這家商店，買東西滿兩千塊（錢），就送一盒巧克力。
text.english: At this store, if you spend two thousand dollars, they will give you a box of chocolates.
text.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā shāngdiàn, mǎi dōng xi mǎn liǎng qiān kuài (qián), jiù sòng yì hé qiǎokèlì.

words.meaning: measure word for stores and families; home
to reach; to meet a threshold

text.simplified: 在这家商店，买东西满两千块（钱），就送一盒巧克力。

text.traditional: 在台灣，便利商店不可以把酒賣給沒滿十八歲的人。
text.english: In Taiwan, convenience stores may not sell alcohol to anyone under eighteen.
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, biànlì shāngdiàn bù kěyǐ bǎ jiǔ mài gěi méi mǎn shíbā suì de rén.
text.simplified: 在台湾，便利商店不可以把酒卖给没满十八岁的人。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 滿 comes before a number and measure word to mark a threshold: once the amount reaches that number, the result in the following clause applies. For example, 滿十杯 marks the ten-cup threshold.

items.question: 「滿」前面的數量是什麼意思？
items.answer: 「滿」表示達到這個數量門檻，後面接達到門檻後的結果。
items.wrongTraditional: 在那家店訂飲料，不滿十杯就可以替客人送過去。
items.wrongSimplified: 在那家店订饮料，不满十杯就可以替客人送过去。

right.traditional: 在那家店訂飲料，滿十杯就可以替客人送過去。
right.english: At that shop, they can deliver an order to the customer once it reaches ten cups.
right.pinyin: zài nà jiā diàn dìng yǐn liào mǎn shí bēi jiù kě yǐ tì kèrén sòng guòqù

words.meaning: measure word for stores and families; home
to reach; to meet a threshold

items.question: 「沒滿十八歲」是已經滿十八歲嗎？
items.answer: 不是。「沒滿十八歲」表示還沒有到十八歲；例句說便利商店不可以把酒賣給這些人。
items.wrongTraditional: 在台灣，便利商店不可以把酒賣給滿十八歲的人。
items.wrongSimplified: 在台湾，便利商店不可以把酒卖给满十八岁的人。

right.traditional: 在台灣，便利商店不可以把酒賣給沒滿十八歲的人。
right.english: In Taiwan, convenience stores may not sell alcohol to anyone under eighteen.
right.pinyin: zài Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn bù kěyǐ bǎ jiǔ mài gěi méi mǎn shíbā suì de rén

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “滿” is followed by a number. This pattern means reaching a certain amount or number.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an unexpected example with 連, including emphatic negative forms.
grammarPages.explanation: 「連」先引出最出乎意料或程度最高的例子，後面接「都／也」和對該例子的說明。否定時可用「連＋一＋量詞（＋名詞）＋都／也＋不／沒＋動詞」，強調連一個也不。
grammarPages.pattern: 連 + Focus + 都/也 + statement；連 + 一 + M (+ N) + 都/也 + Neg + V

text.traditional: 我最近很忙，連睡覺的時間都沒有。
text.english: I have been very busy lately; I do not even have time to sleep.
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn hěn máng, lián shuìjiào de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.simplified: 我最近很忙，连睡觉的时间都没有。

text.traditional: 他做的東西真不好吃，連他家的狗都不吃。
text.english: The food he makes is really bad; even his dog will not eat it.
text.pinyin: Tā zuò de dōngxi zhēn bù hǎochī, lián tā jiā de gǒu dōu bù chī.
text.simplified: 他做的东西真不好吃，连他家的狗都不吃。

text.traditional: 那家民宿很便宜，不但有免費的網路，連早餐、午餐也可以吃到飽。
text.english: That B&B is inexpensive. Not only does it have free internet; even breakfast and lunch are all-you-can-eat.
text.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù hěn piányi, búdàn yǒu miǎnfèi de wǎnglù, lián zǎocān, wǔcān yě kěyǐ chīdàobǎo.

words.meaning: measure word for stores and families; home

text.simplified: 那家民宿很便宜，不但有免费的网路，连早餐、午餐也可以吃到饱。

text.traditional: 這個孩子真討厭念書，連媽媽打他，他都不怕。
text.english: This child really hates studying; even when his mother hits him, he is not afraid.
text.pinyin: Zhè ge háizi zhēn tǎoyàn niànshū, lián māma dǎ tā, tā dōu bú pà.
text.simplified: 这个孩子真讨厌念书，连妈妈打他，他都不怕。

text.traditional: 他沒學過中文，連一句中文都不會說。
text.english: He has never studied Chinese; he cannot even say one sentence in Chinese.
text.pinyin: Tā méi xué guò Zhōngwén, lián yíjù Zhōngwén dōu bú huì shuō.

words.meaning: cannot; do not know how to

text.simplified: 他没学过中文，连一句中文都不会说。

text.traditional: 他的錢都花光了，連一顆糖也買不起。
text.english: He spent all his money and cannot even afford one piece of candy.
text.pinyin: Tā de qián dōu huāguāng le, lián yì kē táng yě mǎi bu qǐ.

words.meaning: measure word for small round things

text.simplified: 他的钱都花光了，连一颗糖也买不起。

text.traditional: 張先生剛來台灣的時候，連一個朋友都沒有。
text.english: When Mr. Zhang first came to Taiwan, he did not have a single friend.
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, lián yí ge péngyou dōu méiyǒu.
text.simplified: 张先生刚来台湾的时候，连一个朋友都没有。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 連 introduces an example that is especially surprising or extreme, and 都／也 introduces what is true even of that example. For a strong negative meaning “not even one,” use 連 + 一 + measure word (+ noun) + 都／也 + 不／沒 + verb.

subsections.title: Even…
subsections.explanation: 「連」引出較特別、出乎意料或程度較高的例子；「都／也」放在該例子後，指出連這種情況也成立。

subsections.title: Not even one…
subsections.titleTraditional: 連 + 一 + M (+N) + 都／也 + Neg + V
subsections.explanation: 用「連＋一＋量詞（＋名詞）＋都／也＋不／沒＋動詞」強調連一個也不。
subsections.pattern: 連 + 一 + Measure word (+ Noun) + 都／也 + Negation + Verb

items.question: 「連……都……」裡的「都」是「全部」嗎？
items.answer: 這裡的「都」強調連睡覺時間這麼基本的事也沒有，不是在列出全部項目。
items.wrongTraditional: 我最近很忙，睡覺的時間連都沒有。
items.wrongSimplified: 我最近很忙，睡觉的时间连都没有。

right.traditional: 我最近很忙，連睡覺的時間都沒有。
right.english: I have been very busy lately; I do not even have time to sleep.
right.pinyin: wǒ zuì jìn hěn máng lián shuìjiào de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu

items.question: 「連早餐、午餐也可以吃到飽」的「連」表示只有早餐和午餐嗎？
items.answer: 不是。「連」把早餐和午餐列為特別值得注意的例子，句子用「也」接出結果。
items.wrongTraditional: 那家民宿很便宜，不但有免費的網路，連早餐、午餐可以吃到飽。
items.wrongSimplified: 那家民宿很便宜，不但有免费的网路，连早餐、午餐可以吃到饱。

right.traditional: 那家民宿很便宜，不但有免費的網路，連早餐、午餐也可以吃到飽。
right.english: That B&B is inexpensive. Not only does it have free internet; even breakfast and lunch are all-you-can-eat.
right.pinyin: nà jiā mínsù hěn pián yi búdàn yǒu miǎnfèi de wǎng lù lián zǎo cān wǔ cān yě kě yǐ chīdàobǎo

words.meaning: measure word for stores and families; home

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish:
The pattern “連……都/也……” is used to emphasize a situation that is more special, abnormal, exaggerated, or with higher degree.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: A Noun Like This or That
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a noun by giving an example with similar features.
grammarPages.explanation: 「像」引出例子，「這樣／那樣」指回該例子的特徵；接「的＋名詞」表示具有這些特徵的一類人、事物或地方。
grammarPages.pattern: 像 + Example + 這樣/那樣 + 的 + Noun

text.traditional: 我想住在像藍小姐家那樣安全的社區。
text.english: I want to live in a community as safe as Ms. Lan’s home.
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhù zài xiàng Lán xiǎojie jiā nàyàng ānquán de shèqū.

words.meaning: measure word for stores and families; home

text.simplified: 我想住在像蓝小姐家那样安全的社区。

text.traditional: 很多外國遊客喜歡去像夜市那樣熱鬧的地方玩。
text.english: Many foreign tourists like going to lively places such as night markets.
text.pinyin: Hěn duō wàiguó yóukè xǐhuan qù xiàng yèshì nàyàng rènao de dìfang wán.

words.meaning: many; much; more; a lot of

text.simplified: 很多外国游客喜欢去像夜市那样热闹的地方玩。

text.traditional: 像洗碗筷這樣的家事，父母可以讓小孩自己做。
text.english: Parents can let children do household chores on their own, such as washing dishes and chopsticks.
text.pinyin: Xiàng xǐwǎn kuài zhèyàng de jiāshì, fùmǔ kěyǐ ràng xiǎohái zìjǐ zuò.
text.simplified: 像洗碗筷这样的家事，父母可以让小孩自己做。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 像 introduces an example; 這樣／那樣 points back to its features. In 像 + example + 這樣／那樣 + 的 + noun, the noun names the kind of person, thing, or place that has those features.

items.question: 「像藍小姐家那樣安全」是在說住在藍小姐家嗎？
items.answer: 不是。這裡拿藍小姐家的安全程度作比較，想住的是一個社區。
items.wrongTraditional: 我想住在藍小姐家，像那樣安全的社區。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想住在蓝小姐家，像那样安全的社区。

right.traditional: 我想住在像藍小姐家那樣安全的社區。
right.english: I want to live in a community as safe as Ms. Lan’s home.
right.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhù zài xiàng lán xiǎo jie jiā nàyàng ānquán de shèqū

words.meaning: measure word for stores and families; home

items.question: 「像洗碗筷這樣的家事」中，哪些是例子，哪些是類別？
items.answer: 「洗碗筷」是例子，「家事」是類別；「像……這樣的」把例子放在類別前面。
items.wrongTraditional: 像家事這樣的洗碗筷，父母可以讓小孩自己做。
items.wrongSimplified: 像家事这样的洗碗筷，父母可以让小孩自己做。

right.traditional: 像洗碗筷這樣的家事，父母可以讓小孩自己做。
right.english: Parents can let children do household chores on their own, such as washing dishes and chopsticks.
right.pinyin: xiàng xǐ wǎn kuài zhèyàng de jiāshì fù mǔ kě yǐ ràng xiǎo hái zì jǐ zuò

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “像……這樣/那樣……的+N” shows the features of the example coming after “像”.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain that an unwanted situation leaves only one practical choice.
grammarPages.explanation: 遇到阻礙、沒有其他選擇時，用「只好」引出不得不採取的做法。原因或困難通常先說，唯一可行的行動放在「只好」後面。
grammarPages.pattern: Reason / obstacle，Subject + 只好 + Remaining action

text.traditional: 因為訂不到去花蓮的火車票，我們只好坐飛機去。
text.english: Because we could not get a train ticket to Hualien, we had no choice but to fly there.
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi dìng bú dào qù Huālián de huǒchēpiào, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zuò fēijī qù.

words.meaning: fail to get; not manage to get

text.simplified: 因为订不到去花莲的火车票，我们只好坐飞机去。

text.traditional: 妹妹想跟同學去看電影，可是明天有考試，只好在家看書。
text.english: My younger sister wants to go to a movie with her classmates, but she has an exam tomorrow, so she has no choice but to stay home and study.
text.pinyin: Mèimei xiǎng gēn tóngxué qù kàn diànyǐng, kěshì míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, zhǐhǎo zài jiā kànshū.
text.simplified: 妹妹想跟同学去看电影，可是明天有考试，只好在家看书。

text.traditional: 這個月我買了太多衣服，現在錢包裡只剩下三百塊錢，只好每天吃麵包了。
text.english: I bought too many clothes this month. I have only three hundred dollars left in my wallet, so I have no choice but to eat bread every day.
text.pinyin: Zhè ge yuè wǒ mǎi le tài duō yīfu, xiànzài qiánbāo lǐ zhǐ shèngxià sān bǎi kuài qián, zhǐhǎo měitiān chī miànbāo le.

words.meaning: many; much; more; a lot of

text.simplified: 这个月我买了太多衣服，现在钱包里只剩下三百块钱，只好每天吃面包了。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 只好 introduces the only practical action left when there is an obstacle or no alternative. The reason or problem often comes first; the action follows 只好.

items.question: 「只好坐飛機去」表示我們想坐飛機嗎？
items.answer: 重點是沒有合適火車票，所以只能選飛機；「只好」說的是受限制後的選擇。
items.wrongTraditional: 因為訂不到去花蓮的火車票，我們可以坐飛機去。
items.wrongSimplified: 因为订不到去花莲的火车票，我们可以坐飞机去。

right.traditional: 因為訂不到去花蓮的火車票，我們只好坐飛機去。
right.english: Because we could not get a train ticket to Hualien, we had no choice but to fly there.
right.pinyin: yīn wèi dìng bú dào qù Huā lián de huǒ chē piào wǒ men zhǐhǎo zuò fēi jī qù

words.meaning: fail to get; not manage to get

items.question: 有考試時，「只好在家看書」和「可以在家看書」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「只好」表示別的選擇受限；「可以」只表示有能力或許可。
items.wrongTraditional: 妹妹想跟同學去看電影，可是明天有考試，只好在家看書。
items.wrongSimplified: 妹妹想跟同学去看电影，可是明天有考试，只好在家看书。

right.traditional: 妹妹想跟同學去看電影，可是明天有考試，只好在家看書。
right.english: My younger sister wants to go to a movie with her classmates, but she has an exam tomorrow, so she has no choice but to stay home and study.
right.pinyin: mèi mei xiǎng gēn tóng xué qù kàn diàn yǐng kě shì míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì zhǐhǎo zài jiā kàn shū

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “只好” is used in the situation where the subject has no alternative but to do something.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State the purpose that motivates an action.
grammarPages.explanation: 「為了」引出行動的目的，後面可接名詞短語或動作短語；主要行動接在目的之後。
grammarPages.pattern: 為了 + Purpose，+ Action

text.traditional: 為了明天的約會，李小姐今天晚上要好好地保養。
text.english: To get ready for her date tomorrow, Ms. Li is going to take good care of her skin tonight.
text.pinyin: Wèile míngtiān de yuēhuì, Lǐ xiǎojiě jīntiān wǎnshang yào hǎohǎo de bǎoyǎng.
text.simplified: 为了明天的约会，李小姐今天晚上要好好地保养。

text.traditional: 為了把英文學好，我決定下個學期去英國留學。
text.english: In order to learn English well, I decided to study in the United Kingdom next semester.
text.pinyin: Wèile bǎ Yīngwén xuéhǎo, wǒ juédìng xià ge xuéqī qù Yīngguó liúxué.
text.simplified: 为了把英文学好，我决定下个学期去英国留学。

text.traditional: 為了租到比較便宜的公寓，阮先生已經找了好幾個地方了。
text.english: To rent a less expensive apartment, Mr. Ruan has already looked at several places.
text.pinyin: Wèile zū dào bǐjiào piányi de gōngyù, Ruǎn xiānsheng yǐjīng zhǎo le hǎojǐ ge dìfang le.
text.simplified: 为了租到比较便宜的公寓，阮先生已经找了好几个地方了。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 為了 introduces the purpose of an action. It can be followed by a noun phrase or an action; the main action comes after the purpose.

items.question: 「為了明天的約會」是在說約會造成她保養嗎？
items.answer: 不是。「為了」引出她想達成的目的；原因可用「因為」表達。
items.wrongTraditional: 因為明天的約會，李小姐今天晚上要好好地保養。
items.wrongSimplified: 因为明天的约会，李小姐今天晚上要好好地保养。

right.traditional: 為了明天的約會，李小姐今天晚上要好好地保養。
right.english: To get ready for her date tomorrow, Ms. Li is going to take good care of her skin tonight.
right.pinyin: wèile míngtiān de yuēhuì Lǐ xiǎojiě jīntiān wǎnshang yào hǎohǎo de bǎoyǎng

items.question: 「為了把英文學好」說的是原因還是目的？
items.answer: 這裡說的是留學前想達成的目的；「為了」後面接目標。
items.wrongTraditional: 為了把英文學好，我決定下個學期去英國留學。
items.wrongSimplified: 为了把英文学好，我决定下个学期去英国留学。

right.traditional: 為了把英文學好，我決定下個學期去英國留學。
right.english: In order to learn English well, I decided to study in the United Kingdom next semester.
right.pinyin: wèile bǎ Yīng wén xué hǎo wǒ jué dìng xià ge xué qī qù Yīng guó liúxué

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “為了” is followed by the purpose of an action or a behavior.

dialogue.title: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
dialogue.setting: 在教室裡 · In the classroom

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （美心跟以凡在教室裡）
lines.simplified: （美心跟以凡在教室里）
lines.pinyin: （Měixīn gēn Yǐfán zài jiàoshì lǐ）
lines.english: (Meixin and Yifan are in the classroom.)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 以凡，你貼在豆漿盒子上的那張貼紙，可以給我嗎？
lines.simplified: 以凡，你贴在豆浆盒子上的那张贴纸，可以给我吗？
lines.pinyin: Yǐfán, nǐ tiē zài dòujiāng hézi shàng de nà zhāng tiēzhǐ, kěyǐ gěi wǒ ma?
lines.english: Yifan, can you give me the sticker that you pasted on the soy milk carton?

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 妳說的貼紙是便利商店店員給我的這張嗎？
lines.simplified: 妳说的贴纸是便利商店店员给我的这张吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de tiēzhǐ shì biànlì shāngdiàn diànyuán gěi wǒ de zhè zhāng ma?
lines.english: Are you talking about the one that the clerk of the convenience store gave me?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 是啊！我只差一張，就能換一個史努比（Snoopy）娃娃了！
lines.simplified: 是啊！我只差一张，就能换一个史努比（Snoopy）娃娃了！
lines.pinyin: Shì a! Wǒ zhǐ chà yì zhāng, jiù néng huàn yí ge Shǐnǔbǐ (Snoopy) wáwa le!
lines.english: Yes! I only need one more to be able to exchange for a Snoopy doll.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 給妳吧！我覺得它很可愛，才把它貼在盒子上，其實我不知道店員為什麼給我貼紙。
lines.simplified: 给妳吧！我觉得它很可爱，才把它贴在盒子上，其实我不知道店员为什么给我贴纸。
lines.pinyin: Gěi nǐ ba! Wǒ juéde tā hěn kě’ài, cái bǎ tā tiē zài hézi shàng, qíshí wǒ bù zhīdào diànyuán wèishénme gěi wǒ tiēzhǐ.
lines.english: Here you are! I put it on the soy milk carton only because I think it's cute. Actually, I don't know why the clerk gave me this sticker.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 這是便利商店的活動，買東西只要滿八十元，就會有一張貼紙，四十張貼紙就可以換一個娃娃，而且不用錢。
lines.simplified: 这是便利商店的活动，买东西只要满八十元，就会有一张贴纸，四十张贴纸就可以换一个娃娃，而且不用钱。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì biànlì shāngdiàn de huódòng, mǎi dōngxi zhǐyào mǎn bāshí yuán, jiù huì yǒu yì zhāng tiēzhǐ, sìshí zhāng tiēzhǐ jiù kěyǐ huàn yí ge wáwa, érqiě búyòng qián.
lines.english: It's a sales promotion of convenience stores. As long as the price of the products you buy exceeds $80, you can get one sticker, 40 stickers can be exchanged for a doll for free.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 免費？真的連一塊錢都不用付，就可以得到像史努比那樣的娃娃嗎？
lines.simplified: 免费？真的连一块钱都不用付，就可以得到像史努比那样的娃娃吗？
lines.pinyin: Miǎnfèi? Zhēn de lián yí kuài qián dōu búyòng fù, jiù kěyǐ dédào xiàng Shǐnǔbǐ nàyàng de wáwa ma?
lines.english: For free? You really don't have to pay even one dollar to get a doll like Snoopy?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 當然是真的。下次你去便利商店，看看門口貼的海報就知道了。這次送的娃娃非常可愛，我擔心很快就換完了！
lines.simplified: 当然是真的。下次你去便利商店，看看门口贴的海报就知道了。这次送的娃娃非常可爱，我担心很快就换完了！
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán shì zhēn de. Xià cì nǐ qù biànlì shāngdiàn, kànkan ménkǒu tiē de hǎibào jiù zhīdào le. Zhè cì sòng de wáwa fēicháng kě’ài, wǒ dānxīn hěn kuài jiù huàn wán le!
lines.english: Of course it's true! Next time when you go to a convenience store, just take a look at the poster on the door and you'll know. This time the dolls given are very cute. I am afraid their stocks will run out soon!

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 這次？妳的意思是像這樣的活動不只一次嗎？為什麼便利商店要辦這樣的活動呢？
lines.simplified: 这次？妳的意思是像这样的活动不只一次吗？为什么便利商店要办这样的活动呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì? Nǐ de yìsi shì xiàng zhèyàng de huódòng bù zhǐ yí cì ma? Wèishénme biànlì shāngdiàn yào bàn zhèyàng de huódòng ne?
lines.english: This time? You mean this kind of sales promotion event can take place more than once? Why do convenience stores organize such sales promotion event?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 因為很多人容易被可愛的小東西吸引，所以商人就利用這種心理，做了像尺、牙刷、杯子、盤子這樣的小禮物，上面都有可愛的卡通人物，讓大家常常想去買東西。
lines.simplified: 因为很多人容易被可爱的小东西吸引，所以商人就利用这种心理，做了像尺、牙刷、杯子、盘子这样的小礼物，上面都有可爱的卡通人物，让大家常常想去买东西。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn duō rén róngyì bèi kě’ài de xiǎo dōngxi xīyǐn, suǒyǐ shāngrén jiù lìyòng zhè zhǒng xīnlǐ, zuò le xiàng chǐ, yáshuā, bēizi, pánzi zhèyàng de xiǎo lǐwù, shàngmiàn dōu yǒu kě’ài de kǎtōng rénwù, ràng dàjiā chángcháng xiǎng qù mǎi dōngxi.
lines.english: Many people are easily attracted by little, cute things, so businessmen take advantage of this psychological fact. They make small gifts such as rulers, toothbrushes, mugs, plates, and so on. They are all printed with cute cartoon characters, making everyone want to buy things more often.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 那麼，有些人想要快點兒得到喜愛的小禮物，只好多花錢買一些不需要的東西吧？
lines.simplified: 那么，有些人想要快点儿得到喜爱的小礼物，只好多花钱买一些不需要的东西吧？
lines.pinyin: Nàme, yǒuxiē rén xiǎngyào kuài diǎnr dédào xǐ’ài de xiǎo lǐwù, zhǐhǎo duō huāqián mǎi yìxiē bù xūyào de dōngxi ba?
lines.english: In that case, some people want to get the gifts they love faster, so they spend more money on unnecessary things, right?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 你說對了！一開始是商人為了吸引顧客，才想出這個辦法的。沒想到小禮物太有吸引力了，後來就變成台灣便利商店的文化了。
lines.simplified: 你说对了！一开始是商人为了吸引顾客，才想出这个办法的。没想到小礼物太有吸引力了，后来就变成台湾便利商店的文化了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō duì le! Yìkāishǐ shì shāngrén wèile xīyǐn gùkè, cái xiǎng chū zhège bànfǎ de. Méi xiǎngdào xiǎo lǐwù tài yǒu xīyǐnlì le, hòulái jiù biànchéng Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn de wénhuà le.
lines.english: You are right! At first, the businessmen came up with this idea in order to attract customers. They didn't expect those little gifts to be that attractive. Later, they have become a part of the culture of Taiwanese convenience stores.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 台灣所有便利商店都有這樣的活動嗎？
lines.simplified: 台湾所有便利商店都有这样的活动吗？
lines.pinyin: Táiwān suǒyǒu biànlì shāngdiàn dōu yǒu zhèyàng de huódòng ma?
lines.english: Do all convenience stores in Taiwan have this kind of sales promotion event?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 差不多都有。這類活動對生意的影響很大，只要有「拿貼紙、送禮物」的活動，就會增加不少顧客。
lines.simplified: 差不多都有。这类活动对生意的影响很大，只要有「拿贴纸、送礼物」的活动，就会增加不少顾客。
lines.pinyin: Chàbuduō dōu yǒu. Zhè lèi huódòng duì shēngyì de yǐngxiǎng hěn dà, zhǐyào yǒu “ná tiēzhǐ, sòng lǐwù” de huódòng, jiù huì zēngjiā bùshǎo gùkè.
lines.english: Almost all of them. This kind of event has a great impact on business. As long as you organize a "Collect the Stickers, Receive the Gifts" type of event, the number of customers will increase a lot.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 聽起來真有趣！以後我也要注意可以換什麼小禮物，這會是我在台灣生活的紀念。
lines.simplified: 听起来真有趣！以后我也要注意可以换什么小礼物，这会是我在台湾生活的纪念。
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái zhēn yǒuqù! Yǐhòu wǒ yě yào zhùyì kěyǐ huàn shénme xiǎo lǐwù, zhè huì shì wǒ zài Táiwān shēnghuó de jìniàn.
lines.english: Sounds really interesting! Later I'll also pay attention to what little gifts I can get. It can be a souvenir of my life in Taiwan.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 沒錯。不過，現在請你把貼紙給我，讓我去換史努比吧！
lines.simplified: 没错。不过，现在请你把贴纸给我，让我去换史努比吧！
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò. Búguò, xiànzài qǐng nǐ bǎ tiēzhǐ gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ qù huàn Shǐnǔbǐ ba!
lines.english: Right. But now please give me the sticker and let me exchange them for Snoopy!
