grammarPages.lessonTitle: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 上 after a verb to show successful contact or reaching a target.
grammarPages.explanation: 動詞後的結果補語「上」在本課有三種意思：加上某物、達到目標，或進入某種狀態。可用「V上了、沒V上、V得上、V不上」等形式；要依動詞和上下文判斷是哪一種意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 上（了） / 沒 + Verb + 上 / Verb + 得上 / Verb + 不上

text.traditional: 天氣冷了，快把外套穿上吧！
text.english: It is cold; quickly put on your coat!
text.pinyin: Tiānqì lěng le, kuài bǎ wàitào chuānshàng ba!
text.simplified: 天气冷了，快把外套穿上吧！

text.traditional: 便利商店的門貼上了「買咖啡送貼紙」的海報。
text.english: The convenience store put a “Buy coffee, get a sticker” poster on its door.
text.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de mén tiē shàng le “Mǎi kāfēi sòng tiēzhǐ” de hǎibào.

words.meaning: result or reaching complement; into a state

text.simplified: 便利商店的门贴上了「买咖啡送贴纸」的海报。

text.traditional: 我要早點兒出門，才趕得上公車。
text.english: I need to leave early so I can catch the bus.
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào zǎo diǎnr chūmén, cái gǎn de shàng gōngchē.

words.meaning: to catch; make it in time
result or reaching complement; into a state

text.simplified: 我要早点儿出门，才赶得上公车。

text.traditional: 爸爸走得太快，我跟不上。
text.english: Dad walks too fast; I cannot keep up with him.
text.pinyin: Bàba zǒu de tài kuài, wǒ gēn bu shàng.
text.simplified: 爸爸走得太快，我跟不上。

text.traditional: 莫以凡一到台灣就喜歡上了台灣文化。
text.english: As soon as Mo Yifan arrived in Taiwan, they fell in love with Taiwanese culture.
text.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán yí dào Táiwān jiù xǐhuan shàng le Táiwān wénhuà.
text.simplified: 莫以凡一到台湾就喜欢上了台湾文化。

text.traditional: 那瓶香水很便宜，味道也不好，李小姐一定看不上。
text.english: That bottle of perfume is cheap and smells bad, so Ms. Li definitely will not want it.
text.pinyin: Nà píng xiāngshuǐ hěn piányi, wèidào yě bù hǎo, Lǐ xiǎojie yídìng kàn bù shàng.

words.meaning: result or reaching complement; into a state

text.simplified: 那瓶香水很便宜，味道也不好，李小姐一定看不上。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The complement 上 has three meanings in these examples: adding or putting something on (穿上、貼上), reaching or catching up (趕得上、跟不上), and entering a new state (喜歡上、看不上). The verb and context tell you which meaning applies. Its form also changes with completion, negation, or possibility, as in V上了, 沒V上, V得上, and V不上.

items.question: 這裡的「穿上」是「穿到上面」的方向嗎？
items.answer: 這一例的「上」和「穿」合用，表示把外套穿好；後面的例句裡「上」也能表示趕上或喜歡上。
items.wrongTraditional: 天氣冷了，快把外套上穿吧！
items.wrongSimplified: 天气冷了，快把外套上穿吧！

right.traditional: 天氣冷了，快把外套穿上吧！
right.english: It is cold; quickly put on your coat!
right.pinyin: tiān qì lěng le kuài bǎ wàitào chuān shàng ba

items.question: 「趕得上公車」的「上」和「穿上外套」的「上」意思完全相同嗎？
items.answer: 不完全相同。「趕得上」表示能趕上、來得及；「穿上」表示穿好。
items.wrongTraditional: 我要早點兒出門，才趕不上公車。
items.wrongSimplified: 我要早点儿出门，才赶不上公车。

right.traditional: 我要早點兒出門，才趕得上公車。
right.english: I need to leave early so I can catch the bus.
right.pinyin: wǒ yào zǎo diǎnr chūmén cái gǎn de shàng gōng chē

words.meaning: to catch; make it in time
result or reaching complement; into a state

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The verb complement “上” has three meanings: (A) add something to another thing, e.g., “穿上” and “加上”. (B) to reach, e.g., “趕上” and “追上” (zhuīshàng, to catch up). (C) a certain status occurs, e.g., “愛上” and “看上”.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give a cause using 因為……的關係.
grammarPages.explanation: 「因為……的關係」用來簡短說明原因；「因為」後接名詞或短語，不接完整子句。原因短語可放在結果前，也可放在結果後。
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 因為 + Cause + 的關係，+ Result

text.traditional: 因為工作的關係，他決定搬到公司附近去住。
text.english: Because of work, he decided to move closer to his company.
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de guānxì, tā juédìng bān dào gōngsī fùjìn qù zhù.
text.simplified: 因为工作的关系，他决定搬到公司附近去住。

text.traditional: 因為放春假的關係，去高雄的高鐵票都賣光了。
text.english: Because of spring break, all the high-speed rail tickets to Kaohsiung sold out.
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi fàng chūnjià de guānxì, qù Gāoxióng de gāotiě piào dōu mài guāng le.
text.simplified: 因为放春假的关系，去高雄的高铁票都卖光了。

text.traditional: 因為沒時間化妝的關係，金小姐不想去參加舞會。
text.english: Because she has no time to put on makeup, Ms. Jin does not want to go to the dance.
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi méi shíjiān huàzhuāng de guānxì, Jīn xiǎojie bù xiǎng qù cānjiā wǔhuì.
text.simplified: 因为没时间化妆的关系，金小姐不想去参加舞会。

text.traditional: 她到韓國留學是因為男朋友的關係。
text.english: She went to study in Korea because of her boyfriend.
text.pinyin: Tā dào Hánguó liúxué shì yīnwèi nánpéngyou de guānxì.
text.simplified: 她到韩国留学是因为男朋友的关系。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 因為……的關係 gives a brief cause without explaining it in a full clause. Put a noun or phrase after 因為 and before 的關係. This cause phrase can come before or after the result.

items.question: 「因為工作的關係」和「為了工作」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「因為」說明造成搬家的原因；「為了」會引出搬家的目的。
items.wrongTraditional: 為了工作的關係，他決定搬到公司附近去住。
items.wrongSimplified: 为了工作的关系，他决定搬到公司附近去住。

right.traditional: 因為工作的關係，他決定搬到公司附近去住。
right.english: Because of work, he decided to move closer to his company.
right.pinyin: yīn wèi gōng zuò de guānxì tā jué dìng bān dào gōng sī fù jìn qù zhù

items.question: 「因為放春假的關係」是在說旅行目的嗎？
items.answer: 不是。這句用春假解釋高鐵票為什麼賣光；原因和目的要分清楚。
items.wrongTraditional: 為了放春假的關係，去高雄的高鐵票都賣光了。
items.wrongSimplified: 为了放春假的关系，去高雄的高铁票都卖光了。

right.traditional: 因為放春假的關係，去高雄的高鐵票都賣光了。
right.english: Because of spring break, all the high-speed rail tickets to Kaohsiung sold out.
right.pinyin: yīn wèi fàng chūnjià de guānxì qù Gāo xióng de gāo tiě piào dōu mài guāng le

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “因為……的關係” is used when the speaker would like to state a brief cause rather than going into details. Thus, in this pattern, “因為” is followed only by nouns or phrases.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 陳可欣發現她的同學方靜文最近變了，不但上課的時候打瞌睡，連作業也不寫。可欣以為靜文發生了什麼事，下課以後就找她聊聊。原來她最近愛上了韓國連續劇，每天都花很多時間看，有時候還為了看韓劇不睡覺，當然就沒時間寫作業了。
lines.simplified: 陈可欣发现她的同学方静文最近变了，不但上课的时候打瞌睡，连作业也不写。可欣以为静文发生了什么事，下课以后就找她聊聊。原来她最近爱上了韩国连续剧，每天都花很多时间看，有时候还为了看韩剧不睡觉，当然就没时间写作业了。
lines.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn fāxiàn tā de tóngxué Fāng Jìngwén zuìjìn biàn le, búdàn shàngkè de shíhou dǎ kēshuì, lián zuòyè yě bù xiě. Kěxīn yǐwéi Jìngwén fāshēng le shénme shì, xiàkè yǐhòu jiù zhǎo tā liáoliao. Yuánlái tā zuìjìn àishàng le Hánguó liánxùjù, měitiān dōu huā hěn duō shíjiān kàn, yǒushíhou hái wèile kàn Hánjù bú shuìjiào, dāngrán jiù méi shíjiān xiě zuòyè le.
lines.english: Chen Kexin found out that her classmate, Fang Jingwen, has recently changed. Not only does she doze off during classes, but she doesn't even do her homework. Kexin thought something had happened to Jingwen, so she went to her after classes to chat. It turned out that she has recently been in love with Korean drama series. She spends a lot of time watching them every day, and sometimes she doesn't even sleep watching Korean dramas. Of course she had no time to do her homework.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 因為韓劇的關係，靜文常去韓式餐廳吃飯，也常上網看韓國最流行的服裝，還買了很多像帽子、毛衣、裙子、化妝品這樣的商品。連韓國小姐化妝的樣子跟保養的方法，她都學會了。她還計畫後年到韓國去遊學，因為這樣不但可以學韓國話，也可以去連續劇裡的那些地方看看。
lines.simplified: 因为韩剧的关系，静文常去韩式餐厅吃饭，也常上网看韩国最流行的服装，还买了很多像帽子、毛衣、裙子、化妆品这样的商品。连韩国小姐化妆的样子跟保养的方法，她都学会了。她还计划后年到韩国去游学，因为这样不但可以学韩国话，也可以去连续剧里的那些地方看看。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi Hánjù de guānxì, Jìngwén cháng qù Hánshì cāntīng chīfàn, yě cháng shàngwǎng kàn Hánguó zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng, hái mǎi le hěn duō xiàng màozi, máoyī, qúnzi, huàzhuāngpǐn zhèyàng de shāngpǐn. Lián Hánguó xiǎojiě huàzhuāng de yàngzi gēn bǎoyǎng de fāngfǎ, tā dōu xuéhuì le. Tā hái jìhuà hòunián dào Hánguó qù yóuxué, yīnwèi zhèyàng búdàn kěyǐ xué Hánguóhuà, yě kěyǐ qù liánxùjù lǐ de nàxiē dìfang kànkan.
lines.english: Because of the Korean drama series, Jingwen often dines out in Korean restaurants. She also often looks at the most popular Korean clothing on the Internet. Besides, she bought many commodities such as hats, sweaters, skirts and cosmetics. She has even learned the make-up style and skincare routine of Korean women. She also plans to go to Korea for a study tour the year after next year. This way she can not only learn Korean, but also go take a look at the places shown in the drama series.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 其實，很多台灣人為了跟上流行，除了看韓劇，還會看日劇或是美國影集。去 KTV 唱日文歌、去美國餐廳吃飯，也都是很平常的活動。可欣想，原來流行會讓人的生活方式有這麼大的改變！現在有「韓流」，以後會有什麼呢？
lines.simplified: 其实，很多台湾人为了跟上流行，除了看韩剧，还会看日剧或是美国影集。去 KTV 唱日文歌、去美国餐厅吃饭，也都是很平常的活动。可欣想，原来流行会让人的生活方式有这么大的改变！现在有「韩流」，以后会有什么呢？
lines.pinyin: Qíshí, hěn duō Táiwān rén wèile gēnshàng liúxíng, chúle kàn Hánjù, hái huì kàn Rìjù huòshì Měiguó yǐngjí. Qù KTV chàng Rìwén gē, qù Měiguó cāntīng chīfàn, yě dōu shì hěn píngcháng de huódòng. Kěxīn xiǎng, yuánlái liúxíng huì ràng rén de shēnghuó fāngshì yǒu zhème dà de gǎibiàn! Xiànzài yǒu “Hánliú”, yǐhòu huì yǒu shénme ne?
lines.english: In fact, many people also watch Japanese dramas or American TV series in order to keep up with the trends. Going to karaoke bars to sing Japanese songs or eating at American restaurants are both very common activities. Kexin thought: “So fashion really can change people's lives that much! Now we have the Korean wave, and then what will come next?”

items.title: Grammar 1–6 · Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use a negative statement plus 嗎 to point out an assumed fact, often with a confrontational tone.
grammarPages.explanation: 「S + 不／沒 + V（+ O）+ 嗎？」不是真的詢問未知資訊；說話者認為事實已知，語氣可能較不客氣。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: A sentence using this pattern is not a real interrogative sentence. Instead, this pattern, which indicates what the speaker says is a known fact, forms a rhetorical question with a more impolite tone. The structure is “S+不/沒+V（+O）+嗎？”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: A sentence using this pattern is not a real interrogative sentence. Instead, this pattern, which indicates what the speaker says is a known fact, forms a rhetorical question with a more impolite tone. The structure is “S+不/沒+V（+O）+嗎？”.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 不／沒 + V（+ O）+ 嗎？

text.traditional: A：這個週末我不知道要做什麼。B：你下個禮拜就要出國留學了，不用準備行李嗎？
text.english: A: I don’t know what to do this weekend. B: You’re going abroad to study next week; shouldn’t you prepare your luggage?
text.simplified: A：这个周末我不知道要做什么。B：你下个礼拜就要出国留学了，不用准备行李吗？
text.pinyin: A: Zhège zhōumò wǒ bù zhīdào yào zuò shénme. B: Nǐ xià ge lǐbài jiù yào chūguó liúxué le, bú yòng zhǔnbèi xíngli ma?

text.traditional: A：明天的中文課要考第幾課？B：老師剛剛上課的時候說了好幾次，你沒聽到嗎？
text.english: A: Which lesson will tomorrow’s Chinese test cover? B: The teacher said it several times in class. Didn’t you hear?
text.simplified: A：明天的中文课要考第几课？B：老师刚刚上课的时候说了好几次，你没听到吗？
text.pinyin: A: Míngtiān de Zhōngwén kè yào kǎo dì jǐ kè? B: Lǎoshī gānggāng shàngkè de shíhou shuō le hǎo jǐ cì, nǐ méi tīngdào ma?

text.traditional: A：我晚上要看那部很有名的韓國連續劇。B：你不是以前看過了嗎？值得再看一次嗎？
text.english: A: I’m going to watch that famous Korean drama tonight. B: Haven’t you seen it before? Is it worth watching again?
text.simplified: A：我晚上要看那部很有名的韩国连续剧。B：你不是以前看过了吗？值得再看一次吗？
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ wǎnshàng yào kàn nà bù hěn yǒumíng de Hánguó liánxùjù. B: Nǐ bú shì yǐqián kànguo le ma? Zhídé zài kàn yí cì ma?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Tell someone to do an action faster or more slowly.
grammarPages.explanation: 「快／慢（一）點兒」放在動詞前，作為催促或提醒的祈使語句。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 快（一）點兒 + V urges someone to act sooner. 慢（一）點兒 + V asks someone to slow down or wait because there is enough time.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “快/慢（+一）點兒+V” is an imperative sentence. It is used when the speaker asks others to put aside what they are doing because there is not enough time or an emergency takes place. The pattern aims to hurry someone up. In addition, “慢（+一）點兒” indicates that the speakers consider the time is sufficient, and no need to hurry to do something. Wait for a moment and do it later and the result may be better.
grammarPages.pattern: 快／慢（+ 一）點兒 + V

text.traditional: 下雨了，你別在外面玩，快（一）點兒進來！
text.english: It’s raining. Don’t play outside; come in quickly!
text.simplified: 下雨了，你别在外面玩，快（一）点儿进来！
text.pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, nǐ bié zài wàimiàn wán, kuài (yì) diǎnr jìnlái!

text.traditional: 已經八點了，你快（一）點兒起床，要不然上班會遲到！
text.english: It’s already eight. Get up quickly, or you’ll be late for work!
text.simplified: 已经八点了，你快（一）点儿起床，要不然上班会迟到！
text.pinyin: Yǐjīng bā diǎn le, nǐ kuài (yì) diǎnr qǐchuáng, yàobùrán shàngbān huì chídào!

text.traditional: 茶還很熱，你慢（一）點兒喝吧！
text.english: The tea is still hot. Drink it slowly.
text.simplified: 茶还很热，你慢（一）点儿喝吧！
text.pinyin: Chá hái hěn rè, nǐ màn (yì) diǎnr hē ba!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Marking a Destination or Endpoint with 到
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say where an action ends, when it lasts until, or how far a range or quantity reaches.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V 到」後面接動作到達的目的地、持續到的時間，或達到的範圍／數量。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 到 follows the verb and marks the endpoint: a place, a time, or the end of a range or quantity.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “V 到” is followed by a destination to which the subject does an action. The destination can be a place, a point of time, a range or a number.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 到 + Place／Time／Range or quantity

text.traditional: 這張書桌，我想搬到房間去。
text.english: I want to move this desk into the room.
text.simplified: 这张书桌，我想搬到房间去。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhāng shūzhuō, wǒ xiǎng bān dào fángjiān qù.

text.traditional: A：我的中文書，你拿到哪裡去了？B：我拿到客廳去了。
text.english: A: Where did you take my Chinese book? B: I took it to the living room.
text.simplified: A：我的中文书，你拿到哪里去了？B：我拿到客厅去了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shū, nǐ nádào nǎlǐ qù le? B: Wǒ nádào kètīng qù le.

text.traditional: A：請問從這裡走到台北101去要多久？B：不太遠，大概十分鐘就走到了。
text.english: A: How long does it take to walk from here to Taipei 101? B: Not far; about ten minutes.
text.simplified: A：请问从这里走到台北101去要多久？B：不太远，大概十分钟就走到了。
text.pinyin: A: Qǐngwèn cóng zhèlǐ zǒudào Táiběi 101 qù yào duōjiǔ? B: Bú tài yuǎn, dàgài shí fēnzhōng jiù zǒudào le.

text.traditional: 爸爸昨天工作到晚上九點才回家。
text.english: Dad worked until nine last night before coming home.
text.simplified: 爸爸昨天工作到晚上九点才回家。
text.pinyin: Bàba zuótiān gōngzuò dào wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn cái huíjiā.

text.traditional: 我們今天要去逛街，打算逛到晚上十點。
text.english: We are going shopping today and plan to shop until ten tonight.
text.simplified: 我们今天要去逛街，打算逛到晚上十点。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào qù guàngjiē, dǎsuàn guàng dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn.

text.traditional: A：你昨天寫作業寫到幾點？B：寫到半夜兩點才寫完。
text.english: A: Until what time did you do your homework yesterday? B: I worked until two a.m. and only then finished.
text.simplified: A：你昨天写作业写到几点？B：写到半夜两点才写完。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zuótiān xiě zuòyè xiě dào jǐ diǎn? B: Xiě dào bànyè liǎng diǎn cái xiě wán.

text.traditional: 昨天歷史課，教授教到第一百六十頁了。
text.english: In history class yesterday, the professor taught up to page 160.
text.simplified: 昨天历史课，教授教到第一百六十页了。

words.pinyin: dì yī bǎi liù shí yè

text.pinyin: Zuótiān lìshǐ kè, jiàoshòu jiāo dào dì yī bǎi liù shí yè le.

text.traditional: 到那個博物館參觀的遊客，今年增加到三百多萬人了。
text.english: The number of visitors to that museum increased to over three million this year.
text.simplified: 到那个博物馆参观的游客，今年增加到三百多万人了。
text.pinyin: Dào nà ge bówùguǎn cānguān de yóukè, jīnnián zēngjiā dào sān bǎi duō wàn rén le.

text.traditional: A：下星期一要考試，你念到第幾課了？B：我念到第三課了，還有兩課沒念。
text.english: A: Which lesson have you studied up to for Monday’s exam? B: I’ve reached lesson three; I still have two lessons to go.
text.simplified: A：下星期一要考试，你念到第几课了？B：我念到第三课了，还有两课没念。
text.pinyin: A: Xià xīngqīyī yào kǎoshì, nǐ niàndào dì jǐ kè le? B: Wǒ niàndào dì sān kè le, hái yǒu liǎng kè méi niàn.

subsections.title: Place destination
subsections.explanation: 到 marks the place reached by the action.
subsections.pattern: V 到 + 地方 + 來／去

subsections.title: Time endpoint
subsections.explanation: 到 marks the endpoint in time.

subsections.title: Range or quantity
subsections.explanation: 到 marks the endpoint of a range or a reached quantity.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Soften or avoid a direct response by pairing a negative with a question word.
grammarPages.explanation: 否定句中的疑問詞可表「不怎麼／不太」、「不多／沒多少」、「不去哪裡」或「不跟誰」等婉轉、避而不答的語氣。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In a negative sentence, a question word can make a noncommittal or softened statement, such as 不怎麼 (not very), 沒去哪裡 (didn’t go anywhere), or 沒跟誰 (didn’t go with anyone).
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is used when the subject is unwilling to show his/her attitude and avoids giving an explicit response. This pattern is always a negative sentence collocating with question words, such as “什麼”, “多少”, “幾”, “誰”, “怎麼”, “哪裡” and “什麼地方”. The structure is “S+不/沒+V+多少/幾 M/什麼/哪裡/什麼地方（+O）” or “S+不/沒+跟+誰+V（+O）”, “S+不+怎麼+Vs” or “S+不+怎麼+Vaux+V（+O）”.
grammarPages.pattern: Negative statement + question word

text.traditional: 那部卡通不怎麼有名，很多人都沒看過。
text.english: That cartoon is not very famous; many people have never seen it.
text.simplified: 那部卡通不怎么有名，很多人都没看过。
text.pinyin: Nà bù kǎtōng bù zěnme yǒumíng, hěn duō rén dōu méi kànguo.

text.traditional: 王先生不怎麼願意做家事，讓太太不怎麼高興。
text.english: Mr. Wang is not very willing to do housework, which makes his wife rather unhappy.
text.simplified: 王先生不怎么愿意做家事，让太太不怎么高兴。
text.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng bù zěnme yuànyì zuò jiāshì, ràng tàitai bù zěnme gāoxìng.

text.traditional: 我昨天下午沒去哪裡／什麼地方，都在家休息。
text.english: I didn’t go anywhere yesterday afternoon; I stayed home and rested.
text.simplified: 我昨天下午没去哪里／什么地方，都在家休息。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān xiàwǔ méi qù nǎlǐ / shénme dìfang, dōu zài jiā xiūxi.

text.traditional: A：你昨天吃了那麼多小吃，花了多少錢？B：沒花多少錢，因為價錢都不貴。
text.english: A: You ate so many snacks yesterday. How much did you spend? B: I didn’t spend much because they were all inexpensive.
text.simplified: A：你昨天吃了那么多小吃，花了多少钱？B：没花多少钱，因为价钱都不贵。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zuótiān chī le nàme duō xiǎochī, huā le duōshao qián? B: Méi huā duōshao qián, yīnwèi jiàqián dōu bú guì.

text.traditional: A：你想去便利商店買什麼？B：我不想買什麼，只想看看新活動海報。
text.english: A: What do you want to buy at the convenience store? B: I don’t want to buy anything; I just want to look at the new event poster.
text.simplified: A：你想去便利商店买什么？B：我不想买什么，只想看看新活动海报。

words.meaning: do not want to buy anything

text.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎng qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi shénme? B: Wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi shénme, zhǐ xiǎng kànkan xīn huódòng hǎibào.

text.traditional: 女朋友：你昨天跟誰去 KTV 唱歌了？快點兒說！男朋友：你放心！我沒跟誰去，我是一個人去的！
text.english: Girlfriend: Who did you go sing karaoke with yesterday? Tell me! Boyfriend: Don’t worry! I didn’t go with anyone; I went alone!
text.simplified: 女朋友：你昨天跟谁去 KTV 唱歌了？快点儿说！男朋友：你放心！我没跟谁去，我是一个人去的！
text.pinyin: Nǚ péngyou: Nǐ zuótiān gēn shéi qù KTV chànggē le? Kuài diǎnr shuō! Nán péngyou: Nǐ fàngxīn! Wǒ méi gēn shéi qù, wǒ shì yí ge rén qù de!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Expressing Surprise with 怎麼這麼
grammarPages.learnerPromise: React with surprise or disbelief about a quality or situation.
grammarPages.explanation: 「怎麼這麼 + Vs」表示對某種情況感到驚訝或不敢相信；說話者不一定真的在等回答。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.pattern: 怎麼這麼 + Vs（+ ...）

text.traditional: A：這個卡通人物怎麼這麼可愛！B：真的嗎？我覺得史努比比較可愛。
text.english: A: How can this cartoon character be so cute! B: Really? I think Snoopy is cuter.
text.simplified: A：这个卡通人物怎么这么可爱！B：真的吗？我觉得史努比比较可爱。
text.pinyin: A: Zhège kǎtōng rénwù zěnme zhème kě'ài! B: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ juéde Shǐnǔbǐ bǐjiào kě'ài.

text.traditional: 你怎麼這麼累？昨天晚上沒睡覺嗎？
text.english: How can you be so tired? Didn’t you sleep last night?
text.simplified: 你怎么这么累？昨天晚上没睡觉吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème lèi? Zuótiān wǎnshàng méi shuìjiào ma?

text.traditional: 明天有期末考，你怎麼這麼輕鬆？都準備好了嗎？
text.english: You have a final exam tomorrow. How can you be so relaxed? Are you all prepared?
text.simplified: 明天有期末考，你怎么这么轻松？都准备好了吗？
text.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu qímòkǎo, nǐ zěnme zhème qīngsōng? Dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Enough Room or Capacity with 得下／不下
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether a place or person has enough capacity to hold, contain, or eat something.
grammarPages.explanation: 「下」作結果補語時表示空間或身心能力是否足以容納／完成某事；此處只用可能式「V 得下／V 不下」。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 下 as a resultative complement describes whether there is enough capacity. This pattern appears only in the potential forms V 得下 and V 不下.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “下” is a resultative complement indicating whether or not the subject has enough space to accommodate the object. Sometimes, the situation results from the subject's mental or physical factors. This resultative complement only has potential structure.
grammarPages.pattern: V 得下／V 不下 + Object

text.traditional: 這個盒子裝得下幾塊蛋糕？
text.english: How many pieces of cake can fit in this box?
text.simplified: 这个盒子装得下几块蛋糕？
text.pinyin: Zhège hézi zhuāng de xià jǐ kuài dàngāo?

text.traditional: 這間公寓很大，住得下六個人。
text.english: This apartment is large enough for six people to live in.
text.simplified: 这间公寓很大，住得下六个人。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiān gōngyù hěn dà, zhù de xià liù ge rén.

text.traditional: 我剛剛吃了好幾個包子，現在吃不下了。
text.english: I just ate several steamed buns; I can’t eat any more now.
text.simplified: 我刚刚吃了好几个包子，现在吃不下了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng chī le hǎo jǐ ge bāozi, xiànzài chī bu xià le.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: （看看牆上的鐘）可欣，已經十二點多了，妳明天早上不是有課嗎？快點兒去睡吧！
lines.simplified: （看看墙上的钟）可欣，已经十二点多了，妳明天早上不是有课吗？快点儿去睡吧！
lines.pinyin: （Kànkan qiáng shàng de zhōng）Kěxīn, yǐjīng shí’èr diǎn duō le, nǐ míngtiān zǎoshang bú shì yǒu kè ma? Kuài diǎnr qù shuì ba!
lines.english: (Looking at the clock on the wall) Kexin, it's already past 12 o'clock. Don't you have classes tomorrow morning? Hurry up and go to sleep!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 我還不能睡。後天日本歷史考試要從第五課考到第八課，（她翻了翻書）我還有十幾頁沒念完。
lines.simplified: 我还不能睡。后天日本历史考试要从第五课考到第八课，（她翻了翻书）我还有十几页没念完。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái bù néng shuì. Hòutiān Rìběn lìshǐ kǎoshì yào cóng dì wǔ kè kǎo dào dì bā kè, (tā fān le fān shū) wǒ hái yǒu shí jǐ yè méi niàn wán.
lines.english: I can't go to sleep yet. The Japanese history exam the day after tomorrow will cover lessons 5 to 8. (She flipped through the book.) I still have more than 10 pages to finish.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 可是妳最近都只吃三明治，又很晚才睡，這樣對身體不好吧？
lines.simplified: 可是妳最近都只吃三明治，又很晚才睡，这样对身体不好吧？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ zuìjìn dōu zhǐ chī sānmíngzhì, yòu hěn wǎn cái shuì, zhèyàng duì shēntǐ bù hǎo ba?
lines.english: But you've been eating only sandwiches recently, and you go to sleep very late. It isn't good for your body, is it?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 沒辦法。這門課除了有課堂小考，期末還要考口試和寫一篇作文。要是不用功一點兒，就會被當的！
lines.simplified: 没办法。这门课除了有课堂小考，期末还要考口试和写一篇作文。要是不用功一点儿，就会被当的！
lines.pinyin: Méi bànfǎ. Zhè mén kè chúle yǒu kètáng xiǎokǎo, qímò hái yào kǎo kǒushì hé xiě yì piān zuòwén. Yàoshi bú yònggōng yìdiǎnr, jiù huì bèi dàng de!
lines.english: There's no other way. In this course there are classroom quizzes. Moreover, at the end of the semester, we have to take an oral exam and write a composition. If we don't study harder, we may flunk the course!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 聽起來很辛苦，妳為什麼要修這門課呢？
lines.simplified: 听起来很辛苦，妳为什么要修这门课呢？
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn xīnkǔ, nǐ wèishénme yào xiū zhè mén kè ne?
lines.english: Sounds tough. Why did you want to take this course?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 因為那位教授知識很豐富，教法也很好。
lines.simplified: 因为那位教授知识很丰富，教法也很好。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi nà wèi jiàoshòu zhīshi hěn fēngfù, jiàofǎ yě hěn hǎo.
lines.english: Because the professor's knowledge is very vast, and the methods of teaching are very good, too.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我們義大利文系的課好像比較輕鬆。這學期我沒修多少課，只有一門文法課要考筆試，其他兩門課只要交報告就好了。
lines.simplified: 我们意大利文系的课好像比较轻松。这学期我没修多少课，只有一门文法课要考笔试，其他两门课只要交报告就好了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen Yìdàlì wénxì de kè hǎoxiàng bǐjiào qīngsōng. Zhè xuéqī wǒ méi xiū duōshǎo kè, zhǐ yǒu yì mén wénfǎ kè yào kǎo bǐshì, qítā liǎng mén kè zhǐyào jiāo bàogào jiù hǎo le.
lines.english: Courses of the Department of Italian Language seem more laid-back. This semester I don't take too many courses. There is only one grammar course in which I have to take a written exam. In the other two, I only need to hand in reports.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 如果沒有期末考，教授怎麼給你們成績呢？
lines.simplified: 如果没有期末考，教授怎么给你们成绩呢？
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu qímò kǎo, jiàoshòu zěnme gěi nǐmen chéngjì ne?
lines.english: How does the professor score you if there is no final exam?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 只要平常認真上課，多查字典，把他要我們翻譯的文章翻好，期末成績就不會太差。
lines.simplified: 只要平常认真上课，多查字典，把他要我们翻译的文章翻好，期末成绩就不会太差。
lines.pinyin: Zhǐyào píngcháng rènzhēn shàngkè, duō chá zìdiǎn, bǎ tā yào wǒmen fānyì de wénzhāng fān hǎo, qímò chéngjì jiù bú huì tài chà.
lines.english: As long as we concentrate in class, use the dictionary often, and translate the articles he assigns, our final scores won't be too bad.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 怎麼這麼好！上次考試我太緊張，有幾題沒寫完，考得比較差，這次我一定要更努力！
lines.simplified: 怎么这么好！上次考试我太紧张，有几题没写完，考得比较差，这次我一定要更努力！
lines.pinyin: Zěnme zhème hǎo! Shàng cì kǎoshì wǒ tài jǐnzhāng, yǒu jǐ tí méi xiě wán, kǎo de bǐjiào chà, zhè cì wǒ yídìng yào gèng nǔlì!
lines.english: How can it be that good! I was too stressed on my last exam. I didn't finish several questions, so I got a worse grade. This time I must work harder!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我小時候也很怕考試，有時候一緊張就吃不下飯，現在好多了。
lines.simplified: 我小时候也很怕考试，有时候一紧张就吃不下饭，现在好多了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou yě hěn pà kǎoshì, yǒu shíhou yì jǐnzhāng jiù chī bu xià fàn, xiànzài hǎo duō le.
lines.english: When I was little, I was afraid of taking exams, too. Sometimes I was so stressed that I couldn't eat, but it's much better now.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 我覺得平常就應該多讀書，讓自己的能力更好，將來才比較容易找到好工作。
lines.simplified: 我觉得平常就应该多读书，让自己的能力更好，将来才比较容易找到好工作。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde píngcháng jiù yīnggāi duō dúshū, ràng zìjǐ de nénglì gèng hǎo, jiānglái cái bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
lines.english: I think we should normally study more to improve our own ability. In the future it will be easier to find a good job.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 念書當然很重要，可是妳今天念的書已經夠多了，現在最重要是睡覺喔！
lines.simplified: 念书当然很重要，可是妳今天念的书已经够多了，现在最重要是睡觉喔！
lines.pinyin: Niànshū dāngrán hěn zhòngyào, kěshì nǐ jīntiān niàn de shū yǐjīng gòu duō le, xiànzài zuì zhòngyào shì shuìjiào o!
lines.english: Although studying is certainly important, you have already studied enough for today. For now, the most important thing is sleep!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 好好好，我把這一頁念完就去洗澡、睡覺，明天再加油吧！
lines.simplified: 好好好，我把这一页念完就去洗澡、睡觉，明天再加油吧！
lines.pinyin: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, wǒ bǎ zhè yí yè niàn wán jiù qù xǐzǎo, shuìjiào, míngtiān zài jiāyóu ba!
lines.english: Alright, alright, alright! When I finish reading this page, I'll take a bath and go to bed right away. Tomorrow I'll keep going!

items.title: Grammar 7 · Ryosuke Yamamoto’s Life of Studying Abroad

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a quality with a vivid, high-degree form, and place it correctly before a noun, in a complement, or before a verb.
grammarPages.explanation: 狀態動詞可以重疊，單音節形式為「A A」，雙音節形式為「AABB」。作謂語時加「的」；修飾名詞時用「的」，修飾動詞時用「地」。重疊本身帶有程度高的意思，因此不和「很」、「非常」等程度副詞一起用。不是所有狀態動詞都適合重疊。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: State verbs reduplicate as AA or AABB. Use 的 for predicates and noun modifiers, and 地 before a verb. Reduplication already expresses a high degree, so it does not combine with degree adverbs. Not every state verb can be reduplicated.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern of reduplication of state verb is “Vs Vs 的/地”. Reduplication of Vs can be divided into monosyllabic Vs reduplication and disyllabic Vs reduplication. The structure of monosyllabic Vs reduplication is simple; for example, “香香的” and “慢慢地”. On the other hand, the structure of disyllabic Vs (XY) reduplication is “XXYY 的/地”; for example, “漂漂亮亮的” and “舒舒服服地”. This pattern cannot be used together with degree adverb (“非常” and “很”) because reduplication of Vs already implies a high degree. When reduplication of Vs serves as a predicate, “的” is necessary to be added, e.g., “他的眼睛大大的” and “他的房間乾乾淨淨的”. When reduplication of Vs serves as a complement, “的” can be omitted, e.g., “他們玩得開開心心（的）”. However, not every state verb can be used in this pattern. For example, “貴 (expensive)”, “忙 (busy)”, “新 (new)”, “好吃 (good to eat)”, “好喝 (good to drink)”, “可愛 (cute)”, “可怕 (terrible)”, “不錯 (not bad)” are inappropriate in this pattern.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs Vs／XXYY 的／地

text.traditional: 這朵玫瑰花紅紅的，真漂亮！
text.english: This rose is red and beautiful!
text.simplified: 这朵玫瑰花红红的，真漂亮！
text.pinyin: Zhè duǒ méiguīhuā hóng hóng de, zhēn piàoliang!

text.traditional: 這塊蛋糕香香甜甜的，真好吃！
text.english: This cake is fragrant and sweet; it tastes great!
text.simplified: 这块蛋糕香香甜甜的，真好吃！
text.pinyin: Zhè kuài dàngāo xiāng xiāng tián tián de, zhēn hǎochī!

text.traditional: 這家民宿乾乾淨淨的，住起來很舒服。
text.english: This guesthouse is clean and comfortable to stay in.
text.simplified: 这家民宿干干净净的，住起来很舒服。

words.meaning: to live in; when living there

text.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù gān gān jìng jìng de, zhù qǐlái hěn shūfu.

text.traditional: 他有一張圓圓的臉，很可愛！
text.english: He has a round face and is very cute!
text.simplified: 他有一张圆圆的脸，很可爱！
text.pinyin: Tā yǒu yì zhāng yuán yuán de liǎn, hěn kě'ài!

text.traditional: 去花蓮可以看到藍藍的大海，風景美極了。
text.english: In Hualien, you can see the blue sea; the scenery is beautiful.
text.simplified: 去花莲可以看到蓝蓝的大海，风景美极了。
text.pinyin: Qù Huālián kěyǐ kàndào lán lán de dàhǎi, fēngjǐng měi jí le.

text.traditional: 明天晚上我要去台北101，參加熱熱鬧鬧的跨年晚會。
text.english: Tomorrow night I am going to Taipei 101 to attend a lively New Year’s Eve party.
text.simplified: 明天晚上我要去台北101，参加热热闹闹的跨年晚会。
text.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshàng wǒ yào qù Táiběi 101, cānjiā rè rè nào nào de kuànián wǎnhuì.

text.traditional: 他每天早上都吃得飽飽的再去上班。
text.english: He eats until he is full every morning before going to work.
text.simplified: 他每天早上都吃得饱饱的再去上班。
text.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu chī de bǎo bǎo de zài qù shàngbān.

text.traditional: 老師說，漢字一定要寫得清清楚楚的。
text.english: The teacher says Chinese characters must be written clearly.
text.simplified: 老师说，汉字一定要写得清清楚楚的。
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, Hànzì yídìng yào xiě de qīng qīng chǔ chǔ de.

text.traditional: 因為有客人要來，所以他把房間打掃得乾乾淨淨的。
text.english: Because guests are coming, he cleaned the room thoroughly.
text.simplified: 因为有客人要来，所以他把房间打扫得干干净净的。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu kèrén yào lái, suǒyǐ tā bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gān gān jìng jìng de.

text.traditional: 這座森林的風景很美，我們慢慢地看吧。
text.english: The scenery in this forest is beautiful. Let’s take our time looking at it.
text.simplified: 这座森林的风景很美，我们慢慢地看吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè zuò sēnlín de fēngjǐng hěn měi, wǒmen màn màn de kàn ba.

text.traditional: 店員客客氣氣地跟顧客介紹新商品，希望他們多買一些。
text.english: The clerk politely introduces the new products to customers, hoping they will buy more.
text.simplified: 店员客客气气地跟顾客介绍新商品，希望他们多买一些。
text.pinyin: Diànyuán kè kè qì qì de gēn gùkè jièshào xīn shāngpǐn, xīwàng tāmen duō mǎi yìxiē.

text.traditional: 他很喜歡學中文，每天都開開心心地去上課。
text.english: He likes studying Chinese and goes to class happily every day.
text.simplified: 他很喜欢学中文，每天都开开心心地去上课。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan xué Zhōngwén, měitiān dōu kāi kāi xīn xīn de qù shàngkè.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 山本良介的大學跟台灣的大學有交換學生的計畫，他很喜歡台灣，所以決定來台灣留學。到了台灣以後，他不但認真地上日文系的課，也在華語文中心學習中文。以前他在日本就學過漢語，他覺得寫漢字一點兒也不難，但是文法跟聲調這兩個部分還需要多練習。
lines.simplified: 山本良介的大学跟台湾的大学有交换学生的计划，他很喜欢台湾，所以决定来台湾留学。到了台湾以后，他不但认真地上日文系的课，也在华语文中心学习中文。以前他在日本就学过汉语，他觉得写汉字一点儿也不难，但是文法跟声调这两个部分还需要多练习。
lines.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè de dàxué gēn Táiwān de dàxué yǒu jiāohuàn xuéshēng de jìhuà, tā hěn xǐhuan Táiwān, suǒyǐ juédìng lái Táiwān liúxué. Dào le Táiwān yǐhòu, tā búdàn rènzhēn de shàng Rìwén xì de kè, yě zài Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn xuéxí Zhōngwén. Yǐqián tā zài Rìběn jiù xué guo Hànyǔ, tā juéde xiě Hànzì yìdiǎnr yě bù nán, dànshì wénfǎ gēn shēngdiào zhè liǎng ge bùfen hái xūyào duō liànxí.
lines.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto’s university has an exchange program with a Taiwanese university. He likes Taiwan very much, so he decided to study in Taiwan. After coming to Taiwan, he not only earnestly studies the courses at the Department of Japanese Language, but also learns Chinese at the Center of Chinese Language and Culture. He has already been learning Chinese in Japan. He thinks writing Chinese characters isn’t difficult at all, but in the two aspects of grammar and tones, he still needs more practice.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介的中文老師很好，總是把生字、課文意思說得清清楚楚。不但要他們用文法造句，還要用中文報告，讓他們練習表達自己意見。期末考有筆試和作文，如果文章錯字太多或是文法不對，成績就比較差。
lines.simplified: 良介的中文老师很好，总是把生字、课文意思说得清清楚楚。不但要他们用文法造句，还要用中文报告，让他们练习表达自己意见。期末考有笔试和作文，如果文章错字太多或是文法不对，成绩就比较差。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè de Zhōngwén lǎoshī hěn hǎo, zǒngshì bǎ shēngzì, kèwén yìsi shuō de qīngqīngchǔchǔ. Búdàn yào tāmen yòng wénfǎ zàojù, hái yào yòng Zhōngwén bàogào, ràng tāmen liànxí biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn. Qímò kǎo yǒu bǐshì hé zuòwén, rúguǒ wénzhāng cuòzì tài duō huòshì wénfǎ bú duì, chéngjì jiù bǐjiào chà.
lines.english: Ryosuke’s Chinese teacher is very good. He always explains new vocabulary and the meaning of texts clearly. He asks them not only to build sentences with grammar, but also to make presentations in Chinese, letting them practice expressing their own opinions. On the final exam, they have to write a composition and take a written test. However, if too many characters are written incorrectly in the essay or if the grammar is incorrect, the score will be lower.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介在台灣交了不少朋友，他常跟他們練習說中文、問他們語法的問題。剛開學的時候，同學帶他去圖書館，教他怎麼借書、還書。有一次他搭錯車、迷了路，台灣人看到他很著急的樣子，就馬上來幫忙，告訴他怎麼走，讓良介非常感動。
lines.simplified: 良介在台湾交了不少朋友，他常跟他们练习说中文、问他们语法的问题。刚开学的时候，同学带他去图书馆，教他怎么借书、还书。有一次他搭错车、迷了路，台湾人看到他很着急的样子，就马上来帮忙，告诉他怎么走，让良介非常感动。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè zài Táiwān jiāo le bù shǎo péngyou, tā cháng gēn tāmen liànxí shuō Zhōngwén, wèn tāmen yǔfǎ de wèntí. Gāng kāixué de shíhou, tóngxué dài tā qù túshūguǎn, jiāo tā zěnme jiè shū, huán shū. Yǒu yí cì tā dā cuò chē, mí le lù, Táiwān rén kàndào tā hěn zhāojí de yàngzi, jiù mǎshàng lái bāngmáng, gàosu tā zěnme zǒu, ràng Liángjiè fēicháng gǎndòng.
lines.english: Ryosuke makes a lot of friends in Taiwan. He often practices speaking Chinese with them and asks them questions about grammar. When the semester just began, the classmates took him to the library and taught him how to borrow or return books. Once he took the wrong bus and got lost, Taiwanese people saw he was so anxious that they immediately came to help and told him how to get there. It made him feel very touched.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 最近，同學們都在討論找工作的問題。良介也很煩惱，所以他決定先請教授給他一些建議，再想想將來要怎麼做。
lines.simplified: 最近，同学们都在讨论找工作的问题。良介也很烦恼，所以他决定先请教授给他一些建议，再想想将来要怎么做。
lines.pinyin: Zuìjìn, tóngxuémen dōu zài tǎolùn zhǎo gōngzuò de wèntí. Liángjiè yě hěn fánnǎo, suǒyǐ tā juédìng xiān qǐng jiàoshòu gěi tā yìxiē jiànyì, zài xiǎngxiang jiānglái yào zěnme zuò.
lines.english: Recently, all of the classmates have been talking about the problem of finding a job. Ryosuke is also troubled with this, so he decides to ask a professor for some advice and then think of what to do in the future.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Let’s Go Work Out after Class!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link two clauses to add a second, stronger point.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.pattern: S + 不但 + clause，(而且) + clause

text.traditional: A：你會說中文嗎？B：我不但會說中文，而且會說台灣話。
text.simplified: A：你会说中文吗？B：我不但会说中文，而且会说台湾话。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén ma? B: Wǒ bú dàn huì shuō Zhōngwén, érqiě huì shuō Táiwānhuà.
text.english: A: Can you speak Chinese? B: I can speak not only Chinese but also Taiwanese.

text.traditional: A：你為什麼來台灣旅行？B：因為台灣不但風景美，而且交通也很方便。
text.simplified: A：你为什么来台湾旅行？B：因为台湾不但风景美，而且交通也很方便。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ wèishénme lái Táiwān lǚxíng? B: Yīnwèi Táiwān bú dàn fēngjǐng měi, érqiě jiāotōng yě hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: A: Why did you come to Taiwan? B: Because Taiwan has not only beautiful scenery, but also very convenient transportation.

text.traditional: 媽媽：你打掃房間了嗎？孩子：我不但把房間打掃好了，而且髒衣服也洗乾淨了。
text.simplified: 妈妈：你打扫房间了吗？孩子：我不但把房间打扫好了，而且脏衣服也洗干净了。
text.pinyin: Māma: Nǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān le ma? Háizi: Wǒ bú dàn bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo hǎo le, érqiě zāng yī fu yě xǐ gānjìng le.
text.english: Mom: Did you clean your room? Child: I not only cleaned the room, but also washed the dirty clothes clean.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an extreme state, usually a negative one.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs + 死了

text.traditional: 百貨公司的大衣貴死了，我買不起。
text.simplified: 百货公司的大衣贵死了，我买不起。
text.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī de dàyī guì sǐ le, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
text.english: The coats at the department store are incredibly expensive; I can’t afford one.

text.traditional: 昨天晚上隔壁鄰居一直在跳舞，吵死了。
text.simplified: 昨天晚上隔壁邻居一直在跳舞，吵死了。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang gébìlínjū yìzhí zài tiàowǔ, chǎo sǐ le.
text.english: The neighbors next door danced all last night. It was terribly noisy.

text.traditional: 教授要我用中文報告在台灣的生活，讓我緊張死了。
text.simplified: 教授要我用中文报告在台湾的生活，让我紧张死了。
text.pinyin: Jiàoshòu yào wǒ yòng Zhōngwén bàogào zài Táiwān de shēnghuó, ràng wǒ jǐnzhāng sǐ le.
text.english: The professor asked me to give a report in Chinese about my life in Taiwan, which made me incredibly nervous.

words.meaning: to want; to be going to
to use; to make use of; to employ
to report, to make a presentation

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Show how a change in one degree or action affects another.
grammarPages.explanation: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.

grammarPages.pattern: S + 越 + V₁/Vs₁，(S₂) + 越 + V₂/Vs₂

text.traditional: 山本良介的中文越說越好了。
text.simplified: 山本良介的中文越说越好了。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè de Zhōngwén yuè shuō yuè hǎo le.
text.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke’s Chinese is getting better and better.

text.traditional: 中文的語法不容易，老師越說，我越不懂。
text.simplified: 中文的语法不容易，老师越说，我越不懂。
text.pinyin: Zhōngwén de yǔfǎ bù róngyì, lǎoshī yuè shuō, wǒ yuè bù dǒng.
text.english: Chinese grammar isn’t easy. The more the teacher explains, the less I understand.

text.traditional: 房子離捷運站越近，房租越貴。
text.simplified: 房子离捷运站越近，房租越贵。
text.pinyin: Fángzi lí jiéyùn zhàn yuè jìn, fángzū yuè guì.
text.english: The closer a house is to the MRT station, the more expensive the rent.

text.traditional: 他很喜歡工作，事情越多，他越高興。
text.simplified: 他很喜欢工作，事情越多，他越高兴。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan gōngzuò, shìqing yuè duō, tā yuè gāoxìng.
text.english: He really likes working. The more things he has to do, the happier he is.

words.meaning: to like; to be fond of
many; much; more; a lot of

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 到底 in a question when the speaker is eager to know the answer.
grammarPages.explanation: “到底” is an adverb which is used in disjunctive questions except for those with final “嗎”, e.g., “到底要不要？” and “到底去不去？” It shows the emotion that the speaker is eager to know the answer. It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”

It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”

It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 到底 + question; 到底 + question word + clause

text.traditional: 我要訂位了，你明天到底要不要跟我們去 KTV？
text.simplified: 我要订位了，你明天到底要不要跟我们去 KTV？
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào dìngwèi le, nǐ míngtiān dàodǐ yào bú yào gēn wǒmen qù KTV?
text.english: I’m going to make a reservation. Do you want to come to KTV with us tomorrow or not?

words.meaning: to want; to be going to
to make a reservation, to book

text.traditional: 到底要用幾張貼紙才換得到便利商店的禮物呢？
text.simplified: 到底要用几张贴纸才换得到便利商店的礼物呢？
text.pinyin: Dàodǐ yào yòng jǐ zhāng tiēzhǐ cái huàn dé dào biànlìshāngdiàn de lǐwù ne?
text.english: How many stickers do you need to use to get the convenience-store gift, after all?

words.meaning: to want; to be going to
to use; to make use of; to employ

text.traditional: 我不知道林老師到底住在學校前面還是後面的社區。
text.simplified: 我不知道林老师到底住在学校前面还是后面的社区。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào Lín lǎoshī dàodǐ zhù zài xuéxiào qiánmiàn háishì hòumiàn de shèqū.
text.english: I don’t know whether Teacher Lin lives in the neighborhood in front of or behind the school.

words.meaning: to know; to become aware of
to live; to reside; to stay

text.traditional: 妳怎麼了？生病了嗎？
text.simplified: 妳怎么了？生病了吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le? Shēngbìng le ma?
text.english: What’s wrong with you? Are you feeling ill?

text.traditional: 我鼻子很不舒服，感冒一個星期了。不但頭痛，而且還拉肚子。等一下要去看病。
text.simplified: 我鼻子很不舒服，感冒一个星期了。不但头痛，而且还拉肚子。等一下要去看病。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bízi hěn bù shūfu, gǎnmào yí ge xīngqī le. Búdàn tóutòng, érqiě hái lādùzi. Děng yíxià yào qù kànbìng.
text.english: There’s something weird with my nose. I caught a cold for a week. I not only have a headache, but also have diarrhea. I’m going to see a doctor later.

text.traditional: 我陪妳去吧！不過妳老是不運動，對身體不好喔！
text.simplified: 我陪妳去吧！不过妳老是不运动，对身体不好喔！
text.pinyin: Wǒ péi nǐ qù ba! Búguò nǐ lǎoshì bù yùndòng, duì shēntǐ bù hǎo o!
text.english: I’ll go with you! But you never exercise at all. This is not good for your body!

words.meaning: a sentence final particle indicating a reminder

text.traditional: 我知道這樣的壞習慣應該改一改，可是……
text.simplified: 我知道这样的坏习惯应该改一改，可是……
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào zhèyàng de huài xíguàn yīnggāi gǎi yi gǎi, kěshì…
text.english: I know I should get out of those bad habits, but…

words.meaning: to know; to become aware of
to modify, to alter, to correct
to modify, to alter, to correct

text.traditional: 我要去健身房運動，要不要一起去？
text.simplified: 我要去健身房运动，要不要一起去？
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù jiànshēnfáng yùndòng, yào bú yào yìqǐ qù?
text.english: I am going to the gym to work out. Would you like to go together?

text.traditional: 我從小就最討厭運動，每次上體育課，老師都要我們在操場上，一下子跑、一下子跳，我的腿跟脖子都痛死了。
text.simplified: 我从小就最讨厌运动，每次上体育课，老师都要我们在操场上，一下子跑、一下子跳，我的腿跟脖子都痛死了。

text.english: I’ve hated sport since childhood. Everytime, when we had a PE class on the playground, the teacher asked us to run one minute and to jump the next. My legs and neck hurt terribly!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Place 的話 at the end of the condition clause.
grammarPages.explanation: In Chinese, “的話” has the same function as “如果” and “要是” to form conditional sentences. However, “如果” and “要是” should be placed at the beginning of a sentence while “的話” should be placed at the end of the first clause. In some cases, using “要是” gives a stronger or even threatening tone than using “如果”. Both “如果” and “要是” can collocate with “的話”, and either can be left out. “的話” is a less formal expression.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: PW + V 了 + N / PW + V 著 + N
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what exists in a place and whether it is standing, sitting, or arranged there.
grammarPages.explanation: “PW+V 了+N /PW+V 著+N” indicates something/ some things exist(s) in a certain place. The verbs used in this pattern can be posture verb and non-posture verb. Posture verbs are used to describe the posture of a human or an animal existing in that place, such as “坐”, “站”, “躺”, “蹲”, etc. Non-posture verbs are used to describe the manner or action some objects are placed, such as “放”, “貼”, “掛”, “停”, “寫”, “畫”, “拿”, etc.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what someone is or is not interested in.
grammarPages.explanation: “感興趣” is used to show the subject’s interests and willingness to have further acquaintance with something.

text.traditional: 白小姐很愛化妝，對現在最流行的化妝品很感興趣。
text.simplified: 白小姐很爱化妆，对现在最流行的化妆品很感兴趣。

text.traditional: 我喜歡幫助別人，所以對去醫院服務的事非常感興趣。

text.english: I like helping other people, so I am very interested in volunteering at hospitals.

text.traditional: 林先生很喜歡張小姐，可是張小姐對他一點兒都不感興趣。
text.simplified: 林先生很喜欢张小姐，可是张小姐对他一点儿都不感兴趣。

grammarPages.titleTraditional: V 出來：V 出來了／沒 V 出來／V 得出來／V 不出來
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use a sensory verb to tell whether you can recognize something, or 想出來 to come up with an idea.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “V 出來”, when V is a sensory verb, such as “看”, “聽”, “吃”, “喝”, means to make out by seeing, hearing, eating and drinking, etc. It suggests whether one can realize or distinguish something by performing a certain sensory action. When the verb is “想” or executive verb, this pattern indicates a development from nothing. “想出來” means to come up with (an idea).
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “V 出來”, when V is a sensory verb, such as “看”, “聽”, “吃”, “喝”, means to make out by seeing, hearing, eating and drinking, etc. It suggests whether one can realize or distinguish something by performing a certain sensory action. When the verb is “想” or executive verb, this pattern indicates a development from nothing. “想出來” means to come up with (an idea).
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “V 出來”, when V is a sensory verb, such as “看”, “聽”, “吃”, “喝”, means to make out by seeing, hearing, eating and drinking, etc. It suggests whether one can realize or distinguish something by performing a certain sensory action. When the verb is “想” or executive verb, this pattern indicates a development from nothing. “想出來” means to come up with (an idea).
grammarPages.pattern: V + 出來（了）／沒 + V + 出來／V + 得出來／V + 不出來

text.traditional: 到底是誰打電話給我的？他的聲音，你聽不出來嗎？
text.simplified: 到底是谁打电话给我的？他的声音，你听不出来吗？
text.english: Who on earth called me? Can’t you recognize his voice?
text.pinyin: Dàodǐ shì shéi dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ de? Tā de shēngyīn, nǐ tīng bù chūlái ma?

text.traditional: 他上班又遲到了，讓老闆很生氣，大家都看得出來。
text.simplified: 他上班又迟到了，让老板很生气，大家都看得出来。
text.english: He was late to work again, which made the boss very angry. Everyone could tell.
text.pinyin: Tā shàngbān yòu chídào le, ràng lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì, dàjiā dōu kàn de chūlái.

text.traditional: A：這是什麼茶，你們喝得出來喝不出來？B：我一喝就喝出來了！這是紅茶。C：真厲害！我還是喝不出來。
text.simplified: A：这是什么茶，你们喝得出来喝不出来？B：我一喝就喝出来了！这是红茶。C：真厉害！我还是喝不出来。
text.english: A: What kind of tea is this? Can you tell by tasting it? B: I could tell as soon as I drank it! It is black tea. C: Amazing! I still can’t tell.
text.pinyin: A: Zhè shì shénme chá, nǐmen hē de chūlái hē bu chūlái? B: Wǒ yì hē jiù hē chūlái le! Zhè shì hóngchá. C: Zhēn lìhài! Wǒ háishi hē bu chūlái.

words.pinyin: hē de chūlái hē bu chūlái

words.pinyin: wǒ yì hē jiù hē chūlái le
words.meaning: I recognized it as soon as I tasted it
I still cannot tell by tasting

text.traditional: 這句義大利文的中文翻譯很難，我想了很久，才想出來怎麼翻譯。
text.simplified: 这句意大利文的中文翻译很难，我想了很久，才想出来怎么翻译。
text.english: The Chinese translation of this Italian sentence is difficult. I thought for a long time before figuring out how to translate it.
text.pinyin: Zhè jù Yìdàlìwén de Zhōngwén fānyì hěn nán, wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, cái xiǎng chūlái zěnme fānyì.

dialogue.title: 你想參加哪一個社團？
grammarFocus: PW + V 了 + N / PW + V 著 + N

text.traditional: （以凡跟良介在校園裡）
text.simplified: （以凡跟良介在校园里）
text.pinyin: （Yǐfán gēn Liángjiè zài xiàoyuán lǐ）
text.english: (Yifan and Ryosuke are on campus.)

text.traditional: 最近校園裡擺了很多攤子，攤子前面站了不少學生，他們在做什麼啊？
text.simplified: 最近校园里摆了很多摊子，摊子前面站了不少学生，他们在做什么啊？
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn xiàoyuán lǐ bǎi le hěn duō tānzi, tānzi qiánmiàn zhàn le bù shǎo xuéshēng, tāmen zài zuò shénme a?
text.english: Recently, many stalls have been set up on campus. In front of the stalls stand a lot of students. What are they doing?

text.traditional: 每個學期開學的時候，學生社團的社員都會給新生介紹自己的社團，讓新生知道他們有什麼活動。
text.simplified: 每个学期开学的时候，学生社团的社员都会给新生介绍自己的社团，让新生知道他们有什么活动。
text.pinyin: Měi ge xuéqī kāixué de shíhou, xuéshēng shètuán de shèyuán dōu huì gěi xīnshēng jièshào zìjǐ de shètuán, ràng xīnshēng zhīdào tāmen yǒu shénme huódòng.
text.english: At the beginning of every semester, members of each student club introduce their clubs to new students, and let new students know what activities their clubs have.

text.traditional: 聽起來很有意思，我們過去看看吧！
text.simplified: 听起来很有意思，我们过去看看吧！
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒmen guòqù kànkan ba!
text.english: Sounds very interesting. Let’s go take a look!

text.traditional: （兩個人把攤子都看了一遍以後）
text.simplified: （两个人把摊子都看了一遍以后）
text.pinyin: （Liǎng ge rén bǎ tānzi dōu kàn le yí biàn yǐhòu）
text.english: (After taking a look at each of the stalls once.)

text.traditional: 這麼多社團，我不知道怎麼選擇。
text.simplified: 这么多社团，我不知道怎么选择。
text.pinyin: Zhème duō shètuán, wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme xuǎnzé.
text.english: There are so many student clubs. I don’t know how to choose.

text.traditional: 對啊！每個社團看起來都很吸引人，真的很難立刻決定。除了鋼琴社，我也想參加書法社和中國功夫社。
text.simplified: 对啊！每个社团看起来都很吸引人，真的很难立刻决定。除了钢琴社，我也想参加书法社和中国功夫社。
text.pinyin: Duì a! Měi ge shètuán kànqǐlái dōu hěn xīyǐn rén, zhēn de hěn nán lìkè juédìng. Chúle gāngqín shè, wǒ yě xiǎng cānjiā shūfǎ shè hé Zhōngguó gōngfu shè.
text.english: Yes! Every club looks very attractive, and it’s really hard to decide right away. Besides the piano club, I also want to participate in the calligraphy and Chinese Kungfu clubs.

text.traditional: 看不出來你對中華文化這麼感興趣！
text.simplified: 看不出来你对中华文化这么感兴趣！
text.pinyin: Kàn bu chūlái nǐ duì Zhōnghuá wénhuà zhème gǎn xìngqù!
text.english: I can’t tell that you are so interested in Chinese culture!

text.traditional: 我覺得中國書法是一種藝術。參加書法社可以讓我認識更多漢字。
text.simplified: 我觉得中国书法是一种艺术。参加书法社可以让我认识更多汉字。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Zhōngguó shūfǎ shì yì zhǒng yìshù. Cānjiā shūfǎ shè kěyǐ ràng wǒ rènshi gèng duō Hànzì.
text.english: I think that Chinese calligraphy is a kind of art. Joining the calligraphy club allows me to learn more Chinese characters.

text.traditional: 那中國功夫社呢？
text.simplified: 那中国功夫社呢？
text.pinyin: Nà Zhōngguó gōngfu shè ne?
text.english: What about Chinese Kungfu club then?

text.traditional: 中國功夫社嘛……我覺得中國功夫好厲害，如果學會了就可以保護自己，讓自己變得更勇敢。你呢？
text.simplified: 中国功夫社嘛……我觉得中国功夫好厉害，如果学会了就可以保护自己，让自己变得更勇敢。你呢？
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó gōngfu shè ma… Wǒ juéde Zhōngguó gōngfu hǎo lìhai, rúguǒ xuéhuì le jiù kěyǐ bǎohù zìjǐ, ràng zìjǐ biàn de gèng yǒnggǎn. Nǐ ne?
text.english: Chinese Kungfu club… I think Chinese Kungfu is amazing. If I learn it, I can protect myself and become braver. And you?

text.traditional: 我想參加吉他社或是愛心服務社。
text.simplified: 我想参加吉他社或是爱心服务社。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā jítā shè huòshì àixīn fúwù shè.
text.english: I want to join the guitar club or the charity service club.

text.traditional: 這兩個社團非常不一樣，你為什麼都有興趣？
text.simplified: 这两个社团非常不一样，你为什么都有兴趣？
text.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge shètuán fēicháng bù yíyàng, nǐ wèishénme dōu yǒu xìngqù?
text.english: These two clubs are very different. Why are you interested in both of them?

text.traditional: 我以前學過吉他，但是太久沒練習，很多技巧都忘了，我想複習複習。愛心服務社嘛……
text.simplified: 我以前学过吉他，但是太久没练习，很多技巧都忘了，我想复习复习。爱心服务社嘛……
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián xué guo jítā, dànshì tài jiǔ méi liànxí, hěn duō jìqiǎo dōu wàng le, wǒ xiǎng fùxí fùxí. Àixīn fúwù shè ma…
text.english: I used to learn how to play the guitar, but I haven’t practiced it for too long. I’ve already forgotten a lot of skills, so I want to review them a bit. As for the charity service club…

text.traditional: 我知道，你想幫助需要幫助的人。
text.simplified: 我知道，你想帮助需要帮助的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, nǐ xiǎng bāngzhù xūyào bāngzhù de rén.
text.english: I know! You want to help the people in need.

text.traditional: 沒錯，我們都生活在同一個地球上，本來就應該互相幫助。
text.simplified: 没错，我们都生活在同一个地球上，本来就应该互相帮助。
text.pinyin: Méi cuò, wǒmen dōu shēnghuó zài tóng yí ge dìqiú shàng, běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
text.english: Right. We all live on the same planet Earth. Of course we should help each other.

text.traditional: 沒想到你想得這麼多！那麼要跟誰談戀愛，你想好了沒有？
text.simplified: 没想到你想得这么多！那么要跟谁谈恋爱，你想好了没有？
text.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào nǐ xiǎng de zhème duō! Nàme yào gēn shéi tán liàn’ài, nǐ xiǎng hǎo le méiyǒu?
text.english: I didn't expect that you think this much! Then have you decided who you're to be in love with?

text.traditional: 你別開玩笑了！
text.simplified: 你别开玩笑了！
text.pinyin: Nǐ bié kāi wánxiào le!
text.english: Don't be kidding me!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 等 to show a category total or that a list has more examples.
grammarPages.explanation: In Chinese, the word “等” has two functions. Firstly, it can be placed before a number that marks the total of items mentioned, or before a word that is the hypernym (category) for the items mentioned. On the other hand, it can be used at the end of a list to show there are still a lot of examples of the same kind.

text.simplified: 请在这里写下你的姓名、国家、出生日期等资料。

text.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ xiě xià nǐ de xìngmíng, guójiā, chūshēng rìqī děng zīliào.

text.traditional: 我哥哥喜愛旅遊，他去過日本、英國、法國等三個國家。
text.simplified: 我哥哥喜爱旅游，他去过日本、英国、法国等三个国家。
text.english: My older brother loves traveling. He has visited three countries: Japan, the UK, and France.
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge xǐ ài lǚyóu, tā qù guo Rìběn, Yīngguó, Fǎguó děng sān ge guójiā.

text.traditional: 學校的社團像鋼琴社、吉他社、書法社等，都有很多社員。
text.simplified: 学校的社团像钢琴社、吉他社、书法社等，都有很多社员。
text.english: The school’s clubs, such as the piano, guitar, and calligraphy clubs, all have many members.
text.pinyin: Xuéxiào de shètuán xiàng gāngqín shè, jítā shè, shūfǎ shè děng, dōu yǒu hěn duō shèyuán.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Which Club Would You Like to Join?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 從……中 to say what someone learns, handles, or gains from an experience or source.
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “中” means “inside” instead of “middle”. The pattern “從……中” indicates someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “中” means “inside” instead of “middle”. The pattern “從……中” indicates someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “中” means “inside” instead of “middle”. The pattern “從……中” indicates someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.
grammarPages.pattern: 從 + source + 中 + result

text.traditional: 醫生從檢查報告中了解病人的情況。
text.simplified: 医生从检查报告中了解病人的情况。
text.english: The doctor learns about the patient’s condition from the examination report.
text.pinyin: Yīshēng cóng jiǎnchá bàogào zhōng liǎojiě bìngrén de qíngkuàng.

text.traditional: 我們可以從生活中得到不少寶貴的經驗。
text.simplified: 我们可以从生活中得到不少宝贵的经验。
text.english: We can gain many valuable experiences from life.
text.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ cóng shēnghuó zhōng dédào bù shǎo bǎoguì de jīngyàn.

text.traditional: 從他說的這些話中，我聽不出來他是高興還是難過。
text.simplified: 从他说的这些话中，我听不出来他是高兴还是难过。
text.english: From what he said, I can’t tell whether he is happy or sad.
text.pinyin: Cóng tā shuō de zhèxiē huà zhōng, wǒ tīng bù chūlái tā shì gāoxìng háishi nánguò.

words.pinyin: tā shuō de zhèxiē huà zhōng
