dialogue.title: 社團活動對山本良介的影響

text.traditional: 山本良介來台灣以後，參加了愛心服務社。社團每個月都會安排兩次活動，利用週末到一些地方去服務。
text.simplified: 山本良介来台湾以后，参加了爱心服务社。社团每个月都会安排两次活动，利用周末到一些地方去服务。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, cānjiā le àixīn fúwù shè. Shètuán měi ge yuè dōu huì ānpái liǎng cì huódòng, lìyòng zhōumò dào yìxiē dìfāng qù fúwù.
text.english: After coming to Taiwan, Yamamoto Ryosuke joined the charity service club. Every month, the club organizes two events and uses the time on weekends to go to some places to help people.

text.traditional: 社員們會到安養院去幫老人打掃環境、擦窗戶、洗廁所、刷馬桶，然後再陪他們聊聊天。他們也會到育幼院去照顧孩子，教比較小的孩子刷牙、穿衣服，陪比較大的孩子讀書、做功課。有時候也給他們上美術課，或是帶他們到外邊運動。上過護理課的社員，就可以到醫院去陪病人檢查身體，幫他們處理掛號、住院、出院等問題，或是到病房關心病人和他們的家人。這些經驗讓良介有不少收穫。
text.simplified: 社员们会到安养院去帮老人打扫环境、擦窗户、洗厕所、刷马桶，然后再陪他们聊聊天。他们也会到育幼院去照顾孩子，教比较小的孩子刷牙、穿衣服，陪比较大的孩子读书、做功课。有时候也给他们上美术课，或是带他们到外边运动。上过护理课的社员，就可以到医院去陪病人检查身体，帮他们处理挂号、住院、出院等问题，或是到病房关心病人和他们的家人。这些经验让良介有不少收获。
text.pinyin: Shèyuánmen huì dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāng lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng, cā chuānghu, xǐ cèsuǒ, shuā mǎtǒng, ránhòu zài péi tāmen liáo liáo tiān. Tāmen yě huì dào yùyòuyuàn qù zhàogù háizi, jiāo bǐjiào xiǎo de háizi shuāyá, chuān yīfu, péi bǐjiào dà de háizi dúshū, zuò gōngkè. Yǒushíhou yě gěi tāmen shàng měishù kè, huòshì dài tāmen dào wàibiān yùndòng. Shàng guo hùlǐ kè de shèyuán, jiù kěyǐ dào yīyuàn qù péi bìngrén jiǎnchá shēntǐ, bāng tāmen chǔlǐ guàhào, zhùyuàn, chūyuàn děng wèntí, huòshì dào bìngfáng guānxīn bìngrén hé tāmen de jiārén. Zhèxiē jīngyàn ràng Liángjiè yǒu bù shǎo shōuhuò.
text.english: Members of the club would go to elderly nursing homes to help the elderly clean up the environment, wipe windows, wash the bathrooms, brush the toilets, and then chat with them. They would also go to children’s homes to look after the children. They teach the younger children how to brush their teeth or put on their clothes, and accompany the older children in studying or doing homework. Sometimes they organize fine art lessons for them, or take them outside to exercise. Furthermore, members who have attended nursing courses can go to hospitals to accompany patients in medical examinations and help them handle issues such as registration, hospitalization and discharge, or go into wards to show concern for patients and their relatives. These experiences benefit Ryosuke a lot.

text.traditional: 以前良介每天只知道念書，對很多事情都不感興趣，常去的地方只有學校、書店或是圖書館。因為他極重視考試的成績，對他來說，只要成績好，就代表會有一個美好的未來。不過，參加了幾次愛心服務以後，他發現自己成長了不少。從服務中得到的經驗，好像比從課本中學到的更寶貴呢！所以良介告訴自己，畢業以後，他還要繼續做這個極有意義的工作。
text.simplified: 以前良介每天只知道念书，对很多事情都不感兴趣，常去的地方只有学校、书店或是图书馆。因为他极重视考试的成绩，对他来说，只要成绩好，就代表会有一个美好的未来。不过，参加了几次爱心服务以后，他发现自己成长了不少。从服务中得到的经验，好像比从课本中学到的更宝贵呢！所以良介告诉自己，毕业以后，他还要继续做这个极有意义的工作。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián Liángjiè měitiān zhǐ zhīdào niànshū, duì hěn duō shìqing dōu bù gǎn xìngqù, cháng qù de dìfāng zhǐ yǒu xuéxiào, shūdiàn huòshì túshūguǎn. Yīnwèi tā jí zhòngshì kǎoshì de chéngjì, duì tā lái shuō, zhǐyào chéngjì hǎo, jiù dàibiǎo huì yǒu yí ge měihǎo de wèilái. Búguò, cānjiā le jǐ cì àixīn fúwù yǐhòu, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ chéngzhǎng le bù shǎo. Cóng fúwù zhōng dédào de jīngyàn, hǎoxiàng bǐ cóng kèběn zhōng xuédào de gèng bǎoguì ne! Suǒyǐ Liángjiè gàosu zìjǐ, bìyè yǐhòu, tā hái yào jìxù zuò zhège jí yǒu yìyì de gōngzuò.
text.english: Before, what Ryosuke did was just studying every day. He wasn’t interested in many things. The places where he went often were only the school, bookstores and libraries. He paid very great attention to the scores of exams. For him, he thought that grades mean everything. As long as the grades are good, it means a bright future. However, after participating in charity service several times, he realized he grew a lot. The experience he gained through service seems to be more valuable than what he learned from textbooks! So Ryosuke tells himself: After graduation, he will continue to do this extremely meaningful work.

items.title: Grammar 1–6 · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

dialogue.title: 對話 · 小職員？大老闆？ · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （美心跟可欣在教室外面聊天）
lines.simplified: （美心跟可欣在教室外面聊天）
lines.pinyin: （Měixīn gēn Kěxīn zài jiàoshì wàimiàn liáotiān）
lines.english: (Meixin and Kexin are chatting outside the classroom.)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我大哥今年六月就大學畢業了，他計畫去英國念研究所。
lines.simplified: 我大哥今年六月就大学毕业了，他计划去英国念研究所。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē jīnnián liùyuè jiù dàxué bìyè le, tā jìhuà qù Yīngguó niàn yánjiùsuǒ.
lines.english: My eldest brother is going to graduate this June. He is planning to study in a graduate school in England.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 他想研究什麼呢？
lines.simplified: 他想研究什么呢？
lines.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yánjiū shénme ne?
lines.english: What does he want to research?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 他對藝術、文化很有興趣，英國的大學有很多這樣的課程，等收到學校的通知，就要去留學了。
lines.simplified: 他对艺术、文化很有兴趣，英国的大学有很多这样的课程，等收到学校的通知，就要去留学了。
lines.pinyin: Tā duì yìshù, wénhuà hěn yǒu xìngqù, Yīngguó de dàxué yǒu hěn duō zhèyàng de kèchéng, děng shōudào xuéxiào de tōngzhī, jiù yào qù liúxué le.
lines.english: He is interested in art and culture. The universities in England have many courses like that. After he receives a notification, he will leave to study abroad in June.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 出國念書很好啊！念了研究所，將來也比較容易找到工作。
lines.simplified: 出国念书很好啊！念了研究所，将来也比较容易找到工作。
lines.pinyin: Chūguó niànshū hěn hǎo a! Niàn le yánjiùsuǒ, jiānglái yě bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò.
lines.english: Studying abroad is really good! Also, after getting the Master’s degree, it will be easier to find a job in the future.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 聽說有些念廣告或是服裝設計的人，還沒畢業就找到工作了。
lines.simplified: 听说有些念广告或是服装设计的人，还没毕业就找到工作了。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō yǒuxiē niàn guǎnggào huòshì fúzhuāng shèjì de rén, hái méi bìyè jiù zhǎodào gōngzuò le.
lines.english: I heard that some people who study advertising or fashion design find a job even before graduation.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 好厲害喔！不過，我覺得興趣也很重要，如果工作太無聊，我一定會想換工作的。
lines.simplified: 好厉害喔！不过，我觉得兴趣也很重要，如果工作太无聊，我一定会想换工作的。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo lìhai o! Búguò, wǒ juéde xìngqù yě hěn zhòngyào, rúguǒ gōngzuò tài wúliáo, wǒ yídìng huì xiǎng huàn gōngzuò de.
lines.english: Wow, amazing! However, I think that interests are important, too. If the work is too boring, I will certainly want to change my job.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 妳對日語有興趣，而且成績很好，應該繼續念研究所，將來當教授啊！
lines.simplified: 妳对日语有兴趣，而且成绩很好，应该继续念研究所，将来当教授啊！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ duì Rìyǔ yǒu xìngqù, érqiě chéngjì hěn hǎo, yīnggāi jìxù niàn yánjiùsuǒ, jiānglái dāng jiàoshòu a!
lines.english: You are interested in the Japanese language, and you get good grades. You should continue going to a graduate school and become a professor in the future!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 我是有這樣的想法。妳呢？妳的課上得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 我是有这样的想法。妳呢？妳的课上得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ. Nǐ ne? Nǐ de kè shàng de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: I do consider this. What about you? How are you doing in class?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 除了翻譯課比較難，聽力跟會話課的成績都不錯。
lines.simplified: 除了翻译课比较难，听力跟会话课的成绩都不错。
lines.pinyin: Chúle fānyì kè bǐjiào nán, tīnglì gēn huìhuà kè de chéngjì dōu búcuò.
lines.english: Except that the translation class is more difficult, both my listening and conversation grades are not bad.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 台灣好像只有一、兩所大學的外語學院有義大利文系，畢業後應該不難找工作吧？
lines.simplified: 台湾好像只有一、两所大学的外语学院有意大利文系，毕业后应该不难找工作吧？
lines.pinyin: Táiwān hǎoxiàng zhǐ yǒu yì, liǎng suǒ dàxué de wàiyǔ xuéyuàn yǒu Yìdàlìwén xì, bìyè hòu yīnggāi bù nán zhǎodào gōngzuò ba?
lines.english: It seems that there are only one or two universities in Taiwan where the College of Foreign Language has a Department of Italian Language. It should not be difficult to find a job after graduation, right?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 也許不像念哲學、歷史的那麼難，可是沒有其他的專業能力，想找到好工作也是很困難的。
lines.simplified: 也许不像念哲学、历史的那么难，可是没有其他的专业能力，想找到好工作也是很困难的。
lines.pinyin: Yěxǔ bú xiàng niàn zhéxué, lìshǐ de nàme nán, kěshì méiyǒu qítā de zhuānyè nénglì, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò yě hěn kùnnán de.
lines.english: Maybe it’s not as hard as those who study philosophy or history. However, without any other professional skill, it is still very difficult to find a good job.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 我覺得日語老師是很好的職業，所以從下個月起，我就要去當王教授的助理，向他學習怎麼教日文。妳呢？妳希望將來的職業是什麼？
lines.simplified: 我觉得日语老师是很好的职业，所以从下个月起，我就要去当王教授的助理，向他学习怎么教日文。妳呢？妳希望将来的职业是什么？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Rìyǔ lǎoshī shì hěn hǎo de zhíyè, suǒyǐ cóng xià ge yuè qǐ, wǒ jiù yào qù dāng Wáng jiàoshòu de zhùlǐ, xiàng tā xuéxí zěnme jiāo Rìwén. Nǐ ne? Nǐ xīwàng jiānglái de zhíyè shì shénme?
lines.english: I think being a Japanese teacher is a very good job, so from next month I am going to work as Professor Wang’s assistant. I will learn from him how to teach Japanese. And you? What kind of job do you hope to have in the future?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 說真的，我只想去貿易公司上班，當一個小職員就好了。
lines.simplified: 说真的，我只想去贸易公司上班，当一个小职员就好了。
lines.pinyin: Shuō zhēnde, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng qù màoyì gōngsī shàngbān, dāng yí ge xiǎo zhíyuán jiù hǎo le.
lines.english: Honestly speaking, I just want to work in a trading company, working as a small office clerk is good enough.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 真的？妳不想自己當老闆嗎？
lines.simplified: 真的？妳不想自己当老板吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de? Nǐ bù xiǎng zìjǐ dāng lǎobǎn ma?
lines.english: Really? Don’t you want to be the boss?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 當老闆太累了！像我爸爸是保險公司的經理，管理三十多個員工，不但常常開會、加班，還要做市場研究。
lines.simplified: 当老板太累了！像我爸爸是保险公司的经理，管理三十多个员工，不但常常开会、加班，还要做市场研究。
lines.pinyin: Dāng lǎobǎn tài lèi le! Xiàng wǒ bàba shì bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, guǎnlǐ sānshí duō ge yuángōng, búdàn chángcháng kāihuì, jiābān, hái yào zuò shìchǎng yánjiū.
lines.english: Being a boss is too tiring! For example, my father is a manager in an insurance company. He manages more than thirty employees. He not only has meetings and works overtime often, but also needs to do market research.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 他要負責這麼多事情，真的太累了，難怪妳不想當老闆。
lines.simplified: 他要负责这么多事情，真的太累了，难怪妳不想当老板。
lines.pinyin: Tā yào fùzé zhème duō shìqing, zhēn de tài lèi le, nánguài nǐ bù xiǎng dāng lǎobǎn.
lines.english: He is responsible for so many things and can be really tired. No wonder you don’t want to be the boss.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 最近他也覺得體力越來越差，做不了那麼多事了，所以想要早一點兒退休。
lines.simplified: 最近他也觉得体力越来越差，做不了那么多事了，所以想要早一点儿退休。
lines.pinyin: Zuìjìn tā yě juéde tǐlì yuèláiyuè chà, zuò bu liǎo nàme duō shì le, suǒyǐ xiǎng yào zǎo yìdiǎnr tuìxiū.
lines.english: Recently, he feels that he’s been getting physically weaker and can’t manage to do so many things, so he really wants to retire.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （可欣看看手錶）
lines.simplified: （可欣看看手表）
lines.pinyin: （Kěxīn kànkan shǒubiǎo）
lines.english: (Kexin is looking at the watch.)

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 快上課了，我們別想那麼多了。到底要找什麼工作，等大四再說吧。
lines.simplified: 快上课了，我们别想那么多了。到底要找什么工作，等大四再说吧。
lines.pinyin: Kuài shàngkè le, wǒmen bié xiǎng nàme duō le. Dàodǐ yào zhǎo shénme gōngzuò, děng dà sì zài shuō ba.
lines.english: It’s time for class. Don’t think too much. Let’s wait until the senior year to think about looking for a job.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Exclude one person or thing while saying what is true of the rest.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 除了 + excluded item, ... 都 ... / 除了 + excluded item, S + ... 都 ...
grammarPages.explanation: 「除了」表示排除，後面可接名詞、動詞、名詞短語或不及物狀態動詞。主語可放在「除了」前，也可放在「都」前。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 「除了」shows exclusion and can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase, or intransitive state verb. The subject can come before 「除了」 or before 「都」.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “除了”, which shows exclusion, can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase or intransitive state verb. The subject of this pattern can be placed in front of either “除了” or “都”, ie: “我除了咖啡，什麼飲料都喝。” or “除了咖啡，我什麼飲料都喝。”

text.traditional: 我除了影集，什麼電視節目都不愛看。
text.simplified: 我除了影集，什么电视节目都不爱看。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chúle yǐngjí, shénme diànshì jiémù dōu bú ài kàn.
text.english: Except for TV series, I don’t like watching any kind of TV program.

text.traditional: 除了加班，爸爸週末都不去公司，一定在家休息。
text.simplified: 除了加班，爸爸周末都不去公司，一定在家休息。
text.pinyin: Chúle jiābān, bàba zhōumò dōu bú qù gōngsī, yídìng zài jiā xiūxi.
text.english: Except for working overtime, Dad does not go to the office on weekends and is surely resting at home.

text.traditional: A：聽說那個研究所的課程很難，教授都用英文上課。B：沒錯，除了電腦課，所有課程都是用英文上的。
text.simplified: A：听说那个研究所的课程很难，教授都用英文上课。B：没错，除了电脑课，所有课程都是用英文上的。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nàge yánjiùsuǒ de kèchéng hěn nán, jiàoshòu dōu yòng Yīngwén shàngkè. B: Méicuò, chúle diànnǎo kè, suǒyǒu kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
text.english: A: I heard the graduate-school courses are hard and the professors teach them all in English. B: That’s right; except for the computer course, all the courses are taught in English.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.titleTraditional: NP₁ + 像／不像 + NP₂ + 那麼／這麼 + Vs
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Compare one person or thing with another using a degree description.
grammarPages.pattern: NP₁ + 像／不像 + NP₂ + 那麼／這麼 + Vs
grammarPages.explanation: 這個句型比較 NP₁ 和 NP₂；「那麼／這麼」後面接表示程度的狀態動詞。「不像」可和「有／沒有……那麼……」的比較句對照。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern compares NP₁ with NP₂. 「那麼／這麼」 is followed by a state verb describing degree. 「不像」 can be compared with 「有／沒有……那麼……」.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern compares NP₁ and NP₂. “那麼” should be followed by an intransitive state verb with a higher degree. This pattern is similar to “NP₁ 有／沒有 NP₂ 那麼 Vs”.

text.traditional: 會話課的考試像翻譯課的（考試）那麼難嗎？
text.simplified: 会话课的考试像翻译课的（考试）那么难吗？
text.pinyin: Huìhuà kè de kǎoshì xiàng fānyì kè de (kǎoshì) nàme nán ma?
text.english: Is the conversation-class exam as difficult as the translation-class exam?

text.traditional: 弟弟的體力不像我這麼好，他在操場跑了十分鐘就累了。
text.simplified: 弟弟的体力不像我这么好，他在操场跑了十分钟就累了。
text.pinyin: Dìdi de tǐlì bú xiàng wǒ zhème hǎo, tā zài cāochǎng pǎo le shí fēnzhōng jiù lèi le.
text.english: My younger brother’s stamina is not as good as mine; he gets tired after running on the track for ten minutes.

text.traditional: 黃先生是吉他老師，他的技巧很厲害，我不像他那麼專業。
text.simplified: 黄先生是吉他老师，他的技巧很厉害，我不像他那么专业。
text.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shì jítā lǎoshī, tā de jìqiǎo hěn lìhai, wǒ bú xiàng tā nàme zhuānyè.
text.english: Mr. Huang is a guitar teacher, and his technique is impressive. I am not as professional as he is.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Mark when an action or situation begins and what follows from that point.
grammarPages.pattern: （S）（+ 從）+ Time／VP + 起，（S）就……
grammarPages.explanation: 這個句型表示事情從某個時間點開始。「起」在此表示開始；「從」常接時間詞或動詞短語，也可以省略。「就」常放在後句開頭。主語可放在句首或後句。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern marks the point in time or action when something begins. 「起」 means “begin”; 「從」 can precede a time word or verb phrase but may be omitted. 「就」 often begins the following clause. The subject can appear at the start or in the second clause.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is used to indicate something which begins with a point in time. “起” serves as a verb here and means “to begin”. “從” is often followed by time words or verb phrases, e.g., “從下個月起” and “從開始學中文起”. Besides, “就” is often used at the beginning of the latter clause to imply an action is going to occur. In this pattern, “從” can be omitted. The subject can be placed in the beginning of the sentence or the second clause.

text.traditional: 從明天起，他就要天天早起去慢跑。
text.simplified: 从明天起，他就要天天早起去慢跑。
text.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ, tā jiù yào tiāntiān zǎoqǐ qù mànpǎo.
text.english: Starting tomorrow, he will get up early to jog every day.

text.traditional: 姐姐從學會開車起，就自己開車去上班了。
text.simplified: 姐姐从学会开车起，就自己开车去上班了。
text.pinyin: Jiějie cóng xuéhuì kāichē qǐ, jiù zìjǐ kāichē qù shàngbān le.
text.english: Since my older sister learned to drive, she has driven herself to work.

text.traditional: 為了身體健康，（從）明天起，我就不吃太甜、太油的食物了。
text.simplified: 为了身体健康，（从）明天起，我就不吃太甜、太油的食物了。
text.pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, (cóng) míngtiān qǐ, wǒ jiù bù chī tài tián, tài yóu de shíwù le.
text.english: For my health, starting tomorrow I will stop eating food that is too sweet or greasy.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 向 before a person to mark the recipient of an action; it is more formal and respectful than 跟.
grammarPages.pattern: 向 + N／NP + V……
grammarPages.explanation: 「向」作介詞時可表示動作方向；接在人名或人物短語前，表示動作的對象。相比「跟……V」，「向……V」較正式、客氣，也較尊重對方。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 「向」 is a preposition for direction. Before a person, it marks the target of an action and sounds more formal and respectful than 「跟……V」.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “向” can be used as a preposition that shows the direction of an action, e.g., “向前走”. If followed by a person, it indicates the object of an action. This pattern is more formal, polite and respectful than the pattern “跟+N/NP+V”.

text.traditional: 餐廳的老闆向客人介紹那個義大利菜。
text.simplified: 餐厅的老板向客人介绍那个意大利菜。
text.pinyin: Cāntīng de lǎobǎn xiàng kèrén jièshào nàge Yìdàlì cài.
text.english: The restaurant owner introduces that Italian dish to the customers.

text.traditional: 這個研究計畫有問題，我應該向教授報告。
text.simplified: 这个研究计划有问题，我应该向教授报告。
text.pinyin: Zhège yánjiū jìhuà yǒu wèntí, wǒ yīnggāi xiàng jiàoshòu bàogào.
text.english: There is a problem with this research project; I should report it to the professor.

text.traditional: 那個學生很認真，成績也很好，我們都應該向他學習。
text.simplified: 那个学生很认真，成绩也很好，我们都应该向他学习。
text.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng hěn rènzhēn, chéngjì yě hěn hǎo, wǒmen dōu yīnggāi xiàng tā xuéxí.
text.english: That student is diligent and gets good grades; we should all learn from him.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link a known fact to the conclusion it makes unsurprising.
grammarPages.pattern: Reason or known fact + 難怪 + result
grammarPages.explanation: 「難怪」前通常先說明已知事實；聽者知道原因後，便不會對結果感到意外。「難怪」後面常接動詞短語，也可用在對話回應中。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: A known fact usually comes before 「難怪」. Once the listener understands the reason, the result is no longer surprising. 「難怪」 is often followed by a verb phrase and can also begin a spoken response.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: Before “難怪”, there is usually an existing fact stated and unlikely to change, so no need to feel surprised. “難怪” is often followed by verb phrases. Sometimes when used in a conversation, the listener will be a little surprised after understanding a stated fact or reason.

text.traditional: 他喝了太多酒，難怪身體不舒服。
text.simplified: 他喝了太多酒，难怪身体不舒服。
text.pinyin: Tā hē le tài duō jiǔ, nánguài shēntǐ bù shūfu.
text.english: He drank too much alcohol; no wonder he feels unwell.

text.traditional: 那個美國人在中國住了五年，難怪中文說得那麼好。
text.simplified: 那个美国人在中国住了五年，难怪中文说得那么好。
text.pinyin: Nàge Měiguó rén zài Zhōngguó zhù le wǔ nián, nánguài Zhōngwén shuō de nàme hǎo.
text.english: That American lived in China for five years; no wonder they speak Chinese so well.

text.traditional: 同事 A：經理說他感冒了，昨天晚上不但發燒，還一直咳嗽。同事 B：難怪他今天上班的時候，一直戴著口罩。
text.simplified: 同事 A：经理说他感冒了，昨天晚上不但发烧，还一直咳嗽。同事 B：难怪他今天上班的时候，一直戴着口罩。
text.pinyin: Tóngshì A: Jīnglǐ shuō tā gǎnmào le, zuótiān wǎnshàng búdàn fāshāo, hái yìzhí késou. Tóngshì B: Nánguài tā jīntiān shàngbān de shíhou, yìzhí dàizhe kǒuzhào.
text.english: Coworker A: The manager said he has a cold. Last night he not only had a fever, but also kept coughing. Coworker B: No wonder he kept wearing a mask at work today.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether someone can accomplish an action or achieve a result.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 得了／不了（+ O）
grammarPages.explanation: 「V得了」表示有能力完成動作或達成結果；否定式為「V不了」。常用單音節動詞。這個可能補語表示能否做到，和表示動作已完成的「V了」不同。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 「V得了」 says an action or result is possible; the negative is 「V不了」. It often follows a one-syllable verb. This possibility complement differs from 「V了」, which says an action has been completed.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “V 得了” shows one’s ability to achieve something or cause a certain result. Its negative form is “V 不了”. The verbs used in this pattern are often monosyllabic, such as “吃（eat）”, “忘（forget）”, “拿（take）”, “做（do）”, “到（reach）”, “管（manage）”, etc. This pattern is different from “V 了”. The former shows likelihood, while the latter implies that something has been done, e.g., “吃了” and “做了”.

text.traditional: 你買了這麼多東西，一個人拿得了嗎？
text.simplified: 你买了这么多东西，一个人拿得了吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi le zhème duō dōngxi, yí ge rén ná de liǎo ma?
text.english: You bought so many things. Can one person carry them all?

text.traditional: 我們只有三個人，吃不了這麼多菜。
text.simplified: 我们只有三个人，吃不了这么多菜。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǐ yǒu sān ge rén, chī bu liǎo zhème duō cài.
text.english: There are only three of us; we can’t eat this many dishes.

text.traditional: 媽媽一個人做不了那麼多家事，所以我的房間自己打掃。
text.simplified: 妈妈一个人做不了那么多家事，所以我的房间自己打扫。
text.pinyin: Māma yí ge rén zuò bu liǎo nàme duō jiāshì, suǒyǐ wǒ de fángjiān zìjǐ dǎsǎo.
text.english: Mom can’t do so many chores alone, so I clean my own room.

items.title: Grammar 7–8 · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

dialogue.title: 短文 · 自我推薦 · A Letter of Self-Recommendation

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 李老闆：
lines.simplified: 李老板：
lines.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn:
lines.english: Dear Mr. Li,

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 您好，我是陳可欣，今年二十一歲，是大學日文系的學生。父親在高中教書，母親是鐵路局的員工，哥哥在貿易公司上班。我是家裡最小的孩子，可是我知道怎麼照顧自己，不讓父母擔心。
lines.simplified: 您好，我是陈可欣，今年二十一岁，是大学日文系的学生。父亲在高中教书，母亲是铁路局的员工，哥哥在贸易公司上班。我是家里最小的孩子，可是我知道怎么照顾自己，不让父母担心。
lines.pinyin: Nín hǎo, wǒ shì Chén Kěxīn, jīnnián èrshíyī suì, shì dàxué Rìwén xì de xuéshēng. Fùqīn zài gāozhōng jiāoshū, mǔqīn shì Tiělùjú de yuángōng, gēge zài màoyì gōngsī shàngbān. Wǒ shì jiālǐ zuì xiǎo de háizi, kěshì wǒ zhīdào zěnme zhàogù zìjǐ, bù ràng fùmǔ dānxīn.
lines.english: I am Kexin Chen, 21 years old. I am a university student in the Department of Japanese Language. My father teaches in a senior high school, my mother is an employee in the Railways Administration, and my elder brother works in a trading company. I am the youngest in my family, but I know how to take care of myself, so I don’t let my parents worry about me.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 這個暑假，您要找人到鄉下的花園去種花、剪草。我不喜歡都市緊張的生活，也不習慣天天穿著襯衫，坐在辦公室裡打電腦。鄉下環境好、空氣新鮮，如果能在花園打工，不但可以認識很多植物，休息的時候，還可以坐在草地上喝個茶、聽個音樂。這樣的生活，一定會讓我很開心的。
lines.simplified: 这个暑假，您要找人到乡下的花园去种花，剪草。我不喜欢都市紧张的生活，也不习惯天天穿着衬衫，坐在办公室里打电脑。乡下环境好，空气新鲜，如果能在花园打工，不但可以认识很多植物，休息的时候，还可以坐在草地上喝个茶，听个音乐。这样的生活，一定会让我很开心的。
lines.pinyin: Zhège shǔjià, nín yào zhǎo rén dào xiāngxià de huāyuán qù zhòng huā, jiǎn cǎo. Wǒ bù xǐhuan dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, yě bù xíguàn tiāntiān chuānzhe chènshān, zuò zài bàngōngshì lǐ dǎ diànnǎo. Xiāngxià huánjìng hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, rúguǒ néng zài huāyuán dǎgōng, búdàn kěyǐ rènshi hěn duō zhíwù, xiūxi de shíhou, hái kěyǐ zuò zài cǎodì shàng hē ge chá, tīng ge yīnyuè. Zhèyàng de shēnghuó, yídìng huì ràng wǒ hěn kāixīn de.
lines.english: This summer vacation, you are looking for people who will grow flowers and trim the lawn in a countryside garden. I don’t like stressful urban life, and I am not used to wearing a shirt every day or sitting in an office using a computer. In the countryside the environment is good, and the air is fresh. If I can work part-time in a garden, I can not only know many plants, but also sit on the grass drinking tea or listen to some music during the breaks. This kind of life will certainly make me happy!

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我現在沒有正式的職業，可是我知道打工的經驗很重要，能讓我有不少的收穫。比如說，可以存一點兒學費，學習做事的方法，讓自己的想法更成熟、工作能力更強。大二時，我為了加強日文的會話能力，就去當教授的助理；也做過日本餐廳的服務生、去工廠打過工。洗碗、打掃或是搬重的東西，我都自己來。有時候工作到夜裡兩、三點才回家，我也不害怕。
lines.simplified: 我现在没有正式的职业，可是我知道打工的经验很重要，能让我有不少的收获。比如说，可以存一点儿学费，学习做事的方法，让自己的想法更成熟，工作能力更强。大二时，我为了加强日文的会话能力，就去当教授的助理；也做过日本餐厅的服务生、去工厂打过工。洗碗、打扫或是搬重东西，我都自己来。有时候工作到夜里两、三点才回家，我也不害怕。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài méiyǒu zhèngshì de zhíyè, kěshì wǒ zhīdào dǎgōng de jīngyàn hěn zhòngyào, néng ràng wǒ yǒu bù shǎo de shōuhuò. Bǐrú shuō, kěyǐ cún yìdiǎnr xuéfèi, xuéxí zuòshì de fāngfǎ, ràng zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ gèng chéngshú, gōngzuò nénglì gèng qiáng. Dà èr shí, wǒ wèile jiāqiáng Rìwén de huìhuà nénglì, jiù qù dāng jiàoshòu de zhùlǐ; yě zuò guo Rìběn cāntīng de fúwùshēng, qù gōngchǎng dǎ guo gōng. Xǐwǎn, dǎsǎo huòshì bān zhòng de dōngxi, wǒ dōu zìjǐ lái. Yǒushíhou gōngzuò dào yèlǐ liǎng, sān diǎn cái huí jiā, wǒ yě bù hàipà.
lines.english: I don’t have a formal job now, but I know that part-time working experience is very important, and it benefits me a lot. For example, I can save some money for the tuition, learn how to do some tasks, and become more mature in thinking and have stronger working ability. In my sophomore year, in order to improve my Japanese conversation ability, I worked as a professor’s assistant. I also worked as a waitress in a Japanese restaurant. I did all tasks such as doing dishes, cleaning, or moving heavy objects by myself. Sometimes I worked until 2 or 3 a.m. before going back home, but I wasn’t afraid, either.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我是一個很樂觀的人，也相信有能力把您的花園照顧好，所以向您推薦我自己，請給我這個工作機會。從現在起，我的手機二十四小時都開著，有好消息的話，請隨時通知我，非常謝謝您！
lines.simplified: 我是一个很乐观的人，也相信有能力把您的花园照顾好，所以向您推荐我自己，请给我这个工作机会。从现在起，我的手机二十四小时都开着，有好消息的话，请随时通知我，非常谢谢您！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì yí ge hěn lèguān de rén, yě xiāngxìn yǒu nénglì bǎ nín de huāyuán zhàogù hǎo, suǒyǐ xiàng nín tuījiàn wǒ zìjǐ, qǐng gěi wǒ zhège gōngzuò jīhuì. Cóng xiànzài qǐ, wǒ de shǒujī èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu kāizhe, yǒu hǎo xiāoxi de huà, qǐng suíshí tōngzhī wǒ, fēicháng xièxie nín!
lines.english: I am a very optimistic person. I believe I have the ability to take good care of your garden. Therefore, I recommend myself to you. Please give me this job opportunity. From now on, you can reach me on my phone 24 hours a day. If you have any good news, please inform me any time. Thank you very much!

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 陳可欣　敬上
lines.simplified: 陈可欣　敬上
lines.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn jìngshàng
lines.english: Sincerely, Kexin Chen

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 5 月 21 日
lines.simplified: 5 月 21 日
lines.pinyin: Wǔ yuè èrshíyī rì
lines.english: May 21st

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 個 after a verb to make an action sound brief, casual, or easy.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 個 + N（O）
grammarPages.explanation: 此處「個」是動詞後的語氣助詞，表示動作時間短，或做得輕鬆、簡單；離合詞也常用這個形式，例如「喝個茶」、「唱個歌」。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Here 「個」 is a particle after the verb. It makes the action sound brief, relaxed, or easy. Separable verb-object words often use this pattern, such as 「喝個茶」 and 「唱個歌」.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “個” serves as a particle showing that an action only lasts for a short time or something is done in a relaxing and easy manner. Verb-object separable words are often used in this pattern, such as “喝個茶”, “唱個歌”, “跳個舞”, etc.

text.traditional: 我覺得洗個碗、倒個垃圾都是很簡單的家事。
text.simplified: 我觉得洗个碗、倒个垃圾都是很简单的家事。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde xǐ ge wǎn, dào ge lājī dōu shì hěn jiǎndān de jiāshì.
text.english: I think washing a few dishes and taking out the trash are both very simple chores.

text.traditional: 爸爸每天下班回家，都先看個電視再吃晚飯。
text.simplified: 爸爸每天下班回家，都先看个电视再吃晚饭。
text.pinyin: Bàba měitiān xiàbān huí jiā, dōu xiān kàn ge diànshì zài chī wǎnfàn.
text.english: When Dad comes home from work each day, he watches a little TV before dinner.

text.traditional: 這個週末我想先去 KTV 唱個歌，再去看個電影，輕鬆一下。
text.simplified: 这个周末我想先去 KTV 唱个歌，再去看个电影，轻松一下。
text.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ xiǎng xiān qù KTV chàng ge gē, zài qù kàn ge diànyǐng, qīngsōng yíxià.
text.english: This weekend I want to sing a song at KTV first, then see a movie and relax a little.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 來 to stand for a known action, or let someone else handle a task.
grammarPages.pattern: N／NP + 來（+ V）
grammarPages.explanation: 此處「來」代替前文已知的動作，常用於動作明確的情況。「自己來」表示不想麻煩別人，是較客氣的說法。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Here 「來」 stands for an action already understood from context, often one that is specific. 「自己來」 politely says the speaker does not want to trouble someone else.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “來” refers to an omitted verb and is often used when there is a specific action, e.g., “我來做” and “我來幫忙”. If the dialogue responds with “自己來”, it indicates that the speaker doesn’t want to bother the other person. It is a polite statement.

text.traditional: 我做了很多菜，你想吃什麼，自己來，別客氣。
text.simplified: 我做了很多菜，你想吃什么，自己来，别客气。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuò le hěn duō cài, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme, zìjǐ lái, bié kèqi.
text.english: I made a lot of dishes. Help yourself to whatever you want; don’t be shy.

text.traditional: 上網訂票、找資料、寫報告，這些事情李老闆都讓助理來。
text.simplified: 上网订票、找资料、写报告，这些事情李老板都让助理来。
text.pinyin: Shàngwǎng dìng piào, zhǎo zīliào, xiě bàogào, zhèxiē shìqing Lǐ lǎobǎn dōu ràng zhùlǐ lái.
text.english: For booking tickets online, finding information, and writing reports, Mr. Li has his assistant handle all those things.

text.traditional: A：像洗碗、打掃房間這樣的事，那個孩子都做不好。B：他才五歲，這些事最好讓父母來（做）。
text.simplified: A：像洗碗、打扫房间这样的事，那个孩子都做不好。B：他才五岁，这些事最好让父母来（做）。
text.pinyin: A: Xiàng xǐwǎn, dǎsǎo fángjiān zhèyàng de shì, nàge háizi dōu zuò bù hǎo. B: Tā cái wǔ suì, zhèxiē shì zuìhǎo ràng fùmǔ lái (zuò).
text.english: A: The child cannot do things like washing dishes and cleaning the room well. B: He is only five; it’s best to let his parents do those things.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · I Want to Buy a Laptop

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State a result that stays true under every condition.
grammarPages.pattern: 不管 + question/condition，(subject) + 都 + unchanged result
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates in every possible condition, the stated situation in the latter part of the sentence will not change. “不管” is followed by possible conditions, and “都” is followed by the situation that will remain unchanged. Besides, the sentence following “不管” is an interrogative sentence, which can be Wh-Question, A-not-A Question, Alternative Question, and two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates in every possible condition, the stated situation in the latter part of the sentence will not change. “不管” is followed by possible conditions, and “都” is followed by the situation that will remain unchanged. Besides, the sentence following “不管” is an interrogative sentence, which can be Wh-Question, A-not-A Question, Alternative Question, and two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates in every possible condition, the stated situation in the latter part of the sentence will not change. “不管” is followed by possible conditions, and “都” is followed by the situation that will remain unchanged. Besides, the sentence following “不管” is an interrogative sentence, which can be Wh-Question, A-not-A Question, Alternative Question, and two opposite monosyllabic words.

text.traditional: 不管這支手機貴不貴，我都要買。
text.simplified: 不管这支手机贵不贵，我都要买。
text.pinyin: Bù guǎn zhè zhī shǒujī guì bú guì, wǒ dōu yào mǎi.
text.english: No matter whether this phone is expensive, I still want to buy it.

text.traditional: 不管看什麼電影，我都喜歡跟朋友一起看。
text.simplified: 不管看什么电影，我都喜欢跟朋友一起看。
text.pinyin: Bù guǎn kàn shénme diànyǐng, wǒ dōu xǐhuan gēn péng you yìqǐ kàn.
text.english: No matter what movie it is, I like watching it with friends.

text.traditional: 這個城市交通便利，不管搭公車還是火車都很方便。
text.simplified: 这个城市交通便利，不管搭公车还是火车都很方便。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge chéngshì jiāotōng biànlì, bù guǎn dā gōngchē háishì huǒchē dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Transportation in this city is convenient; it is easy to get around by either bus or train.

text.traditional: 員工：我今天心情不好，我要請假。老闆：不管心情好壞，你都得來上班。
text.simplified: 员工：我今天心情不好，我要请假。老板：不管心情好坏，你都得来上班。
text.pinyin: Yuángōng: Wǒ jīntiān xīnqíng bù hǎo, wǒ yào qǐngjià. Lǎobǎn: Bù guǎn xīnqíng hǎohuài, nǐ dōu děi lái shàngbān.
text.english: Employee: I’m in a bad mood today, so I want to take a day off. Boss: Whether you’re in a good or bad mood, you still have to come to work.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Offer a better alternative after explaining the first option.
grammarPages.pattern: original action/comment，不如 + better suggestion (+ explanation)
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern in a conversation is usually used to help the speaker offer a better suggestion. Before “不如”, the speaker can give comments on the original action to explain why there is a better suggestion which follows “不如”. And, accordingly, a further explanation can be added to the better suggestion.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern in a conversation is usually used to help the speaker offer a better suggestion. Before “不如”, the speaker can give comments on the original action to explain why there is a better suggestion which follows “不如”. And, accordingly, a further explanation can be added to the better suggestion.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern in a conversation is usually used to help the speaker offer a better suggestion. Before “不如”, the speaker can give comments on the original action to explain why there is a better suggestion which follows “不如”. And, accordingly, a further explanation can be added to the better suggestion.

text.traditional: 這台筆電太舊了，如果要花不少錢修理，不如買一台新的。
text.simplified: 这台笔电太旧了，如果要花不少钱修理，不如买一台新的。
text.pinyin: Zhè tái bǐdiàn tài jiù le, rúguǒ yào huā bù shǎo qián xiūlǐ, bù rú mǎi yì tái xīn de.
text.english: This laptop is too old. If repairing it would cost a lot, it would be better to buy a new one.

words.meaning: if; in case; in the event that

text.traditional: 先生：那台最新的平板不但很輕，功能也很好，我想要買。太太：可是新產品都很貴，不如等便宜一點兒再買吧！
text.simplified: 先生：那台最新的平板不但很轻，功能也很好，我想要买。太太：可是新产品都很贵，不如等便宜一点儿再买吧！
text.pinyin: Xiānsheng: Nà tái zuìxīn de píngbǎn bú dàn hěn qīng, gōngnéng yě hěn hǎo, wǒ xiǎng yào mǎi. Tàitai: Kěshì xīn chǎnpǐn dōu hěn guì, bù rú děng piányi yì diǎnr zài mǎi ba!
text.english: Husband: That newest tablet is light and has great features. I want to buy it. Wife: But new products are all expensive. It would be better to wait until it’s a little cheaper.

text.traditional: A：我們去附近的飯館吃餃子，好不好？B：那家飯館常常客滿，不如去便利商店買三明治，不必等。
text.simplified: A：我们去附近的饭馆吃饺子，好不好？B：那家饭馆常常客满，不如去便利商店买三明治，不必等。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒmen qù fùjìn de fànguǎn chī jiǎozi, hǎo bù hǎo? B: Nà jiā fànguǎn chángcháng kèmǎn, bù rú qù biànlìshāngdiàn mǎi sānmíngzhì, bú bì děng.
text.english: A: Shall we go to the nearby restaurant for dumplings? B: That restaurant is often full. We’d better go to the convenience store for a sandwich; we won’t have to wait.

words.meaning: don't have to, no need to

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a small shortcoming or complaint.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs + 了 +（一）點兒
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern is used when the speaker wants to show a situation is not as good as expected, but there is not much difference. Usually, it implies minor weaknesses or complaints. For example, “這支手機不錯，可是貴了一點兒 (This cell phone is not bad, but it is a little bit expensive.)” In the example, the speaker thinks the cell phone is more expensive than he expects, but it is not a big issue.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern is used when the speaker wants to show a situation is not as good as expected, but there is not much difference. Usually, it implies minor weaknesses or complaints. For example, “這支手機不錯，可是貴了一點兒 (This cell phone is not bad, but it is a little bit expensive.)” In the example, the speaker thinks the cell phone is more expensive than he expects, but it is not a big issue.

Usually, it implies minor weaknesses or complaints. For example, “這支手機不錯，可是貴了一點兒 (This cell phone is not bad, but it is a little bit expensive.)” In the example, the speaker thinks the cell phone is more expensive than he expects, but it is not a big issue.

text.traditional: 這堂美術課很有意思，可是學生多了一點兒。
text.simplified: 这堂美术课很有意思，可是学生多了一点儿。
text.pinyin: Zhè táng měi shù kè hěn yǒuyìsi, kěshì xuésheng duō le yì diǎnr.
text.english: This art class is interesting, but there are a bit too many students.

words.meaning: many; much; more; a lot of

text.traditional: 健身雖然對身體有很多好處，但是健身房的費用高了一點兒。
text.simplified: 健身虽然对身体有很多好处，但是健身房的费用高了一点儿。
text.pinyin: Jiànshēn suīrán duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎochù, dànshì jiànshēnfáng de fèiyòng gāo le yì diǎnr.
text.english: Although working out has many benefits for your health, the gym fee is a little high.

words.meaning: many; much; more; a lot of

text.traditional: A：聽說你趁這次春假去了日月潭，那裡的風景怎麼樣？B：日月潭很美，花也都開了。可惜人太多，擠了點兒。
text.simplified: A：听说你趁这次春假去了日月潭，那里的风景怎么样？B：日月潭很美，花也都开了。可惜人太多，挤了点儿。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ chèn zhè cì chūnjià qù le Rìyuètán, nàlǐ de fēngjǐng zěnmeyàng? B: Rìyuètán hěn měi, huā yě dōu kāi le. Kěxī rén tài duō, jǐ le diǎnr.
text.english: A: I heard you went to Sun Moon Lake during spring break. How was the scenery? B: Sun Moon Lake is beautiful, and the flowers have all bloomed. Too bad there were so many people; it was a little crowded.

words.meaning: many; much; more; a lot of

dialogue.title: 對話 · 我要買筆電 · I Want to Buy a Laptop

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 您好，要找哪種產品？筆電還是平板？
lines.simplified: 您好，要找哪种产品？笔电还是平板？
lines.pinyin: Nín hǎo, yào zhǎo nǎ zhǒng chǎnpǐn? Bǐ diàn háishi píngbǎn?
lines.english: Hello! What kind of product are you looking for? A laptop or a tablet?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 你好，請問這兩種有什麼差別？你可以說明一下嗎？
lines.simplified: 你好，请问这两种有什么差别？你可以说明一下吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn zhè liǎng zhǒng yǒu shénme chābié? Nǐ kěyǐ shuōmíng yíxià ma?
lines.english: Hello. May I ask that what is the difference between these two? Could you please explain?

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 其實功能都差不多，可是平板比較輕，不少上班族出差時，得隨時處理公司的事情，所以他們比較喜歡買平板。
lines.simplified: 其实功能都差不多，可是平板比较轻，不少上班族出差时，得随时处理公司的事情，所以他们比较喜欢买平板。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí gōngnéng dōu chàbuduō, kěshì píngbǎn bǐjiào qīng, bù shǎo shàngbānzú chūchāi shí, děi suíshí chǔlǐ gōngsī de shìqing, suǒyǐ tāmen bǐjiào xǐhuan mǎi píngbǎn.
lines.english: Actually, their functions are similar, but tablets are lighter. When many office workers go on business trips, they have to deal with tasks of their companies anytime, so they prefer buying tablets.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 你的意思是，帶著筆電出門很麻煩，不如買平板？
lines.simplified: 你的意思是，带着笔电出门很麻烦，不如买平板？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsi shì, dài zhe bǐ diàn chūmén hěn máfan, bùrú mǎi píngbǎn?
lines.english: You mean it is very troublesome to go out with a laptop, and it is better to buy a laptop, right?

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 也不一定，大多數的大學生把筆電放在背包裡，不管去圖書館還是咖啡廳，隨時都能做功課、寫報告。
lines.simplified: 也不一定，大多数的大学生把笔电放在背包里，不管去图书馆还是咖啡厅，随时都能做功课、写报告。
lines.pinyin: Yě bù yídìng, dàduōshù de dàxuéshēng bǎ bǐ diàn fàng zài bèibāo lǐ, bùguǎn qù túshūguǎn háishi kāfēitīng, suíshí dōu néng zuò gōngkè, xiě bàogào.
lines.english: Not necessarily. Most university students put laptops in their backpacks. No matter where they go, to a library or to a café, they can do homework and write reports anytime.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我好像比較需要這樣的產品。那有沒有輕一點兒的筆電？
lines.simplified: 我好像比较需要这样的产品。那有没有轻一点儿的笔电？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng bǐjiào xūyào zhèyàng de chǎnpǐn. Nà yǒu méiyǒu qīng yìdiǎnr de bǐ diàn?
lines.english: I seem to need this kind of product more. In that case, do you have any laptop that is lighter?

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 有，請跟我來。您看，這部筆電是最新的，牌子很有名，也非常輕。
lines.simplified: 有，请跟我来。您看，这部笔电是最新的，牌子很有名，也非常轻。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, qǐng gēn wǒ lái. Nín kàn, zhè bù bǐ diàn shì zuìxīn de, páizi hěn yǒumíng, yě fēicháng qīng.
lines.english: We do. Please follow me. Look! This laptop is the newest. The brand is very famous and the laptop is very light, too.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 看起來很好用，拿起來也很輕，可是最近電視新聞說這個牌子的筆電不好，很多人都抱怨電池有問題。
lines.simplified: 看起来很好用，拿起来也很轻，可是最近电视新闻说这个牌子的笔电不好，很多人都抱怨电池有问题。
lines.pinyin: Kànqǐlái hěn hǎo yòng, ná qǐlái yě hěn qīng, kěshì zuìjìn diànshì xīnwén shuō zhège páizi de bǐ diàn bù hǎo, hěn duō rén dōu bàoyuàn diànchí yǒu wèntí.
lines.english: It looks useful, and is very light to carry. However, recently, in TV news people say laptops of this brand are not good. Many people complain about problems with the battery.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 電腦用久了，有問題是正常的。以後有問題的話，您就帶著保證書來，我們會幫您免費修理的。
lines.simplified: 电脑用久了，有问题是正常的。以后有问题的话，您就带着保证书来，我们会帮您免费修理的。
lines.pinyin: Diànnǎo yòng jiǔ le, yǒu wèntí shì zhèngcháng de. Yǐhòu yǒu wèntí de huà, nín jiù dài zhe bǎozhèngshū lái, wǒmen huì bāng nín miǎnfèi xiūlǐ de.
lines.english: If a computer has been used for a long time, it would be normal to have some problems. If there is really something wrong with it, you can bring this warranty, and we will repair it for you for free.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 這樣啊，不過三萬六千塊貴了一點兒，恐怕我買不起。我改天再來看看，謝謝。
lines.simplified: 这样啊，不过三万六千块贵了一点儿，恐怕我买不起。我改天再来看看，谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng a, búguò sān wàn liù qiān kuài guì le yìdiǎnr, kǒngpà wǒ mǎi bu qǐ. Wǒ gǎitiān zài lái kànkan, xièxie.
lines.english: I see. But a computer costing 36,000 dollars is a little expensive. I’m afraid I can’t afford it. I’ll come again another day, thank you.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 請等一下！除了傳真機，我們的產品這個禮拜都打八五折，還有「滿三萬送三千」的活動。
lines.simplified: 请等一下！除了传真机，我们的产品这个礼拜都打八五折，还有「满三万送三千」的活动。
lines.pinyin: Qǐng děng yíxià! Chúle chuánzhēnjī, wǒmen de chǎnpǐn zhège lǐbài dōu dǎ bā wǔ zhé, hái yǒu “mǎn sān wàn sòng sān qiān” de huódòng.
lines.english: Please wait a moment! In addition to fax machines, our products are 15% off this week. We are also having a sales promotion, which is “3,000-dollar cash rebate on every 30,000-dollar purchase”.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 你的意思是打折以後要是超過三萬元，還可以再便宜三千塊嗎？
lines.simplified: 你的意思是打折以后要是超过三万元，还可以再便宜三千块吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsi shì dǎzhé yǐhòu yàoshi chāoguò sān wàn yuán, hái kěyǐ zài piányi sān qiān kuài ma?
lines.english: Do you mean that if the price of the product after the discount exceeds 30,000 dollars, it can be another 3,000 dollars cheaper?

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 沒錯，而且這個活動下禮拜就結束了，請把握機會喔！
lines.simplified: 没错，而且这个活动下礼拜就结束了，请把握机会喔！
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò, érqiě zhège huódòng xià lǐbài jiù jiéshù le, qǐng bǎwò jīhuì o!
lines.english: Exactly. What’s more, this offer will end next week. Please seize the opportunity!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 那麼，我只要付大約兩萬八，就能夠把這部筆電帶回家，是嗎？
lines.simplified: 那么，我只要付大约两万八，就能够把这部笔电带回家，是吗？
lines.pinyin: Nàme, wǒ zhǐyào fù dàyuē liǎng wàn bā, jiù nénggòu bǎ zhè bù bǐ diàn dài huí jiā, shì ma?
lines.english: So, I only need to pay about 28,000 dollars to bring the laptop home, right?

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 是的。我們有白色、黑色、紅色等三種顏色讓客人選擇。
lines.simplified: 是的。我们有白色、黑色、红色等三种颜色让客人选择。
lines.pinyin: Shì de. Wǒmen yǒu báisè, hēisè, hóngsè děng sān zhǒng yánsè ràng kèrén xuǎnzé.
lines.english: Yes, and we have three colors, white, black and red for our guests to choose.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我要黑色的。
lines.simplified: 我要黑色的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào hēisè de.
lines.english: I’ll take the black one.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 好的。打折後是兩萬七千六百元，再送您一個真皮的背包。
lines.simplified: 好的。打折后是两万七千六百元，再送您一个真皮的背包。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Dǎzhé hòu shì liǎng wàn qī qiān liù bǎi yuán, zài sòng nín yí ge zhēnpí de bèibāo.
lines.english: Alright. That would be 27,600 dollars with the discount. I’ll give you a backpack made of genuine leather as a gift.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 謝謝，再見。
lines.simplified: 谢谢，再见。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, zàijiàn.
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.traditional: 先生，這支手機是您的嗎？
lines.simplified: 先生，这支手机是您的吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiānsheng, zhè zhī shǒujī shì nín de ma?
lines.english: Sir, is this cellphone yours?

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · I Want to Buy a Laptop

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.titleEnglish: comparative sentences 比, 比較 and 比起來
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Compare two things with 比, 比較, or 比起來.
grammarPages.pattern: A 比 B + Vs / S + 比較 + Vs / 跟 B 比起來，A 比較……

columns.meaning: A is more/less Vs than B

columns.traditional: 跟 B 比起來，A 比較……
columns.simplified: 跟 B 比起來，A 比較……
columns.meaning: compared with B, A is more/less…

grammarPages.explanation: “比” is a preposition that indicates the status of the subject when a comparison is made. “比” is followed by the compared object, e.g., “我比你高” and “搭公車比搭火車便宜”, equivalent to “than” in English. “比較” is an adverb that indicates a higher or lower degree, e.g., “台灣比較熱” and “坐公車比較便宜”, equivalent to “more” in English. The subject is placed before “比較”, while the stative verb is placed after it. “比起來” is a phrase that shows the remark about one thing as compared to another. The common pattern is “(A/B)跟 B/A 比起來，A/B 比較……”, e.g., “（你）跟他比起來，你比較漂亮” and “（我）跟你比起來，我沒有你那麼漂亮”.

The subject is placed before “比較”, while the stative verb is placed after it. “比起來” is a phrase that shows the remark about one thing as compared to another. The common pattern is “(A/B)跟 B/A 比起來，A/B 比較……”, e.g., “（你）跟他比起來，你比較漂亮” and “（我）跟你比起來，我沒有你那麼漂亮”.

text.traditional: 平板比筆電便宜，所以我比較想買平板。
text.simplified: 平板比笔电便宜，所以我比较想买平板。
text.pinyin: Píngbǎn bǐ bǐdiàn piányi, suǒyǐ wǒ bǐjiào xiǎng mǎi píngbǎn.
text.english: Tablets are cheaper than laptops, so I’d rather buy a tablet.

text.traditional: 跟國外旅遊比起來，大部分的國內旅遊便宜一點兒。
text.simplified: 跟国外旅游比起来，大部分的国内旅游便宜一点儿。
text.pinyin: Gēn guówài lǚyóu bǐ qǐ lái, dàbùfen de guónèi lǚyóu piányi yì diǎnr.
text.english: Compared with traveling abroad, most domestic trips are a little cheaper.

words.meaning: the greater part; the majority; most

text.traditional: 雖然筆電的功能比平板好，可是跟平板比起來，筆電比較重。
text.simplified: 虽然笔电的功能比平板好，可是跟平板比起来，笔电比较重。
text.pinyin: Suīrán bǐdiàn de gōngnéng bǐ píngbǎn hǎo, kěshì gēn píngbǎn bǐ qǐ lái, bǐdiàn bǐjiào zhòng.
text.english: Although laptops have better features than tablets, laptops are heavier compared with tablets.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe something unwanted that nearly happened.
grammarPages.pattern: 差（一）點兒 + verb phrase (+ 就 + result)
grammarPages.explanation: “差一點兒” is usually followed by verbs or verb phrases. This pattern is usually used in a situation when something which the speaker did not wish almost happened.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “差一點兒” is usually followed by verbs or verb phrases. This pattern is usually used in a situation when something which the speaker did not wish almost happened.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “差一點兒” is usually followed by verbs or verb phrases. This pattern is usually used in a situation when something which the speaker did not wish almost happened.

text.traditional: 我以為我的手機不見了，差一點兒就要去買新的。
text.simplified: 我以为我的手机不见了，差一点儿就要去买新的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi wǒ de shǒujī bú jiàn le, chà yì diǎnr jiù yào qù mǎi xīn de.
text.english: I thought I had lost my phone and almost went to buy a new one.

text.traditional: 他吃了不新鮮的食物，拉了三天的肚子，差一點兒就死了。
text.simplified: 他吃了不新鲜的食物，拉了三天的肚子，差一点儿就死了。
text.pinyin: Tā chī le bù xīnxiān de shíwù, lā le sān tiān de dùzi, chà yì diǎnr jiù sǐ le.
text.english: He ate stale food and had diarrhea for three days; he almost died.

text.traditional: 我差點兒忘了今天要考試，還好你告訴我，要不然這門課我一定會被當。
text.simplified: 我差点儿忘了今天要考试，还好你告诉我，要不然这门课我一定会被当。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chà diǎnr wàng le jīntiān yào kǎoshì, háihǎo nǐ gàosu wǒ, yào bù rán zhè mén kè wǒ yídìng huì bèi dàng.
text.english: I almost forgot that I had an exam today. Good thing you told me; otherwise, I would definitely have failed this class.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Show that an action had no expected effect.
grammarPages.pattern: 白 + V (+ 了)
grammarPages.explanation: “白” should be followed by a verb, often a monosyllabic verb. It indicates an action is carried out with no effects it should have. Note when collocating with some verbs such as “吃 (eat)”, “喝 (drink)” and “住 (live)”, it means “unwilling to pay money or make effort”, e.g., “他常常來我家白吃白喝”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “白” should be followed by a verb, often a monosyllabic verb. It indicates an action is carried out with no effects it should have. Note when collocating with some verbs such as “吃 (eat)”, “喝 (drink)” and “住 (live)”, it means “unwilling to pay money or make effort”, e.g., “他常常來我家白吃白喝”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “白” should be followed by a verb, often a monosyllabic verb. It indicates an action is carried out with no effects it should have. Note when collocating with some verbs such as “吃 (eat)”, “喝 (drink)” and “住 (live)”, it means “unwilling to pay money or make effort”, e.g., “他常常來我家白吃白喝”.

text.traditional: 我說了這麼多次，你還是沒聽懂，真是白說了。
text.simplified: 我说了这么多次，你还是没听懂，真是白说了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shuō le zhème duōcì, nǐ háishì méi tīngdǒng, zhēnshì bái shuō le.
text.english: I’ve said it so many times, but you still didn’t understand. It was all for nothing.

words.meaning: (negative prefix for verbs) have not; not

text.traditional: 那家餐廳很遠，你先打電話問他們今天做不做生意，別白跑了！
text.simplified: 那家餐厅很远，你先打电话问他们今天做不做生意，别白跑了！
text.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn yuǎn, nǐ xiān dǎ diàn huà wèn tāmen jīntiān zuò bu zuò shēng yì, bié bái pǎo le!
text.english: That restaurant is far away. Call first to ask whether they’re open today so you don’t make the trip for nothing!

text.traditional: 我把野餐要吃的三明治都準備好了，可是朋友忽然說不去了，我白準備了。
text.simplified: 我把野餐要吃的三明治都准备好了，可是朋友忽然说不去了，我白准备了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yěcān yào chī de sānmíngzhì dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le, kěshì péngyou hūrán shuō bú qù le, wǒ bái zhǔn bèi le.
text.english: I prepared all the sandwiches for the picnic, but my friend suddenly said they weren’t going. I prepared them for nothing.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 去光華商場買筆電 · Going to Guanghua Digital Plaza to Buy a Laptop

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我在台灣沒買過 3C 產品，所以買電腦以前，我看了好幾本電腦雜誌，也問了有經驗的朋友。朋友說他總是先上網打聽哪家店比較好、哪家店打折，或是哪家店的店員比較客氣。我覺得他說得很有道理，所以前兩天我也先上網找了一家不錯的商店。
lines.simplified: 我在台湾没买过 3C 产品，所以买电脑以前，我看了好几本电脑杂志，也问了有经验的朋友。朋友说他总是先上网打听哪家店比较好、哪家店打折，或是哪家店的店员比较客气。我觉得他说得很有道理，所以前两天我也先上网找了一家不错的商店。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān méi mǎi guo 3C chǎnpǐn, suǒyǐ mǎi diànnǎo yǐqián, wǒ kàn le hǎo jǐ běn diànnǎo zázhì, yě wèn le yǒu jīngyàn de péngyou. Péngyou shuō tā zǒngshì xiān shàngwǎng dǎting nǎ jiā diàn bǐjiào hǎo, nǎ jiā diàn dǎzhé, huòshì nǎ jiā diàn de diànyuán bǐjiào kèqi. Wǒ juéde tā shuō de hěn yǒu dàolǐ, suǒyǐ qián liǎng tiān wǒ yě xiān shàngwǎng zhǎo le yì jiā búcuò de shāngdiàn.
lines.english: I had never bought any electronic product in Taiwan before, so I read several computer magazines and asked an experienced friend before buying a computer. A friend told me that he would first inquire on the Internet about which store is better, which store gives discounts, or in which store the clerks are more polite. I thought that what he said made sense, so in the past two days, I also searched for a store on the Internet.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 那家店在光華商場，昨天我一下課就去那裡看看。本來我想買平板，但是店員認為大學生用筆電比較方便，而且跟平板比起來，筆電還是比較好用的。
lines.simplified: 那家店在光华商场，昨天我一下课就去那里看看。本来我想买平板，但是店员认为大学生用笔电比较方便，而且跟平板比起来，笔电还是比较好用的。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zài Guānghuá Shāngchǎng, zuótiān wǒ yí xiàkè jiù qù nàli kànkan. Běnlái wǒ xiǎng mǎi píngbǎn, dànshì diànyuán rènwéi dàxuéshēng yòng bǐ diàn bǐjiào fāngbiàn, érqiě gēn píngbǎn bǐqǐlái, bǐ diàn háishi bǐjiào hǎo yòng de.
lines.english: The store was in Guanghua Digital Plaza. I went there and had a look right after class yesterday. Originally, I wanted to buy the tablet, but the clerk thought using a laptop is more convenient for university students. Besides, in comparison to a tablet, a laptop is still more useful.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 店員建議我買的那部筆電是最新的產品，拿起來很輕、看起來很好用，可是價格太高了。我最近窮死了，買不起那麼貴的電腦。因為上次搬家的時候手機不見了，父母說我不愛惜東西，這兩個月不給我零用錢，逼我省錢。還好店員告訴我，那部電腦打折以後能便宜八千塊錢，而且還答應我，要是電腦有問題，不超過一年都可以免費修理，所以我當天就把電腦買回家了。付了錢以後，我差一點兒就又忘了拿自己的手機，真糊塗！
lines.simplified: 店员建议我买的那部笔电是最新的产品，拿起来很轻、看起来很好用，可是价格太高了。我最近穷死了，买不起那么贵的电脑。因为上次搬家的时候手机不见了，父母说我不爱惜东西，这两个月不给我零用钱，逼我省钱。还好店员告诉我，那部电脑打折以后能便宜八千块钱，而且还答应我，要是电脑有问题，不超过一年都可以免费修理，所以我当天就把电脑买回家了。付了钱以后，我差一点儿就又忘了拿自己的手机，真胡涂！
lines.pinyin: Diànyuán jiànyì wǒ mǎi de nà bù bǐ diàn shì zuìxīn de chǎnpǐn, ná qǐlái hěn qīng, kàn qǐlái hěn hǎo yòng, kěshì jiàgé tài gāo le. Wǒ zuìjìn qióng sǐ le, mǎi bu qǐ nàme guì de diànnǎo. Yīnwèi shàng cì bān jiā de shíhou shǒujī bújiàn le, fùmǔ shuō wǒ bú àixí dōngxi, zhè liǎng ge yuè bù gěi wǒ língyòngqián, bī wǒ shěngqián. Hái hǎo diànyuán gàosu wǒ, nà bù diànnǎo dǎzhé yǐhòu néng piányi bā qiān kuài qián, érqiě hái dāying wǒ, yàoshi diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, bù chāoguò yì nián dōu kěyǐ miǎnfèi xiūlǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ dāngtiān jiù bǎ diànnǎo mǎi huí jiā le. Fù le qián yǐhòu, wǒ chà yìdiǎnr jiù yòu wàng le ná zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútu!
lines.english: The laptop the clerk suggested me to buy was the newest product. It was very light to carry and looked useful, but the price was too high. I was terribly poor recently, and I couldn’t afford such an expensive computer. Because my new cell phone was gone when I was moving house last time, my parents said that I didn’t cherish my stuff, so they didn’t give me pocket money these two months in order for me to save money. Fortunately, the clerk told me later that I could save 8,000 dollars after a discount, and he also promised me that if there were problems with the computer within a year, he would definitely help me repair it for free, so I brought the computer home on that same day. After paying the money, I almost forgot my cell phone again. How clumsy I was!

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我很高興這次去光華商場沒白跑，很快就買到需要的筆電，省了不少麻煩。後來我又去看了其他的科技產品，有不少新發現。新產品的功能越來越多，不但能幫我們解決很多問題，也能讓我們的生活變得更便利。
lines.simplified: 我很高兴这次去光华商场没白跑，很快就买到需要的笔电，省了不少麻烦。后来我又去看了其他的科技产品，有不少新发现。新产品的功能越来越多，不但能帮我们解决很多问题，也能让我们的生活变得更便利。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng zhè cì qù Guānghuá Shāngchǎng méi báipǎo, hěn kuài jiù mǎi dào xūyào de bǐ diàn, shěng le bù shǎo máfan. Hòulái wǒ yòu qù kàn le qítā de kējì chǎnpǐn, yǒu bù shǎo xīn fāxiàn. Xīn chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yuèláiyuè duō, búdàn néng bāng wǒmen jiějué hěn duō wèntí, yě néng ràng wǒmen de shēnghuó biàn de gèng biànlì.
lines.english: I am glad that this time I didn’t go to Guanghua Digital Plaza for nothing. I quickly bought the laptop I wanted, and it saved me a lot of trouble. Afterwards I went to see other technological products and had many new discoveries. I think new products have more and more functions. They not only can help us solve many problems, but also can make our lives more convenient.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.titleTraditional: 想起來：想起來了／沒想起來／想得起來／想不起來
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Now Remember / Can or Can’t Remember
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Recall something you nearly forgot.
grammarPages.explanation: “想起來” is used when someone suddenly remembers something that is almost forgotten or recalls something with great effort. “想得起來／想不起來” indicates whether or not someone can remember something almost forgotten or happened a long time ago.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “想起來” is used when someone suddenly remembers something that is almost forgotten or recalls something with great effort. “想得起來／想不起來” indicates whether or not someone can remember something almost forgotten or happened a long time ago.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “想起來” is used when someone suddenly remembers something that is almost forgotten or recalls something with great effort. “想得起來／想不起來” indicates whether or not someone can remember something almost forgotten or happened a long time ago.
grammarPages.pattern: 想起來了／沒想起來／想得起來／想不起來

text.traditional: 太太：你怎麼看起來這麼緊張啊？先生：我忽然想起來今天要開會，我得快點兒去公司！
text.simplified: 太太：你怎么看起来这么紧张啊？先生：我忽然想起来今天要开会，我得快点儿去公司！
text.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ zěnme kànqǐlái zhème jǐnzhāng a? Xiānsheng: Wǒ hūrán xiǎng qǐlái jīntiān yào kāihuì, wǒ děi kuài diǎnr qù gōngsī!
text.english: Wife: Why do you look so nervous? Husband: I suddenly remembered that I have a meeting today. I have to hurry to the office!

text.traditional: A：你記得我們上次去的 KTV 在哪裡嗎？B：我想想……想起來了！就在捷運龍山寺站的附近。
text.simplified: A：你记得我们上次去的 KTV 在哪里吗？B：我想想……想起来了！就在捷运龙山寺站的附近。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ jìde wǒmen shàngcì qù de KTV zài nǎlǐ ma? B: Wǒ xiǎngxiang…… xiǎng qǐlái le! Jiù zài Jiéyùn Lóngshānsì Zhàn de fùjìn.
text.english: A: Do you remember where the KTV we went to last time is? B: Let me think… I remember now! It’s right near Longshan Temple MRT Station.

text.traditional: A：我是你的小學同學，你還記得我的名字嗎？B：你叫……對不起，我想不起來了。
text.simplified: A：我是你的小学同学，你还记得我的名字吗？B：你叫……对不起，我想不起来了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ shì nǐ de xiǎoxué tóngxué, nǐ hái jìde wǒ de míngzi ma? B: Nǐ jiào…… duìbuqǐ, wǒ xiǎng bù qǐlái le.
text.english: A: I am your elementary school classmate. Do you still remember my name? B: Your name is… Sorry, I can’t remember.

text.traditional: A：你小時候第一次看的卡通是什麼，你想得起來嗎？B：那麼久以前的事，我怎麼想得起來！
text.simplified: A：你小时候第一次看的卡通是什么，你想得起来吗？B：那么久以前的事，我怎么想得起来！
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎoshíhou dì yī cì kàn de kǎtōng shì shénme, nǐ xiǎng de qǐlái ma? B: Nàme jiǔ yǐqián de shì, wǒ zěnme xiǎng de qǐlái!
text.english: A: What was the first cartoon you watched as a child? Can you remember? B: How could I remember something from so long ago!

grammarPages.explanation: This pattern expresses that someone has never done something, or never does something.

text.traditional: A：這個週末我們一起去 KTV 唱歌，怎麼樣？B：太好了！我從來沒去過 KTV，一定很好玩。
text.simplified: A：这个周末我们一起去 KTV 唱歌，怎么样？B：太好了！我从来没去过 KTV，一定很好玩。
text.pinyin: A: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù KTV chànggē, zěnmeyàng? B: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ cónglái méi qùguo KTV, yídìng hěn hǎowán.
text.english: A: How about going to KTV to sing together this weekend? B: Great! I’ve never been to KTV; it must be fun.

text.traditional: A：下班以後，我們找老王一起去健身吧！B：不用找他了，他從來不運動！
text.simplified: A：下班以后，我们找老王一起去健身吧！B：不用找他了，他从来不运动！
text.pinyin: A: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒmen zhǎo Lǎo Wáng yìqǐ qù jiànshēn ba! B: Bú yòng zhǎo tā le, tā cónglái bú yùndòng!
text.english: A: Let’s ask Lao Wang to work out with us after work! B: There’s no need; he never exercises!

text.traditional: A：我從來沒去過阿里山，聽說那裡的日出很美，是真的嗎？B：阿里山的日出是很美，夜裡看星星也不錯喔！
text.simplified: A：我从来没去过阿里山，听说那里的日出很美，是真的吗？B：阿里山的日出是很美，夜里看星星也不错喔！
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ cónglái méi qù guo Ālǐshān, tīngshuō nàlǐ de rìchū hěn měi, shì zhēn de ma? B: Ālǐshān de rìchū shì hěn měi, yèli kàn xīngxing yě búcuò o!
text.english: A: I’ve never been to Alishan. I heard the sunrise there is beautiful. Is that true? B: The sunrise at Alishan is beautiful, and stargazing at night is nice too!

text.traditional: 便利商店的貼紙，可以換尺、牙刷、卡通娃娃等等。
text.simplified: 便利商店的贴纸，可以换尺、牙刷、卡通娃娃等等。
text.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de tiēzhǐ, kěyǐ huàn chǐ, yáshuā, kǎtōng wáwa děngděng.
text.english: Convenience store stickers can be exchanged for rulers, toothbrushes, cartoon dolls, and so on.

text.traditional: 為了身體健康，薯條、漢堡、餅乾等等，最好少吃。
text.simplified: 为了身体健康，薯条、汉堡、饼干等等，最好少吃。
text.pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, shǔtiáo, hànbǎo, bǐnggān děngděng, zuìhǎo shǎo chī.
text.english: For good health, it’s best to eat fewer french fries, hamburgers, cookies, and similar foods.

text.traditional: 去鄉下爺爺奶奶家的時候，我會幫他們種花、剪草等等。
text.simplified: 去乡下爷爷奶奶家的时候，我会帮他们种花、剪草等等。
text.pinyin: Qù xiāngxià yéye nǎinai jiā de shíhou, wǒ huì bāng tāmen zhòng huā, jiǎn cǎo děngděng.
text.english: When I go to my grandparents’ home in the countryside, I help them plant flowers, cut grass, and so on.

dialogue.title: 年年有「魚」
dialogue.setting: 在學校餐廳 · In the school canteen
grammarFocus: 想起來：想起來了／沒想起來／想得起來／想不起來

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （在學校餐廳）
lines.simplified: （在学校餐厅）
lines.pinyin: （Zài xuéxiào cāntīng）
lines.english: (In the school canteen.)

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 老師對報告的要求真多，所以我的期末報告修改了好幾次，還好最後都完成了，可以開心地放寒假了！
lines.simplified: 老师对报告的要求真多，所以我的期末报告修改了好几次，还好最后都完成了，可以开心地放寒假了！
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì bàogào de yāoqiú zhēn duō, suǒyǐ wǒ de qímò bàogào xiūgǎi le hǎo jǐ cì, hái hǎo zuìhòu dōu wánchéng le, kěyǐ kāixīn de fàng hánjià le!
lines.english: The teacher had many requirements for our reports, so I revised my final report many times. Fortunately, I’ve got everything done at last. I can happily enjoy the winter vacation!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 是啊！我一回去就要幫媽媽打掃，準備過年。
lines.simplified: 是啊！我一回去就要帮妈妈打扫，准备过年。
lines.pinyin: Shì a! Wǒ yì huíqù jiù yào bāng māma dǎsǎo, zhǔnbèi guònián.
lines.english: Right! As soon as I go back home, I will help my mom do the cleaning and prepare for the coming New Year.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 過年？我想起來了，是不是中國新年？
lines.simplified: 过年？我想起来了，是不是中国新年？
lines.pinyin: Guònián? Wǒ xiǎngqǐlái le, shì bú shì Zhōngguó xīnnián?
lines.english: New Year? I remember! Is it the Chinese New Year?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 對，就是中國新年，也叫春節。義大利人不過年嗎？
lines.simplified: 对，就是中国新年，也叫春节。意大利人不过年吗？
lines.pinyin: Duì, jiù shì Zhōngguó xīnnián, yě jiào Chūnjié. Yìdàlì rén bú guònián ma?
lines.english: Yes, it is exactly the Chinese New Year, also called the Spring Festival. Don’t the Italians celebrate the New Year?

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 我們過的是一月一號的新年。十二月三十一號跨年那天，熱鬧極了。
lines.simplified: 我们过的是一月一号的新年。十二月三十一号跨年那天，热闹极了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen guò de shì yī yuè yī hào de xīnnián. Shí’èr yuè sānshíyī hào kuànián nà tiān, rènào jí le.
lines.english: We celebrate it on January 1st. On December 31st, New Year’s Eve, it is extremely lively.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 原來是這樣。不過，你知道中國人是怎麼過年的嗎？
lines.simplified: 原来是这样。不过，你知道中国人是怎么过年的吗？
lines.pinyin: Yuánlái shì zhèyàng. Búguò, nǐ zhīdào Zhōngguó rén shì zěnme guònián de ma?
lines.english: Oh, I see. But do you know how Chinese people celebrate the New Year?

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 從來沒聽過……妳們給我介紹一下吧！
lines.simplified: 从来没听过……妳们给我介绍一下吧！
lines.pinyin: Cónglái méi tīng guo… Nǐmen gěi wǒ jièshào yíxià ba!
lines.english: I’ve never heard about it... Please give me a short introduction!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 春節的前一天是「除夕」，除夕前幾天，得把房子打掃乾淨……
lines.simplified: 春节的前一天是「除夕」，除夕前几天，得把房子打扫干净……
lines.pinyin: Chūnjié de qián yì tiān shì “chúxī”, chúxī qián jǐ tiān, děi bǎ fángzi dǎsǎo gānjìng…
lines.english: The day before the Spring Festival is Chinese New Year’s Eve. A few days before the Chinese New Year’s Eve, we need to clean up the house…

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: （美心接著說）除夕那天下午，我們回到爺爺、奶奶家以後，要先拜拜；等拜完了祖先，家人就聚在一起吃「年夜飯」。
lines.simplified: （美心接着说）除夕那天下午，我们回到爷爷、奶奶家以后，要先拜拜；等拜完了祖先，家人就聚在一起吃「年夜饭」。
lines.pinyin: （Měixīn jiēzhe shuō）Chúxī nà tiān xiàwǔ, wǒmen huí dào yéye, nǎinai jiā yǐhòu, yào xiān bàibài; děng bài wán le zǔxiān, jiārén jiù jù zài yìqǐ chī “niányèfàn”.
lines.english: (Continues to speak.) On the afternoon of Chinese New Year’s Eve, after we return to grandpa and grandma’s house, we worship together first. After worshiping the ancestors, the whole family gathers to eat “family reunion dinner” together.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 年夜飯跟平常吃的飯不一樣嗎？
lines.simplified: 年夜饭跟平常吃的饭不一样吗？
lines.pinyin: Niányèfàn gēn píngcháng chī de fàn bù yíyàng ma?
lines.english: Is the family reunion dinner different from usual food?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 年夜飯特別豐富喔！我媽媽會炸年糕、煮水餃、炒米粉，還會煎一條好吃的魚，可是不能吃完。
lines.simplified: 年夜饭特别丰富喔！我妈妈会炸年糕、煮水饺、炒米粉，还会煎一条好吃的鱼，可是不能吃完。
lines.pinyin: Niányèfàn tèbié fēngfù o! Wǒ māma huì zhá niángāo, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, chǎo mǐfěn, hái huì jiān yì tiáo hǎochī de yú, kěshì bù néng chī wán.
lines.english: The family reunion dinner is particularly abundant! My mom will make deep-fried glutinous rice cake, boiled dumplings, and fried rice noodles along with a delicious fried fish. However, we can’t eat up the whole fish.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 為什麼不能吃完？
lines.simplified: 为什么不能吃完？
lines.pinyin: Wèishénme bù néng chī wán?
lines.english: Why can’t you eat it up?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 因為要「年年有餘」，「餘」跟「魚」都唸 yú，有「剩下」的意思。如果年夜飯有剩下的魚，新的一年就會有很多食物。
lines.simplified: 因为要「年年有余」，「余」跟「鱼」都念 yú，有「剩下」的意思。如果年夜饭有剩下的鱼，新的一年就会有很多食物。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi yào “niánnián yǒuyú”, “yú” gēn “yú” dōu niàn yú, yǒu “shèngxià” de yìsi. Rúguǒ niányèfàn yǒu shèngxià de yú, xīn de yì nián jiù huì yǒu hěn duō shíwù.
lines.english: Because we hope to have a prosperous new year! Both “餘” and “魚” are both pronounced as yú. It means “surplus”. If there’s some fish left during the dinner, we’ll have plenty of food in the coming new year!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 除了魚，像年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕等等，也是過年會吃的食物。
lines.simplified: 除了鱼，像年糕、发糕、萝卜糕等等，也是过年会吃的食物。
lines.pinyin: Chúle yú, xiàng niángāo, fāgāo, luóbogāo děngděng, yě shì guònián huì chī de shíwù.
lines.english: Apart from fish, things like glutinous rice cakes, sponge cakes, radish cakes, and so on are also eaten during the Chinese New Year.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 這些東西也有特別的意思嗎？
lines.simplified: 这些东西也有特别的意思吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yě yǒu tèbié de yìsi ma?
lines.english: Do these things have special meanings, too?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 有啊！年糕代表「年年高升」、發糕是「發財」的意思；吃了蘿蔔糕就會很幸運喔！
lines.simplified: 有啊！年糕代表「年年高升」、发糕是「发财」的意思；吃了萝卜糕就会很幸运喔！
lines.pinyin: Yǒu a! Niángāo dàibiǎo “niánnián gāoshēng”, fāgāo shì “fācái” de yìsi; chī le luóbogāo jiù huì hěn xìngyùn o!
lines.english: They do! Glutinous rice cake represents getting promoted year by year, sponge cake means making a fortune, and you will be lucky when you eat the radish cake!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 還要準備「平平安安」的蘋果跟「大吉大利」的橘子。
lines.simplified: 还要准备「平平安安」的苹果跟「大吉大利」的橘子。
lines.pinyin: Hái yào zhǔnbèi “píngpíng ān’ān” de píngguǒ gēn “dàjídàlì” de júzi.
lines.english: Also, we still have apples symbolizing peace, and tangerines symbolizing great fortune and great favor.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 我了解了，真是又特別又豐富的大餐！
lines.simplified: 我了解了，真是又特别又丰富的大餐！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ liǎojiě le, zhēn shì yòu tèbié yòu fēngfù de dàcān!
lines.english: I get it. It is really a special and abundant meal!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 如果你跟我去爺爺奶奶家過年，今年的除夕就更加熱鬧了！
lines.simplified: 如果你跟我去爷爷奶奶家过年，今年的除夕就更加热闹了！
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ gēn wǒ qù yéye nǎinai jiā guònián, jīnnián de chúxī jiù gèngjiā rènào le!
lines.english: If you go to my grandparents’ house with me, this Chinese New Year’s Eve will be even more lively!

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （這個時候，以凡的手機響了，是媽媽寄給他的一封電子郵件，他看完以後很難過。）
lines.simplified: （这个时候，以凡的手机响了，是妈妈寄给他的一封电子邮件，他看完以后很难过。）
lines.pinyin: （Zhège shíhou, Yǐfán de shǒujī xiǎng le, shì māma jì gěi tā de yì fēng diànzǐ yóujiàn, tā kàn wán yǐhòu hěn nánguò）
lines.english: (At that moment Yifan’s cellphone rang. It was his mom sending him an email. He was very sad after reading it.)

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 我媽媽說，她訂不到機票，寒假不能來看我了。
lines.simplified: 我妈妈说，她订不到机票，寒假不能来看我了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ māma shuō, tā dìng bu dào jīpiào, hánjià bù néng lái kàn wǒ le.
lines.english: My mom said that she couldn’t book the ticket so that she couldn’t come to see me during winter vacation.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 沒關係，等過完年，我帶你去找我舅舅、舅媽，他們很親切，而且舅媽會做義大利麵，你可以吃吃看。
lines.simplified: 没关系，等过完年，我带你去找我舅舅、舅妈，他们很亲切，而且舅妈会做意大利面，你可以吃吃看。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi, děng guò wánnián, wǒ dài nǐ qù zhǎo wǒ jiùjiu, jiùmā, tāmen hěn qīnqiè, érqiě jiùmā huì zuò Yìdàlìmiàn, nǐ kěyǐ chīchi kàn.
lines.english: It’s ok. After the Chinese New Year, I’ll take you to visit my uncle and aunt. They are very kind to people. Besides, my aunt can make pasta. You can try it.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: （心裡感覺相當溫暖）好啊！太感謝妳了！
lines.simplified: （心里感觉相当温暖）好啊！太感谢妳了！
lines.pinyin: （Xīnlǐ gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn）Hǎo a! Tài gǎnxiè nǐ le!
lines.english: (Feels quite warm inside.) Alright! Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 對了！元宵節那天，我可以帶你去看燈會，有的燈籠上面還畫了十二生肖。
lines.simplified: 对了！元宵节那天，我可以带你去看灯会，有的灯笼上面还画了十二生肖。
lines.pinyin: Duì le! Yuánxiāojié nà tiān, wǒ kěyǐ dài nǐ qù kàn dēnghuì, yǒu de dēnglóng shàngmiàn hái huà le shí’èr shēngxiào.
lines.english: Oh! On Lantern Festival, I can take you to the lantern show. There are also zodiac paintings on some of the lanterns.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 十二生肖？
lines.simplified: 十二生肖？
lines.pinyin: Shí’èr shēngxiào?
lines.english: Zodiac?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 對啊！就是鼠、牛、虎、兔、龍、蛇、馬、羊、猴、雞、狗、豬。
lines.simplified: 对啊！就是鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪。
lines.pinyin: Duì a! Jiù shì shǔ, niú, hǔ, tù, lóng, shé, mǎ, yáng, hóu, jī, gǒu, zhū.
lines.english: Right! It is the mouse, the cow, the tiger, the rabbit, the dragon, the snake, the horse, the sheep, the monkey, the chicken, the dog, and the pig.

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 妳說了這麼多動物，怎麼沒有貓呢？
lines.simplified: 妳说了这么多动物，怎么没有猫呢？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō le zhème duō dòngwù, zěnme méiyǒu māo ne?
lines.english: You mentioned so many animals. Why are there no cats?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 有空我們再告訴你十二生肖的故事。你不知道我是屬虎的吧？
lines.simplified: 有空我们再告诉你十二生肖的故事。你不知道我是属虎的吧？
lines.pinyin: Yǒu kòng wǒmen zài gàosu nǐ shí’èr shēngxiào de gùshi. Nǐ bù zhīdào wǒ shì shǔ hǔ de ba?
lines.english: When we have time, we will tell you the story of the zodiac. You don’t know that I was born in the year of the tiger?

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 是嗎？難怪妳那麼愛生氣！
lines.simplified: 是吗？难怪妳那么爱生气！
lines.pinyin: Shì ma? Nánguài nǐ nàme ài shēngqì!
lines.english: Were you? No wonder you enjoy getting angry so much!

lines.speaker: 大家
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈……
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈……
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā…
lines.english: Hahaha...

items.title: Grammar 4–8 · Here Comes the “Nian”

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link a situation with the result that follows right away.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates when a situation occurs, another situation ensues right away. In this pattern, “當” is often followed by “……的時候”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates when a situation occurs, another situation ensues right away. In this pattern, “當” is often followed by “……的時候”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates when a situation occurs, another situation ensues right away. In this pattern, “當” is often followed by “……的時候”.
grammarPages.pattern: 當 + situation，（的時候）+ 就 + result

text.traditional: 當警察一出現，小偷就趕快跑了。
text.simplified: 当警察一出现，小偷就赶快跑了。
text.pinyin: Dāng jǐngchá yì chūxiàn, xiǎotōu jiù gǎnkuài pǎo le.
text.english: When the police appeared, the thief quickly ran away.

text.traditional: 當你覺得難過、生氣的時候，就應該去操場運動一下。
text.simplified: 当你觉得难过、生气的时候，就应该去操场运动一下。
text.pinyin: Dāng nǐ juéde nánguò, shēngqì de shíhou, jiù yīnggāi qù cāochǎng yùndòng yíxià.
text.english: When you feel sad or angry, you should go exercise on the sports field.

text.traditional: 當莫以凡第一天參加功夫社的時候，就愛上了中國功夫。
text.simplified: 当莫以凡第一天参加功夫社的时候，就爱上了中国功夫。
text.pinyin: Dāng Mò Yǐfán dì yī tiān cānjiā gōngfu shè de shíhou, jiù ài shàng le Zhōngguó gōngfu.
text.english: When Mo Yifan joined the kungfu club on his first day, he fell in love with Chinese kungfu.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the dialogues with 當……，就…….
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Answer each question with 當……，就…….

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 讓 as a passive marker or as a verb meaning cause, allow, or let.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 讓 + NP（+ 給）+ V了

text.traditional: 李先生剛買的照相機讓同事（給）弄壞了。
text.simplified: 李先生刚买的照相机让同事（给）弄坏了。
text.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng gāng mǎi de zhàoxiàngjī ràng tóngshì (gěi) nòng huài le.
text.english: The camera Mr. Li just bought was broken by a coworker.

text.traditional: 每次跟朋友去 KTV 唱歌，都讓他非常開心。
text.simplified: 每次跟朋友去 KTV 唱歌，都让他非常开心。
text.pinyin: Měicì gēn péngyou qù KTV chànggē, dōu ràng tā fēicháng kāixīn.
text.english: Every time he goes to KTV to sing with friends, it makes him very happy.

text.traditional: 我不舒服，老師讓我早一點兒回家休息。
text.simplified: 我不舒服，老师让我早一点儿回家休息。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bù shūfu, lǎoshī ràng wǒ zǎo yìdiǎnr huí jiā xiūxi.
text.english: I didn’t feel well, so the teacher let me go home early to rest.

text.traditional: 媽媽讓孩子把臥室打掃好了以後，才能玩遊戲。
text.simplified: 妈妈让孩子把卧室打扫好了以后，才能玩游戏。
text.pinyin: Māma ràng háizi bǎ wòshì dǎsǎo hǎo le yǐhòu, cái néng wán yóuxì.
text.english: Mom told the child to finish cleaning the bedroom before playing games.

text.traditional: 老闆讓我留下來把筆電修好，才讓我下班。這件事讓我很生氣。
text.simplified: 老板让我留下来把笔电修好，才让我下班。这件事让我很生气。
text.pinyin: Lǎobǎn ràng wǒ liú xiàlái bǎ bǐdiàn xiū hǎo, cái ràng wǒ xiàbān. Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ hěn shēngqì.
text.english: The boss made me stay and fix the laptop before letting me leave work. This made me very angry.

words.meaning: only then let me leave work

subsections.title: Used as Preposition
subsections.explanation: This pattern functions as the passive voice expression. The usage of “讓” here is similar to “被”; however, the Agent after “被” can be omitted while after “讓” cannot be.
subsections.pattern: S + 讓 + NP（+ 給）+ V了

subsections.title: Used as Verb
subsections.explanation:
(1) to make someone ..., to cause something to happen
(2) to allow, to permit someone to do something
(3) to let someone do something or to have someone do something: This usage of imperative “讓” is more polite and euphemistic.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that a choice or situation does not matter to someone.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern is often placed after the things the speaker feels indifferent to or does not care about. It can also be used independently.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern is often placed after the things the speaker feels indifferent to or does not care about. It can also be used independently.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is often placed after the things the speaker feels indifferent to or does not care about. It can also be used independently.
grammarPages.pattern: (Thing) + 無所謂

text.traditional: 父母覺得孩子胖或是瘦都無所謂，只要健康就好了。
text.simplified: 父母觉得孩子胖或是瘦都无所谓，只要健康就好了。
text.pinyin: Fùmǔ juéde háizi pàng huòshì shòu dōu wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào jiànkāng jiù hǎo le.
text.english: The parents don’t mind whether their child is fat or thin, as long as the child is healthy.

text.traditional: 太太：這個週末我們要去哪裡玩？先生：妳決定吧！我無所謂。
text.simplified: 太太：这个周末我们要去哪里玩？先生：妳决定吧！我无所谓。
text.pinyin: Tàitai: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen yào qù nǎlǐ wán? Xiānsheng: Nǐ juédìng ba! Wǒ wúsuǒwèi.
text.english: Wife: Where should we go this weekend? Husband: You decide! I don’t mind.

text.traditional: 老闆：歡迎你來我的餐廳打工，可是錢不多，你願意嗎？學生：錢多不多無所謂，只要能得到寶貴的經驗就好了。
text.simplified: 老板：欢迎你来我的餐厅打工，可是钱不多，你愿意吗？学生：钱多不多无所谓，只要能得到宝贵的经验就好了。
text.pinyin: Lǎobǎn: Huānyíng nǐ lái wǒ de cāntīng dǎgōng, kěshì qián bù duō, nǐ yuànyì ma? Xuésheng: Qián duō bu duō wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào néng dédào bǎoguì de jīngyàn jiù hǎo le.
text.english: Boss: Welcome to work at my restaurant, but the pay is low. Are you willing? Student: Whether the pay is high or low doesn’t matter, as long as I can gain valuable experience.

words.meaning: whether the pay is high or low
as long as I can gain

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete each response with 無所謂.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 走 after a verb to show that something leaves or disappears, or that an action can or cannot make it leave.
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, V can be action verbs, such as “搬（move）”, “拿（take）”, “帶（bring）”, “跑（run）”, “趕（drive）”, “嚇（scare）”, etc. “走” means “to go” or “to leave”. The “走” after the verb, used as post verb complement, means to leave or to disappear.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, V can be action verbs, such as “搬（move）”, “拿（take）”, “帶（bring）”, “跑（run）”, “趕（drive）”, “嚇（scare）”, etc. “走” means “to go” or “to leave”. The “走” after the verb, used as post verb complement, means to leave or to disappear.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, V can be action verbs, such as “搬（move）”, “拿（take）”, “帶（bring）”, “跑（run）”, “趕（drive）”, “嚇（scare）”, etc. “走” means “to go” or “to leave”. The “走” after the verb, used as post verb complement, means to leave or to disappear.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 走了／沒 + V + 走／V + 得走／V + 不走

text.traditional: 你們說話的聲音太大了，把孩子們都嚇走了。
text.simplified: 你们说话的声音太大了，把孩子们都吓走了。
text.pinyin: Nǐmen shuōhuà de shēngyīn tài dà le, bǎ háizimen dōu xià zǒu le.
text.english: Your voices were so loud that you scared the children away.

text.traditional: 良介已經不住在宿舍了，他上個學期末就搬走了。
text.simplified: 良介已经不住在宿舍了，他上个学期末就搬走了。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè yǐjīng bú zhù zài sùshè le, tā shàng ge xuéqī mò jiù bān zǒu le.
text.english: Ryosuke no longer lives in the dorm; he moved out at the end of last semester.

words.pinyin: yǐjīng bú zhù zài sùshè le
words.meaning: no longer lives in the dorm
at the end of last semester

text.traditional: 這些小說是她要送給同學的，所以回國的時候沒帶走。
text.simplified: 这些小说是她要送给同学的，所以回国的时候没带走。
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē xiǎoshuō shì tā yào sòng gěi tóngxué de, suǒyǐ huíguó de shíhou méi dài zǒu.
text.english: These novels are for her classmates, so she didn’t take them with her when she returned home.

words.pinyin: shì tā yào sòng gěi tóngxué de
words.meaning: are what she plans to give her classmates

text.traditional: 把錢存在銀行很安全，誰偷得走呢？
text.simplified: 把钱存在银行很安全，谁偷得走呢？
text.pinyin: Bǎ qián cún zài yínháng hěn ānquán, shéi tōu de zǒu ne?
text.english: It’s safe to keep money in the bank. Who could steal it?

text.traditional: 有一隻蟲子飛進我的房間裡，怎麼趕都趕不走。
text.simplified: 有一只虫子飞进我的房间里，怎么赶都赶不走。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yì zhī chóngzi fēi jìn wǒ de fángjiān lǐ, zěnme gǎn dōu gǎn bù zǒu.
text.english: A bug flew into my room, and no matter how I shoo it, I can’t get it to leave.

words.pinyin: fēi jìn wǒ de fángjiān lǐ

words.meaning: no matter how I shoo it

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Name an accomplished fact that prevented a different situation from happening.
grammarPages.explanation: “要不是” is followed by an accomplished fact. Without the fact, a following situation would occur. That is, the following situation did not really occur.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “要不是” is followed by an accomplished fact. Without the fact, a following situation would occur. That is, the following situation did not really occur.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “要不是” is followed by an accomplished fact. Without the fact, a following situation would occur. That is, the following situation did not really occur.
grammarPages.pattern: 要不是 + accomplished fact，result that would otherwise occur

text.traditional: 要不是春假去了阿里山，我就看不到那麼美麗的日出了。
text.simplified: 要不是春假去了阿里山，我就看不到那么美丽的日出了。
text.pinyin: Yàobúshì chūnjià qù le Ālǐshān, wǒ jiù kàn bú dào nàme měilì de rìchū le.
text.english: If I hadn’t gone to Alishan during spring break, I wouldn’t have seen such a beautiful sunrise.

words.meaning: went to Alishan during spring break

text.traditional: 要不是去同學家過年，莫以凡一個人在宿舍一定會很無聊的。
text.simplified: 要不是去同学家过年，莫以凡一个人在宿舍一定会很无聊的。
text.pinyin: Yàobúshì qù tóngxué jiā guònián, Mò Yǐfán yí ge rén zài sùshè yídìng huì hěn wúliáo de.
text.english: If he hadn’t gone to a classmate’s home for New Year, Mo Yifan would have been very bored alone in the dorm.

words.meaning: celebrating New Year at a classmate’s home

text.traditional: 要不是住過民宿，我就不知道有些民宿比飯店更舒服呢！
text.simplified: 要不是住过民宿，我就不知道有些民宿比饭店更舒服呢！
text.pinyin: Yàobúshì zhù guo mínsù, wǒ jiù bù zhīdào yǒuxiē mínsù bǐ fàndiàn gèng shūfu ne!
text.english: If I hadn’t stayed at a homestay, I wouldn’t know that some homestays are more comfortable than hotels!
