grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the dialogues with 要不是.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 從前，有一隻住在海裡的怪獸，名字叫「年」。從一月到十二月，「年」都在睡覺，什麼東西都不吃。到了除夕，當天一黑，「年」就會出來找東西吃。雞、鴨、人等動物，「年」都吃，讓大家非常害怕，不能好好地過日子，只好帶著一些食物，趕快跑到山上去。
lines.simplified: 从前，有一只住在海里的怪兽，名字叫「年」。从一月到十二月，「年」都在睡觉，什么东西都不吃。到了除夕，当天一黑，「年」就会出来找东西吃。鸡、鸭、人等动物，「年」都吃，让大家非常害怕，不能好好地过日子，只好带着一些食物，赶快跑到山上去。
lines.pinyin: Cóngqián, yǒu yì zhī zhù zài hǎilǐ de guàishòu, míngzi jiào “Nián”. Cóng yī yuè dào shí’èr yuè, “Nián” dōu zài shuìjiào, shénme dōngxi dōu bù chī. Dào le chúxī, dàngtiān yì hēi, “Nián” jiù huì chūlái zhǎo dōngxi chī. Jī, yā, rén děng dòngwù, “Nián” dōu chī, ràng dàjiā fēicháng hàipà, bù néng hǎohǎo de guò rìzi, zhǐhǎo dài zhe yìxiē shíwù, gǎnkuài pǎo dào shān shàng qù.
lines.english: Once upon a time, there was a monster living in the sea. It was called “Nian”. Nian slept all the time from January to December without eating anything. On the Chinese New Year’s Eve, as soon as the sky went dark, Nian went out to search for food. Nian ate animals, such as chickens, ducks, people, and so on. This made everyone very frightened and unable to live a normal life. They had no choice but to take some food and rush to the mountains.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 有一年除夕，一個老太太和她先生不願意離開家。他們家很窮，只有一點米，什麼食物都沒有。而且老太太覺得他們家只有兩口人，年紀都大了，讓怪獸給吃了也無所謂。
lines.simplified: 有一年除夕，一个老太太和她先生不愿意离开家。他们家很穷，只有一点米，什么食物都没有。而且老太太觉得他们家只有两口人，年纪都大了，让怪兽给吃了也无所谓。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì nián chúxī, yí ge lǎotàitai hé tā xiānsheng bú yuànyì líkāi jiā. Tāmen jiā hěn qióng, zhǐ yǒu yìdiǎn mǐ, shénme shíwù dōu méiyǒu. Érqiě lǎotàitai juéde tāmen jiā zhǐ yǒu liǎng kǒu rén, niánjì dōu dà le, ràng guàishòu gěi chī le yě wúsuǒwèi.
lines.english: On one Chinese New Year’s Eve, an old lady and her husband didn’t want to leave their home. They were very poor. They had no food except for a little rice. Furthermore, the old lady thought there were only two people in the family, and both were in old age, so they did not care if they were eaten.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 那天下午，老太太的家門口忽然出現了一個老人，他請老太太分一點東西給他吃。老太太覺得他很可憐，就煮了一點兒飯請他吃。老人一邊吃，一邊跟老太太說：「妳不用怕『年』，只要準備幾張紅紙、一些竹子，就可以把『年』趕走了。」
lines.simplified: 那天下午，老太太的家门口忽然出现了一个老人，他请老太太分一点东西给他吃。老太太觉得他很可怜，就煮了一点儿饭请他吃。老人一边吃，一边跟老太太说：「妳不用怕『年』，只要准备几张红纸、一些竹子，就可以把『年』赶走了。」
lines.pinyin: Nà tiān xiàwǔ, lǎotàitai de jiāménkǒu hūrán chūxiàn le yí ge lǎorén, tā qǐng lǎotàitai fēn yìdiǎn dōngxi gěi tā chī. Lǎotàitai juéde tā hěn kělián, jiù zhǔ le yìdiǎnr fàn qǐng tā chī. Lǎorén yìbiān chī, yìbiān gēn lǎotàitai shuō: “Nǐ búyòng pà ‘Nián’, zhǐyào zhǔnbèi jǐ zhāng hóngzhǐ, yìxiē zhúzi, jiù kěyǐ bǎ ‘Nián’ gǎn zǒu le.”
lines.english: That afternoon, an old man appeared suddenly in front of their house door. He asked the old lady to give him something to eat. The old lady thought he was very pitiful, so she cooked a little rice for him. While the old man was eating, he said: “You don’t need to be afraid of Nian. As long as you prepare a few sheets of red paper and some bamboo, you can drive it away.”

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 天剛黑，「年」就真的來了。「年」看見了門上的紅紙、地上燒竹子的火，又聽見燒竹子的時候大大的聲音，就嚇得跑走了。原來，「年」怕的就是：紅色、亮亮的東西和很大的聲音。
lines.simplified: 天刚黑，「年」就真的来了。「年」看见了门上红纸、地上烧竹子的火，又听见烧竹子的时候大大的声音，就吓得跑走了。原来，「年」怕的就是：红色、亮亮的东西和很大的声音。
lines.pinyin: Tiān gāng hēi, “Nián” jiù zhēn de lái le. “Nián” kànjiàn le mén shàng de hóngzhǐ, dì shàng shāo zhúzi de huǒ, yòu tīngjiàn shāo zhúzi de shíhou dàdà de shēngyīn, jiù xià de pǎo zǒu le. Yuánlái, “Nián” pà de jiù shì: hóngsè, liàngliàng de dōngxi hé hěn dà de shēngyīn.
lines.english: When the sky just got dark, Nian did come. As soon as Nian saw the red paper at the door, a fire that burned bamboo on the ground, and heard the loud sound made by the burning bamboo, it became so scared that it ran away. It turned out that Nian was afraid of red, bright things and loud sounds.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 第二天，大家從山上回來時，發現老太太和她先生沒被「年」吃了，都覺得很奇怪。老太太說，要不是老人告訴她把「年」嚇走的方法，他們就被吃了。
lines.simplified: 第二天，大家从山上回来时，发现老太太和她先生没被「年」吃了，都觉得很奇怪。老太太说，要不是老人告诉她把「年」吓走的方法，他们就被吃了。
lines.pinyin: Dì èr tiān, dàjiā cóng shān shàng huílái shí, fāxiàn lǎotàitai hé tā xiānsheng méi bèi “Nián” chī le, dōu juéde hěn qíguài. Lǎotàitai shuō, yào bú shì lǎorén gàosu tā bǎ “Nián” xià zǒu de fāngfǎ, tāmen jiù bèi chī le.
lines.english: The next day, everybody came back from the mountains and found it strange that the old lady and her husband were not eaten by Nian. The old lady said that if the old man hadn’t told her how to scare Nian away, they would have been eaten.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 從那個時候起，每年的除夕，大家都會在門口貼紅紙、燒竹子。這就是為什麼中國人在過年的時候，要貼春聯、放鞭炮了。
lines.simplified: 从那个时候起，每年的除夕，大家都会在门口贴红纸、烧竹子。这就是为什么中国人在过年的时候，要贴春联、放鞭炮了。
lines.pinyin: Cóng nà ge shíhou qǐ, měi nián de chúxī, dàjiā dōu huì zài ménkǒu tiē hóngzhǐ, shāo zhúzi. Zhè jiù shì wèishénme Zhōngguó rén zài guònián de shíhou, yào tiē chūnlián, fàng biānpào le.
lines.english: From then on, every Chinese New Year’s Eve, everyone pastes red paper on their door and burns bamboo. This is also the very reason why the Chinese paste spring couplets and set off firecrackers during the Chinese New Year.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know

dialogue.title: 對話 · 孔子不知道的事 · The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （學校附近的飲料店）
lines.simplified: （学校附近的饮料店）
lines.pinyin: xuéxiào fùjìn de yǐnliào diàn.
lines.english: (At a drink shop near the school.)

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 良介，你知道我們學校九月二十八號為什麼放假嗎？
lines.simplified: 良介，你知道我们学校九月二十八号为什么放假吗？
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè, nǐ zhīdào wǒmen xuéxiào jiǔ yuè èrshíbā hào wèishénme fàngjià ma?
lines.english: Ryosuke, do you know why we have a school holiday on September 28th?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我不知道。為什麼呢？
lines.simplified: 我不知道。为什么呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào. Wèishénme ne?
lines.english: No, I don't know. Why?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 因為那天是孔子的生日，也是台灣的「教師節」。
lines.simplified: 因为那天是孔子的生日，也是台湾的「教师节」。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi nà tiān shì Kǒngzǐ de shēngrì, yě shì Táiwān de “Jiàoshījié”.
lines.english: It is because that day is Confucius' birthday. It's also the Teachers' Day in Taiwan.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 我聽過孔子，可是知道的不多。
lines.simplified: 我听过孔子，可是知道的不多。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīng guo Kǒngzǐ, kěshì zhīdào de bù duō.
lines.english: I've heard about Confucius, but I don't know much about him.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 那我就給你們說一個孔子的故事吧。
lines.simplified: 那我就给你们说一个孔子的故事吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ jiù gěi nǐmen shuō yí ge Kǒngzǐ de gùshi ba.
lines.english: Then, I'll tell you a story about Confucius!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 太棒了！我雖然是日本人，但是對中國文化可有興趣了。快點兒說！
lines.simplified: 太棒了！我虽然是日本人，但是对中国文化可有兴趣了。快点儿说！
lines.pinyin: Tài bàng le! Wǒ suīrán shì Rìběn rén, dànshì duì Zhōngguó wénhuà kě yǒu xìngqù le. Kuài diǎnr shuō!
lines.english: Great! Although I'm Japanese, I'm quite interested in Chinese culture. Tell me quickly!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 有一天，孔子和學生子路到了一個美麗的地方，遇到了兩個小孩……
lines.simplified: 有一天，孔子和学生子路到了一个美丽的地方，遇到了两个小孩……
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān, Kǒngzǐ hé xuésheng Zǐlù dào le yí ge měilì de dìfang, yùdào le liǎng ge xiǎohái...
lines.english: One day, Confucius and his student Zilu went to a very beautiful place and met two children...

lines.speaker: 孔子
lines.traditional: 子路，把船停在那座橋旁邊，我們休息一下。
lines.simplified: 子路，把船停在那座桥旁边，我们休息一下。
lines.pinyin: Zǐlù, bǎ chuán tíng zài nà zuò qiáo pángbiān, wǒmen xiūxi yíxià.
lines.english: Zilu, moor the boat next to that bridge. Let's take a rest.

lines.speaker: 子路
lines.traditional: 是，老師。
lines.simplified: 是，老师。
lines.pinyin: Shì, lǎoshī.
lines.english: Yes, Teacher.

lines.speaker: 孔子
lines.traditional: 路邊的那棵大樹下有兩個小孩在吵架，不知道在吵什麼？
lines.simplified: 路边的那棵大树下有两个小孩在吵架，不知道在吵什么？
lines.pinyin: Lùbiān de nà kē dà shù xià yǒu liǎng ge xiǎohái zài chǎojià, bù zhīdào zài chǎo shénme?
lines.english: There are two children arguing under the big tree by the side of the road. I wonder what they are arguing about...

lines.speaker: 子路
lines.traditional: 他們兩個你看我一眼、我踢你一腳，你推我、我推你，看起來很激動，好像快打架了。
lines.simplified: 他们两个你看我一眼、我踢你一脚，你推我、我推你，看起来很激动，好像快打架了。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge nǐ kàn wǒ yì yǎn, wǒ tī nǐ yì jiǎo, nǐ tuī wǒ, wǒ tuī nǐ, kànqǐlái hěn jīdòng, hǎoxiàng kuài dǎjià le.
lines.english: They're giving glares and kicks and pushing each other around. They look very agitated and it seems like they're going to fight.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （孔子和子路走過去）
lines.simplified: （孔子和子路走过去）
lines.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ hé Zǐlù zǒu guòqù.
lines.english: (Confucius and Zilu go over.)

lines.speaker: 孔子
lines.traditional: （客氣地對兩個小孩）小朋友，你們在吵什麼啊？
lines.simplified: （客气地对两个小孩）小朋友，你们在吵什么啊？
lines.pinyin: (Kèqi de duì liǎng ge xiǎohái) Xiǎopéngyou, nǐmen zài chǎo shénme a?
lines.english: (Kindly to both of the children) Kids, what are you arguing about?

lines.speaker: 小孩A
lines.traditional: （指著太陽）我們在討論「太陽什麼時候離我們比較遠？什麼時候離我們比較近？」
lines.simplified: （指着太阳）我们在讨论「太阳什么时候离我们比较远？什么时候离我们比较近？」
lines.pinyin: (Zhǐ zhe tàiyáng) Wǒmen zài tǎolùn “tàiyáng shénme shíhou lí wǒmen bǐjiào yuǎn? Shénme shíhou lí wǒmen bǐjiào jìn?”
lines.english: (Pointing at the sun) We are discussing when the sun is farther from us, and when it is closer to us.

lines.speaker: 小孩B
lines.traditional: （有禮貌地）老先生，請您聽聽看，到底誰對誰錯。
lines.simplified: （有礼貌地）老先生，请您听听看，到底谁对谁错。
lines.pinyin: (Yǒu lǐmào de) Lǎo xiānsheng, qǐng nín tīngting kàn, dàodǐ shéi duì shéi cuò.
lines.english: (Politely) Sir, please listen and tell us who is right and who is wrong.

lines.speaker: 孔子
lines.traditional: 這個問題很有意思，你們都說說看。
lines.simplified: 这个问题很有意思，你们都说说看。
lines.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn yǒu yìsi, nǐmen dōu shuōshuo kàn.
lines.english: This question is very interesting. You both tell me!

lines.speaker: 小孩A
lines.traditional: 我認為早上太陽剛從東方出來的時候，離我們比較遠，因為溫度比較低、給人的感覺比較涼快；中午的時候比較近，因為感覺比較熱。
lines.simplified: 我认为早上太阳刚从东方出来的时候，离我们比较远，因为温度比较低、给人的感觉比较凉快；中午的时候比较近，因为感觉比较热。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi zǎoshang tàiyáng gāng cóng dōngfāng chūlái de shíhou, lí wǒmen bǐjiào yuǎn, yīnwèi wēndù bǐjiào dī, gěi rén de gǎnjué bǐjiào liángkuai; zhōngwǔ de shíhou bǐjiào jìn, yīnwèi gǎnjué bǐjiào rè.
lines.english: I think that the sun is farther from us when it just rises from the east in the morning. That is because the temperature is lower then and makes people feel cooler. At noon, the sun is closer because it is hotter.

lines.speaker: 小孩B
lines.traditional: 不對！不對！早上太陽剛出來的時候離我們比較近，因為太陽比較大；中午的時候比較遠，因為太陽比較小。
lines.simplified: 不对！不对！早上太阳刚出来的时候离我们比较近，因为太阳比较大；中午的时候比较远，因为太阳比较小。
lines.pinyin: Bú duì! Bú duì! Zǎoshang tàiyáng gāng chūlái de shíhou lí wǒmen bǐjiào jìn, yīnwèi tàiyáng bǐjiào dà; zhōngwǔ de shíhou bǐjiào yuǎn, yīnwèi tàiyáng bǐjiào xiǎo.
lines.english: Wrong! Wrong! It is closer to us when it just rises from the east in the morning, because it's bigger then. At noon it's farther because it's smaller.

lines.speaker: 子路
lines.traditional: 老師，他們說的都很有道理，那您的回答是什麼？
lines.simplified: 老师，他们说的都很有道理，那您的回答是什么？
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī, tāmen shuō de dōu hěn yǒu dàolǐ, nà nín de huídá shì shénme?
lines.english: Teacher, the words they both said are very reasonable. Well, what's your answer?

lines.speaker: 孔子
lines.traditional: 我也不知道，因為他們說的都對。
lines.simplified: 我也不知道，因为他们说的都对。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào, yīnwèi tāmen shuō de dōu duì.
lines.english: I don't know either because they are both right.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 這個故事真有意思，我一定要記下來。
lines.simplified: 这个故事真有意思，我一定要记下来。
lines.pinyin: Zhège gùshi zhēn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yídìng yào jì xiàlai.
lines.english: This story is very interesting. I must note it down.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 連孔子都有不知道的事，我們一般人不懂的就更多了。
lines.simplified: 连孔子都有不知道的事，我们一般人不懂的就更多了。
lines.pinyin: Lián Kǒngzǐ dōu yǒu bù zhīdào de shì, wǒmen yìbān rén bù dǒng de jiù gèng duō le.
lines.english: Even Confucius had something he didn't know, there are more things that we ordinary people don't know.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 是啊，知識是永遠學不完的。孔子常用這個例子來教育學生，要他們一直努力地學習，這也是他最大的希望。
lines.simplified: 是啊，知识是永远学不完的。孔子常用这个例子来教育学生，要他们一直努力地学习，这也是他最大的希望。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, zhīshi shì yǒngyuǎn xué bu wán de. Kǒngzǐ cháng yòng zhège lìzi lái jiàoyù xuésheng, yào tāmen yìzhí nǔlì de xuéxí, zhè yě shì tā zuì dà de xīwàng.
lines.english: Right. Knowledge is infinite and we can never ever learn all of it. Confucius often used this example to educate students to keep learning diligently. This was his biggest hope.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 聽完了孔子的故事，想不想看看孔廟啊？有空的時候，我們可以一起去走走。
lines.simplified: 听完了孔子的故事，想不想看看孔庙啊？有空的时候，我们可以一起去走走。
lines.pinyin: Tīng wán le Kǒngzǐ de gùshi, xiǎng bu xiǎng kànkan Kǒngmiào a? Yǒu kòng de shíhou, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù zǒuzou.
lines.english: After hearing Confucius' story, do you want to go to a Confucius Temple? We can walk around there together in our free time.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 現在有空啊！要不要馬上去？
lines.simplified: 现在有空啊！要不要马上去？
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài yǒu kòng a! Yào bu yào mǎshàng qù?
lines.english: We are free now! Let's go right now, shall we?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 沒問題，說走就走！
lines.simplified: 没问题，说走就走！
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, shuō zǒu jiù zǒu!
lines.english: No problem! Let's go as you say!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add emphasis to a verb or state verb, including warnings and reminders.
grammarPages.pattern: 可（+ Neg）+ V／可 + Vs
grammarPages.explanation: 「可」可加強後接動詞或狀態動詞的語氣，例如反駁、強調事實或表示預期結果終於發生；也可表示「一定要」或提醒別人。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “可” can be used to add emphasis to the following verbs or state verbs. This pattern is used in situations, such as denying another person’s opinion, emphasizing the fact or an expression showing the expected result finally happens. “可” also carries the meaning of “be sure to” and “remind someone to do something”, e.g., “可別忘了！” and “可要記得！”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “可” can be used to add emphasis to the following verbs or state verbs. This pattern is used in situations, such as denying another person’s opinion, emphasizing the fact or an expression showing the expected result finally happens. “可” also carries the meaning of “be sure to” and “remind someone to do something”, e.g., “可別忘了！” and “可要記得！”

text.traditional: A：對不起，我來晚了。B：你可來了，我等你等了半天了。
text.simplified: A：对不起，我来晚了。B：你可来了，我等你等了半天了。
text.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ lái wǎn le. B: Nǐ kě lái le, wǒ děng nǐ děng le bàntiān le.
text.english: A: Sorry I’m late. B: You finally came! I’ve been waiting for you for ages.

text.traditional: A：怎麼那麼多人喜歡看韓劇？真是太無聊了。B：韓劇在台灣可流行呢！大家都愛看！
text.simplified: A：怎么那么多人喜欢看韩剧？真是太无聊了。B：韩剧在台湾可流行呢！大家都爱看！
text.pinyin: A: Zěnme nàme duō rén xǐhuan kàn Hánjù? Zhēn shì tài wúliáo le. B: Hánjù zài Táiwān kě liúxíng ne! Dàjiā dōu ài kàn!
text.english: A: Why do so many people like Korean dramas? They’re so boring. B: Korean dramas are really popular in Taiwan! Everyone loves watching them!

text.traditional: 孩子：我明天就要出國留學了。父親：你可別忘了帶護照喔！要不然會上不了飛機的。
text.simplified: 孩子：我明天就要出国留学了。父亲：你可别忘了带护照喔！要不然会上不了飞机的。
text.pinyin: Háizi: Wǒ míngtiān jiù yào chūguó liúxué le. Fùqīn: Nǐ kě bié wàng le dài hùzhào o! Yàoburán huì shàng bù liǎo fēijī de.
text.english: Child: I’m leaving to study abroad tomorrow. Father: Be sure not to forget your passport! Otherwise, you won’t be able to board the plane.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Count an action with a measure word such as 拳, 眼, or 口.
grammarPages.pattern: V（+了）+ 一 + M
grammarPages.explanation: 動量詞表示動作的次數或單位，例如「拳」、「眼」、「口」、「次」和「遍」等。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The measure word in this pattern, referred to as MV, “Measure word for verbs”, is used to indicate the unit of times of actions, such as “眼”, “腳”, “拳(quán, fist)”, “口”, “次”, “遍”, etc.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The measure word in this pattern, referred to as MV, “Measure word for verbs”, is used to indicate the unit of times of actions, such as “眼”, “腳”, “拳(quán, fist)”, “口”, “次”, “遍”, etc.

text.traditional: 弟弟很生氣，所以打了哥哥一拳。
text.simplified: 弟弟很生气，所以打了哥哥一拳。
text.pinyin: Dìdi hěn shēngqì, suǒyǐ dǎ le gēge yì quán.
text.english: My younger brother was angry, so he punched his older brother once.

text.traditional: 他看了我一眼，什麼話都沒說，就出去了。
text.simplified: 他看了我一眼，什么话都没说，就出去了。
text.pinyin: Tā kàn le wǒ yì yǎn, shénme huà dōu méi shuō, jiù chūqù le.
text.english: He glanced at me, didn’t say a word, and went out.

text.traditional: 客人：老闆，這個橘子甜不甜？我怕酸。老闆：我賣的橘子都很甜。你可以吃一口，不酸再買。
text.simplified: 客人：老板，这个橘子甜不甜？我怕酸。老板：我卖的橘子都很甜。你可以吃一口，不酸再买。
text.pinyin: Kèrén: Lǎobǎn, zhège júzi tián bu tián? Wǒ pà suān. Lǎobǎn: Wǒ mài de júzi dōu hěn tián. Nǐ kěyǐ chī yì kǒu, bù suān zài mǎi.
text.english: Customer: Boss, is this orange sweet? I’m afraid it’ll be sour. Owner: The oranges I sell are all sweet. You can take a bite; if it isn’t sour, buy it.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 下來 for downward movement, recording or acquiring something, or stopping/staying.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 下來
grammarPages.explanation: 「下來」可表示動作朝下方移動、記錄／買下某物，或停止移動並留下。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
- To show the direction of a physical action, e.g., “跑下來” and “走下來”.
- To write down, take note or to buy something, e.g., “記下來”, “寫下來” and “買下來”.
- To stay or to stop the moving process, e.g., “住下來”, “留下來” and “停下來”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish:
- To show the direction of a physical action, e.g., “跑下來” and “走下來”.
- To write down, take note or to buy something, e.g., “記下來”, “寫下來” and “買下來”.
- To stay or to stop the moving process, e.g., “住下來”, “留下來” and “停下來”.

text.traditional: 前面有人，快點兒把車停下來！
text.simplified: 前面有人，快点儿把车停下来！
text.pinyin: Qiánmiàn yǒu rén, kuài diǎnr bǎ chē tíng xiàlái!
text.english: There’s someone ahead. Hurry and stop the car!

text.traditional: 妹妹從二樓跑下來，到便利商店去買東西。
text.simplified: 妹妹从二楼跑下来，到便利商店去买东西。
text.pinyin: Mèimei cóng èr lóu pǎo xiàlái, dào biànlì shāngdiàn qù mǎi dōngxi.
text.english: My younger sister ran down from the second floor and went to the convenience store to buy something.

text.traditional: 上課的時候，我把老師的話寫下來，回家才可以複習。
text.simplified: 上课的时候，我把老师的话写下来，回家才可以复习。
text.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, wǒ bǎ lǎoshī de huà xiě xiàlái, huí jiā cái kěyǐ fùxí.
text.english: During class, I write down what the teacher says so I can review it at home.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Without warning; at the drop of a hat
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe doing something readily, without much hesitation, or often.
grammarPages.pattern: 說 + V（+O）+ 就 + V（+O）
grammarPages.explanation: 這個句型表示做某事時不太猶豫或不多考慮，也可表示某種情況容易或常常發生。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
- This pattern is used to express doing something without much hesitation or consideration.
- Used to indicate a situation that occurs easily or frequently.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish:
- This pattern is used to express doing something without much hesitation or consideration.
- Used to indicate a situation that occurs easily or frequently.

text.traditional: 那個小男孩很愛哭，常常說哭就哭。
text.simplified: 那个小男孩很爱哭，常常说哭就哭。
text.pinyin: Nàge xiǎo nánhái hěn ài kū, chángcháng shuō kū jiù kū.
text.english: That little boy loves to cry; he often bursts into tears just like that.

words.meaning: cries at the drop of a hat

text.traditional: 他很容易生氣，常常說生氣就生氣。
text.simplified: 他很容易生气，常常说生气就生气。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn róngyì shēngqì, chángcháng shuō shēngqì jiù shēngqì.
text.english: He gets angry easily and often gets angry in an instant.

text.traditional: A：我今天太累了，明天再運動吧。B：健身要說做就做，我們現在就去運動吧！
text.simplified: A：我今天太累了，明天再运动吧。B：健身要说做就做，我们现在就去运动吧！
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ jīntiān tài lèi le, míngtiān zài yùndòng ba. B: Jiànshēn yào shuō zuò jiù zuò, wǒmen xiànzài jiù qù yùndòng ba!
text.english: A: I’m too tired today. Let’s exercise tomorrow. B: You have to just do it when it comes to fitness. Let’s go exercise now!

items.title: Grammar 5 · The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know

dialogue.title: 短文 · 中國最偉大的老師——孔子 · The Greatest Teacher of China — Confucius

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 有人說，不管是中國人或是外國人，想研究中國哲學，就必須先認識孔子，因為他是中國最偉大的教師。在台灣，九月二十八號「教師節」就是紀念他的節日。
lines.simplified: 有人说，不管是中国人或是外国人，想研究中国哲学，就必须先认识孔子，因为他是中国最伟大的教师。在台湾，九月二十八号「教师节」就是纪念他的节日。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, bùguǎn shì Zhōngguó rén huòshì wàiguó rén, xiǎng yánjiū Zhōngguó zhéxué, jiù bìxū xiān rènshi Kǒngzǐ, yīnwèi tā shì Zhōngguó zuì wěidà de jiàoshī. Zài Táiwān, jiǔ yuè èrshíbā hào “Jiàoshījié” jiù shì jìniàn tā de jiérì.
lines.english: Some people say that whether Chinese or foreigners, if they want to study Chinese philosophy, they must know Confucius first because he is the greatest teacher in China. In Taiwan, the Teacher's Day on September 28th is the holiday to commemorate him.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 孔子曾經和學生們去過很多國家，讓大家了解他的政治理想。雖然辛苦，可是這是他的選擇，因為他一輩子就是希望有君王能接受他的建議，用他的方法來管理國家。誰知道過了十三年，也等待了十三年，都沒有任何一位君王信他的話、明白他的想法。最後，孔子不得不回到自己的國家。那個時候，他已經六十八歲了。
lines.simplified: 孔子曾经和学生们去过很多国家，让大家了解他的政治理想。虽然辛苦，可是这是他的选择，因为他一辈子就是希望有君王能接受他的建议，用他的方法来管理国家。谁知道过了十三年，也等待了十三年，都没有任何一位君王信他的话，明白他的想法。最后，孔子不得不回到自己的国家。那个时候，他已经六十八岁了。
lines.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ céngjīng hé xuéshengmen qù guo hěn duō guójiā, ràng dàjiā liǎojiě tā de zhèngzhì lǐxiǎng. Suīrán xīnkǔ, kěshì zhè shì tā de xuǎnzé, yīnwèi tā yíbèizi jiù shì xīwàng yǒu jūnwáng néng jiēshòu tā de jiànyì, yòng tā de fāngfǎ lái guǎnlǐ guójiā. Shéi zhīdào guò le shísān nián, yě děngdài le shísān nián, dōu méiyǒu rènhé yí wèi jūnwáng xìn tā de huà, míngbai tā de xiǎngfǎ. Zuìhòu, Kǒngzǐ bùdébù huídào zìjǐ de guójiā. Nàge shíhou, tā yǐjīng liùshíbā suì le.
lines.english: Confucius had taken his students to many different countries, so that everyone could understand his political ideals. It was tough, but that was his choice, because throughout his life, he always hoped there would be a king who could take his advice and rule the country with his methods. Nobody had expected that after 13 years, and he had also been waiting for 13 years, none of the kings believed him and understood his thoughts. At last, Confucius had no choice but to return to his own country. At that time, he was already 68 years old.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 中國古代的思想很保守，有錢、有背景的人才可以去學校讀書，一般人是沒辦法的。可是對孔子來說，不管年紀大或是小、笨或是聰明、有錢或是沒有錢，只要想學習，他都願意教他們，讓大家都有念書和學習的機會。孔子也認為，必須先看學生的個性、表現和程度等等，再用不同的方法來教他們做人做事的道理。這樣，學生才能學得好、學得快。
lines.simplified: 中国古代的思想很保守，有钱、有背景的人才可以去学校读书，一般人是没办法的。可是对孔子来说，不管年纪大或是小、笨或是聪明、有钱或是没有钱，只要想学习，他都愿意教他们，让大家都有念书和学习的机会。孔子也认为，必须先看学生的个性、表现和程度等等，再用不同的方法来教他们做人做事的道理。这样，学生才能学得好、学得快。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu, yǒu qián, yǒu bèijǐng de rén cái kěyǐ qù xuéxiào dúshū, yìbān rén shì méi bànfǎ de. Kěshì duì Kǒngzǐ lái shuō, bùguǎn niánjì dà huòshì xiǎo, bèn huòshì cōngming, yǒu qián huòshì méiyǒu qián, zhǐyào xiǎng xuéxí, tā dōu yuànyì jiāo tāmen, ràng dàjiā dōu yǒu niànshū hé xuéxí de jīhuì. Kǒngzǐ yě rènwéi, bìxū xiān kàn xuésheng de gèxìng, biǎoxiàn hé chéngdù děngděng, zài yòng bùtóng de fāngfǎ lái jiāo tāmen zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ. Zhèyàng, xuésheng cái néng xué de hǎo, xué de kuài.
lines.english: The thoughts in ancient China were very conservative. The rich and people with a privileged background could go to school while ordinary people were not allowed to. But for Confucius, no matter how old or young, stupid or clever, rich or poor, as long as they want to learn, he is willing to teach them, so that everyone has the opportunity to study and learn. Confucius also believes that we have to first identify students' personalities, performances and levels, and so on, and then use different methods to teach them the truth of conducting oneself and doing things. In this way, students can learn well and learn quickly.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 孔子用他的教育方法成功地教育了不少學生，他的政治、哲學思想不但影響了中國歷史和文化，而且也影響了日本、韓國、越南等國家。所以從以前到現在，大家都認為孔子是中國最偉大的老師。
lines.simplified: 孔子用他的教育方法成功地教育了不少学生，他的政治、哲学思想不但影响了中国的历史和文化，而且也影响了日本、韩国、越南等国家。所以从以前到现在，大家都认为孔子是中国最伟大的老师。
lines.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ yòng tā de jiàoyù fāngfǎ chénggōng de jiàoyù le bù shǎo xuésheng, tā de zhèngzhì, zhéxué sīxiǎng búdàn yǐngxiǎng le Zhōngguó lìshǐ hé wénhuà, érqiě yě yǐngxiǎng le Rìběn, Hánguó, Yuènán děng guójiā. Suǒyǐ cóng yǐqián dào xiànzài, dàjiā dōu rènwéi Kǒngzǐ shì Zhōngguó zuì wěidà de lǎoshī.
lines.english: Confucius successfully educated many students with his educational methods. His political and philosophical thoughts not only affected the history and culture of China, but also affected countries such as Japan, South Korea, Vietnam, etc. So from the past to the present, everyone thinks that Confucius is the greatest teacher of China.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Who knows; who would have thought
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 誰知道 to react to an unexpected outcome, not to ask for information.
grammarPages.pattern: 誰知道 + unexpected outcome
grammarPages.explanation: 「誰知道」在此不是要對方回答的問句，而是表示事情出乎意料。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern is used as a rhetorical question that does not aim to elicit an answer. It indicates that something happens unexpectedly.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is used as a rhetorical question that does not aim to elicit an answer. It indicates that something happens unexpectedly.

text.traditional: A：你不是很早就出門了嗎？為什麼遲到了？B：我七點就出門了，誰知道路上車那麼多！
text.simplified: A：你不是很早就出门了吗？为什么迟到了？B：我七点就出门了，谁知道路上车那么多！
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ bú shì hěn zǎo jiù chūmén le ma? Wèishénme chídào le? B: Wǒ qī diǎn jiù chūmén le, shéi zhīdào lùshàng chē nàme duō!
text.english: A: Didn’t you leave early? Why were you late? B: I left at seven. Who knew there would be so much traffic!

text.traditional: A：聽說春節的高鐵票很難訂，你怎麼那麼順利就訂到了？B：我也以為很難訂，誰知道一下子就成功了。
text.simplified: A：听说春节的高铁票很难订，你怎么那么顺利就订到了？B：我也以为很难订，谁知道一下子就成功了。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Chūnjié de gāotiě piào hěn nán dìng, nǐ zěnme nàme shùnlì jiù dìng dào le? B: Wǒ yě yǐwéi hěn nán dìng, shéi zhīdào yíxiàzi jiù chénggōng le.
text.english: A: I heard it’s hard to book high-speed rail tickets for Lunar New Year. How did you book yours so easily? B: I thought it would be difficult too. Who knew I’d succeed right away?

text.traditional: A：你昨天在夜市怎麼花了一千多塊？太多了吧！B：我以為夜市的小吃都很便宜，誰知道有的很貴。
text.simplified: A：你昨天在夜市怎么花了一千多块？太多了吧！B：我以为夜市的小吃都很便宜，谁知道有的很贵。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zuótiān zài yèshì zěnme huā le yì qiān duō kuài? Tài duō le ba! B: Wǒ yǐwéi yèshì de xiǎochī dōu hěn piányi, shéi zhīdào yǒude hěn guì.
text.english: A: How did you spend over a thousand dollars at the night market yesterday? That’s too much! B: I thought the snacks at the night market were all cheap. Who knew some would be expensive?

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Friends from All Over the World

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize a high degree, often to disagree with someone’s opinion.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs + 得 + 很
grammarPages.explanation: “得很” expresses a high degree. It is more common in conversations to show the speaker’s emphasis on a certain situation. This pattern is very close to “Vs 死了” and “Vs 得不得了” in meaning, but it is often used to show disapproval of someone’s opinion.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “得很” expresses a high degree. It is more common in conversations to show the speaker’s emphasis on a certain situation. This pattern is very close to “Vs 死了” and “Vs 得不得了” in meaning, but it is often used to show disapproval of someone’s opinion.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “得很” expresses a high degree. It is more common in conversations to show the speaker’s emphasis on a certain situation. This pattern is very close to “Vs 死了” and “Vs 得不得了” in meaning, but it is often used to show disapproval of someone’s opinion.

text.traditional: 他的個性活潑得很，為什麼你覺得他很保守呢？
text.simplified: 他的个性活泼得很，为什么你觉得他很保守呢？
text.pinyin: Tā de gè xìng huópō dehěn, wèishénme nǐ jué de tā hěn bǎoshǒu ne?
text.english: His personality is very lively. Why do you think he is conservative?

text.traditional: 外國人：臭豆腐太臭了，我一口也不敢吃。台灣人：臭豆腐一點兒都不臭，好吃得很呢！
text.simplified: 外国人：臭豆腐太臭了，我一口也不敢吃。台湾人：臭豆腐一点儿都不臭，好吃得很呢！
text.pinyin: Wàiguórén: Chòudòufu tài chòu le, wǒ yìkǒu yě bù gǎn chī. Táiwānrén: Chòudòufu yì diǎnr dōu bú chòu, hǎochī dehěn ne!
text.english: Foreigner: Stinky tofu smells so bad; I wouldn’t dare eat even one bite. Taiwanese: Stinky tofu doesn’t smell at all; it’s very tasty!

text.traditional: A：你等一下就要去見新老闆了，怎麼看起來無所謂的樣子。B：我緊張得很，你看不出來嗎？
text.simplified: A：你等一下就要去见新老板了，怎么看起来无所谓的样子。B：我紧张得很，你看不出来吗？
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ děng yíxià jiù yào qù jiàn xīn lǎobǎn le, zěnme kàn qǐ lái wúsuǒwèi de yàngzi. B: Wǒ jǐnzhāng dehěn, nǐ kàn bu chū lái ma?
text.english: A: You’re about to meet the new boss. Why do you look so unconcerned? B: I’m very nervous. Can’t you tell?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say a decision depends on the condition after 看.
grammarPages.pattern: 得看／要看 + condition
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates what someone will do depends on the situation after “看”. “看” is often followed by phrases or nouns, including (1) question word, (2) A not A, (3) two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates what someone will do depends on the situation after “看”. “看” is often followed by phrases or nouns, including (1) question word, (2) A not A, (3) two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates what someone will do depends on the situation after “看”. “看” is often followed by phrases or nouns, including (1) question word, (2) A not A, (3) two opposite monosyllabic words.

text.traditional: A：你這個週末要加班嗎？B：不知道，得看老闆的決定。
text.simplified: A：你这个周末要加班吗？B：不知道，得看老板的决定。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhè ge zhōumò yào jiābān ma? B: Bù zhīdào, děi kàn lǎobǎn de juédìng.
text.english: A: Do you have to work overtime this weekend? B: I don’t know. It depends on the boss’s decision.

text.traditional: A：你什麼冰淇淋都喜歡嗎？B：不一定，要看是哪一種口味的。
text.simplified: A：你什么冰淇淋都喜欢吗？B：不一定，要看是哪一种口味的。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme bīngqílín dōu xǐhuan ma? B: Bù yí dìng, yào kàn shì nǎ yìzhǒng kǒuwèi de.
text.english: A: Do you like every kind of ice cream? B: Not necessarily. It depends on which flavor it is.

words.meaning: to like; to be fond of
one kind of; one type of

text.traditional: A：我暑假想到國外去旅行，你建議去哪裡？B：得看機票價格的高低，便宜的話就去歐洲。
text.simplified: A：我暑假想到国外去旅行，你建议去哪里？B：得看机票价格的高低，便宜的话就去欧洲。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ shǔjià xiǎngdào guówài qù lǚxíng, nǐ jiànyì qù nǎlǐ? B: Děi kàn jīpiào jiàgé de gāodī, piányi de huà jiù qù Ōuzhōu.
text.english: A: I’m thinking of traveling abroad this summer. Where do you recommend? B: It depends on how much the airfare costs; if it’s cheap, go to Europe.

words.meaning: to think of, to come into one's head

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give examples while signaling that the list continues.
grammarPages.pattern: 像 + 2–3 examples + 什麼的
grammarPages.explanation: When the speaker gives examples for further explanation, the “像……什麼的” pattern is often used. “什麼的” implies that there is a long list of examples, but the speaker often gives only 2-3 items due to limited space or time.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When the speaker gives examples for further explanation, the “像……什麼的” pattern is often used. “什麼的” implies that there is a long list of examples, but the speaker often gives only 2-3 items due to limited space or time.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When the speaker gives examples for further explanation, the “像……什麼的” pattern is often used. “什麼的” implies that there is a long list of examples, but the speaker often gives only 2-3 items due to limited space or time.

text.traditional: 他會很多種樂器，像鋼琴、吉他、笛子什麼的。
text.simplified: 他会很多种乐器，像钢琴、吉他、笛子什么的。
text.pinyin: Tā huì hěn duōzhǒng yuèqì, xiàng gāngqín, jítā, dízi shén me de.
text.english: He can play many instruments, such as piano, guitar, flute, and so on.

words.meaning: many kinds of; multiple; diverse; multi-

text.traditional: 媽媽準備了很豐富的年夜飯，像蘿蔔糕、水餃、烤鴨什麼的。
text.simplified: 妈妈准备了很丰富的年夜饭，像萝卜糕、水饺、烤鸭什么的。
text.pinyin: Māma zhǔnbèi le hěn fēngfù de niányèfàn, xiàng luóbogāo, shuǐjiǎo, kǎoyā shén me de.
text.english: Mom prepared a very plentiful New Year’s Eve dinner, with things like turnip cake, dumplings, roast duck, and so on.

text.traditional: 台灣的食物，像雞排、水煎包、滷肉飯什麼的，都是很受歡迎的小吃。
text.simplified: 台湾的食物，像鸡排、水煎包、卤肉饭什么的，都是很受欢迎的小吃。
text.pinyin: Táiwān de shíwù, xiàng jīpái, shuǐjiānbāo, lǔ ròu fàn shén me de, dōu shì hěn shòuhuānyíng de xiǎochī.
text.english: Taiwanese foods such as fried chicken cutlets, pan-fried buns, braised pork rice, and so on are all popular snacks.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action repeated frequently over a short time.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 來 + V + 去
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “來” and “去” are directional verbs, indicating an action is being repeated with high frequency in a short period of time. It can be used when someone is waiting or walking around. The two verbs here are often the same.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “來” and “去” are directional verbs, indicating an action is being repeated with high frequency in a short period of time. It can be used when someone is waiting or walking around. The two verbs here are often the same.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “來” and “去” are directional verbs, indicating an action is being repeated with high frequency in a short period of time. It can be used when someone is waiting or walking around. The two verbs here are often the same.

text.traditional: 他在門口走來走去，好像在等人。
text.simplified: 他在门口走来走去，好像在等人。
text.pinyin: Tā zài ménkǒu zǒu lái zǒu qù, hǎoxiàng zài děng rén.
text.english: He is pacing at the doorway as if he were waiting for someone.

text.traditional: 那三隻小狗跑來跑去，玩得很開心。
text.simplified: 那三只小狗跑来跑去，玩得很开心。
text.pinyin: Nà sān zhī xiǎogǒu pǎoláipǎoqù, wán dehěn kāixīn.
text.english: Those three puppies run around and play happily.

text.traditional: 我看來看去，最後決定買那個台灣牌子的手機。
text.simplified: 我看来看去，最后决定买那个台湾牌子的手机。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, zuìhòu juédìng mǎi nà ge Táiwān páizi de shǒujī.
text.english: I looked around and finally decided to buy that Taiwanese-brand cellphone.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 世界各國的朋友 · Friends from All Over the World

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （良介和可欣在宿舍門口，聊天）
lines.simplified: （良介和可欣在宿舍门口，聊天）
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè hé Kěxīn zài sùshè ménkǒu, liáotiān.
lines.english: (In front of the dormitory, Ryosuke and Kexin are chatting.)

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 下個星期二中午，華語文中心要舉辦世界文化日，我想請妳跟美心來參加。
lines.simplified: 下个星期二中午，华语文中心要举办世界文化日，我想请妳跟美心来参加。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqī'èr zhōngwǔ, Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn yào jǔbàn Shìjiè Wénhuàrì, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ gēn Měixīn lái cānjiā.
lines.english: Next Tuesday noon, the Center of Chinese Language and Culture is going to hold the World Culture Appreciation Day. I would like to invite you and Meixin to participate.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 好玩嗎？活動的內容是什麼？
lines.simplified: 好玩吗？活动的内容是什么？
lines.pinyin: Hǎowán ma? Huódòng de nèiróng shì shénme?
lines.english: Is it fun? What's the content of the event?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 外國學生要擺攤子或表演唱歌跳舞，向大家介紹自己民族文化的特色。
lines.simplified: 外国学生要摆摊子或表演唱歌跳舞，向大家介绍自己民族文化的特色。
lines.pinyin: Wàiguó xuésheng yào bǎi tānzi huò biǎoyǎn chànggē tiàowǔ, xiàng dàjiā jièshào zìjǐ mínzú wénhuà de tèsè.
lines.english: Foreign students will set up stalls or have dancing and singing performances to introduce the features of their own national cultures.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 聽起來很有意思，你有上次的照片嗎？
lines.simplified: 听起来很有意思，你有上次的照片吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn yǒu yìsi, nǐ yǒu shàng cì de zhàopiàn ma?
lines.english: Sounds interesting. Do you have any photo from last time?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 有啊！妳看，這張照片就是去年日本學生的攤子。他們穿著日本的傳統服裝，向大家介紹日本的食物跟玩具。
lines.simplified: 有啊！妳看，这张照片就是去年日本学生的摊子。他们穿着日本的传统服装，向大家介绍日本的食物跟玩具。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu a! Nǐ kàn, zhè zhāng zhàopiàn jiù shì qùnián Rìběn xuésheng de tānzi. Tāmen chuān zhe Rìběn de chuántǒng fúzhuāng, xiàng dàjiā jièshào Rìběn de shíwù gēn wánjù.
lines.english: I do! Look! This photo shows the stall of Japanese students last year. They were introducing Japanese food and toys in traditional Japanese clothes to everybody.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （美心跟以凡走過來）
lines.simplified: （美心跟以凡走过来）
lines.pinyin: Měixīn gēn Yǐfán zǒu guòlái.
lines.english: (Meixin and Yifan come over.)

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 你們在看什麼啊？（仔細地看著照片）這個東西看起來怪怪的，是吃的嗎？
lines.simplified: 你们在看什么啊？（仔细地看着照片）这个东西看起来怪怪的，是吃的吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zài kàn shénme a? (Zǐxì de kàn zhe zhàopiàn) Zhège dōngxi kànqǐlái guàiguài de, shì chī de ma?
lines.english: What are you looking at? (Looks carefully at the photo.) This stuff looks strange. Is it food?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 這是日本的納豆。我第一次去日本的時候，飯店的早餐有納豆，可是我嚐了一口就不敢吃了。
lines.simplified: 这是日本的纳豆。我第一次去日本的时候，饭店的早餐有纳豆，可是我尝了一口就不敢吃了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì Rìběn de Nàdòu. Wǒ dì yī cì qù Rìběn de shíhou, fàndiàn de zǎocān yǒu Nàdòu, kěshì wǒ cháng le yì kǒu jiù bù gǎn chī le.
lines.english: This is Japanese Natto. When I went traveling in Japan for the first time, the hotel breakfast had Natto. I had a taste and dared not eat more.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 納豆雖然聞起來有一點兒臭，不過對身體很好。
lines.simplified: 纳豆虽然闻起来有一点儿臭，不过对身体很好。
lines.pinyin: Nàdòu suīrán wénqǐlái yǒu yìdiǎnr chòu, búguò duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
lines.english: Although Natto is a bit smelly, it's very good for your body.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 可是上次去夜市的時候，你說臭豆腐臭得很，連一口也不吃！
lines.simplified: 可是上次去夜市的时候，你说臭豆腐臭得很，连一口也不吃！
lines.pinyin: Kěshì shàng cì qù yèshì de shíhou, nǐ shuō chòudòufu chòu de hěn, lián yì kǒu yě bù chī!
lines.english: But last time when we went to the night market, you said stinky tofu is very smelly, and you didn't even take one bite!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 其實食物好不好吃，得看個人的口味。我很喜歡納豆，可是臭豆腐真的太……
lines.simplified: 其实食物好不好吃，得看个人的口味。我很喜欢纳豆，可是臭豆腐真的太……
lines.pinyin: Qíshí shíwù hǎo bu hǎochī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan Nàdòu, kěshì chòudòufu zhēn de tài...
lines.english: In fact, whether a kind of food is yummy or not depends on personal tastes. I like Natto very much, but stinky tofu is just too...

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 好好好，你們別吵了。良介，文化日那天，有好看的表演嗎？
lines.simplified: 好好好，你们别吵了。良介，文化日那天，有好看的表演吗？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, nǐmen bié chǎo le. Liángjiè, Wénhuàrì nà tiān, yǒu hǎokàn de biǎoyǎn ma?
lines.english: Alright, alright! Don't argue. Ryosuke, is there going to be any good performance on the World Culture Appreciation Day?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 有啊！像唱歌、跳舞什麼的，我們日本同學要一邊吹笛子，一邊跳舞。
lines.simplified: 有啊！像唱歌、跳舞什么的，我们日本同学要一边吹笛子，一边跳舞。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu a! Xiàng chànggē, tiàowǔ shénme de, wǒmen Rìběn tóngxué yào yìbiān chuī dízi, yìbiān tiàowǔ.
lines.english: Yes! Like singing, dancing, and so on. Our Japanese classmates are going to play the flute while dancing.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 你們好厲害喔！我昨天經過華語文中心的時候，看到很多外國學生走來走去，說著不同的語言，其中有一個學生用中文跟我說「妳好」，真有意思！
lines.simplified: 你们好厉害喔！我昨天经过华语文中心的时候，看到很多外国学生走来走去，说着不同的语言，其中有一个学生用中文跟我说「妳好」，真有意思！
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo lìhai o! Wǒ zuótiān jīngguò Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn de shíhou, kàndào hěn duō wàiguó xuésheng zǒu lái zǒu qù, shuō zhe bùtóng de yǔyán, qízhōng yǒu yí ge xuésheng yòng Zhōngwén gēn wǒ shuō “Nǐ hǎo”, zhēn yǒu yìsi!
lines.english: You are so amazing! Yesterday, when I passed by the Center of Chinese Language and Culture, I saw many foreign students walking around and speaking different languages. One of the students said "Hello" to me in Chinese. Very interesting!

lines.speaker: 以凡
lines.traditional: 我下個月也要在華語文中心學中文，希望能把中文學得更好，這樣才能更加了解中華文化。
lines.simplified: 我下个月也要在华语文中心学中文，希望能把中文学得更好，这样才能更加了解中华文化。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yě yào zài Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn xué Zhōngwén, xīwàng néng bǎ Zhōngwén xué de gèng hǎo, zhèyàng cái néng gèngjiā liǎojiě Zhōnghuá wénhuà.
lines.english: I will also study Chinese at the Center of Chinese Language and Culture next month, hoping to improve my Chinese and in this way, I can understand more about Chinese culture.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 太好了！歡迎你來。每個國家都有特別的風俗習慣，我的同學有亞洲人、歐洲人、非洲人，大家互相交流、學習，就像是一個熱鬧的大家庭。
lines.simplified: 太好了！欢迎你来。每个国家都有特别的风俗习惯，我的同学有亚洲人、欧洲人、非洲人，大家互相交流、学习，就像是一个热闹的大家庭。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Huānyíng nǐ lái. Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu tèbié de fēngsú xíguàn, wǒ de tóngxué yǒu Yàzhōu rén, Ōuzhōu rén, Fēizhōu rén, dàjiā hùxiāng jiāoliú, xuéxí, jiù xiàng shì yí ge rènào de dà jiātíng.
lines.english: Every country has its own special customs. I have Asian, European and African classmates. We share and learn with each other, just like a big and lively family.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 說了半天，你還沒告訴我們文化日的地點呢！
lines.simplified: 说了半天，你还没告诉我们文化日的地点呢！
lines.pinyin: Shuō le bàntiān, nǐ hái méi gàosu wǒmen Wénhuàrì de dìdiǎn ne!
lines.english: We've been talking for a long time, but you still haven't told us the venue of the World Culture Appreciation Day!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 在學校的大禮堂，就是上次鋼琴社表演的會場。想參加的話，要快點兒去辦公室報名喔！
lines.simplified: 在学校的大礼堂，就是上次钢琴社表演的会场。想参加的话，要快点儿去办公室报名喔！
lines.pinyin: Zài xuéxiào de dà lǐtáng, jiù shì shàng cì gāngqín shè biǎoyǎn de huìchǎng. Xiǎng cānjiā de huà, yào kuài diǎnr qù bàngōngshì bàomíng o!
lines.english: It's in the auditorium of the school – the place where the piano club performed last time. If you want to participate, hurry up and go to the office to register!

items.title: Grammar 5–6 · Friends from All Over the World

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether one thing can match or surpass another.
grammarPages.pattern: A + 比得上／比不上 + B
grammarPages.explanation: When drawing a comparison between A and B, if we say “A 比得上 B”, it means that A can compare with B or even surpass B.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When drawing a comparison between A and B, if we say “A 比得上 B”, it means that A can compare with B or even surpass B.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When drawing a comparison between A and B, if we say “A 比得上 B”, it means that A can compare with B or even surpass B.

text.traditional: 藍小姐覺得自己的家最溫暖，哪裡都比不上。
text.simplified: 蓝小姐觉得自己的家最温暖，哪里都比不上。
text.pinyin: Lán xiǎojiě jué de zìjǐ de jiā zuì wēnnuǎn, nǎlǐ dōu bǐ bu shàng.
text.english: Ms. Lan thinks her own home is the warmest; nowhere else compares.

text.traditional: 我覺得荷蘭鬆餅好吃極了，只有我奶奶做的甜點比得上。
text.simplified: 我觉得荷兰松饼好吃极了，只有我奶奶做的甜点比得上。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jué de Hélán sōngbǐng hǎochī jí le, zhǐyǒu wǒ nǎinai zuò de tiándiǎn bǐ de shàng.
text.english: I think Dutch pancakes are delicious; only the desserts my grandmother makes can compare.

text.traditional: 許多台灣人覺得滷肉飯最好吃，其他小吃都比不上。
text.simplified: 许多台湾人觉得卤肉饭最好吃，其他小吃都比不上。
text.pinyin: Xǔduō Táiwānrén jué de lǔ ròu fàn zuì hǎochī, qítā xiǎochī dōu bǐ bu shàng.
text.english: Many Taiwanese people think braised pork rice is the best; no other snack compares.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Show that a result is possible only when its condition is met.
grammarPages.pattern: 只有 + necessary condition，才 + result
grammarPages.explanation: “只有” is followed by the necessary condition. This pattern emphasizes that only by fulfilling the condition can the result after “才” be achieved.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “只有” is followed by the necessary condition. This pattern emphasizes that only by fulfilling the condition can the result after “才” be achieved.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “只有” is followed by the necessary condition. This pattern emphasizes that only by fulfilling the condition can the result after “才” be achieved.

text.traditional: 在便利商店買東西，只有滿七十九元，才能得到一張貼紙。
text.simplified: 在便利商店买东西，只有满七十九元，才能得到一张贴纸。
text.pinyin: Zài biànlìshāngdiàn mǎi dōng xi, zhǐyǒu mǎn qī shí jiǔ yuán, cáinéng dé dào yì zhāng tiēzhǐ.
text.english: At a convenience store, you can get a sticker only when you spend at least 79 dollars.

words.meaning: to reach a certain amount, to be full

text.traditional: 只有報名的學生，才可以參加這個文化日的活動。
text.simplified: 只有报名的学生，才可以参加这个文化日的活动。
text.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu bàomíng de xuésheng, cái kěyǐ cānjiā zhè ge wén huà rì de huódòng.
text.english: Only students who registered can take part in this Culture Day event.

text.traditional: 外國人：聽說孔子的知識很豐富，他的哲學思想大家都懂嗎？中國人：我想只有認真研究過他的思想，才能了解那些道理吧。
text.simplified: 外国人：听说孔子的知识很丰富，他的哲学思想大家都懂吗？中国人：我想只有认真研究过他的思想，才能了解那些道理吧。
text.pinyin: Wàiguórén: Tīngshuō Kǒngzǐ de zhīshi hěn fēngfù, tā de zhéxué sīxiǎng dàjiā dōu dǒng ma? Zhōngguórén: Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyǒu rènzhēn yánjiū guo tā de sīxiǎng, cáinéng liǎo jiě nàxiē dàolǐ ba.
text.english: Foreigner: I heard Confucius was very knowledgeable. Does everyone understand his philosophical ideas? Chinese person: I think only by seriously studying his ideas can people understand those principles.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 熱鬧的世界文化日！ · The Lively World Culture Appreciation Day!

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 華語文中心要舉辦世界文化日，邀請所有的老師、學生來參加。各國學生要照中心的安排，表演有特色的節目。學校也會準備一些簡單的食物，像三明治、水餃等等，歡迎大家來看表演、吃小吃。
lines.simplified: 华语文中心要举办世界文化日，邀请所有的老师、学生来参加。各国学生要照中心的安排，表演有特色的节目。学校也会准备一些简单的食物，像三明治、水饺等等，欢迎大家来看表演、吃小吃。
lines.pinyin: Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn yào jǔbàn Shìjiè Wénhuàrì, yāoqǐng suǒyǒu de lǎoshī, xuésheng lái cānjiā. Gè guó xuésheng yào zhào Zhōngxīn de ānpái, biǎoyǎn yǒu tèsè de jiémù. Xuéxiào yě huì zhǔnbèi yìxiē jiǎndān de shíwù, xiàng sānmíngzhì, shuǐjiǎo děngděng, huānyíng dàjiā lái kàn biǎoyǎn, chī xiǎochī.
lines.english: The Center of Chinese Language and Culture held the World Culture Appreciation Day and all teachers and students were invited to participate. Students from various countries had to give special performances according to the arrangement of the Center. The Center also provided some simple food, such as sandwiches, dumplings, and so on. Everybody was welcome to watch the performances and have some snacks.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介要用跳舞的方式，表演日本東北的傳統歌曲；荷蘭同學要介紹鬆餅和啤酒的做法；越南同學想做影片來介紹他們的文化。一開始，良介很擔心跳不好，常常留在學校練習，後來就越跳越好了。
lines.simplified: 良介要用跳舞的方式，表演日本东北的传统歌曲；荷兰同学要介绍松饼和啤酒的做法；越南同学想做影片来介绍他们的文化。一开始，良介很担心跳不好，常常留在学校练习，后来就越跳越好了。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè yào yòng tiàowǔ de fāngshì, biǎoyǎn Rìběn Dōngběi de chuántǒng gēqǔ; Hélán tóngxué yào jièshào sōngbǐng hé píjiǔ de zuòfǎ; Yuènán tóngxué xiǎng zuò yǐngpiàn lái jièshào tāmen de wénhuà. Yì kāishǐ, Liángjiè hěn dānxīn tiào bu hǎo, chángcháng liú zài xuéxiào liànxí, hòulái jiù yuè tiào yuè hǎo le.
lines.english: Ryosuke was planning to perform traditional songs from northeastern Japan by dancing. Classmates from the Netherlands would introduce how to make Dutch baby pancake and beer. The Vietnamese classmates wanted to produce a video introducing their culture. In the beginning, Ryosuke worried that he could not dance well, so he often stayed in school to practice. Afterwards, he danced better and better.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 文化日當天，華語文中心熱鬧極了，許多人都來看表演，連校長也親自來參加，他站在學生當中，跟大家開心地照相。良介跳舞跳得好極了，大家都拍手叫好呢！表演結束後，良介去參觀各國的攤子，不但喝了葡萄酒、吃了披薩，還穿上韓國的傳統服裝照相。良介也趁這個機會認識了五大洲的朋友，他覺得中美洲人活潑大方、歐洲人很有禮貌、美國人愛說笑話、亞洲人常常微笑；非洲人最會跳舞，誰都比不上他們！
lines.simplified: 文化日当天，华语文中心热闹极了，许多人都来看表演，连校长也亲自来参加，他站在学生当中，跟大家开心地照相。良介跳舞跳得好极了，大家都拍手叫好呢！表演结束后，良介去参观各国的摊子，不但喝了葡萄酒、吃了披萨，还穿上韩国的传统服装照相。良介也趁这个机会认识了五大洲的朋友，他觉得中美洲人活泼大方、欧洲人很有礼貌、美国人爱说笑话、亚洲人常常微笑；非洲人最会跳舞，谁都比不上他们！
lines.pinyin: Wénhuàrì dàngtiān, Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn rènào jí le, xǔduō rén dōu lái kàn biǎoyǎn, lián xiàozhǎng yě qīnzì lái cānjiā, tā zhàn zài xuésheng dāngzhōng, gēn dàjiā kāixīn de zhàoxiàng. Liángjiè tiào wǔ tiào de hǎo jí le, dàjiā dōu pāishǒu jiàohǎo ne! Biǎoyǎn jiéshù hòu, Liángjiè qù cānguān gè guó de tānzi, búdàn hē le pútáojiǔ, chī le pīsà, hái chuān shàng Hánguó de chuántǒng fúzhuāng zhàoxiàng. Liángjiè yě chèn zhège jīhuì rènshi le Wǔ Dàzhōu de péngyou, tā juéde Zhōng Měizhōu rén huópō dàfang, Ōuzhōu rén hěn yǒu lǐmào, Měiguó rén ài shuō xiàohua, Yàzhōu rén chángcháng wēixiào; Fēizhōu rén zuì huì tiàowǔ, shéi dōu bǐ bu shàng tāmen!
lines.english: On the World Culture Appreciation Day, the Center of Chinese Language and Culture was bustling with activities. Many people came to watch the performances, and even the President of the university came in person. He stood among students and happily took photos with everybody. Ryosuke danced very well. Everyone applauded and hoorayed. After the performance was finished, Ryosuke visited the stall of each country. He not only drank some grape wine and ate pizza, but also posed for photos in traditional Korean clothes. Ryosuke also took advantage of the opportunity to meet many friends from the five continents. He thought Central Americans are vigorous and generous, Europeans are very polite, Americans love joking, Asians smile very often, and Africans dance the best – nobody can compare with them!

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介在日本不曾參加過這類的活動，對他來說，這個世界文化日極有意義。除了讓他有機會表現自己，也讓他明白，來台灣不只是學習中文，每個國家、地區的民族都有自己的特色，都有值得學習的地方。只有多看、多聽、多學習，才會發現自己的問題，才有機會讓自己更進步。
lines.simplified: 良介在日本不曾参加过这类的活动，对他来说，这个世界文化日极有意义。除了让他有机会表现自己，也让他明白，来台湾不只是学习中文，每个国家、地区的民族都有自己的特色，都有值得学习的地方。只有多看、多听、多学习，才会发现自己的问题，才有机会让自己更进步。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè zài Rìběn bùcéng cānjiā guo zhè lèi de huódòng, duì tā lái shuō, zhège Shìjiè Wénhuàrì jí yǒu yìyì. Chúle ràng tā yǒu jīhuì biǎoxiàn zìjǐ, yě ràng tā míngbai, lái Táiwān bù zhǐ shì xuéxí Zhōngwén, měi ge guójiā, dìqū de mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèsè, dōu yǒu zhídé xuéxí de dìfang. Zhǐyǒu duō kàn, duō tīng, duō xuéxí, cái huì fāxiàn zìjǐ de wèntí, cái yǒu jīhuì ràng zìjǐ gèng jìnbù.
lines.english: Ryosuke never participated in such event in Japan. To him, this World Culture Appreciation Day was extremely meaningful. It gave him a chance to show himself and made him understand that coming to Taiwan is more than just learning Chinese. The ethnic groups from every country and region have their own characteristics and all are worth learning. The most important thing is that only by watching more, listening more and learning more can we find out our own problems and have the opportunity to make more progress.
